AI.result: 实验：在 SkillsBench checkout（87 个可运行任务、227 个任务本地技能包）中按难度分层抽取 7 个验证任务（hard: 3d-scan-calc、mars-clouds-clustering、video-tutorial-indexer；medium: citation-check、jax-computing-basics、pptx-reference-formatting；easy: offer-letter-generator）。对比 Raw-Skills、SkVM-Compiled Skills 与 no-skills 三组基线，三种智能体框架（内部 Agent-H、Codex、OpenCode）、四个模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Qwen3.6 35B A3B），统一走 OpenRouter，MacBook Pro 32GB，每条件重复 5 次取均值。总体结果（GPT-5.5）：SkillSmith 7/7 全通过，620K token、494 秒、61 次思考迭代；Raw-Skills 同样全通过但为 1.5M token、999 秒、107 次；SkVM 为 1.2M token、933 秒、75 次；no-skills 为 699K token、923.6 秒但仅解出 6/7。跨模型稳定性（产物均由 Claude Opus 4.7 编译后复用）：18 个可比单元平均耗时 −38.33%、token −32.83%、迭代 −23.89%；DeepSeek 上 SkillSmith 额外解出 Raw-Skills 失败的 offer-letter-generator、pptx-reference-formatting、video-tutorial-indexer；但也出现回归（Claude/PPTX、DeepSeek/JAX、Qwen 的 3D Scan 与 JAX 由 P 变 F），且 Qwen/3D Scan 与 Qwen/JAX 在部分任务上 token 反而上升，说明收益依赖运行时模型能力。框架稳定性：OpenCode token −55.8%/时间 −27.4%/迭代 −7.6%；Codex token −77.0%/时间 −52.7%（CLI 不暴露迭代数，故 N/A）；Agent-H token −57.4%/时间 −50.6%/迭代 −43.0%；token 降幅大于时间降幅，因工具执行耗时无法压缩。编译成本：9 个技能上，单个产物平均 3,104 token、13.22 秒；同模型 raw→compiled 的聚合求解 token 从 742K 降至 343K（−53.79%）、耗时 476→234 秒（−50.73%），编译开销可随重复调用摊销。
AI.conclusion: SkillSmith 将可复用的智能体技能从"反复解读的 SKILL.md 上下文"降低为只暴露算子、输入、策略、验证证据与回退路径的最小运行时接口，通过渐进披露与受控执行，在保持（部分情形提升）任务正确性的同时显著降低 token、延迟与推理轮数；其核心洞见是"边界契约"比统一工作流 IR 更适合作为异构自然语言技能的编译目标，从而实现技能理解的一次性离线化与跨模型复用。局限与风险：有效性依赖技能自身暴露稳定的过程、约束与资源，技能不完整/过时/环境错配会被编译产物继承；产物绑定当时的工具版本、文件格式、依赖与策略，环境变化需重新校验或重编译；不可约的外部工具执行、文件 I/O、媒体处理与任务特定判断仍留在运行时；评测仅覆盖 7 个任务、单一本地平台与特定模型组合，跨模型实验出现若干正确性回归，且 token 折算成本只是同 provider 路由下的单调代理而非独立定价研究。作者强调编译产物是"执行辅助"而非安全/正确性保证，建议配合沙箱执行、verifier 校验、溯源检查与人在环审核。

title: Mask-Morph Graph U-Net: A Generalisable Mesh-Based Surrogate for Crashworthiness Field Prediction under Large Geometric Variation
comment: 48 pages, 15 figures, jounral paper to be submitted
summary: Nonlinear finite element crash simulations are accurate but computationally expensive, limiting their use in iterative design optimisation. Machine-learning surrogate models based on graph neural networks (GNNs) offer a faster alternative. Message-passing GNNs are widely used for mesh simulation, and their shared node and edge update functions are relatively generalisable across varying graph structures. By contrast, non-shareable edge-specific aggregation layers can capture nonlinear relationships more accurately but usually require fixed graph connectivity, which limits generalisability. This paper presents Mask-Morph Graph U-Net (MMGUNet), a practical approach to addressing the limitation of hierarchical Graph U-Net architectures that use edge-specific downsampling and upsampling layers. Fixed coarse graph connectivity is required for edge-specific layers. To retain this while improving spatial correspondence, the proposed method morphs the coarsened graph hierarchy to each input mesh using feature-aligned barycentric parameterisation before constructing cross-graph edges. It further applies node masking during supervised pretraining, followed by parameter-efficient fine-tuning in which high-parameter edge-specific layers are frozen. The proposed approach is evaluated in in-distribution, out-of-distribution, and cross-component transfer settings using mean Euclidean distance and maximum intrusion percentage error. Results show that coarse-graph morphing improves test accuracy relative to a fixed-coarse-graph baseline, while masked supervised pretraining reduces the train-test discrepancy and improves data efficiency during transfer. The proposed model also achieves lower prediction error compared with external baselines. These results demonstrate a practical route toward reusable, data-efficient mesh-based surrogate modelling for crashworthiness design exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mask-Morph Graph U-Net (MMGUNet)，一种面向大几何变动的网格化碰撞耐受性场预测代理模型。其核心思路是：保留固定拓扑的粗化图层级以继续使用高容量、非共享的边专属（edge-specific）聚合层，同时用「特征对齐的重心坐标（barycentric）变形」把粗图层级变形到每个输入网格的形状后再构建细—粗跨图边；再配合「监督式掩码预训练 + 参数高效微调」（冻结边专属层与粗层 IG-MP，仅 0.18M/37.02M ≈0.48% 参数可训练）。在 6 个 B 柱算例 + 1 个 U 形通道算例上，MMGUNet 取得最低测试误差（MED 0.1261 mm / MIPE 0.3536%，B-pillar A3；U 通道 1.5177 mm / 2.4113%），并优于 MGN、MS-MGN、Multigrid 等外部基线；预训练迁移在全部 5 个 trial 上稳定降低误差（MED 最多降低 58.73%），50 样本微调即可超过 300 样本从零训练。
AI.motivation: 碰撞耐受性分析传统依赖非线性有限元（FE）仿真，虽准确但计算昂贵，难以嵌入迭代式设计优化流程；基于 GNN 的代理模型可显著提速，但存在一个关键矛盾：共享权重的消息传递（shared-weight MPNN，如 MGN）可跨拓扑泛化却容量有限；非共享的边专属多通道聚合（如 MAgNET）非线性逼近能力更强，但要求固定/拓扑一致的图连通性。前期工作 ReGUNet（层级 Graph U-Net + 固定粗图 + 边专属下/上采样）虽精度高，但其跨图边依靠空间近邻在「共享粗模板」与输入细网格间建立，当几何形状、尺度、复杂度变化大时，细节点会连到语义不匹配的非对应粗区域（如右上角节点连到 T 型接头区），造成部分节点孤立、跨层信息传递失效，从而牺牲泛化性与可迁移性。因此需要一个既保留固定粗拓扑以复用高容量边专属算子、又能随输入几何自适应对齐粗层级，并具备可迁移预训练策略的通用网格代理模型。
AI.method: 任务：单步终端位移场预测（固定载荷、边界、材料与接触条件，仅变几何），输入为细网格图，输出节点级 x/y/z 位移。特征：节点特征（1H 节点类型 + 到关键区距离 DTC）、边特征（相对位置向量 + 欧氏距离）。架构 MMGUNet：编码器与最细/最粗层的图内消息传递（IG-MP）使用共享权重 MLP；第一层下采样同样是拓扑无关的 MLP 层；更粗层使用边专属通道式下/上采样（DS-ES/US-ES，权重不可共享，容量高但参数多）；解码器用 MLP 输出位移。粗图层级来自软件生成的模板网格并被所有样本共享，以保证粗层连通性固定。关键新增——特征对齐的参数化变形（第 5 节）：对模板与目标壳网格分别做 Tutte 重心嵌入求解稀疏线性方程组得到共享 UV 域（内部节点为邻点重心平均的调和条件）；边界不采用通用圆盘，而是依据检测到的角点把边界环锚定到凸多边形（B 柱用八边形 8 锚点，U 通道用正方形 4 锚点），以消除相位歧义、稳定语义对应；随后在 UV 域内用重心插值把模板节点坐标映射到目标几何，得到形变后的模板坐标 x̃=Σλ_q x_q^tgt，并用 α∈[0,1] 插值可视化过渡过程；最后在形变后的粗图上用 k 近邻建立细—粗跨图边。训练策略：两阶段。第一阶段为监督式掩码预训练——随机掩蔽节点及其关联边（掩蔽沿第一层下采样传播到跨图边），但边界约束节点与冲击器接触区节点设为受保护集不掩蔽，损失仍在全部节点上计算（起正则化 + 降低每次迭代活跃节点/边数的作用）；第二阶段参数高效微调——冻结全部边专属 DS/US 层与粗层 IG-MP，仅训练编码器、第一层细 IG-MP 与 DS-MP（示例配置 37.02M 参数中仅 0.18M 可训）。超参：batch 4、lr 4e-4、细层隐通道 32 逐层翻倍至粗层 128、细层 2 步 / 粗层 15 步消息传递、MSE 损失；单算例等协议训练 2000 epoch（预训练 1000 + 微调 1000）。数据：VPS 求解非线性 FE，构造 7 个算例（B 柱 A1/A2/A3 约 1/3 尺度 3k 节点，A3 为 x,y,z 全向 morph；B 1/3 尺度 6k；C 2/3 尺度 7k；D 全尺度 8k；U 通道全尺度 5k，16 个 CAD 参数变化），B 柱每算例 300 训练/50 测试，U 通道 1000/200，训练测试集独立 LHS 采样；网格用 Blender 控制点 morph + HyperMesh 重新划分以产生不同拓扑。评估协议：single-case、all cases、all but target、transfer learning 四种训练策略，A–E 五个 trial（设计空间、形状/网格密度、尺度/复杂度 I 与 II、跨组件 U 通道）；指标为平均节点欧氏距离 MED 与最大侵入量百分比误差 MIPE。
AI.result: 消融：位置编码 1H+DTC 最优（A3 上 MED 0.1261、MIPE 0.3536），单独 LE 0.1563/0.5320，LE+1H+DTC 反而劣化（0.1348/0.4303，源于特征向量符号歧义与样本间谱序不稳定）；掩码比例 0–80% 扫描显示适度掩码有益，MED 在 20% 最优、MIPE 在 10% 最优，综合取 20%。基线对比（B-pillar A3，测试集，MED mm / MIPE %）：MGN 0.2114/0.6494、MS-MGN 0.1385/0.5243、Multigrid 0.1573/0.5499、GUNet-fix 0.2126/0.6195、MGUNet 0.1399/0.4398、MMGUNet 0.1261/0.3536；U 通道：MMGUNet 最优 1.5177/2.4113（GUNet-fix 1.7956/3.7589，Multigrid 2.1793/4.9226）。可以看出粗图变形（MGUNet vs GUNet-fix）带来显著增益，而掩码预训练+参数冻结进一步降低误差并收窄训练—测试差距。泛化/迁移：all-but-target 的直接 OOD 泛化在分布偏移大的 trial B–D 仍然困难，all-cases 与目标算例单独训练大体相当；迁移微调普遍更优或持平且训练更快。预训练相对从零训练的误差改善：Trial A MED −58.73%、MIPE −48.11%；B −48.86%/−47.85%；C −25.78%/−38.90%；D −16.37%/−22.17%；E（跨组件 B 柱→U 通道）−8.41%/−10.06%。数据效率：Trial A/B 中仅用 50 个目标样本微调即可优于从零训练使用 300 样本，且训练/测试误差分布更紧凑（箱线图与概率密度图）。
AI.conclusion: MMGUNet 提供了一条兼顾「固定粗拓扑下高容量边专属聚合」与「大几何变动下泛化性」的实用路径：粗图层级按输入几何做特征对齐的重心变形后构建跨图边，既保留可复用的边专属参数，又避免空间近邻导致的错误对应；配合监督式掩码预训练与参数高效微调，显著降低过拟合、缩小训练—测试差距并提升目标数据效率（最多降低约 59% 误差，50 样本即可超越 300 样本从零训练）。所有 trial 均观察到预训练的正向收益，但收益随迁移难度增加而递减（跨组件场景最小）。局限：仅预测固定载荷/材料/接触/边界下的终端位移（无时间演化）；变形方法依赖可检测的几何特征角点与跨构件族共享的粗图层级前提；对强偏移目标几何在无目标域微调时预测仍然困难。后续工作将扩展到时变碰撞响应、可变载荷与材料条件、更广泛的构件族与整车级装配，并嵌入面向车辆面板构件的设计优化平台。

title: ParamSpMM: Adaptive and Efficient Sparse Matrix-Matrix Multiplication on GPUs for GNNs
comment: Accepted by the 9th International Workshop on Graph Data Management and Analysis (GDMA 2025), held in conjunction with the 30th International Conference on Database Systems for Advanced Applications (DASFAA 2025). 15 pages, 6 figures
summary: Fueled by the ability to mine real-world graph data, GNN applications have experienced phenomenal growth. Sparse Matrix-Matrix Multiplication (SpMM) is a critical operator in GNNs. However, existing SpMM designs for GNNs struggle to adapt to diverse input characteristics. In this paper, we first conduct a comprehensive analysis of existing SpMM optimizations, revealing their limitations through statistical and empirical evidence. Based on this analysis, we introduce ParamSpMM, a parametric approach for highly adaptive and efficient SpMM computation in GNNs. It incorporates a new data structure, the Parameterized Compressed Sparse Row (PCSR), to flexibly integrate existing optimization techniques. ParamSpMM enables the configuration of these optimization techniques according to various input characteristics. Furthermore, we complement ParamSpMM with an ML-based SpMM-decider that predicts optimal configurations based on carefully crafted input features. Our evaluations demonstrate that ParamSpMM outperforms Nvidia cuSPARSE with an average speedup of 1.92x, significantly enhancing GNN training efficiency.

AI.tldr: 针对GNN中SpMM算子难以适应多样化输入特征的问题，提出了ParamSpMM参数化方法。该方法通过新数据结构PCSR灵活整合优化技术，并配合ML-decider根据输入特征自适应选择最优配置，实现平均1.92x加速。
AI.motivation: GNN应用快速增长，SpMM是其关键算子，但现有SpMM设计难以适应多样化的输入特征，限制了GNN的训练效率。
AI.method: 提出了参数化方法：1) 设计了新的数据结构PCSR (Parameterized Compressed Sparse Row) 以灵活整合现有优化技术；2) 开发了ML-based SpMM-decider，根据精心设计的输入特征预测最优配置，实现自适应优化。
AI.result: ParamSpMM相比Nvidia cuSPARSE平均加速1.92x，显著提升了GNN训练效率。
AI.conclusion: ParamSpMM在GNN训练中实现了显著的性能提升，平均加速1.92倍，超越了Nvidia cuSPARSE。

title: Jobs' AI Exposure Should Be Measured from Evidence, Not Model Priors
summary: This position paper argues that job exposure to AI should be measured with grounded, evidence-based methods, not inferred from LLM priors alone. Current theoretical exposure measures use zero-shot prompting to classify task-level AI exposure, generating labels with no explicit evidence, no transparent chain of reasoning, and no external validation. The stakes of these measurements are too high to rely on such methods, as they influence policy making, where public and private funds are directed, and how workers understand their future prospects. We therefore argue that AI capability claims should meet three standards: reproducibility, external grounding, and inspectability. We propose a retrieval-augmented framework that assigns AI exposure labels to all 18,796 occupation--task pairs in O*NET 30.2, using open-weight reasoning and instruct models with retrieved news articles and academic paper abstracts as evidence of current AI capabilities. Relative to a zero-shot baseline, the grounded condition is preferred in over 72\% of disagreement cases under both automatic and human evaluation, and yields scores that align more closely with observed real-world AI usage. Taken together, these findings suggest that evidence-grounded measurement better captures what current AI systems can plausibly do in practice, rather than what a model asserts without external evidence. Because AI capabilities continue to change, the measurements used to inform policy must evolve with them: theoretical AI exposure scores should be periodically reassessed, not inherited as immutable ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了当前AI暴露测量方法依赖零样本提示缺乏证据支撑的问题，主张采用基于检索增强的框架，为O*NET中的18,796个职业-任务对分配AI暴露标签，通过新闻文章和学术论文摘要为模型提供外部证据。实验表明，证据驱动的方法在72%以上的分歧案例中获得更优评价，且与实际AI使用情况更吻合。
AI.motivation: Current theoretical AI exposure measures rely on zero-shot prompting to classify task-level AI exposure without explicit evidence, transparent reasoning, or external validation. Given that these measurements influence policy, funding decisions, and workers' understanding of their future, the absence of grounded evidence is a critical methodological gap.
AI.method: Propose a retrieval-augmented framework that assigns AI exposure labels to all 18,796 occupation-task pairs in O*NET 30.2, using open-weight reasoning and instruct models with retrieved news articles and academic paper abstracts as evidence of current AI capabilities. Compare against zero-shot baseline.
AI.result: Grounded condition is preferred in over 72% of disagreement cases under both automatic and human evaluation, yielding scores that align more closely with observed real-world AI usage.
AI.conclusion: Evidence-grounded measurement should replace zero-shot prompting for AI exposure assessment; measurements must be periodically reassessed as AI capabilities evolve, not treated as immutable ground truth.

title: Inside Baseball: The Automated Ball-Strike System as an Object Lesson in Technological Rule Enforcement
summary: Clearly-defined rules are often assumed to be straightforward to automate and evaluate. We challenge this assumption through an in-depth study of Major League Baseball's (MLB) seven-year experimentation with the Automated Ball-Strike System (ABS). ABS is envisioned to call balls and strikes accurately: a seemingly straightforward use of technology to objectively determine the distance between a pitch and the strike zone. Although the strike zone is an area clearly defined in the rulebook, it took MLB seven years to figure out how to automate calling balls and strikes with ABS, showing how even seemingly straightforward rules require a complex translation process to operationalize via technological systems. In this paper, we trace the design decisions that led to the current implementation of ABS. Our case study reveals that "distance" exists even between a clear rule and its technological implementation. Using analytic frameworks from Science and Technology Studies (STS), we show that such distance exists because (1) historically, the "ground truth" of the strike zone is contested: the rule in practice has always reflected a hybrid between the rulebook definition and umpires' enforcement decisions; and (2) the use of ABS is embedded in an existing eco-system, where the implementation of a technological enforcement system needs to balance multiple stakeholder values. This perspective challenges conventional evaluation paradigms that center on the distance between a formalized rule and its technological implementation, and instead calls for evaluating how such systems are experienced in practice. Addressing this question requires in-depth social science approaches, contributing to ongoing conversations in FAccT about the implementation and evaluation of sociotechnical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过MLB的ABS系统七年实践案例，揭示即使明确定义的规则（如strike zone）在自动化过程中也面临复杂挑战。研究发现规则的技术实现与规则文本之间存在距离，这种距离源于strike zone的"ground truth"历史上存在争议（规则实践始终是规则定义与裁判执法的混合体），且技术系统嵌入在多方利益相关者的生态系统中。研究挑战了以规则与技术实现之间距离为中心的传统评估范式，呼吁采用深度社会科学方法评估技术在实践中的体验。
AI.motivation: MLB的ABS系统经过七年实验才实现自动化判罚，看似简单的"准确判断投球与好球带距离"任务却花了七年，挑战了"明确定义的规则易于自动化和评估"的假设
AI.method: 使用科学技术研究（STS）的分析框架追踪ABS的设计决策，揭示规则到技术实现之间存在距离的两个原因：（1）strike zone的"ground truth"历史上存在争议——规则在实践中始终是规则书定义与裁判执法决策的混合体；（2）ABS的使用嵌入在现有生态系统中，技术执法系统的实现需要平衡多方利益相关者的价值
AI.result: 揭示"明确定义的规则"与"技术实现"之间存在距离；该距离源于strike zone的历史争议性（规则实践 = 规则书定义 + 裁判执法决策的混合体）以及ABS嵌入多方利益相关者的生态系统
AI.conclusion: 挑战了以规则与技术实现之间"距离"为中心的传统评估范式，呼吁采用深度社会科学方法来评估技术在实践中的体验，贡献于FAccT（公平、问责与透明度）领域关于sociotechnical系统实施与评估的持续讨论

title: Gaussian Relational Graph Transformer
summary: Relational graph learning models relational databases as graphs and has demonstrated superior performance on a wide range of relational predictive tasks. However, existing methods struggle to capture long-range dependencies due to information decay in their message-passing mechanisms, and recent relational graph transformers remain limited in jointly modeling structural, semantic, and temporal information. In this paper, we propose GelGT, a Gaussian relational graph transformer that explicitly addresses these challenges. GelGT introduces a structure-semantic collaborative sampling strategy to preserve structural connectivity while filtering irrelevant semantic information, and incorporates a Gaussian graph attention mechanism with a learnable Gaussian bias on the sampled subgraphs to dynamically encode temporal dependencies. Extensive experiments on various real-world datasets demonstrate that GelGT achieves state-of-the-art downstream task performance, with up to a 13.8% improvement in predictive performance.

AI.tldr: GelGT是一种高斯关系图Transformer，通过结构-语义协作采样策略和可学习高斯偏差的注意力机制，解决现有关系图学习方法中信息衰减导致的长程依赖捕捉难题，以及结构、语义和时间信息联合建模不足的问题，在多个真实数据集上实现最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有关系图学习方法面临两大挑战：1) 信息衰减导致难以捕捉长程依赖；2) 现有关系图Transformer在联合建模结构、语义和时间信息方面存在局限性。这些问题限制了关系数据库预测任务的性能提升。
AI.method: GelGT提出两个核心机制：1) 结构-语义协作采样策略，在保持结构连通性的同时过滤无关语义信息；2) 高斯图注意力机制，在采样子图上引入可学习高斯偏差，动态编码时间依赖关系。
AI.result: 实验表明GelGT在多个真实数据集上达到最先进的下游任务性能，预测性能提升最高达13.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式融合结构、语义和时间信息，GelGT有效解决了关系图学习中长程依赖建模的难题，验证了所提采样策略和高斯注意力机制的有效性。

title: Greedy or not, here I come: Language production under vocabulary constraints in humans and resource-rational models
summary: Communicating using only a limited vocabulary is a common but challenging cognitive phenomenon, requiring an ideal communicator to plan carefully to optimize for intelligibility while circumventing a constrained lexicon. In this work, we investigate how humans respond to a broad array of questions under variable vocabulary limitations, consisting of only 250 highly frequent words at the most restrictive. We provide theoretically motivated comparisons to greedy and globally optimal sampling algorithms using Sequential Monte Carlo inference with large language models. Humans generally resemble greedy sampling more than globally optimal sampling, though more skilled humans are more likely to backtrack and revise -- a non-greedy behavior. An observed human pattern of leaning on semantically light words in high-constraint settings falls out of both greedy and globally optimal sampling. We discuss the results and their broader implications for resource-rational cognition, psycholinguistics, L2 communication, and language impairments.

AI.tldr: 在250至16000词的可变词汇限制下，144名人类被试与基于大模型的算法进行对比：人类的语言产出更接近"贪心采样"而非"全局最优（SMC/Awrs）采样"；但高技能被试表现出明显的回溯修改（一种非贪心行为）；高约束下人类与模型都更频繁使用 thing、do、people 等"语义轻"词。
AI.motivation: 语言产出是渐进的、需要规划的认知过程，而词汇受限的沟通常见（如L2学习者、少数语言群体、专家向 layperson 解释、aphasia 语言障碍）。已有研究不清楚词汇受限具体如何改变用词，以及何种算法层面的（Marr 1982）语言生成模型能刻画这一现象。新近的约束采样技术（如 Lipkin et al. 2025 的 AWRS）使得"贪心"与"近全局最优推断"之间的对比成为可检验的算法级假设，从而可对接资源理性（resource-rational）认知理论、心理学语言学与语言学习/语言障碍研究。
AI.method: 1) 词汇集：按 wordfreq 取英语最高频 N 词（250、4000、16000 等 7 档），并用 lemminflect/spaCy 纳入同词元（lemma）的所有变位形式。2) 问题集：192 个问题，分为 Why（48，取自 Sulik et al. 2023）、How（48）、ExplainSimple（48）、RedditELI5（48）四类。3) 人类实验：Prolific 招募 144 名英语母语者，每人 16 题（无约束、4000、1000、250 各阶段），界面仅允许输入词表内词、禁止选择替换、90 秒限时；记录全部击键与最终答案。4) 模型：用 GenLM-control 的 AWRS（Sequential Monte Carlo，权重粒子增量采样）对 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 做硬约束生成，粒子数 1 = 贪心，16/32 = SMC（Awrs-16/32）。5) 评分：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 作 LLM-as-judge 打 1–7 分并按 SMC 归一化权重计算加权期望；另做 norming 研究（64 题 × 24 名人类评分者，与 LLM 评分 Spearman ρ=0.60）验证该管线。6) 分析：分数随词汇量的函数、词频 rank 变化（bump plot）、以及以"有效词删除数"作为修订/规划指标，并按平均分后验二分高低技能组（Mann-Whitney U + Bonferroni）。
AI.result: (1) 人类与三种算法均表现出边际收益递减：词表每翻一倍，分数近似等量提升。(2) 人类得分在绝对值上低于模型（部分因人类回答更短），但随词汇收紧的下降轨迹与贪心算法几乎一致；AWRS 对约束更鲁棒，在 250 词时比"按人类/贪心同等退化率"预期高出约 0.5 分。(3) 词汇收紧系统性地提升"语义轻"实词（thing、do、people、way 等）的使用频率排名，而功能词（or、when 等）排名持平或下降；该模式在人类与所有模型（贪心与 SMC）中都出现。(4) 高技能被试（后验前 50%）在 1000 词与 250 词条件下显著更频繁地删除并重写已完成的词，表现出非贪心的规划/回溯特征；低技能组删除率随约束无变化。(5) 题目难度差异主要由可替代词与类比资源决定（如"如何做炸猪排"因无 pork 难以表达而低分，"安慰剂效应"因 feel、work 可用而高分），而非学科技术难度；How 类题目普遍偏低。
AI.conclusion: 人类的词汇受限生成位于资源理性权衡的"贪心端点"附近——低计算成本但高局部偏差（dead-end 风险）；高能力/高动机个体则通过增加修订投入来部分抵消贪心偏差，但其最终得分仍接近贪心模型。语义轻词的普遍上升是"可替代性"（substitutability）的结构性推论，而非主动贝叶斯推断的结果，因此模型无需显式规划即可复现。研究提示：预期仅学 250–1000 词的 L2 学习者应优先掌握通用型语义轻词；最常用的前几百至一千词具有不成比例的高沟通效用，可解释"Basic Variety"与高频词过度使用现象；对 aphasia 等语言障碍，模型化约束生成可帮助设计推断意图与辅助沟通技术。局限与展望：LLM-as-judge 只是不完美代理（绝对分可能有偏，关注趋势变化）；样本量与任务非自然（不能选择替换、限时）；未来可考察激励、面对面/结对互动、以及 L2 经验如何塑造"好的提议分布"（摊销计算假设）。

title: Hydra: Efficient, Correct Code Generation via Checkpoint-and-Rollback Support
summary:
Large language models are increasingly used for code generation, but many generated programs fail to compile, a prerequisite for further correctness checks such as unit tests. Existing solutions for repairing static errors are costly in both latency and token consumption. Post-hoc repair delays error detection until generation completes and commonly regenerates large regions of previously valid code. Constrained semantic decoding checks after each token, incurring per-token overhead while limiting repair to the current token even when the root cause lies earlier.
  We present Hydra, a system for efficient recovery from static errors during code generation. Hydra allows checking to proceed asynchronously with generation, avoiding checker overhead when the generated code is semantically correct. In addition, it provides checkpoint-and-rollback support for targeted repair, avoiding regeneration and rechecking of valid prefixes. We retrofit the Clang C/C++ compiler to support Hydra with modest modifications. Paired with a token-efficient repair strategy, Hydra reduces latency by up to 71% and token consumption by up to 70% relative to post-hoc repair on C/C++ code generation tasks that encounter static errors.

AI.tldr: Hydra是一个在代码生成过程中高效恢复静态错误的系统，通过异步检查消除语义正确代码的开销，通过检查点回滚避免重生成有效前缀，配合令牌高效的修复策略，在C/C++代码生成任务中相比事后修复方法实现了最多71%的延迟降低和最多70%的令牌消耗降低。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型生成的代码经常无法编译，现有的静态错误修复方案存在高延迟和高令牌消耗的问题。事后修复需延迟到生成完成且常需重生成大量有效代码；约束性语义解码虽逐令牌检查但每个令牌都有开销，且修复仅限于当前令牌，无法定位更早的根本原因。
AI.method: 对Clang C/C++编译器进行适度改造以支持Hydra，并设计了令牌高效（token-efficient）的修复策略。
AI.result: Hydra实现了异步检查机制（避免语义正确代码的检查开销）和检查点回滚支持（避免有效前缀的重新生成和重新检查），并通过令牌高效的修复策略，在静态错误场景下显著降低了延迟和令牌消耗。
AI.conclusion: Hydra通过异步检查和检查点回滚机制，配合高效的修复策略，在C/C++代码生成任务中，相比事后修复方法，延迟降低最多71%，令牌消耗降低最多70%。

title: Fair outputs, Biased Internals: Causal Potency and Asymmetry of Latent Bias in LLMs for High-Stakes Decisions
summary: Instruction-tuned language models exhibit behavioural fairness in high-stakes decisions while retaining biased associations in their internal representations. However, whether these suppressed representations can affect model outputs - and whether such causal potency is symmetric across demographic groups - remains unknown. We investigate the use of open-weight models for mortgage underwriting using matched applications that differ only in racially-associated names and reveal a critical disconnect: models show no output-level bias, yet retain and amplify demographic representations across model layers. Through activation steering and novel cross-layer interventions, we demonstrate that this suppressed information is decision-relevant: when reinjected at critical layers, it produces near-complete decision reversals. Critically, this latent bias is asymmetric - steering interventions affect decisions in one demographic direction, while producing minimal effects in reverse - and susceptible to adversarial prompt engineering and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These findings demonstrate that behavioural audits focused on outputs are insufficient: fair outputs can mask exploitable internal biases. They also motivate dual-layer testing frameworks combining output evaluation with representational analysis for AI governance in high-stakes decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型在抵押贷款审批中输出层面无偏见，但内部表征保留了种族信息且可被激活转向技术操控，产生不对称偏见效应，表明仅依赖输出审计不足以保障AI公平性。
AI.motivation: 指令微调语言模型在输出层面表现出公平性，但在内部表征中保留并放大了人口统计信息，且这种隐性偏差在不同人口群体间呈现不对称性。
AI.method: 使用仅在种族相关姓名上有差异的匹配抵押贷款申请，对开源权重模型进行测试；通过激活转向（activation steering）和跨层干预技术实验。
AI.result: 模型输出无明显偏见，但在各层保留并放大了人口统计表征；关键层重新注入隐藏表征信息可产生近乎完全的决策逆转；隐性偏见呈现不对称性——转向干预只影响单一方向的决策；且易受对抗性提示工程和参数高效微调影响。
AI.conclusion: 行为审计不足以检测AI公平性问题，需要结合输出评估与表征分析的"双层测试框架"用于AI治理。

title: MuteBench: Modality Unavailability Tolerance Evaluation for Incomplete Multimodal Fusion
summary: Multimodal physiological data powers clinical AI systems from intensive care units to wearable devices, but sensors routinely fail in practice. Two failure modes are common: modality missing, where an entire channel is absent, and within-modality missing, where a contiguous time segment is lost. No existing benchmark evaluates multiple fusion architectures under both failure modes at controlled severity levels across diverse clinical datasets. We present MuteBench, a benchmark covering 9 datasets from 7 clinical domains, 6 fusion architectures, and 2 missing-data modes over 125,000 samples. Through this benchmark, we find that architecture family is the strongest predictor of robustness, outweighing parameter count. Channel-independent models tolerate modality missing well but can be sensitive to within-modality missing, especially on short sequences. Curriculum modality dropout protects reliably only up to the maximum dropout rate used in training. We also find that channel count, sequence length, and modality alignment jointly determine which failure mode poses the greater threat. Finally, a PTB-XL case study suggests that diffusion-based imputation can improve downstream classification under within-modality missing, with the largest gains for models whose expert routing is most sensitive to corrupted inputs, though broader validation across datasets remains an open direction. MuteBench provides practitioners with concrete guidance for both selecting existing architectures and informing the design of future robust multimodal fusion methods.

AI.tldr: MuteBench是一个用于评估多模态临床AI系统在两种数据缺失模式下（模态缺失和模态内缺失）鲁棒性的基准测试平台，覆盖9个数据集、6种融合架构、12.5万样本。研究发现架构家族是鲁棒性的最强预测因素，通道独立模型对模态缺失容忍度高但对模态内缺失敏感，课程模态dropout的保护作用受限于训练时的最大dropout率，且扩散插补可改善模态内缺失下的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 临床AI系统中多模态生理数据传感器频繁失效，但现有基准无法系统评估多种融合架构在受控缺失严重度下的表现。需要一个全面评估框架来指导临床环境中多模态融合方法的鲁棒性设计与选择。
AI.method: 构建MuteBench基准平台，覆盖9个临床数据集、6种融合架构、2种缺失数据模式（共125,000样本），并在PTB-XL数据集上验证扩散插补对下游分类的效果。
AI.result: ①架构家族是鲁棒性的最强预测因素，优于参数量；②通道独立模型对模态缺失容忍度高，但对短序列的模态内缺失敏感；③课程模态dropout仅在训练最大dropout率范围内提供可靠保护；④通道数、序列长度和模态对齐共同决定哪种缺失模式威胁更大；⑤扩散插补可改善模态内缺失下的分类性能，对专家路由敏感的模型增益最大。
AI.conclusion: MuteBench为从业者提供了选择现有架构和设计未来鲁棒多模态融合方法的明确指导，强调架构家族选择优先于参数规模，且针对特定缺失模式需要定制化的融合策略。

title: Scale: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Container Scheduling in Serverless Edge Computing
summary: Serverless computing has emerged as a promising computing paradigm for edge computing. However, adopting the event driven model in highly dynamic, heterogeneous, and distributed edge systems poses significant challenges in request placement and resource management. Efficiently allocating requests to containers is therefore critical to reduce resource over provisioning and unnecessary data movement. This paper proposes Scale, a Service Level Objective aware container scheduling and resource allocation framework designed for serverless edge computing. Scale employs a policy based deep reinforcement learning algorithm to balance system stability and performance under dynamic workloads. The design jointly incorporates SLO constraints, end to end latency, and data locality into the scheduling decision process. Extensive simulations using large scale real world datasets from Huawei Cloud demonstrate that Scale achieves solutions within a factor of 1.11 to 1.15 of a state of the art Integer Linear Programming solver, while reducing decision making time by up to 99%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scale框架——一种面向无服务器边缘计算的SLO感知容器调度与资源分配框架，采用策略驱动的深度强化学习算法，综合考虑SLO约束、延迟和数据局部性，在保持接近最优解的同时实现毫秒级调度决策。
AI.motivation: 无服务器计算(Serverless)虽为边缘计算带来前景，但事件驱动模型在高度动态、异构、分布式的边缘系统中面临请求放置和资源管理的重大挑战，需要减少资源过度配置和不必要的数据移动。
AI.method: 采用基于策略的深度强化学习(DRL)算法，将SLO约束、端到端延迟和数据局部性联合纳入调度决策过程，实现稳定性与性能的平衡。
AI.result: Scale在华为云大规模真实数据集上验证，效果达到最优整数线性规划(ILP)求解器的1.11~1.15倍，同时决策时间减少达99%，实现了接近最优解与毫秒级响应的兼顾。
AI.conclusion: Scale通过结合DRL和传统优化的混合方法，在华为云大规模真实数据集上验证了其有效性。该框架在保持接近最优解的同时，将决策时间缩短至毫秒级（降低99%），具备显著的实用价值。

title: Generative Long-term User Interest Modeling for Click-Through Rate Prediction
summary: Modeling long-term user interests with massive historical user behaviors enhances click-through rate (CTR) prediction performance in advertising and recommendation systems. Typically, a two-stage framework is widely adopted, where a general search unit (GSU) first retrieves top-$k$ relevant behaviors towards the target item, and an exact search unit (ESU) generates interest features via tailored attention. However, current target-centered GSU would ignore other latent user interests, leading to incomplete and biased interest features. Additionally, the matching-based retrieval process in GSUs depends on the pairwise similarity score between target item and each historical behavior, which not only becomes time-consuming for online services as user behaviors continue to grow, but also overlooks the interaction information among user behaviors. To combat these problems, we propose a \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{L}ong-term user \textbf{I}nterest model named GenLI for CTR prediction. GenLI consists of an interest generation module (IGM), a behavior retrieval module (BRM), and an interest fusion module (IFM). The IGM generates multiple interest distributions to indicate different aspects of real-time user interests, which is target-independent and incorporates interaction information among behaviors, ensuring complete and diverse interest features. The BRM selects related behaviors via a simple lookup operation, reducing the time complexity for weighting each behavior to $O(1)$. Finally, the IFM uses delicate gating mechanisms to generate interest features. Based on the generation process, GenLI improves the diversity of user interests and avoids complex matching-based behavioral retrieval, achieving a better balance between accuracy and efficiency for CTR prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenLI模型，用于CTR预测中的长期用户兴趣建模。通过兴趣生成模块、行为检索模块和兴趣融合模块三个组件，解决现有两阶段框架中以目标为中心检索的偏差问题和基于匹配检索的效率问题，实现准确性-效率的平衡优化。
AI.motivation: 现有两阶段框架(GSU+ESU)的两个核心问题：1) 以目标为中心的GSU会忽略其他潜在用户兴趣，导致兴趣特征不完整和有偏；2) 基于匹配的行为检索依赖目标与历史行为的成对相似度评分，随着用户行为增长计算耗时且忽略行为间的交互信息。
AI.method: 提出三模块架构：兴趣生成模块(IGM)生成多个目标无关的兴趣分布；行为检索模块(BRM)通过简单查找操作选择相关行为，时间复杂度降至O(1)；兴趣融合模块(IFM)利用门控机制生成兴趣特征。
AI.result: GenLI提高了用户兴趣的多样性，避免了复杂的基于匹配的行为检索，在CTR预测的准确性和效率之间实现了更好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: GenLI通过生成式方法改进了用户兴趣建模，在准确性和效率之间取得了更好的平衡。

title: TeamTR: Trust-Region Fine-Tuning for Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems have shown promise for complex reasoning, yet recent evaluations reveal they often underperform single-model baselines. We identify a structural failure mode in sequential fine-tuning of shared-context teams: updating one agent shifts the team's context distribution, and when subsequent updates are evaluated on cached rollouts, this mismatch compounds. We formalize this as the compounding occupancy shift and prove that stale-occupancy evaluation incurs a penalty that scales quadratically with the number of agents. In contrast, intermediate-occupancy evaluation reduces this to linear scaling. We propose TeamTR, a trust-region framework that resamples trajectories after each component update and enforces per-agent divergence control, yielding rigorous per-update and per-stage improvement lower bounds. Experiments show that TeamTR outperforms single-agent and sequential baselines with 7.1% on average, mitigates coordination regressions, and supports plug-and-play component replacement. Code is available at https://github.com/Yydc/TeamTR.

AI.tldr: This paper identifies and formalizes the "compounding occupancy shift" problem in sequential fine-tuning of multi-agent LLM systems, where context distribution mismatch compounds across agent updates. The proposed TeamTR framework uses trust-region optimization with trajectory resampling to achieve linear (vs. quadratic) penalty scaling and provides rigorous improvement guarantees.
AI.motivation: Multi-agent LLM systems often underperform single-model baselines despite showing promise for complex reasoning. A structural failure mode exists in sequential fine-tuning where updating one agent shifts the team's context distribution, and evaluating on cached rollouts causes compounding mismatch.
AI.method: Propose TeamTR, a trust-region framework that resamples trajectories after each component update and enforces per-agent divergence control, reducing compounding occupancy shift penalty from quadratic to linear scaling.
AI.result: TeamTR outperforms single-agent and sequential baselines with 7.1% on average, mitigates coordination regressions, and supports plug-and-play component replacement.
AI.conclusion: TeamTR provides rigorous per-update and per-stage improvement lower bounds, outperforming baselines by 7.1% on average while mitigating coordination regressions and supporting plug-and-play component replacement.

title: AI-Mediated Communication Can Steer Collective Opinion
summary: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into the online platforms where humans exchange opinions; large language models (LLMs) now polish users' posts on LinkedIn and provide context for content shared on X. While prior work has shown that AI can express biased opinions and shape individuals' opinions during human-AI interactions, less attention has been paid to its influence on collective opinion formation when mediating human-to-human communication. We address this gap via a combination of empirical and theoretical analyses. We show empirically that LLMs from multiple popular families introduce directional biases when instructed to edit human-written texts on contested topics, for example, nudging texts in favor of gun control and against atheism. Building on this observation, we introduce a mathematical model of opinion dynamics in which an AI system sits between users on a social network, transforming the opinions they express and perceive. By analytically characterizing the equilibrium of this model and performing simulations on real social network data, we show that biases introduced by AI in human-to-human communication can be amplified through the network and shift collective opinion in their direction. In light of these findings, we investigate whether such biases are controllable by online platforms. We audit the "Explain this post" feature on X and find evidence of pro-life bias in Grok's outputs on abortion-related content, which we trace back to specific design choices. We conclude with a discussion of the broader implications of our findings in relation to ongoing legislative efforts in the European Union.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates how generative AI biases — when embedded as mediators in human-to-human online communication — propagate through social networks and influence collective opinion. Using empirical audits, theoretical modeling, and platform-level investigations, the authors demonstrate that LLMs introduce directional biases that can amplify through networks, and call for regulatory attention (e.g., EU frameworks) to govern AI's role as an intermediary in public discourse.
AI.motivation: While prior research established that AI can express biased opinions and shape individual opinions in direct human-AI interaction, the influence of AI mediators on collective opinion formation during human-to-human communication remains underexplored — despite the growing integration of LLMs into online platforms that mediate social discourse.
AI.method: Three-pronged approach: (1) Empirical auditing of LLMs (multiple popular families) for directional biases when instructed to edit human-written texts on contested topics (gun control, atheism, abortion); (2) Mathematical modeling of opinion dynamics with AI-mediated communication on social networks, analytically characterized at equilibrium; (3) Simulation on real social network data and platform feature auditing ("Explain this post" on X/Grok).
AI.result: LLMs across popular families introduce consistent directional biases when editing texts on contested topics (e.g., nudging toward gun control, against atheism). These biases can amplify through social networks and shift collective opinion equilibria. Platform auditing revealed Grok's "Explain this post" feature exhibits pro-life bias on abortion content, traceable to specific design choices.
AI.conclusion: AI biases in human-to-human communication can amplify through social networks and shift collective opinion. Platform-level interventions (auditing tools like X's "Explain this post") can partially detect these biases, but systemic regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU legislation) are needed to address this emerging societal risk.

title: A Generative AI Framework for Intelligent Utility Billing CO 2 Analytics and Sustainable Resource Optimisation
summary: Distribution utilities are now expected to deliver bills that customers can actually read attach a defensible carbon number to every kWh sold and schedule load against grid stress and emissions constraints We propose an end-to-end framework that unifies four production-grade capabilities under one architectural roof a generative-AI agent that drafts each customers natural-language billing statement from structured numeric inputs under a constrained decoding policy a transformer-based forecaster that supplies the day-ahead consumption estimate with calibrated quantile bands

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端框架，在单一架构下统一配电公司（distribution utility）的四项生产能力：(1) 受约束解码策略下的生成式AI代理，将结构化数值输入转写为客户可读的自然语言账单；(2) 基于Transformer的预测器，输出带校准分位数区间的日前用电量估计；(3) 逐kWh碳强度核算，为每笔售电量附加可辩护的碳排数字；(4) 在电网压力与排放约束下进行负荷调度。原文提供的片段仅完整覆盖前两项能力，后两项在摘要中被截断，实验结果与量化指标未在所给内容中披露。
AI.motivation: 配电企业当前面临三重压力：一是账单可读性不足，客户难以理解复杂计费结构；二是需要为每千瓦时售电附加一个可审计、可辩护的碳排放数字，以满足脱碳核算与合规要求；三是需要在电网紧张与排放强度高的时段主动引导负荷调度，以降低峰值压力与运营排放。现有方案多为孤立的、逐点定制的AI工具，缺乏统一架构，难以保证从预测到账单、再到调度的数据一致性与端到端可验证性，因此需要一个把"数值—生成—碳核算—调度"串成闭环的端到端生产级框架。
AI.method: 统一架构以"结构化数值输入"为单一事实来源：Transformer预测器以历史与外生特征为输入，输出日前用电量的点估计及经校准的分位数带（quantile bands），以量化不确定性并保证覆盖率；生成式AI代理在该预测与计费结构化字段之上进行受约束解码（constrained decoding policy），即解码过程受事实性/模板/数值一致性约束，从而将数值字段忠实转写为自然语言账单，避免幻觉与数值漂移；同一数值流被复用于逐kWh碳强度核算模块，形成可追溯的碳数字；在调度模块中，负荷计划以预测分位数带与碳强度、电网压力/排放约束共同作为优化条件，实现风险感知的负荷与购电安排。四项能力共享同一数据契约与模型服务层，以保障生产环境的可部署性、审计与可辩护性。
AI.result: 所提供文本为被截断的摘要，仅陈述了框架的架构主张与四项能力中的两项（账单生成代理与带校准分位区间的日前预测器），未给出定量实验结果、基准对比、数据集规模或系统上线指标（如分位数覆盖率、事实一致性率、峰值削减或碳减排幅度等）。因此本文的实证有效性在现有材料下无法评估。
AI.conclusion: 结论方向为：把"可读账单—可辩护碳数字—电网/排放约束下的负荷调度"四类原本割裂的能力整合到统一架构下，可提升配电企业的运营效率、合规性与脱碳决策能力，并使从预测到账单再到调度的全链路保持数值一致性与可审计性。需注意，所给内容不完整：摘要后半部分（四项能力中的其余两项的细节、实验设置、量化结果与结论陈述）缺失，故无法就该框架的实际性能与结论给出有依据的判断，建议获取arXiv全文后再评估其创新性与实证强度。

title: Adesua: Development and Feasibility Study of an AI WhatsApp Bot for Science Learning in West Africa
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Sub-Saharan Africa faces persistently high student-teacher ratios and shortages of qualified teachers, limiting students' access to personalized learning support and formative assessment. To address this challenge, we present Adesua, a WhatsApp-based AI Teaching Assistant for science education that extends the Kwame for Science platform. Adesua leverages WhatsApp's widespread adoption in Africa to provide accessible, curriculum-aligned learning support for Junior High School (JHS) and Senior High School (SHS) students across West Africa. The system integrates curated textbooks and 33 years of national examination questions with generative AI to enable conversational question answering and automated assessment with feedback via a WhatsApp bot. Students can ask science questions, take timed or untimed multiple-choice tests by topic or exam year, and receive instant grading and detailed explanations of correct and incorrect responses. A 6-month feasibility deployment in 2025 had 56 active users in Ghana, including students and parents. Quantitative evaluation showed a high perceived usefulness, with a helpfulness score of 93.75\% for AI-generated answers, albeit with a small number of ratings (n=16). These preliminary results provide a basis for more extensive future evaluation of a WhatsApp-based AI assistant to assess its potential to offer scalable, low-cost personalized learning support and formative assessment in resource-constrained educational contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Adesua，一个基于WhatsApp的人工智能教学助手，旨在解决撒哈拉以南非洲地区师资短缺导致学生难以获得个性化学习支持的问题。该系统整合教材和33年国家考试数据，通过生成式AI为加纳中学生提供科学问答和自动评估服务。初步部署结果显示用户对AI回答的帮助性评分高达93.75%，但样本量较小。
AI.motivation: Sub-Saharan Africa faces persistently high student-teacher ratios and shortages of qualified teachers, which limits students' access to personalized learning support and formative assessment in science education.
AI.method: Adesua was developed as a WhatsApp-based AI Teaching Assistant extending the Kwame for Science platform, integrating curated textbooks and 33 years of national examination questions with generative AI. The system provides conversational question answering, timed/untimed multiple-choice assessments by topic or exam year, and automated grading with detailed feedback through a WhatsApp bot interface.
AI.result: A 6-month feasibility deployment in Ghana had 56 active users (students and parents). Quantitative evaluation showed high perceived usefulness with a helpfulness score of 93.75% for AI-generated answers, though the sample size for ratings was small (n=16).
AI.conclusion: Preliminary results demonstrate the potential of WhatsApp-based AI assistants to offer scalable, low-cost personalized learning support and formative assessment in resource-constrained educational contexts in Sub-Saharan Africa.

title: Assistance to Autonomy: A Systematic Literature Review of Agentic AI across the Software Development Life Cycle
summary: Agentic AI in software product development is increasingly adopted by organizations, yet the field lacks a consolidated synthesis of where adoption is mature, which architectural patterns dominate, and what limitations and coping mechanisms exist in industrial deployments. This systematic literature review addresses these gaps by establishing a body of knowledge as a starting point. Following Kitchenham guidelines, we queried four major research databases, obtaining over 1600 candidate publications. To handle this volume, we developed and validated a domain-agnostic multi-agent screening pipeline that extends prior LLM-assisted review tools by combining automatic metadata curation, inter-agent iterative dialogue, and conflict-resolution defaults that minimize false negatives. From the 92 manually verified primary studies, our thematic synthesis reveals that output verifiability is the primary enabler of agentic adoption: later SDLC phases, whose outputs are objectively evaluable through executable feedback, demonstrate the highest maturity and industrial presence, while earlier phases remain almost exclusively academic proofs-of-concept. We identify the Planner-Executor-Reviewer role specialization as the dominant architectural pattern, with the Reviewer agent implementing verifiability through executable feedback loops. Across all challenge categories, industrial mitigation strategies converge on confining agent actions to verifiable, bounded spaces. This study contributes a comprehensive characterization of the current literature on agentic systems in software product development, and a methodological contribution in the form of an AI-assisted tool to automate the screening phase in high-volume SLR domains.

AI.tldr: This systematic review of 92 studies on agentic AI in software development reveals that output verifiability—particularly through executable feedback—is the key factor determining adoption maturity. Later SDLC phases and the Planner-Executor-Reviewer architectural pattern dominate industrial deployments, while mitigation strategies universally involve bounding agent actions to verifiable spaces.
AI.motivation: Agentic AI adoption in software product development lacks consolidated synthesis; no clear understanding of adoption maturity by SDLC phase, dominant architectural patterns, or industrial limitations and coping mechanisms.
AI.method: Systematic literature review following Kitchenham guidelines; queried 4 major databases yielding 1600+ publications; developed and validated a domain-agnostic multi-agent screening pipeline with automatic metadata curation, inter-agent iterative dialogue, and conflict-resolution defaults; manual verification of 92 primary studies; thematic synthesis conducted.
AI.result: Output verifiability is the primary enabler of agentic adoption; later SDLC phases with objectively evaluable outputs show highest maturity and industrial presence; earlier phases remain predominantly academic proofs-of-concept. The Planner-Executor-Reviewer role specialization is the dominant architectural pattern, with the Reviewer agent implementing verifiability through executable feedback loops.
AI.conclusion: Agentic AI adoption in software development is bottlenecked by output verifiability—phases with objective evaluation (e.g., testing, deployment) show high industrial maturity, while earlier phases remain academic. The Planner-Executor-Reviewer pattern with executable feedback loops is the dominant architecture. Industrial solutions converge on confining agents to verifiable, bounded action spaces. The study also contributes a validated multi-agent screening pipeline for high-volume SLRs.

title: CAX-Agent: A Lightweight Agent Harness for Reliable APDL Automation
summary: Large language models deployed for MAPDL finite-element simulation face practical reliability challenges: without structured execution control, tool encapsulation, and fault recovery, outputs may be inconsistent and task failures are common. The Agent Harness paradigm addresses this by inserting domain-specific orchestration middleware that manages tool lifecycles, workflow state, and recovery escalation. This paper presents the architecture of CAX-Agent, a lightweight agent harness purpose-built for MAPDL automation, and empirically evaluates one of its core components -- the recovery policy.CAX-Agent organizes execution into three layers -- LLM service, agent harness, and solver backend -- with a recovery ladder that escalates from deterministic rule patching through model-driven regeneration to context enrichment and human intervention. We evaluate three recovery strategies (no_recovery, rule_only, and model_only) on 50 standard structural benchmarks with three repeated runs per strategy (450 case-runs total). Two independent human raters score task completion under blind conditions; inter-rater agreement is strong (quadratic weighted Cohen's kappa = 0.84, 96 percent of score pairs within one point). Model_only achieves the best completion rate (0.9267), task score (3.59/4), total score (9.16/10), and zero-intervention rate (0.84), outperforming rule_only (0.7733, 3.17/4, 7.03/10, 0.00) and no_recovery (0.6933, 2.74/4, 5.60/10, 0.00) with large effect sizes (Cliff's delta = 0.81-0.87). The benchmark uses deliberately simple geometries to isolate recovery-policy effects; we discuss the scope of these findings and directions for broader validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用于MAPDL自动化的CAX-Agent智能体框架，重点评估其恢复策略组件。实验表明基于模型的恢复策略表现最佳，任务完成率达92.67%，显著优于规则驱动和无恢复策略。
AI.motivation: LLM在MAPDL有限元仿真中面临可靠性问题：缺乏结构化执行控制、工具封装和故障恢复机制，导致输出不一致和任务失败率较高。
AI.method: 提出CAX-Agent三层架构（LLM服务层、Agent工具层、求解器后端层），设计四级恢复阶梯（确定性规则修补→模型驱动重生成→上下文增强→人工介入）；在50个标准结构基准测试上评估三种恢复策略，每种策略重复3次运行；采用双盲独立评分，验证评分者一致性（κ=0.84）。
AI.result: model_only策略在所有指标上优于其他策略：任务完成率92.67%、任务评分3.59/4、总评分9.16/10、零干预率84%；相比rule_only和no_recovery具有显著优势（Cliff's delta效应量0.81-0.87）。
AI.conclusion: CAX-Agent框架采用分层架构实现MAPDL自动化中的故障恢复，实验验证了model_only策略的有效性。研究局限性在于基准测试使用简化几何体，结论的普适性需进一步验证，未来工作应扩展到更复杂的工程场景。

title: Reducing the Safety Tax in LLM Safety Alignment with On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Safety alignment often improves robustness to harmful queries at the cost of reasoning ability, a tradeoff known as the safety tax. A common cause is distributional mismatch: supervised fine-tuning trains the target model on safety demonstrations produced by humans, external models, or fixed self-generated traces, rather than on trajectories sampled from its own policy. We identify off-policy training mismatch as a second source of this tax and study on-policy self-distillation for safety alignment, which we call OPSA. The model generates its own rollouts and receives dense per-token KL supervision from a frozen teacher copy of itself conditioned on a privileged safety context. Because this teacher must be safer than the sampled student trajectory, we introduce \emph{teacher flip rate}: a criterion that measures how often a privileged context converts unsafe responses into safe ones. We use this signal to search for contexts that activate latent safety reasoning rather than merely elicit safe-looking demonstrations. Across two reasoning-model families and five model scales, OPSA achieves a stronger safety--reasoning tradeoff than off-policy self-distillation and external-teacher distillation under matched data and full-parameter fine-tuning, with the largest gains on smaller models (+8.85 points on R1-Distill-1.5B and +5.49 points on Qwen3-0.6B). The gains persist across training-set sizes and adaptive jailbreak evaluations. Token-level analyses further show that OPSA concentrates updates near early compliance-decision tokens, providing a mechanism for improving safety while preserving general reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPSA方法，通过同策略自蒸馏解决安全对齐中的"安全税"问题，利用教师翻转率筛选特权上下文以激活深层安全推理，在小型模型上取得显著效果提升。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐通常以牺牲推理能力为代价（安全税问题）。现有方法存在两类分布不匹配：(1) 监督微调使用外部或固定轨迹而非自身策略采样；(2) 离策略训练也存在类似问题。
AI.method: OPSA采用同策略自蒸馏方法：模型基于特权安全上下文生成自己的rollout，并从冻结的教师模型（基于安全上下文条件）获得密集的逐token KL散度监督。同时引入"教师翻转率"作为选择特权上下文的指标，以激活潜在安全推理能力而非仅产生表面安全的响应。
AI.result: OPSA在两个推理模型家族和五种模型规模上，均优于离策略自蒸馏和外部教师蒸馏。在匹配数据和全参数微调条件下，小型模型提升最大（R1-Distill-1.5B提升8.85分，Qwen3-0.6B提升5.49分）。Token级分析显示，OPSA主要在早期合规决策token附近集中更新，从而在提升安全性的同时保持通用推理能力。
AI.conclusion: OPSA通过自知识蒸馏框架，在保持推理能力的同时显著提升安全对齐效果，尤其对小型模型效果显著（+8.85和+5.49点提升），且在对抗性攻击下表现鲁棒。

title: ADAPT: A Self-Calibrating Proactive Autoscaler for Container Orchestration
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Includes reproducible simulation framework for proactive Kubernetes autoscaling with adaptive cold-start estimation and MPC-based scaling. Source code and experiment configurations available at: https://github.com/Himanshu21035/autoscaling_research
summary: Proactive autoscaling for containerized workloads depends on knowing the provisioning delay, i.e., the time between a scaling decision and the moment new capacity is ready to serve traffic. In practice, this cold-start duration can vary substantially across environments and even across consecutive scale-out events. We present ADAPT (Adaptive Duration Approximation for Predictive Timing), an online EWMA estimator that tracks coldstart duration at runtime. ADAPT feeds a dynamic planning horizon, FH-OPT, into a Model Predictive Controller (MPC) that optimizes replica counts over a rolling window. Together, these components form a closed-loop proactive autoscaling design that adapts its lookahead based on measured provisioning delay. Evaluated across three policies (MPC+LSTM, MPC+Prophet, HPA) and six workload archetypes with five random seeds, MPC+LSTM achieves below 5% SLA violation on all workloads, compared with 7-19% for reactive HPA and up to 28.7% for MPC+Prophet on bimodal traffic.

AI.tldr: ADAPT是一种自适应冷启动时长预测的主动容器伸缩系统，通过EWMA在线估计和MPC动态规划视野调整，在多场景测试中实现了优于反应式方案和Prophet模型的SLA保障。
AI.motivation: 主动伸缩依赖于准确预估配置延迟（冷启动时长），但该延迟在实际环境中存在显著差异，既可能在不同环境中不同，也可能在连续扩容事件中波动。
AI.method: ADAPT采用在线EWMA估计器实时追踪冷启动时长，并将动态规划视野（FH-OPT）输入模型预测控制器（MPC）以优化滚动窗口内的副本数，形成闭环主动伸缩系统。
AI.result: MPC+LSTM在6种工作负载类型、5个随机种子测试下，所有工作负载均实现低于5%的SLA违规；相比之下，反应式HPA违规率为7-19%，MPC+Prophet在双峰流量下高达28.7%。
AI.conclusion: ADAPT通过实时测量提供延迟，实现了闭环主动伸缩设计，MPC+LSTM在所有工作负载上实现低于5%的SLA违规，显著优于反应式HPA（7-19%）和MPC+Prophet（高达28.7%）。

title: ICRL: Learning to Internalize Self-Critique with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language model-based agents make mistakes, yet critique can often guide the same model toward correct behavior. However, when critique is removed, the model may fail again on the same query, indicating that it has not internalized the critique's guidance into its underlying capability. Meanwhile, a frozen critic cannot improve its feedback quality over time, limiting the potential for iterative self-improvement. To address this, we propose learning to internalize self-critique with reinforcement learning(ICRL), a novel framework that jointly trains a solver and a critic from a shared backbone to convert critique-induced success into unassisted solver ability. The critic is rewarded based on the solver's subsequent performance gain, incentivizing actionable feedback. To address the distribution shift between critique-conditioned and critique-free behavior, ICRL introduces a distribution-calibration re-weighting ratio that selectively transfers critique-guided improvements compatible with the solver's own prompt distribution. Additionally, a role-wise group advantage estimation stabilizes joint optimization across the two roles. Together, these mechanisms ensure that the solver learns to improve itself without external critique, rather than becoming dependent on critique-conditioned behavior. We evaluate ICRL on diverse benchmarks spanning agentic and mathematical reasoning tasks, using Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B as backbones. Results show consistent improvements, with average gains of 6.4 points over GRPO on agentic tasks, and 7.0 points on mathematical reasoning. Notably, the learned 8B critic is comparable to 32B critics while using substantially fewer tokens. The code is available at https://github.com/brick-pid/ICRL.

AI.tldr: ICRL 提出一个共享骨干网络的“求解器+评论器”双角色强化学习框架，用评论器带来的后续成功（或性能增益）作为评论奖励，并把评论条件下的改进轨迹通过分布校准重加权回传到无评论的求解器策略中，从而让求解器“内化”自我批评的能力。在 Qwen3-4B/8B 上，智能体任务平均超 GRPO 6.4 分、数学推理超 GRPO 7.0 分，且 8B 的评论器效果可比 32B 冻结评论器、token 消耗远低。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在复杂任务中常犯错，自我批评（critique）可以把失败轨迹修正为成功，但一旦移除批评，同一模型在相同查询上仍会失败，说明批评的指导没有被内化为模型自身能力（internalization 缺失）。同时现有方法多依赖冻结的评论器，反馈质量不随求解器提升而演化，限制了持续自我改进。核心挑战有二：(1) 分布偏移——经批评修正后的成功轨迹来自 π(y|q,c) 而非 π(y|q)，直接当作无批评样本训练会强化“依赖批评”的行为，使策略更新产生偏差；(2) 角色异质——求解器与评论器的提示前缀与奖励语义不同，混在一个 group 内做归一化会破坏 GRPO 的相对比较原则。
AI.method: 以 GRPO 为底层 RL 原语，从同一骨干参数 θ 用角色化提示实例化求解者 π^S 与评论者 π^C 两个角色（无需外部教师或人工评论数据）。自改进 rollout：求解者先采样 τ1，若失败则评论者基于 (q,τi) 生成评论 ci，求解者再基于 (q,ci) 采样修订轨迹 τi+1，最多 K 轮（实际 K=2）。奖励：求解者用任务结果奖励 r(τ)∈[0,1]；评论者按下游效用计分——若修订轨迹成功则 r(c)=1，否则为 r(τi+1)-r(τi)（仅在环境提供稠密奖励时非零）。两项关键机制：(1) 分布校准重加权比 w_t = π_rollout^S(y_t|q,y_<t) / π_rollout^S(y_t|q,c,y_<t)，对修订轨迹先剥离评论前缀再计算重要性采样比 ρ_t，并用 min(w_t, w_max=2) 裁剪以抑制梯度方差；w_t≈1 的 token 被强迁移，依赖评论上下文的 token 被降权；(2) 角色化组优势估计，对求解者组与评论者组分别做组内标准化（式5），保留各自奖励语义。最终目标为带角色优势的 GRPO 裁剪目标乘以 min(w_t,w_max)（式6）。训练细节：AgentGym 框架、最多 30 轮交互、Adam 常数学习率 1e-6、每查询 8 条 rollout、上下文 16384、4B/8B 分别用 2/4 张 H100。
AI.result: 智能体任务（ALFWorld、WebShop、HotpotQA/2Wiki/Bamboogle/MuSiQue）：4B 上 ICRL 平均 57.0%，超 GRPO 7.8、超 Critique-GRPO 1.1；8B 上 57.8%，超 GRPO 5.0、超 Critique-GRPO 1.2，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、2Wiki 上最优。数学推理（Qwen3-8B）：SFT 59.2、GRPO 68.3、Critique-GRPO 73.3、ICRL 75.3（超 GRPO 7.0、超 Critique-GRPO 2.0），AIME24 从 50.0→65.1、OlympiadBench 65.6→68.9，仅 AMC23 略逊。测试时多轮自改进：ALFWorld 第三轮达 98% SR，WebShop 76%→83.5%，SearchQA 37.5%→45%，均优于 GRPO/Critique-GRPO。训练动态：求解者奖励 40%→90%+，评论者奖励 26%→60%，梯度范数有界；w_t 从低于 1 逐步上升，说明更多修订 token 变得与无批评分布兼容。评论器交换实验：固定 ICRL-8B 求解者，仅替换评论者，ICRL-8B 评论器在 ALFWorld 达 95.0 SR（与 OSS-20B 持平、高于 Qwen3-32B 的 94.5），WebShop 76.0→78.5，且平均评论长度仅 57.0/93.9 token，远低于 20B（921.6/975.1）和 32B（526.6/417.7）。消融：去掉角色化优势均值 69.8→68.4，去掉重加权比 69.8→67.8，两组件均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: ICRL 是首个在 RL 设定下同时优化“批评能力”与“批评内化”的框架：通过分布校准重加权把批评诱导的成功转成无批评能力，通过角色化组优势稳定双角色联合优化。实验表明其一致优于强 RL 基线，且学到的评论器在测试时仍有效、以远少 token 达到 32B 冻结评论器水平，说明自批评最有效的条件是评论生成与批评内化被共同学习。局限：依赖评论修订使长尾轨迹的 rollout 时间变长、同步 RL 中慢轨迹构成吞吐瓶颈（当前迭代轮数设为 2），异步训练尚未探索。

title: Eskwai for Students: Generative AI Assistant for Legal Education in Ghana
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Recent advances in generative AI have shown their potential to be leveraged for legal education. Yet, work on the development and deployment of such systems for legal education in the Global South is limited. In this work, we developed Eskwai for Students, a generative AI assistant to help law students with their legal education. Eskwai for Students is a retrieval augmented generation (RAG) system that provides answers to a wide range of legal questions for law students grounded in a curated database of over 12K case laws and 1.4K legislation in Ghana. We deployed Eskwai for Students in a longitudinal study of 30 months (2.5 years) used by 3.1K law students in Ghana who made 32K queries. We evaluated the helpfulness of our AI, and provided insight into the kinds of queries law students submit to this generative AI tool, which raises some ethical concerns. This work contributes to an understanding of how law students in the Global South are using generative AI for their studies and the ways it could be leveraged responsibly to advance legal education.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了"Eskwai for Students"系统，一个基于检索增强生成(RAG)的生成式AI助手，用于加纳法律教育。该系统基于超过12,000个案例和1,400部法规的数据库，在30个月内对3,100名法律专业学生进行了纵向研究，共处理32,000次查询，评估了AI的实用性和查询类型，并指出了伦理问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在法律教育领域具有潜力，但针对全球南部（发展中国家）法律教育的AI系统研究有限。研究团队旨在开发一个面向加纳法律专业学生的生成式AI助手，以探索其在法律教育中的应用价值。
AI.method: 研究采用检索增强生成(RAG)技术构建"Eskwai for Students"系统，数据库包含加纳12,000余个案例和1,400余部法规。通过为期30个月（2.5年）的纵向研究，对3,100名法律专业学生进行跟踪调研，收集并分析32,000次查询记录。
AI.result: 系统成功部署并运行，评估了AI助手的实用性，分析了法律专业学生的查询类型。研究发现学生广泛使用该工具进行法律学习，同时揭示了使用过程中存在的一些伦理问题。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为理解全球南部法律专业学生如何使用生成式AI进行学习提供了重要参考，强调了负责任地利用AI技术推动法律教育的可行性，同时提醒需关注相关的伦理风险。

title: Probing Privacy Leaks in LLM-based Code Generation via Test Generation
summary: The widespread availability of large-scale code datasets has fueled the rapid development of large language models (LLMs) for code-related tasks. These datasets may include sensitive personally identifiable information (PII), which can lead to privacy leakage when LLMs memorize and reproduce it. However, existing privacy-leakage detection methods rely on ad-hoc prompt construction (manually or automatically designed). Therefore, they do not adequately approximate the real-world contexts in which PII appears in code corpora, making it difficult to extract realistic privacy leakage. In this paper, we propose a pipeline that simulates practical privacy-related code generation scenarios and adopts a test-driven strategy to elicit the memorized information from the generated test cases. We further introduce an automatically constructed privacy feature library that replaces manual prompt engineering by providing realistic templates and examples to guide test case generation. Large-scale experiments on 5 widely used LLMs show that our pipeline exposes more confirmed privacy leakage, achieving a 2.56 times increase in detected leakage compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对代码LLM中隐私泄露检测问题，提出了结合测试驱动策略的模拟管道和自动化隐私特征库，突破了传统方法的局限，在5个主流LLM上实现了更全面的隐私泄露检测，检测效率提升2.56倍。
AI.motivation: 大规模代码数据集中包含敏感的个人身份信息(PII)，LLM在训练过程中可能记忆并复现这些信息，导致隐私泄露。现有检测方法依赖临时提示构建（人工或自动设计），未能充分模拟PII在代码语料库中出现的真实场景，难以提取真实的隐私泄露。
AI.method: 提出了一个模拟实际隐私相关代码生成场景的管道，采用测试驱动策略从生成的测试用例中引出记忆信息；并构建了自动化隐私特征库，使用真实模板和示例引导测试用例生成，替代了人工提示工程。
AI.result: 相比现有基线方法，检测到的隐私泄露增加了2.56倍，覆盖了更多已确认的隐私泄露类型。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的管道在5个主流LLM上验证了方法的有效性，检测到的隐私泄露数量是现有基线方法的2.56倍，显著提升了实际场景中隐私泄露检测的能力。

title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
summary: Can AI systems discover genuinely new knowledge through iterative self improvement, and if so, at what cost? We introduce the NOVA framework, which models the common ``generate, verify, accumulate, retrain'' loop as an adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space. We identify sufficient conditions under which accumulated genuine knowledge eventually covers a finite domain, and show how their violations produce distinct failure modes: contamination, forgetting, exploration failure, and acceptance failure. We then analyze imperfect verification and identify a contamination trap: as easy-to-find knowledge is exhausted, the model mass assigned to new valid artifacts shrinks, so even small false-positive rates can cause invalid artifacts to enter the knowledge base faster than genuine discoveries. We clarify that Good--Turing estimation is a local batch-diversity diagnostic, not an estimator of the historically undiscovered valid mass that governs long-term discovery. Under a separate tail-equivalence assumption relating the model's effective discovery distribution to a Zipf law with exponent $α>1$, we prove that the cumulative generation cost required to obtain $D$ distinct genuine discoveries satisfies $R_{\mathrm{cum}}(D)=Θ(c_{\mathrm{gen}}D^α)$, where $c_{\mathrm{gen}}$ is the per-candidate generation cost. This scaling law quantifies asymptotic diminishing returns as the discovery frontier advances. Finally, we formalize human amplification through guidance, generation, and verification, explaining why expert input is most valuable near autonomous exploration barriers.

AI.tldr: NOVA框架通过将迭代自我改进建模为知识空间上的自适应采样，系统分析了AI发现新知识的条件与代价。研究发现了污染陷阱现象——当易发现知识耗尽时，小误报率即可导致知识库退化；并证明了在Zipf定律假设下发现成本随D^α扩展的扩展定律，揭示了探索前沿推进时收益递减的数学本质。
AI.motivation: 探索AI系统通过迭代自我改进能否发现真正的新知识，以及发现知识的代价是什么。
AI.method: NOVA框架将"生成-验证-积累-重训练"循环建模为知识空间上的自适应采样过程；识别有限域覆盖的充分条件及违反时的四种失败模式；分析不完美验证下的污染陷阱机制；在Zipf尾等价假设下推导扩展律。
AI.result: （1）识别了导致知识最终覆盖有限域的充分条件，以及违反条件时的四种失败模式：污染、遗忘、探索失败和接受失败；（2）发现污染陷阱：易发现知识耗尽后，即使小误报率也会使无效产物进入知识库的速度超过真发现；（3）澄清Good-Turing估计是局部批量多样性诊断量，而非历史未发现有效质量的估计量；（4）证明在Zipf定律（α>1）假设下，累积成本满足R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α)的扩展定律，量化了探索前沿推进时的渐近收益递减；（5）形式化人类在引导、生成和验证中的放大作用。
AI.conclusion: 在有限域上，满足充分条件时，累积的真知识最终会覆盖整个域；但违反条件时会产生四种失败模式。文章揭示了污染陷阱现象：当易发现知识耗尽时，即使较低的误报率也会导致无效产物进入知识库的速度超过真发现的速度。研究澄清了Good-Turing估计的局限性，并在Zipf定律（α>1）假设下证明了累积成本满足R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α)的扩展定律。人机协作中，专家输入在自主探索障碍附近最有价值。

title: Logical Grammar Induction via Graph Kolmogorov Complexity: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Self-Healing Clinical Data Integrity
summary: The reliability of Healthcare Information Systems (HIS) is frequently compromised by human-induced data entry errors, which existing statistical anomaly detection methods fail to distinguish from legitimate clinical extremes. This paper proposes Logic-GNN, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that treats clinical records as a structured ``private language'' governed by latent logical games. By integrating Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNN) with Graph Kolmogorov Complexity, we induce a symbolic grammar that represents the underlying logic of medical interactions. We define anomalies as ``grammatical violations'' that cause a significant expansion in the Minimum Description Length (MDL) of the clinical graph. Evaluated on the Sina System dataset (2M+ records), Logic-GNN achieves an F1-score of 0.94, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by 12\% in distinguishing between life-threatening medical outliers and data corruption. Our approach introduces a self-healing mechanism that suggests logical corrections to maintain data integrity in real-time HIS environments.

AI.tldr: Logic-GNN 将医院信息系统（HIS）临床记录建模为受隐含逻辑语法约束的「私有语言」，用时序图注意力网络（TGAT）编码后经可微分神经符号模块归纳软一阶逻辑规则，再以图 Kolmogorov 复杂度/最小描述长度（MDL）量化「语法违反」，实现对逻辑错误的检测与自愈修复。在 Sina HIS 数据集（220 万条记录、28.5 万患者）上取得 F1=0.94、AUC=0.97，较最强基线 EpiGraph 的 F1 提升约 12%。
AI.motivation: 临床数据（HIS）中的人为录入错误（随机笔误与系统性逻辑矛盾）严重损害数据可靠性，但现有基于统计密度估计/距离的异常检测方法无法区分两类情形：统计上罕见的事件往往是真正危及生命的合法疾病状态，而许多数据错误数值上「看起来合理」却违反医疗的基本逻辑规则（如男性患者被记录为接受产科操作）。因此需要从「统计稀有性」范式转向「结构/符号一致性」范式：把临床数据库看作由隐式语法支配的动态逻辑交互系统，每条记录是这一「私有临床语言」中的句子，异常即「语法违反」。此外临床数据流存在概念漂移（诊疗规范演变、季节性流行趋势），静态检测方法不适用，需要能够随时间演化语法并保持可解释性的检测与自愈机制，以支撑资源受限、实时运行的 HIS 部署。
AI.method: 框架整体流程（Fig.1）：HIS 数据构建 → 几何编码 → 时序 GAT → 神经符号逻辑归纳 → MDL 复杂度层 → 异常检测与自愈。（1）图构建：将 HIS 表示为动态异质时序图 G(t)=(V(t),E(t),X(t))，节点包括患者、医生、检验、处方、ICD-10 诊断、住院事件，语义交互边（问诊、诊断指派、处方、检验申请、随访）附时间戳，保留因果与时序演化；统计量为 28.5 万患者节点、180 万时序边、340 万带属性交互、12,400 个 ICD-10 编码、64 万检验事件、42 个科室。（2）几何表示学习：采用 Temporal Graph Attention Network，h_v^(t+1)=σ(Σ_{u∈N(v)} α_uv^(t) W h_u^(t))，并嵌入双曲隐空间以契合 ICD-10 等层级分类体系的树状/无树状结构。（3）可微分逻辑归纳：提出 Logic Extraction Layer，归纳软一阶逻辑子句集 Γ={C1..Ck}（如 Pregnancy(x)→Female(x)、PediatricWard(x)→Age(x)<18），节点逻辑一致性得分 H(v|Γ)=−Σ_C (1−S_norm(v⊨C))，约束与嵌入通过梯度联合优化。（4）图 Kolmogorov 复杂度（GKC）：定义 K(G)=min{|p|: U(p)=G}，因不可计算而用 MDL 近似 K(G)≈L(Γ)+L(G|Γ)，逻辑一致记录在归纳语法下可高效压缩，不一致记录需例外编码从而抬高总复杂度。（5）异常打分：S(v)=K(G∪v)−K(G)，当 S(v)>τ 判定为逻辑不一致，度量的是语义扰动而非数值稀有度。（6）自愈优化：检测到违反后定位被违反子句，计算属性梯度 ∇_X S(v)，并求解 min_{Δx} S(x+Δx) 获得使一致性恢复的最小属性修改（如判断矛盾源自性别元数据、诊断编码还是检验数据损坏），支持自动或 human-in-the-loop 修复。（7）训练目标：L = L_recon + α·K(Γ) + β·Σ_v D_KL(q(Z_v|G)||p(Z_v))，涵盖图重建、逻辑程序复杂度与变分正则；时序编码器复杂度约 O(|E|d+|V|d²)，符号推理 O(k|V|)，总体随时序交互线性扩展。（8）另结合自适应滑动窗口/强化学习窗口机制以应对概念漂移（作者先前期 RL-Window 工作）。
AI.result: （1）主实验（Sina HIS 数据集，2.2M+ 记录，NVIDIA A100/128GB，PyTorch Geometric）：Logic-GNN Precision 0.95、Recall 0.93、F1 0.94、AUC 0.97；对比 Isolation Forest（0.72/0.65/0.68/0.74）、VAE（0.79/0.76/0.77/0.82）、Graph Autoencoder（0.84/0.80/0.82/0.87）、EpiGraph（0.85/0.81/0.83/0.89），F1 较最强基线约提升 12%。（2）消融：去掉符号层 F1 降至 0.79（假阳性高、可解释性低），去掉 MDL 近似 0.83，去掉时序 TGAT 0.81，去掉自愈模块 0.88；完整模型在准确率与可解释性（假阳性最低、可解释性最高）上取得最佳权衡，说明符号层贡献最大，验证纯神经模型难以区分罕见合法病例与真实逻辑错误。（3）可扩展性：5 万节点 12 分钟/4.2GB，12 万节点 27 分钟/7.8GB，28.5 万节点 49 分钟/12.4GB，50 万+ 节点 81 分钟/18.7GB，随规模近似线性增长，满足大型 HIS 部署需求。（4）案例研究：成功区分真实生理极端、时序疾病爆发、行政错误与逻辑上不可能的组合，正确检出男性患者产科记录、老年患者儿科诊断、临床不可能的药物组合、住院事件的时序矛盾，并给出有意义的纠正建议（性别更正、诊断修订、时间戳调整）。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出 Logic-GNN：一个面向临床数据完整性的神经符号框架，把异常检测从统计噪声建模转为以 Kolmogorov 复杂度/图 Kolmogorov 复杂度为基础的语法归纳问题，证明 AI 不仅能「理解」医疗数据的内在逻辑（区分合法医学极端值与逻辑录入错误），还能定位被违反的约束并给出自愈式修复路径，从而兼顾检测精度与可解释性、支撑实时 HIS 的数据质量治理。作者认为该思路可推广至其他受隐式语法约束的结构化领域。局限与后续方向：主要验证于单一中心化 Sina 数据集，跨机构泛化性未验证；MDL/GKC 近似方式与软一阶逻辑表达能力（一阶约束、无法覆盖更高阶与时序序贯约束）的理论保证尚不充分；自愈建议存在错误修改风险，缺少临床人员闭环评估与安全性分析；未来工作将扩展到去中心化的区块链健康记录以保证跨机构数据一致性，并计划研究更大规模流式场景下的增量式逻辑归纳与资源受限部署。

title: Evaluating Container Orchestration for Neuromorphic Workloads in Virtual Edge Environments
summary:
The growing adoption of edge computing has created an increasing need for workloads capable of operating under strict resource and energy constraints. Neuromorphic computing, and spiking neural networks (SNNs) in particular, offers an energy-efficient alternative to conventional machine learning through event-driven computation. However, how SNN workloads behave when deployed within modern container orchestration frameworks, especially in edge environments, remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying and orchestrating SNN workloads in a virtual edge environment using Kubernetes, focusing on end-to-end latency, throughput, classification accuracy, infrastructure overhead, and runtime behavior under concurrent load.
  Experiments were conducted on a single-node K3d cluster running on a Windows 11 host with WSL2 and Docker Desktop. The results show that SNN workloads are highly sensitive to resource availability. Restricting CPU to 0.5 cores increased median latency by 47.6x and reduced throughput by 49x, while the most constrained configuration failed due to insufficient memory. Classification accuracy remained stable across all working configurations. From an orchestration perspective, K3d successfully deployed and scaled SNN workloads, though its default round-robin routing policy introduced significant tail latency under replica scaling, highlighting a mismatch between stateless load-balancing assumptions and long-running inference workloads.
  Overall, this study provides a baseline for deploying neuromorphic workloads in containerized edge environments and highlights the importance of resource provisioning and orchestration configuration. Future work should explore improved routing strategies, memory optimization, and validation on physical edge hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文在单节点 K3d（Windows 11 + WSL2 + Docker Desktop）虚拟边缘环境中评估 BindsNET 实现的 MNIST SNN 推理服务：0.5 核/512 MB 限制下中位延迟上升 47.6 倍、吞吐下降 49 倍，0.25 核/256 MB 直接 OOM 失败；分类精度保持稳定；K3d 可成功部署并扩缩容，但 Traefik 默认轮询路由导致尾延迟剧增（p99/p50 从 1.1× 升至 6.1×），吞吐仅为理论值的 51%。
AI.motivation: 边缘计算节点资源与功耗受限，而 SNN 依靠事件驱动计算被认为能效更高，但其在现代容器编排框架（尤其 K3s/K3d 等轻量 Kubernetes 发行版）中的实际行为鲜有研究。现有 Kubernetes 调度、自动伸缩与健康探针机制假设负载稳定连续，而 SNN 工作负载具有稀疏、异步、突发（bursty）的特性，二者是否存在结构性不匹配尚未验证，因此需要建立可复现的基线。
AI.method: 系统分为离线训练、容器化、部署、基准测试四阶段。基于 Diehl & Cook 无监督数字识别架构（784 输入神经元、400 兴奋性神经元 + 抑制层，100 ms 仿真窗口，Poisson 编码，LIF 神经元模型，STDP + 侧向抑制学习），用 BindsNET 0.3.3 + CPU 版 PyTorch 2.9.1 在全量 MNIST（60,000 训练 / 10,000 测试）上离线训练并冻结权重，将权重与 FastAPI 服务打包进 python:3.11-slim 镜像。RQ1 采用三组独立 Docker 配置（Baseline 无限制；0.5 CPU/512 MB；0.25 CPU/256 MB，禁用 swap），测量 p50/p75/p95/p99/max 延迟、吞吐、基础设施开销（p50 减经验下限）、分类精度（all-activity 与 proportion-weighting 两种解码）、输出层脉冲数与失败条件。RQ2 在单节点 K3d（K3s v1.31.5-k3s1，K3d v5.8.3）集群中部署同一镜像，Pod request 500m CPU/512Mi、limit 1000m CPU/1Gi，设置三种并发场景（1 副本 1 客户端、1 副本 3 客户端、3 副本 3 客户端，各 50 请求），以 p99 作为尾延迟主指标。实验环境为 Lenovo Yoga Pro 9 16IAH10（Core Ultra 9 285H，64 GB RAM），全程接电。
AI.result: RQ1：基线 p50/p95/max 为 2,172/2,846/3,043 ms，吞吐 0.44 req/s，基础设施开销约 157 ms；经验下限 2,015 ms 约为 100 ms 仿真窗口的 20 倍，源于 Poisson 编码、PyTorch 张量运算与 HTTP 栈。限制到 0.5 核后 p50 升至 103,447 ms（47.6×），p95 114,003 ms，max 116,806 ms，吞吐降至 0.009 req/s（49× 下降），开销 101,481 ms，约 98% 延迟归因于 CPU 限流而非仿真本身；分布出现两簇，表明限流放大了输入相关的计算成本差异。逐数字延迟上，数字 4/5/6 最高（111,655–112,875 ms），0/1 最低（约 99,000 ms）。精度基线 76.5%、受限下 80.5%，各数字精度模式一致（2、4、7、8 较难），说明资源约束只影响性能而不影响预测质量。0.25 核/256 MB 配置在容器初始化时 OOM，确立 PyTorch 运行时 + BindsNET 计算图 + 权重的内存下限（>256 MB）。RQ2：K3d 部署需人工修改 kubeconfig server 地址、开发容器接入 K3d 网络，并因长时推理需调优健康探针与 Traefik 代理超时（否则请求失败）。1 副本 1 客户端：p50 749 ms、p99 852 ms、极差仅 203 ms，吞吐 1.33 req/s；1 副本 3 客户端：p50 2,109 ms（2.8×），吞吐几乎不变 1.37 req/s，暴露单 worker 串行瓶颈；3 副本 3 客户端：p50 降至 1,095 ms、吞吐升至 2.05 req/s，但 p99 升至 6,657 ms、max 7,979 ms，p99/p50 比从 1.1×、1.3× 骤增至 6.1×，且仅为三副本理论上限 3.99 req/s 的 51%。
AI.conclusion: SNN 推理对容器资源供给高度敏感：CPU 限流是延迟的主导因素（98%），内存不足则直接触发 OOM，从而为边缘部署给出明确资源下界；精度表现不受部署环境影响。K3d 能成功部署与扩缩容 SNN 工作负载，但默认的 Traefik 轮询负载均衡基于无状态假设，与长时推理负载不匹配，造成副本间负载不均与严重尾延迟，吞吐扩展效率低下。后续工作方向包括：最小连接数或占用感知的路由策略、以异步处理解耦推理与请求-响应周期以兼容健康检查、缩小模型与内存占用以适配 256–512 MB 级边缘设备、以及在物理边缘硬件（含网络波动与异构资源）上验证结论。

title: MERVIN: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Event Retrieval in Vietnamese News Videos
summary: The growth of online video platforms drives the need for effective, semantically grounded event retrieval. We present MERVIN, a unified multimodal framework for Vietnamese news videos that integrates keyframes, transcripts, and video summaries. Transcript quality is enhanced via Gemini 1.5 Flash, reducing noise from accents, background sounds, and recognition errors. Visual features are extracted with Perception Encoder, while a Vietnamese language model produces textual embeddings; both are indexed in Milvus for efficient similarity-based retrieval. In addition, a React-based interface enables iterative query refinement across modalities, improving semantic alignment. Experimental results on Vietnamese news videos demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system, with MERVIN achieving 79 out of 88 points in AI Challenge HCMC 2025 qualification phase and successfully retrieved all results for every query in the final round.

AI.tldr: MERVIN是一个越南语新闻视频多模态检索框架，通过整合视觉（Perception Encoder）、文本（Gemini 1.5 Flash转录优化+越南语模型嵌入）和Milvus向量索引，实现跨模态语义检索，在AI Challenge HCMC 2025中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 在线视频平台的增长催生了对有效、语义精准的事件检索系统的需求。
AI.method: MERVIN是一个统一的多模态框架，整合关键帧、转录文本和视频摘要。转录质量通过Gemini 1.5 Flash提升（降噪处理）；视觉特征由Perception Encoder提取；文本嵌入由越南语模型生成；两者均在Milvus中建立索引以支持高效相似度检索；React前端支持跨模态迭代查询优化。
AI.result: 在越南新闻视频数据集上验证有效：资格赛79/88分，决赛全部查询均成功检索。
AI.conclusion: MERVIN框架在AI Challenge HCMC 2025资格赛中获得79/88分，并在决赛中成功检索出所有查询结果，验证了其有效性。

title: SMCEvolve: Principled Scientific Discovery via Sequential Monte Carlo Evolution
summary: LLM-driven program evolution has emerged as a powerful tool for automated scientific discovery, yet existing frameworks offer no principled guide for designing their individual components and provide no guarantee that the search converges. We introduce SMCEvolve, which recasts program search as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and approximates it with a Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) sampler. From this view, three core mechanisms emerge as principled components: adaptive parent resampling, mixture of mutation with acceptance, and automatic convergence control. We further provide a finite-sample complexity analysis that bounds the LLM-call budget required to reach a target approximation error. Across math, algorithm efficiency, symbolic regression, and end-to-end ML research benchmarks, SMCEvolve surpasses state-of-the-art evolving systems while using fewer LLM calls under self-determined termination. The code is available at https://github.com/kongwanbianjinyu/SMCEvolve.

AI.tldr: SMCEvolve 将 LLM 驱动的程序进化（自动化科学发现）统一为“从奖励倾斜目标分布采样”，并用序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样器近似之。其父代重采样、混合变异+MH 接受、自动收敛控制三个机制均由 SMC 理论直接导出，并给出首个针对程序进化的有限样本复杂度界。四个领域实验显示其超越 SOTA 进化系统且 LLM 调用更少（自动终止）。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 程序进化框架（AlphaEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、ReEvo、OpenEvolve 等）的组件——父代选择、上下文构造、种群管理、停止规则——均为孤立的手工启发式设计，缺乏统一原则与收敛保证；迭代数需事先固定，无法区分“已收敛到高奖励区”与“陷入局部停滞”，导致方差大、要么不足要么浪费算力。作者的核心问题是：能否把 LLM 程序进化建立在严格的概率框架上，统一其组件并给出收敛保证。
AI.method: 1) 建模：把程序搜索写成 KL 正则化变分问题 max_p E_p[R]-(1/β)D_KL(p||p0)，其唯一最优解为奖励倾斜分布 p*(x|q) ∝ p0(x|q)e^{βR(x)}（Lemma 2.1），直接采样因配分函数不可解而不可行。2) 桥接路径：几何退火 p_t ∝ p0·e^{β_t R}，β_t=λ_tβ。3) 自适应父代重采样：取时间反演后向核，前向/后向核抵消，得重要性权重 w_t=exp((β_t-β_{t-1})R(x_{t-1}))，重采样概率为奖励上的温度 softmax。4) 混合变异+接受：以 LLM 提案 Q_t(·|x,C_t) 构造 MH 核保证 p_t-不变性（附录 C 证明详细平衡），黑盒 API 下用仅奖励准则 α_t=min{1, e^{β_t(R(x')-R(x))} 近似（附录 E）；四个提案核（diff/rewrite × 有/无灵感），灵感程序取 top-k 高奖励与嵌入距离最大者，且历史含被拒绝提案；用 Thompson 采样在核上自适应选择以加速遍历性。5) 自动收敛控制：以 ESS(λ) 为准二分搜索 λ_t 使 ESS=κN，λ_t=1 时自动终止，总 LLM 调用为 N·K·T。6) 理论：Theorem 3.1 借 Marion et al. 的有限样本 SMC 界，给出 P(|η_T^N(f)-p*(f)|≤ε)≥3/4 及预算 ℬ=Õ((ε^-2 ∨ κ^-1)/(1-ρ)·βΔ_R)，三项映射为桥接正则性 γ²≤κ^-1、混合时间 τ≤1/(1-ρ)（一致遍历性）、路径长度 logΓ≤βΔ_R。7) 实现细节：岛式并行+迁移、系统重采样、log-sum-exp 数值稳定。
AI.result: 实验覆盖四域：Math（AlphaEvolve 组合几何 10 题）、AlgoTune（8 个数值/信号处理/线性代数加速任务）、符号回归（LLM-SRBench 16 题）、AutoResearch（TinyStories 单卡 GPT 预训练脚本演化，奖励 max(0, 2.0−val_bpb)）。所有方法共用 gpt-5-mini+gemini-3-flash 集成，3 seed 取最优，基线用固定调用预算（Math/AutoResearch 200、符号回归 400、AlgoTune 500），SMCEvolve 自主终止。SMCEvolve 在四域绝大多数任务取得最佳成绩（Math 如 Circle Packing N=21 达 0.9993、Kissing Number 0.9005、2nd Autocorrelation 1.0220；AlgoTune 如 fft_convolution 19.9×、psd_cone_projection 45.82×），且平均调用数（128–480）低于基线预算。消融（Circle Packing）显示：固定 uniform 或 greedy 重采样、单一变异核、均匀混合、Thompson 改为均匀、N=4/K=4 或 N=16/K=1 均退化（0.9379–0.9929 vs 默认 0.9993），验证自适应重采样、核多样性与自适应选择、N·K=16 均衡分配的必要性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: SMCEvolve 证明 LLM 程序进化可被严格表述为奖励倾斜分布上的 SMC 采样，从单一原则导出三个耦合机制并给出首个有限样本收敛与调用预算界，实验上以更少 LLM 调用超越现有 SOTA。贡献定位为“专门化到 LLM 程序进化”（借用而非重证通用 SMC 复杂度理论），其理论依赖显式假设（相邻桥接 L2 比 ≤ κ^-1、核一致遍历性），而 ESS 二分对桥接正则性仅是“瞄准”而非严格推导；MH 使用奖励-only 近似破坏精确不变性，属实践近似。局限：黑盒 LLM 密度不可得、无法计算完整 MH 比；ESS 调度对桥接正则性的形式化刻画留作未来工作；结论适用域为产品式奖励函数。展望：收紧界、扩展到多目标与无奖励设定。代码已开源（github.com/kongwanbianjinyu/SMCEvolve）。

title: GESD: Beyond Outcome-Oriented Fairness
summary: Machine learning (ML) algorithms are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making domains such as loan approvals, hiring, and recidivism predictions. While existing fairness metrics (e.g., statistical parity, equal opportunity) effectively quantify outcome-oriented disparities, they offer limited insight into the procedure or explanation behind biased decisions. To address this gap, we propose Group-level Explanation Stability Disparity (GESD), a \textit{procedural-oriented} fairness metric that measures disparities in the stability, robustness, and sensitivity of model explanations across different subgroups in a protected category. %GESD is explainer-agnostic, model-agnostic, and extends the scope of fairness analyses to the level of explainability. We further integrate GESD into a multi-objective optimization framework that jointly optimizes for utility, outcome-based fairness, and explanation-based fairness called FEU (Fairness--Explainability--Utility). Empirical results on multiple benchmark datasets show that GESD effectively captures group-wise discrepancies in explanation quality, and that FEU improves both utility and fairness over state-of-the-art methods. By bridging outcome-based and explanation-based fairness, GESD offers a comprehensive tool for diagnosing and mitigating bias in predictive modeling. Our code and datasets are available on GitHub {\hyperlink{https://github.com/horlahsunbo/GESD}{https://github.com/horlahsunbo/GESD}}

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GESD（群体级解释稳定性差异）这一程序导向公平性指标，用于衡量受保护类别下不同群体在模型解释稳定性方面的差异，并设计了FEU多目标优化框架联合优化效用、结果公平性和解释公平性。实验验证了该方法的有效性，为预测模型的偏见诊断与缓解提供了从结果到解释的完整分析工具。
AI.motivation: 现有公平性指标（如统计均等、均等机会）主要量化结果导向的差异，但无法揭示偏见决策背后的程序或解释机制，缺乏对模型解释质量的组间差异的分析能力。
AI.method: 提出Group-level Explanation Stability Disparity (GESD)指标，测量受保护类别下不同子群在模型解释稳定性、鲁棒性和敏感性方面的差异；该指标具有解释器无关和模型无关的特性。进一步将GESD整合到多目标优化框架FEU (Fairness-Explainability-Utility) 中，联合优化效用、结果公平性和解释公平性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明：GESD能有效捕捉组间解释质量的差异；FEU框架相比现有最优方法，在效用和公平性上均有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了GESD这一程序导向的公平性指标，填补了传统公平性度量仅关注结果而忽视解释过程稳健性的空白。FEU框架通过多目标优化在效用、结果公平性和解释公平性之间取得平衡。实验表明该方法能有效诊断和缓解预测模型中的偏见，为公平性分析提供了从结果层到解释层的完整工具链。

title: Capability Conditioned Scaffolding for Professional Human LLM Collaboration
summary: Large language model personalization typically adapts outputs to user preferences and style but does not account for differences in user evaluation capacity across domains of expertise. This limitation can encourage Professional Domain Drift, where users rely on AI generated reasoning in domains they cannot reliably evaluate. We introduce Capability Conditioned Scaffolding, a typed framework that partitions expertise into strong, mixed, and weak domains and conditions intervention behavior on structured capability profiles. A pilot evaluation across multiple MMLU subsets and four LLM substrates shows consistent profile conditioned intervention behavior, including categorical inversion under profile swapping and selective activation in mixed domain risk zones. These findings suggest that capability aware scaffolding can support more reliable professional human AI collaboration beyond stylistic personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"能力条件支架"(Capability Conditioned Scaffolding)框架，解决大语言模型个性化中忽视用户领域评估能力差异的问题，通过根据用户能力画像调节AI干预行为来防止专业领域漂移。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM个性化仅关注用户偏好和风格适配，未考虑用户在专业领域内评估AI推理可靠性的能力差异。这可能导致"专业领域漂移"现象——用户在其无法可靠评估的领域过度依赖AI生成的推理。
AI.method: 提出一种类型化框架，将专业知识划分为强领域、混合领域和弱领域，并基于结构化能力画像(conditioning intervention behavior)调节AI干预行为。在多个MMLU子集和四种LLM基底上进行试点评估。
AI.result: 实验显示一致的画像条件干预行为，包括：画像交换下的分类反转(categorical inversion under profile swapping)以及在混合领域风险区的选择性激活(selective activation in mixed domain risk zones)。
AI.conclusion: 能力感知支架技术可支持比单纯风格个性化更可靠的专业人机协作。

title: Runtime-Structured Task Decomposition for Agentic Coding Systems
comment: Paper presented at ACM Conference on AI and Agentic Systems 2026 at the Agentic Software Engineering workshop
summary:
Agentic coding systems increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for software engineering tasks such as debugging, root cause analysis, and code review. However, many existing systems encode task logic, execution flow, and output generation inside monolithic prompts. This design creates brittle behavior, limited debuggability, and high retry costs because failures often require rerunning the full workflow.
  We present runtime-structured task decomposition, an architectural approach in which task partitioning and execution flow are managed through executable control logic rather than prompt structure alone. LLMs are used only for focused judgment tasks, and outputs are validated against predefined schemas before downstream execution.
  We evaluate this approach on two software engineering workloads using three configurations: monolithic execution, static decomposition with fixed subtasks and no runtime branching, and runtime-structured decomposition. Each configuration was evaluated across 10 runs.
  Our results show that decomposition alone does not necessarily reduce retry cost. In the Kubernetes root cause analysis workload, the static decomposition baseline produced a retry cost of 1,632 +/- 145 tokens versus 904 +/- 17 tokens for the monolithic baseline because failures forced reruns of downstream subtasks. A similar pattern appeared in the multi-file debugging workload, where the static baseline consumed 933 tokens compared to 703 tokens for the monolithic system.
  The runtime-structured approach reran only failed subtasks, reducing retry costs to 436 +/- 132 tokens for root cause analysis and 460 tokens for debugging. Overall, the approach achieved up to 51.7% lower retry cost than monolithic systems and 73.2% lower retry cost than static decomposition baselines, improving efficiency, debuggability, and operational reliability in agentic coding systems.
