AI.tldr: 本文基于谱特征学习理论，将谱范数条件形式化为特征学习定义，推导出Complete-P缩放规律，并引入修正谱范数处理不满秩权重矩阵，首次实现了GQA（分组查询注意力）的μP缩放规律推导，通过实验验证了学习率和权重衰减跨GQA配置的有效迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前μP方法虽然能确保超参数跨模型架构迁移，但针对新模型架构的推导较为困难，限制了其在更多模型（如GQA）上的应用。
AI.method: 基于谱特征学习视角，将权重上的谱范数条件从启发式方法提升为特征学习的定义，从而推导出Complete-P的深度和权重衰减缩放规律；引入修正谱范数以处理权重矩阵不满秩的情况，进而推导出GQA的μP缩放规律。
AI.result: 首次成功推导出GQA的μP缩放规律，实验验证了学习率可跨GQA重复超参数迁移，权重衰减也可实现跨设置迁移。
AI.conclusion: 成功推导了GQA的μP缩放规律，并通过GQA重复超参数的学习率迁移和权重衰减迁移实验验证了理论推导的有效性。

title: GiLT: Augmenting Transformer Language Models with Dependency Graphs
summary: Augmenting Transformers with linguistic structures effectively enhances the syntactic generalization performance of language models. Previous work in this direction focuses on syntactic tree structures of languages, in particular constituency tree structures. We propose Graph-Infused Layers Transformer Language Model (GiLT) which leverages dependency graphs for augmenting Transformer language models. Unlike most previous work, GiLT does not insert extra structural tokens in language modeling; instead, it injects structural information into language modeling by modulating attention weights in the Transformer with features extracted from the dependency graph that is incrementally constructed along with token prediction. In our experiments, GiLT with semantic dependency graphs achieves better syntactic generalization while maintaining competitive perplexity in comparison with Transformer language model baselines. In addition, GiLT can be finetuned from a pretrained language model to achieve improved downstream task performance. Our code is released at https://github.com/cookie-pie-oops/GiLT-LM.

AI.tldr: GiLT是一种将依赖图结构信息注入Transformer语言模型的新方法，通过调制注意力权重而非插入额外结构标记来增强模型的句法泛化能力，同时保持良好的语言建模困惑度。
AI.motivation: 现有增强Transformer句法泛化能力的工作主要关注句法树结构（如成分句法树），本文认为依赖图结构可作为一种更灵活且有效的替代方案。
AI.method: GiLT利用依赖图增量构建过程中提取的特征来调制Transformer的注意力权重，而非在语言建模中插入额外的结构标记，从而实现结构信息注入。
AI.result: 使用语义依赖图的GiLT在保持竞争力的困惑度同时实现了更好的句法泛化能力；预训练模型微调后下游任务性能也得到提升。
AI.conclusion: GiLT通过非侵入式的图注入方式增强Transformer语言模型，在保持良好困惑度的同时提升了句法泛化能力，且可通过微调迁移到下游任务，具有实用价值。

title: From LLM-Generated Conjectures to Lean Formalizations: Automated Polynomial Inequality Proving via Sum-of-Squares Certificates
summary: Automated proving of polynomial inequalities is a fundamental challenge in automated mathematical reasoning, where rich algebraic structure and a rapidly growing certificate search space hinder scalability. Purely symbolic approaches provide strong guarantees but often scale poorly as the number of variables or the degree increases, due to expensive algebraic manipulations and rapidly growing intermediate expressions. In parallel, LLM-guided methods have made notable progress, particularly on competition-style inequalities with a small number of variables. To address the remaining scalability challenges, we propose NSPI, a neuro-symbolic framework that combines the complementary strengths of LLMs and symbolic computation for polynomial-inequality proving. Concretely, an LLM proposes a conjecture in the form of an approximate polynomial Sum-Of-Squares (SOS) decomposition; we refine it via symbolic computation to obtain an exact polynomial SOS representation, which directly proves the target inequality, and we further certify the proof in Lean, yielding an end-to-end pipeline from heuristic discovery to machine-checked proof. Experiments on challenging benchmarks involving polynomials with up to 10 variables demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NSPI框架，通过结合LLM的启发式猜想能力与符号计算的精确推导能力，以及Lean的形式化验证，实现多项式不等式证明的端到端流水线。该方法在保持强证明保证的同时，解决了纯符号方法的可扩展性问题，能够处理最多10个变量的大规模多项式不等式。
AI.motivation: 纯符号方法虽提供强保证但随着变量数或度数增加可扩展性差（代价昂贵的代数运算和快速膨胀的中间表达式）；LLM引导方法在少量变量的问题上表现良好，但需解决可扩展性问题。
AI.method: 提出NSPI神经符号框架：首先利用LLM生成近似多项式SOS分解猜想，再通过符号计算将其精化为精确的多项式SOS表示以直接证明目标不等式，最后在Lean中形式化验证证明。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在最多达10个变量的多项式基准测试上有效且可扩展。
AI.conclusion: NSPI框架在包含最多10个变量的多项式基准测试上展现了高效性和可扩展性，实现了从启发式发现到机器验证证明的端到端流水线，为大规模多项式不等式证明提供了新思路。

title: Measuring Maximum Activations in Open Large Language Models
summary: The dynamic range of activations is a first-order constraint for low-bit quantization, activation scaling, and stable LLM inference. Prior work characterized outlier features and massive activations on pre-2024 LLaMA-style models, and the downstream activation-quantization stack inherits that picture without revisiting it for the post-LLaMA open-model boom. We ask the deployment-oriented question: how large can activations get in modern open LLMs, and how does this magnitude vary across families, generations, and training stages? Under a unified pipeline (5,000-sample multi-domain corpus, family-specific tokenization, identical hooks across embeddings, hidden states, attention, MLP/MoE, SwiGLU gates, and final norm), we measure global and layerwise maxima on 27 checkpoints from 8 open families spanning dense, MoE, vision-language, intermediate-training, and instruction-tuned variants. We find that (i) global maxima span over nearly four orders of magnitude at comparable parameter counts, with Qwen3.5 and MoE checkpoints in the 10^2 to 10^3 range and Gemma3-27B-it reaching ~7 x 10^5; (ii) cross-family and cross-generation comparisons break simple monotonic scaling; and (iii) MoE checkpoints exhibit 14.0-23.4x lower peaks than matched-scale dense counterparts, while the residual stream carries the global maximum in 22/24 checkpoints. A lightweight INT-8 sanity check shows that measured maxima co-vary with low-bit reconstruction error via activation-scale selection. We conclude that maximum activation magnitude is a model property tied to family, architecture, and training stage - not a simple byproduct of size - and should be measured and reported alongside any open-weight release before low-bit deployment. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/clx1415926/Max_act_llm.

AI.tldr: 论文系统测量了8个开源家族27个检查点的激活最大值，发现激活幅度跨度近四个数量级，与家族、架构和训练阶段密切相关，而非简单的模型规模函数。MoE模型峰值显著低于密集模型，残差流普遍携带全局最大值，建议将最大激活幅度作为开源模型的标准报告指标。
AI.motivation: 先前工作仅在2024年前的LLaMA风格模型上表征了异常值特征和大规模激活，对后LLaMA开源模型热潮中的激活特性缺乏系统研究。部署导向的问题：现代开源LLM的激活能有多大？不同家族、世代和训练阶段之间的幅度如何变化？
AI.method: 使用统一的测试流程（5000样本多领域语料库、家族特定分词、跨嵌入层、隐藏状态、注意力机制、MLP/MoE、SwiGLU门控和最终归一化层的相同钩子），对27个检查点进行了激活最大值的全局和分层测量。
AI.result: 发现：（i）在相近参数规模下，全局最大值跨度近四个数量级，Qwen3.5和MoE检查点在10²至10³范围，Gemma3-27B-it达~7×10⁵；（ii）跨家族和跨世代比较打破了简单的单调缩放规律；（iii）MoE检查点比同规模密集模型低14.0-23.4倍的峰值，残差流在22/24个检查点中携带全局最大值。INT-8轻量级检查表明测量到的最大值与激活尺度选择的低比特重建误差协变。
AI.conclusion:
最大激活幅度是与模型家族、架构和训练阶段相关的模型属性，而非模型规模的简单副产品。建议在任何开源权重发布时都应测量和报告最大激活幅度，以支持低比特量化部署。

开源代码：https://github.com/clx1415926/Max_act_llm

title: How Data Augmentation Shapes Neural Representations
summary: Data augmentation is widely recognized for improving generalization in deep networks, yet its impact on the geometry of learned representations remains poorly understood. In this work, we characterize how different data augmentation strategies reshape internal representations in neural networks. Using tools from shape analysis, we embed network hidden representations into a metric space where distance is invariant to scaling, translation, rotation and reflection. We show that increasing augmentation strength leads to well-behaved trajectories in this space, and that different augmentation types steer representations in distinct directions. Moreover, we investigate how neural representation shapes are distorted along data augmentation trajectories, and show that insights from neural geometry can predict which representations provide the most improvement when ensembling models. Our results reveal shared geometric patterns across architectures and seeds, and suggest that analyzing shape-space trajectories offers a principled tool for understanding and comparing data augmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用黎曼形状距离（Riemannian shape distance）构建的"形状空间"来刻画数据增强如何重塑神经网络的内部表征：增强强度增大时，表征沿形状空间中的平滑轨迹移动，不同增强类型导向不同方向；增强造成的表征变化幅度可与随机种子变化相比；不同增强轨迹之间的测地夹角越大，模型集成带来的精度增益越大；且增强导致的"地标位移"具有层依赖性。
AI.motivation: 数据增强虽被广泛使用，但其对隐藏层表征几何结构的影响仍不清楚：许多不同增强超参数组合给出几乎相同的验证精度，性能指标掩盖了训练协议之间的实质差异。核心问题包括：增强强度是否推动表征沿确定轨迹移动？不同增强方法（旋转、随机裁剪）是否以本质不同的方式塑造隐藏计算？两种增强如何交互？表征几何的多样性能否预测集成收益？
AI.method: 基于已有工作（Williams et al. 等）的形式化度量空间框架，构建黎曼形状距离度量：先将表征矩阵 X∈R^{M×N} 中心化并归一化得到 pre-shape，定义 ρ(X_i,X_j)=arccos(sup_{O∈O(N)} Tr[Z_j^T Z_i O])，其闭式解为 arccos(Σσ_k)，并证明其等价于归一化 Bures 相似度（cos ρ）；由于对平移、缩放、旋转、反射不变，可计算 pre-shape 球面上的大圆测地线 γ(t)，用切向量夹角 θ_{1,2} 度量两条轨迹的"测地角"。此外定义地标位移 ΔZ=Z_A - Z_B O* 以逐样本分析形变。实验：在 CIFAR-10 上训练 ResNet-18/VGG-16/DenseNet-40/ViT-Tiny，采集 10,000 张未增强测试图像的隐藏层响应，对齐后用 MDS-PCA 可视化；用岭回归从对齐形状线性预测增强超参数（留一交叉验证）；定义 D_aug 与 D_seed 比较增强与随机种子的效应尺度；对 8 种增强（旋转、剪切、色彩抖动、灰度、高斯噪声、椒盐噪声、随机裁剪、Cutout）两两软投票集成并计算 ΔAcc，与测地角做相关性分析；对高维表征（N>1000）保留前 1000 个主成分。
AI.result: 1) 只有在执行正交对齐时，形状距离矩阵才呈现与增强超参数一致的规则结构，未对齐时该结构被破坏；MDS-PCA 显示平滑、有序的轨迹，对双参数 patch Gaussian 则形成有组织的二维曲面。2) 对齐后的形状可线性解码训练所用的增强超参数（留一岭回归预测值接近真值），说明表征在形状空间中是系统组织的。3) ResNet-18 与 ViT 上 D_aug 与 D_seed 随噪声强度 s 增大而分离，分离点约在 s=0.2，为该超参数提供"自然单位"。4) 8 种增强类型的轨迹在形状空间中方向不同，按几何/光度/噪声/遮挡类型出现聚类；实测测地角约 60°–81°，在约 10^6 维切空间中属显著非随机现象。5) 成对增强集成带来的精度增益与两条轨迹的测地角正相关。6) 地标位移分析显示增强对表征的影响具层与方法依赖性：layer 2 中位移最大的地标多与低层特征（如明亮背景色、对角边缘）相关，而 avgpool 层的前两主成分方差更低且模式不明显。
AI.conclusion: 形状空间中的轨迹分析为理解与比较数据增强方法提供了有原则性的几何工具，并可推广到优化器、正则化、架构、监督方式、微调协议等训练选择的比较，潜在应用包括超参搜索、增强策略设计、原则化的集成构建及微调引起的表征变化解释。局限：仅限图像分类与经典增强，仅做对固定干净探针样本的事后分析，未涵盖其他模态、更大模型、学习式增强策略与训练动态；黎曼形状距离对高维卷积表征计算代价高，实践中需先做降维。

title: CAPS: Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
summary: Parallel reasoning, where a generator samples many candidate solutions and an aggregator selects the best, is one of the most effective forms of test-time scaling in large language models, and pairwise self-verification has become its strongest aggregation primitive. Yet pairwise verification carries a heavy cost: each judgment reads two complete solutions in full, and existing methods perform tens of such judgments per problem regardless of whether the comparison is informative. We introduce CAPS (Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection), an inference-only framework that allocates verifier compute non-uniformly along two orthogonal axes: an evidence axis that adapts how much of each candidate the judge sees, and a distribution axis that adapts how comparisons are spread across the pool. CAPS instantiates these into a four-stage cascade with an optional rescue subroutine, and admits a closed-form verifier-token cost in which the per-candidate marginal cost is roughly halved relative to uniform full-evidence schedules. On four self-verifying models (Qwen3-14B, GPT-OSS-20B, Qwen3-4B-Instruct/Thinking) and five reasoning benchmarks spanning code (LiveCodeBench-v5/v6, CodeContests) and math (AIME 2025, HMMT 2025), CAPS outperforms the leading pairwise verifier on 14 of 20 suites while using 25.4% of its verifier-token budget on code, and outperforms pointwise self-verification on all 20. The trade-off suites admit an interpretable diagnostic in terms of the verifier's accuracy at partial versus full evidence, providing a concrete pre-deployment check for cascade suitability.

AI.tldr: CAPS proposes a cascaded adaptive pairwise selection framework that reduces verifier compute by ~50% per candidate by non-uniformly allocating evidence viewing and comparison distribution across a four-stage cascade.
AI.motivation: Pairwise self-verification is costly: each judgment reads two complete solutions, and existing methods perform fixed number of comparisons regardless of informativeness. This inefficiency limits scalability of test-time compute allocation.
AI.method: Four-stage cascade with evidence axis (adaptive partial evidence) and distribution axis (adaptive comparison spreading), plus optional rescue subroutine. Adopts closed-form verifier-token cost analysis.
AI.result: Outperforms leading pairwise verifier on 14/20 benchmark suites, uses 25.4% of verifier-token budget, outperforms pointwise self-verification on all 20 suites.
AI.conclusion: CAPS achieves comparable or superior performance to leading pairwise verifiers while using only 25.4% of the verifier-token budget, with interpretable diagnostics for cascade suitability pre-deployment.

title: Time-Varying Deep State Space Models for Sequences with Switching Dynamics
summary: The identification and modeling of time-varying systems is a fundamental challenge in signal processing and system identification. To address this challenge, we propose a class of time-varying state-space model (SSM) based neural networks in which the neurons' states are governed by time-varying dynamics. The proposed model provides the learnable time-varying dynamics through a dictionary of basis functions, where each basis function evolves differently over time. We evaluate the proposed approach on both synthetic data from switching systems and a speech denoising task where real audio is corrupted with switching dynamics noise. The results show that the proposed time-varying model consistently outperforms its time-invariant counterparts while maintaining comparable computational complexity. Our investigations also reveal which aspects of the time-varying dynamics of the data most need to be captured by the proposed time-invariant models, how the additional freedom provided by time-varying basis functions should be allocated across model components, and to what extent larger models can compensate for time-invariant limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类基于基函数展开的时变深度状态空间模型（time-varying deep SSM），用可学习的基函数字典对状态转移、输入与输出矩阵随时间的变化进行参数化；在合成切换系统数据与受切换噪声污染的语音去噪任务上，时变模型一致优于时不变模型，且推理阶段乘加运算量保持不变。
AI.motivation: 真实世界过程（金融、气象、能耗、神经活动、旋转机械噪声等）普遍具有时变、非平稳特性。经典线性动力系统（LDS）及深度SSM假设时间不变的转移动力学，无法刻画周期性/切换动态；切换线性动力系统（SLDS）虽能描述模式切换，但需显式估计模式数量、各模式阶数与参数，学习困难且训练低效；而输入依赖式（如 Mamba 一类）时变机制无法建模与输入无关的纯时间演化。因此需要一种既能显式表达时间依赖动力学、又可经由标准 BPTT 高效训练、且不需指定切换模式的深度 SSM 结构。
AI.method: 核心方法：将 SSM 的 A、B、C 矩阵的每个元素表示为可学习基函数的线性组合，即 [A[t]]_ij = Σ_k a_ij^(k) φ^(k)[t]（B、C 同理），基函数字典为 1 个常数项加 K−1 个高斯函数（幅度 1，均值 U(0,T)，标准差按 K 与 T 设定）；K_A、K_B、K_C 可独立选取，因此 A/B/C 可各自保持时不变。稳定性方面，在 A 对角化且 |φ|≤1 条件下，若 Σ_k|a_ii^(k)|<1 则保证 |a_ii[t]|<1；训练中每次前向传播检查该约束，违反时按 1/(c+ε) 缩放系数以强制稳定。参数与复杂度：每元素参数量按 K_A/K_B/K_C 倍增，但因 n≪h，在字典规模适中时代增参数相对总量很小；推理时可预计算 A(t),B(t),C(t)，故 MAC 复杂度与时不变模型相同，仅空间复杂度随序列长度 T 线性增长。实现上采用输入层 + 1~2 个含 h 个 SSM 神经元的隐藏层 + 输出层，恒等或 GELU 激活，批归一化，BPTT + AdamW；A 系数采用 S4D-Lin 初始化并按 K_A 均匀展开，B 系数初始化为 1，C 系数 U[0,1)。实验含两个数据集：(1) 四模式 SLDS（固定切换顺序、等时长；N=128 的双正弦输入；2000 对样本，80/20 划分；A/B/C 可独立切换或固定）；(2) MSWC “surrounding” 关键词子集（500/100/100，1 s=48000 点）干净语音，用四模式 SLDS 噪声循环污染（每周期 128 点、375 次重复，初始 SNR 5 dB），模型输入噪声、估计失真语音，再相减还原干净语音，模拟主动降噪场景；超参经 200 次随机搜索确定。评估指标为逐时间步 MSE、SNR、SI-SNR，并对时变/时不变模型做参数量公平匹配（n_invar = n_vary(K_A+K_B+K_C)/3）。
AI.result: 四模式系统：数据完全固定时所有模型 MSE=0；数据含切换时，全时变模型（ooo）在所有数据配置下匹配或最优，MSE 约 10^-3~10^-2，而时不变模型在切换 B/C 时 MSE 高达 0.4~1.9（约两个数量级差距）。消融显示：仅 A 时变（oxx）无法补偿 B/C 的切换，效果最差；仅 B 或 C 时变（xox/xxo）即可达 10^-2 量级；A 与 B/C 之一共同时变（oxo、oox）与全时变相当，说明不必全部时变。语音去噪：时变模型一致优于时不变模型，最佳 19.6 dB vs 14.2 dB SI-SNR（起始 5 dB）；所有时不变模型饱和在 7.8±0 dB，即仅学到跨模式平均。深度/宽度：恒等激活下加层或加神经元无显著增益；GELU 下两层优于或持平一层，深度仅在非线性激活下有益；单层时 GELU 改善时不变模型但对时变模型无一致增益。参数量：固定 h 增加每神经元参数量 p 时，时变模型由 13.6→16.5→19.4 dB 持续提升，时不变模型始终停在 7.8 dB，说明增加容量不能弥补结构缺少时变自由度；且在参数量严格相等时（p_vary = p_invar）时变模型仍胜出。基函数分配：把全部预算给 K_A 显著最差（总K=12时仅 6.5 dB），全部给 K_B 或 K_C 最佳（17.5/18.5 dB），在两三个矩阵间均分亦相近（15.6~16.6 dB）。
AI.conclusion: 可学习基函数展开能把连续、平滑的时变动力学注入现代深度 SSM 架构，无需显式切换模式即可捕捉周期性切换行为，训练可经标准 BPTT 完成、推理复杂度与时不变模型相当，为时变系统辨识提供了可行路径。主要经验结论是：时变性应优先分配给输入矩阵 B 与输出矩阵 C 而非状态转移矩阵 A；时不变模型的结构性限制无法用更大规模补偿；深度收益依赖于非线性激活。局限与未来工作：目前仅验证周期性的切换/非平稳设定，非周期非平稳行为待研究；需探索其他基函数族（傅里叶、多项式、径向基等）；与更简单回归方法及非平稳 Transformer 等更复杂架构的基准对比尚待完成。

title: Calibrating LLMs with Semantic-level Reward
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed in consequential settings such as medical question answering and legal reasoning, the ability to estimate when their outputs are likely to be correct is essential for safe and reliable use, requiring well-calibrated uncertainty. Standard reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains models with a binary correctness reward that is indifferent to confidence, providing no penalty for confident but wrong predictions and thereby degrading calibration. Recent work addresses this by training models to produce verbalized confidence scores alongside answers and rewarding agreement with correctness. However, verbalized confidence is calibrated at the token level and thus exhibits inconsistency across textual variations with same semantic meaning. We propose \textbf{Calibration with Semantic Reward (CSR)}, a framework that calibrates language models directly in semantic space without a verbalized confidence interface. CSR combines the correctness reward with a novel semantic calibration reward that encourages exploitation among correct rollouts by promoting semantic agreement, and exploration among incorrect ones by discouraging spurious consistency. Experiments across three model families on HotpotQA (in-distribution) and TriviaQA, MSMARCO, and NQ-Open (out-of-distribution) show that CSR consistently achieves lower ECE and higher AUROC than verbalized-confidence baselines across nearly all settings, reducing ECE by up to $40\%$ and improving AUROC by up to $31\%$ over verbalized-confidence baselines, with calibration behavior generalizing robustly across all four evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CSR（Calibration with Semantic Reward）：放弃“让模型口头报告置信度”的接口，改为在语义空间直接校准 LLM 的不确定性。其做法是在 GRPO 训练中把二元正确性奖励与新的“语义校准奖励”（rollout 间的成对语义一致性与该 rollout 正确性做二元交叉熵对齐）结合，并用线性课程调度 λ(t) 避免单独优化校准项导致的准确率退化。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B 三个模型族、HotpotQA（分布内）与 TriviaQA/MSMARCO/NQ-Open（分布外）上，CSR 的 ECE 与 AUROC 几乎全面优于 RD、RLCR 等口头置信度方法，且 token 成本与 Base/RLVR 相当、远低于 RLCR。
AI.motivation: 标准 RLVR 的二元正确性奖励对置信度“完全不敏感”，猜错且过度自信与弃答得到同等信号，结构性地激励过度自信的猜测；已有实证表明 RL 训练会恶化校准、增加幻觉。近期方法（SaySelf、Rewarding Doubt、RLCR、ConfTuner、LACIE）通过让模型生成 verbalized confidence（口头化置信度）并奖励其与正确性一致来改进校准。但本文用 RLCR 模型做动机实验发现口头置信度并不可靠：(a) 单次采样答案的解码置信度本身不稳定，输出分布中其他取值有相当概率；(b) 多个语义等价的回答给出不一致的置信度；(c) 按语义等价对 rollout 分组后组内置信度方差依然很大。这说明口头置信度校准的是“报告接口”而非模型对答案含义的底层不确定性，且受提示格式、措辞影响，缺乏语义不变性。因此需要一种不依赖置信度报告接口、直接在语义层面建模不确定性的校准范式。
AI.method:
**问题形式化与语义级不确定性**：将校准定义为语义级不确定性——同一问题重复采样所得“含义”的分布；语义上校准良好的模型表现为：正确预测形成集中的语义簇，错误预测语义多样且分散。置信度由语义熵（semantic entropy，K 个 rollout 经双向蕴含聚类为语义等价类后求类分布的 Shannon 熵）给出，置信度代理 c(x)=exp(−SE(x))，无需任何置信度输出接口。

**奖励设计**：
- 正确性奖励 r_RLVR = J(C^(j), C*)，J 为语义等价判定器（精确匹配 / token 级 F1 / LLM 判定）。
- 语义校准奖励 r_calibration = −(1/(K−1)) Σ_{i≠j} CE( J(C^(j), C^(i)), J(C^(j), C*) )，即让每个 rollout 与组内其他 rollout 的成对语义一致性与其自身正确性相匹配：正确 rollout 彼此语义一致（利用/exploitation，形成紧密簇），错误 rollout 相互不一致（探索/exploration，避免虚假一致性）。其期望效果等价于让 E[与新样本的语义一致率 | 本 rollout] 匹配其正确性。
- 命题 1（平均场分解）：组平均校准奖励 ≈ α·E[log p_j | 正确] + (1−α)·E[log(1−p_j) | 错误]，其中 α 为组内经验准确率、p_j 为与新样本的期望一致率。当 α→0 时梯度推动 p_j→0（所有答案最大化多样化，准确率崩塌），当 α→1 时推动 p_j→1（塌缩到单一答案），两种极限下梯度与正确性解耦，存在低准确率退化不动点。

**课程学习与优化**：总奖励 r_CSR = r_RLVR + λ(t)·r_calibration，λ(t)=λ_min+(λ_max−λ_min)·t/T 线性递增（λ_min=0.1、λ_max=0.2），先由 RLVR 建立非零准确率再逐步引入校准项，规避退化。使用 GRPO，组内 K=8 个 rollout 同时用于优势估计与成对语义一致性计算，无额外采样开销。

**实验设置**：在 HotpotQA 的 1 万条样本上用 LoRA（r=32）做 1 epoch RL 微调，评测集为 HotpotQA（分布内）与 TriviaQA、MSMARCO、NQ-Open（分布外）各 1000 条；基线为 Base、RLVR、RD、RLCR；指标为准确率、ECE、AUROC、token 成本；判定器用 GPT-4.1 nano；另比较 LLM 判定器与 token 级 F1 阈值判定器（τ 分别为 0.55/0.70/0.75），并做奖励组件、λ 调度、评测 rollout 预算 K、格式解析率等消融。
AI.result:
**主结果（表 1）**：CSR 在几乎所有模型-数据集组合上取得最低 ECE、最高 AUROC。Llama 上 HotpotQA ECE 0.0783 / AUROC 0.8886（Base 0.1821/0.7666，RLVR 0.1349/0.8118，RD 0.1150/0.8469，RLCR 0.2137/0.6616）；四数据集宏平均 ECE 0.0557、AUROC 0.8076，显著优于 RD（0.1173/0.7662）与 RLCR（0.1745/0.6186）。Qwen 与 Mistral 呈现相同趋势（如 Mistral 宏平均 ECE 0.0474、AUROC 0.8067）。分布外泛化明显：TriviaQA 上 CSR 在所有模型上 ECE 最低、AUROC 最高（Llama 0.0196/0.8577，Qwen 0.0184/0.8702，Mistral 0.0174/0.8436），MSMARCO 与 NQ-Open 上准确率互有优劣但置信度判别力最强。相对 base 模型，CSR 的 ECE 最多降低约 42%、AUROC 提升约 16%；相对口头置信度基线，摘要报告 ECE 最多降低 40%、AUROC 最多提升 31%（不同段落给出的相对口径略有差异）。

**效率（表 1、5.4 节）**：CSR 因需 K=8 个并行 rollout，总 token 成本约为 RLCR 的 1/2.7–1/5.7，与 Base/RLVR 相当；RD 最省 token（单次 rollout、格式紧凑）。

**判定器消融（表 2、3）**：用 token 级 F1 阈值替代 LLM 判定器（CSR-F1）仍显著优于对应 Base-F1/RLVR-F1（如 Qwen 宏平均 ECE 由约 0.20 降至 0.0978），说明收益并非 LLM 判定器的伪影；但整体略逊于 LLM 判定器，尤其 Mistral 上差距明显（宏平均 AUROC 0.7323 vs 0.8067），在短答案/强词面重叠的事实型 QA 上 F1 是更划算的默认选择。

**其他消融（图 4、附录 D.2）**：仅用正确性奖励（RLVR）提升准确率但 ECE 改善有限；仅用校准奖励 AUROC 极高但准确率崩塌，证实命题 1 的退化；两者结合兼顾。常数/线性/sigmoid 三种 λ 调度结果接近，线性略优，说明对调度不敏感。CSR 相对 Base 的 AUROC 优势随评测 rollout 数 K 增大不消失，结构稳健。格式可靠性方面，RD 在 Mistral 上解析率为 0（模型输出小数而非整数分箱），需数值回退；RLCR 存在因思考链耗尽预算而截断的情况，CSR 解析率恒为 1.00。
AI.conclusion: CSR 证明可以在不引入任何显式置信度接口的情况下，通过在语义空间塑造模型答案分布来实现 LLM 校准：把“rollout 间的语义一致性”作为正确性的隐式代理来训练，使语义熵成为可靠的置信度信号。相比口头置信度方法，CSR 在分布内与分布外均取得更低 ECE 与更高 AUROC，且泛化更稳健（因监督作用在语义含义而非特定数据集的置信度格式上）、推理接口成本可比甚至更低。局限：语义等价判定需要 rollout 间的成对 LLM 调用，带来训练时延迟与算力开销，token 级 F1 阈值是高效替代但仍有差距；未来可设计更细粒度的、规则化的一致性度量。总体而言，该工作把“校准”从接口层的报告问题转化为模型输出分布的结构问题，为医疗、法律等高风险场景下的可靠不确定性估计提供了有前景的路线。

title: RTL-BenchMT: Dynamic Maintenance of RTL Generation Benchmark Through Agent-Assisted Analysis and Revision
comment: This paper has been accepted by DAC 2026
summary: This paper introduces RTL-BenchMT, an agentic framework for dynamically maintaining RTL generation benchmarks. Large Language Models (LLMs) assisted automated RTL generation is one of the most important directions in EDA research. However, current RTL benchmarks face two critical challenges: (1) flawed cases in the benchmarks and (2) overfitting to the benchmarks. Both challenges are difficult to resolve purely by manual engineering effort. To address these issues and systematically reduce human maintenance costs, we propose an automated agentic framework, RTL-BenchMT. RTL-BenchMT focuses on two key applications: (1) automatically identifying and revising flawed benchmark cases and (2) automatically detecting and updating overfitting cases. With the assistance of RTL-BenchMT, we conduct a thorough, in-depth analysis of flawed and overfitting cases and produce a refined benchmark suite that will be open-sourced to the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RTL-BenchMT，一个用于动态维护RTL生成基准测试的智能体框架，旨在解决现有基准测试中的缺陷案例和过度拟合两大挑战，通过自动化方式降低人工维护成本。
AI.motivation: 当前RTL基准测试面临两个关键挑战：基准测试中存在缺陷案例，以及模型对基准测试的过度拟合。这两个问题难以通过纯人工工程方式解决。
AI.method: 提出RTL-BenchMT智能体框架，包含两个核心功能模块：缺陷案例识别与修订、过度拟合案例检测与更新。
AI.result: 对有缺陷和过度拟合的案例进行了全面深入分析，生成了精炼的基准测试套件。
AI.conclusion: 通过RTL-BenchMT框架自动化维护RTL生成基准测试，显著降低人工成本，生成高质量基准套件并计划开源。

title: Beyond Bounded Variance: Variance-Reduced Normalized Methods for Nonconvex Optimization under Blum-Gladyshev Noise
summary: We study nonconvex stochastic optimization under the Blum-Gladyshev ($\mathsf{BG}$-0) noise model, where the stochastic gradient variance grows quadratically with the distance from the initialization. We consider this problem under both standard smoothness and the symmetric generalized-smoothness framework, which captures objectives whose local curvature can scale with the gradient norm. We prove that normalized stochastic gradient descent with momentum, using only one stochastic gradient per iteration, converges under $\mathsf{BG}$-0 noise with oracle complexity $O(\varepsilon^{-6})$. This rate holds both for standard smoothness and for $α$-symmetric generalized smoothness, showing that generalized smoothness is rate-neutral for normalized momentum in this setting. We then study a variance-reduced normalized STORM method. Under mean-square smoothness and sharp initialization, the method achieves the minimax optimal $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ complexity, matching the lower bound. Under expected $α$-symmetric generalized smoothness, the STORM recursion couples gradient-dependent smoothness with distance-dependent noise, leading to complexity $O(\varepsilon^{-(4+α)})$ for $α\in(0,1)$ and $O(\varepsilon^{-5})$ for $α=1$. When the distance-growth parameter in the noise model vanishes, our guarantees recover the standard bounded-variance rates: $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ for momentum, $O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ for variance reduction, and $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ in the deterministic case. To our knowledge, these are the first convergence guarantees for normalized methods in non-convex stochastic optimization under $\mathsf{BG}$-0 noise without bounded domains, increasing batch sizes, or explicit anchoring, covering both standard and generalized smoothness regimes.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次在BG-0噪声模型下为归一化优化方法提供了收敛保证，证明归一化动量方法复杂度为O(ε^-6)，而方差缩减STORM方法在标准平滑下达到最优O(ε^-4)，在广义平滑下复杂度为O(ε^-(4+α))。
AI.motivation: Blum-Gladyshev（BG-0）噪声模型中，随机梯度方差随初始化距离二次增长，突破了传统有界方差假设的限制，为非凸随机优化提供了更真实的噪声建模。
AI.method: 研究了两种方法：1）带动量的归一化随机梯度下降（SGD），每迭代仅使用一个随机梯度；2）方差缩减的归一化STORM方法。分别在标准平滑性和对称广义平滑性框架下进行分析。
AI.result: 带动量的归一化SGD在BG-0噪声下达到O(ε^-6)复杂度；归一化STORM在均方平滑性下达到O(ε^-4)（匹配下界），在α-对称广义平滑性下达到O(ε^-(4+α))（α∈(0,1)）或O(ε^-5)（α=1）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次为BG-0噪声模型下的归一化方法提供了收敛保证，无需有界域、批量增加或显式锚定。在标准平滑假设下，动量方法达到O(ε^-6)，STORM达到O(ε^-4)（ minimax最优）；在广义平滑框架下，动量方法复杂度保持不变，而STORM方法复杂度为O(ε^-(4+α))或O(ε^-5)。当噪声距离增长参数消失时，可恢复到标准有界方差率。

title: MHGraphBench: Knowledge Graph-Grounded Benchmarking of Mental Health Knowledge in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to GEM 2026, ACL 2026 Workshop; 9 pages main text plus references and appendices
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in the mental health domain, yet it remains unclear how well they capture related biomedical knowledge and how reliably they apply it to clinically salient structured judgments. Here, we present a knowledge-graph (KG)-grounded benchmark for assessing LLMs on mental-health entity recognition, relation judgment, and two-hop reasoning. The benchmark is derived from PrimeKG and comprises nine task families with KG-supported answers and controlled negative options. Experiments across 15 closed- and open-source LLMs reveal a persistent recognition-to-judgment gap: leading models achieve near-ceiling performance on entity typing and on the small relation-typing subset, yet they still struggle with relation prediction and two-hop reasoning. Additionally, short KG-derived snippets benefit some models but degrade performance for others. Moreover, output-format reliability can substantially influence measured performance under constrained multiple-choice settings, highlighting the critical role of response validity in benchmark-based evaluation. MHGraphBench should therefore be interpreted as evaluating agreement with a curated mental-health slice of PrimeKG under a constrained multiple-choice interface, rather than as a direct assessment of real-world clinical safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MHGraphBench基准，用于评估LLM在心理健康领域的生物医学知识捕捉和临床判断能力，涵盖9个任务族，测试15个模型，发现模型在实体识别上表现优异但在关系预测和多跳推理上存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: LLM在心理健康领域的应用日益广泛，但其对相关生物医学知识的掌握程度及临床判断可靠性尚不明确，需要系统性的评估基准。
AI.method: 基于PrimeKG构建知识图谱支持的基准测试，涵盖9个任务族，包括实体识别、关系判断和两跳推理；测试15个闭源和开源LLM，使用KG支持的答案和受控负样本。
AI.result: 主要模型在实体类型识别和小规模关系类型子集上接近满分表现，但在关系预测和两跳推理上表现不佳；短KG派生片段对部分模型有益但对其他模型反而降低性能；输出格式可靠性显著影响约束多选题设置下的测量性能。
AI.conclusion: 存在"识别-判断鸿沟"现象；MHGraphBench应被解释为在约束多选题界面下对PrimeKG心理健康切片的符合度评估，而非现实世界临床安全性的直接评估。

title: DRS-GUI: Dynamic Region Search for Training-Free GUI Grounding
summary: GUI agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capability in understanding and executing user instructions. However, accurately grounding instruction-relevant elements from high-resolution screenshots cluttered with irrelevant UI components remains challenging for existing approaches. Inspired by how humans dynamically adjust their perceptual scope to locate task-related regions on complex screens, we propose DRS-GUI, a training-free dynamic region search framework for GUI grounding that can be seamlessly integrated into existing MLLMs. DRS-GUI introduces a lightweight UI Perceptor that performs three human-like perceptual actions (Focus, Shift, and Scatter) to progressively explore the interface and generate region proposals. To dynamically schedule these actions, we further design an Action Planner based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). A region quality reward is employed to evaluate and select the highly instruction-relevant region, efficiently pruning redundant UI elements. Experiments demonstrate that DRS-GUI yields a 14\% improvement on ScreenSpot-Pro for general and GUI-specific MLLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-7B and UGround-V1-7B), significantly enhancing grounding performance and generalization.

AI.tldr: DRS-GUI 是一个免训练的 GUI 定位（grounding）增强框架：在多模态大模型（MLLM）执行坐标预测之前，先通过轻量级 UI Perceptor 解析界面元素并计算指令相关性分数，再由基于 MCTS 的 Action Planner 在 Focus（收缩聚焦）、Shift（转移注意力）、Scatter（扩散扩展）三种类人感知动作之间进行动态搜索，并依据"区域质量奖励"选出最优区域，最后只在该区域内让基础 MLLM 完成定位。在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上对 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 UGround-V1-7B 分别带来约 14.1% 与 14.3% 的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体的可靠性高度依赖 grounding（从自然语言指令定位到具体 UI 元素）。但真实 GUI 截图分辨率高、元素密集、视觉冗余大，现有方法存在两类缺陷：(1) 单步全屏预测范式（SeeClick、OS-Atlas、UGround 等）缺乏对注意力的显式控制，容易被背景干扰；(2) 多步迭代裁剪/缩放范式（ECP、R-VLM、DiMo-GUI、LASER）虽逐步聚焦，但"只进不退"，一旦早期轨迹偏离语义线索就会累积误差且无法回溯。作者受人类视觉搜索行为启发（会扫描布局、逐步精化注意力、在不确定时回退或转移注意），指出可靠的 GUI grounding 框架应具备两大能力：动态感知（能修正/转移视野）与区域质量评估（每一步给出可度量的"是否靠近目标"的信号）。此外，此类"think-with-image"策略本身也需考虑推理开销，因此需要一个高效、可逆的搜索决策过程。
AI.method: 将 grounding 重构为 "search-then-predict" 过程：R_best = π_S(S_full, T)，再由基础模型在 R_best 内定位 p = M(R_best, T)。核心为两个协作模块。(1) UI Perceptor：基于 OmniParser V2 将区域解析为结构化元素集合 u_i = [b_i, d_i, i_i]（框、语义描述、可交互标记），用 instructor-large 嵌入器对指令与元素描述编码时前置"领域特定前缀" P_d（按应用类型与系统类型设定），计算余弦相似度 s_i 作为指令相关性分数；据此实现三种感知动作：Focus（取 top-p% 高相关元素，剔除偏离聚类质心的空间离群点，最小包围盒收缩，不足收缩比则迭代剪枝）；Shift（当高相关线索位于空间分离区域时，按一致布局方向分组并重定位，保证与上一区域最小重叠）；Scatter（当前区域语义线索不足时，收集区域外高相关元素扩展视野，并限制放大比例避免过度扩张）。(2) MCTS Action Planner：将区域状态 S=(R, U, {s_i}) 作为搜索树节点，动作为 Focus/Shift/Scatter，采用 UCT 策略 (a* = argmax[Q(S,a)+c√(ln V(S)/V(S,a))]) 做节点选择、Expansion、Simulation 与 Backpropagation，根节点以一步 Focus 初始化，搜索结束取奖励最高区域交给基础 MLLM。区域质量奖励由三项加权组合：交互加权相关性 r_rel（可交互元素权重 1，其余 λ<1）、UI 覆盖一致性 r_cov（元素面积和/区域面积）、语义集中度 r_con（温度归一化后归一化熵的补），r = α·r_rel + β·r_cov + γ·r_con。实现上 OmniParser V2 与 Instructor-large 均不微调；Focus 保留 top 15% 元素，Scatter 加入 top 10% 外部元素且面积扩张限 1.5×，Shift 以 top 15% 外部锚点重定位并要求 IoU≤0.3；MCTS rollout 预算 N=8、深度上限 H=3、UCT 探索常数 c=1，奖励权重 α=β=0.4、γ=0.2，两块 NVIDIA A6000。
AI.result: ScreenSpot-Pro：Qwen2.5-VL-3B 16.1→28.7，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 26.8→40.9（+14.1），UGround-V1-2B 26.8→38.3，UGround-V1-7B 31.4→45.7（+14.3）；增强后的 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 超过 OS-Atlas-7B（18.9）。ScreenSpot-V2：Qwen2.5-VL-7B 86.5→90.5（约 +4），UGround-V1-7B 87.6→91.8（约 +4.2）。ScreenSpot-V1：Qwen2.5-VL-7B 84.9→88.9，UGround-V1-7B 86.3→89.9；增益在 icon/widget 类目上更明显。冗余度分析显示聚焦后的裁剪平均将输入像素面积与 UI 元素数量分别削减约 64% 与 54%。消融：仅 Focus 提升 2.2%，Focus+Shift 达 91.0%，三动作全用达最优 91.8%；奖励项单独 r_rel 提升 2.0%，三项组合最优（+1.9~3.5）。迭代预算 N 增大持续提升，N=8 后收益边际递减，故取 N=8。
AI.conclusion: DRS-GUI 以"先搜索、后预测"的解耦设计，将"看哪里"与"预测什么"分离：通过 UI Perceptor、三种类人感知动作、MCTS 规划器与区域质量奖励实现可逆的动态区域搜索，在不训练、不微调的前提下可即插即用地增强通用与 GUI 专用 MLLM，在高分辨率、元素密集的界面上提升显著（ScreenSpot-Pro 约 14%），证明有效的 grounding 更依赖自适应感知搜索而非单纯扩大模型规模。局限与后续方向：依赖 OmniParser 解析质量与额外感知模块的推理开销（仅两卡实验）、奖励权重需按域设定，且动作空间与领域前缀仍可进一步自动化。

title: From Weight Perturbation to Feature Attribution for Explaining Fully Connected Neural Networks
summary: Fully Connected Neural Networks (FCNNs) are often regarded as simple and intuitive architectures, yet they serve as the foundation for more complex models. Nonetheless, the lack of consensus on their interpretability continues to pose challenges, underscoring the enduring relevance of simpler, attribution-based approaches for understanding even the most advanced neural architectures. In this regard, we explore a novel idea for estimating feature attribution, by applying perturbation to the features' attached weights instead of their values. This method offers a fresh perspective aimed at mitigating common limitations in Occlusion techniques, such as Added Bias and Out-of-Distribution data. The application of this rule leads to the formation of a pair of novel attribution methods we call XWP and XWP_c. Founded on simple rules, our methods achieve competitive performance in identifying image signals for simple DNNs, competing with the most established attribution methods on standard baseline metrics. Our work thus contributes to the field of Explainability by introducing a robust framework that paves the way for addressing these long-standing vulnerabilities, and leads to more reliable and interpretable model explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「权重扰动式特征归因」框架：不遮挡/扰动输入，而是将输入层神经元所连接的权重从训练态回退到未训练（初始）态，用模型输出的变化量作为该特征的归因得分，由此得到 XWP 与 XWP_c 两种方法；在 Typeface MNIST 与 Fashion MNIST 的 FCNN 上与 OCCL、SHAP、RISE、IG、LRP 对比，量化指标接近 SHAP/IG，热力图更干净、噪声与伪影更少。
AI.motivation: 全连接网络（FCNN）虽结构简单、却是 Transformer 等复杂架构的基础，但其可解释性仍缺乏共识。现有归因方法分为梯度类（Vanilla Gradient、Integrated Gradients）、反向传播类（LRP、DeepLIFT）与扰动/遮挡类（LIME、SHAP、RISE、Occlusion Sensitivity、Meaningful Perturbations）。其中扰动类方法存在两个理论缺陷：（1）Added Bias 问题——基线（baseline）值往往不是"无信息"，而是引入模型的固有偏置与图像统计特征；（2）Out-of-Distribution 问题——遮挡生成的样本落在训练分布之外，模型对其响应不可靠，导致归因不稳定、出现伪影。另一个方向是权重贡献/机制可解释性（Olah 等的权重可视化与神经元优化、B-cos、Embedded Methods），但这些方法无法给出输入神经元贡献的定量度量。作者希望寻找一种既能利用权重中可解释的模式结构（空间结构），又能规避输入扰动基线选择难题的归因框架。
AI.method: 1) 数学标注：将 FCNN 视为计算图 f=f^L∘…∘f^0，层 l 输出 x^l_j=Σ_i z^{l-1}_i·w^l_ij + b^l_j，经 ReLU 激活（末层用 Softmax）；定义输入层神经元 i 的第一层权重集合 W_i={w_ij}。2) 模式形成观察：可视化第一层权重 W^T_j 可发现可解释的图案（数字 0-9 的形状模式），证明输入特征之间存在空间结构；但单个权重的解释无法直接转化为神经元贡献的定量度量。3) XWP（Explainable Weight Perturbation）：将输入层神经元 i 的权重从训练态 W_i 替换为未训练态 W^o_i，得到 f_{W_i=W^o_i}(x)，并以 R_i(x)=I^t·(f(x) − f_{W_i=W^o_i}(x)) 作为得分，其中奖励信号 I^t_{n^L} 在输出神经元等于目标 t 时为 1、不等时为 −1（即目标类置信上升或非目标类置信下降记为正向贡献）。中间层参数保持不变（假设其作用在输入神经元间均匀共享），扰动只发生在参数空间而非输入空间，且基线由模型自身初始状态提供，无需人工基线或统计假设。4) XWP_c：互补规则，将除 i 以外所有输入层神经元的权重回退到初始态（i'≠i），衡量"仅凭自身"所取得的贡献。5) 实验设置：标准 FCNN（784-400-100-10，ReLU+Softmax），10 epoch 内测试精度 >90%，RTX 4060；数据集为 Typeface MNIST（29,900 张 28×28 多字体数字）与 Fashion MNIST（60,000/10,000）；基线方法为 OCCL、SHAP、RISE、IG、LRP；指标为 Deletion AUC（越低越好）与 Average Drop（掩蔽 20% 最高分区域，越高越好），并配合热力图可视化与 Deletion AUC 曲线演变。
AI.result: TMNIST：SHAP 最佳（AD 0.357 / AUC 0.095），IG 次之（0.35/0.157），XWP_c（0.352/0.162）与 XWP（0.308/0.138）、OCCL（0.327/0.126）、LRP（0.285/0.203）、RISE（0.33/0.17）依次；XWP 在 Deletion AUC 上表现强。FMNIST：IG 最佳（0.661/0.461），XWP_c（0.655/0.524）、XWP（0.647/0.473）、SHAP（0.633/0.491）、RISE（0.622/0.564）、OCCL（0.636/0.489）、LRP（0.645/0.551）。总体上 SHAP 与 IG 以小幅优势领先，XWP/XWP_c 紧随其后但跨评估更稳定；XWP_c 在 Average Drop 上更优，热力图最干净、无明显伪影且能体现多义神经元的负向模式，XWP 的热力图则更聚焦。作者也承认：个别情况下单个特征变化的效果与输入信号本身不完全一致（表现与 Occlusion 相似），这是因为 XWP 面向"模型更新/泛化需求"而非"当前输入响应"，这一差距由 XWP_c 弥补（移除其他变更效应、增大距离度量）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出基于权重扰动的可解释性框架，将遮挡思想从输入空间迁移到参数空间，从而规避 Added Bias 与 OOD 基线问题，并通过权重图案中的空间结构得到更干净、更稳定、更可解释的解释。XWP 与 XWP_c 构成互补视角（"在所有更新中我贡献了什么"与"仅凭我自己贡献了什么"），在简单 DNN 上与最成熟方法竞争且稳定性更优。局限与展望：实验仅用相对简单的数据集（基线选择难题被弱化）与 FCNN，尚未验证于 CNN、Transformer 等更复杂架构；与因果分析的结合是后续方向，作者称之为解决遮挡理论难题的"关键第一步"。

title: Syntax Without Semantics: Teaching Large Language Models to Code in an Unseen Language
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high pass rates on code generation benchmarks, yet whether they can transfer this ability to languages absent from pretraining remains poorly understood. We introduce PyLang, a minimal imperative language absent from all pretraining corpora, and evaluate frontier models zero-shot and fine-tuned Qwen3 (4B, 8B, 32B) on 352 problems. We find that fine-tuning quickly teaches syntax but fails to transfer semantic competence: Python outperforms PyLang by up to 19% across all configurations, and no intervention (multi-task learning, preference tuning, code infilling, or latent-space objectives) closes the gap. An LLM judge reveals that frontier models select an identical algorithm to Python 80% of the time, yet cannot translate it into a working PyLang implementation., and CKA analysis confirms that fine-tuned models converge to nearly identical internal representations across languages (CKA > 0.97) while diverging at the output stage. We term this the implementation fidelity gap: models possess language-agnostic algorithmic understanding but cannot express it in an unfamiliar language. Our findings highlight the need for training methods that decouple reasoning from language-specific realization.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了LLM代码生成能力中存在"实现保真度差距"：模型虽具备语言无关的算法理解能力，但无法在陌生编程语言中准确实现，即使通过多种干预手段也无法克服。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在代码生成基准测试中达到高通过率，但其能否将这种能力迁移到预训练中从未见过的语言，目前尚不清楚。这一问题对于理解模型的真正泛化能力至关重要。
AI.method: 引入PyLang（一种预训练语料中不存在的极简命令式语言），对Qwen3（4B、8B、32B）模型进行零样本和微调评估，测试352道题目。并采用多任务学习、偏好调优、代码填充和潜在空间目标等多种干预手段，探索是否能弥合语言能力差距。使用CKA（中心核对齐）分析模型内部表征，并让LLM评判者分析算法选择的一致性。
AI.result: 微调能快速教会模型语法，但无法迁移语义能力：Python在所有配置下均比PyLang高出最多19%；即使尝试多种干预措施都无法弥合这一差距。LLM评判者发现前沿模型在80%的情况下选择了与Python相同的算法，却无法将其转化为有效的PyLang实现。CKA分析证实微调后的模型在内部表征上几乎完全一致（CKA > 0.97），但输出阶段出现分化。
AI.conclusion: 模型存在"实现保真度差距"（implementation fidelity gap）：虽然具备语言无关的算法理解能力，但无法在陌生语言中表达出来。这表明需要开发将推理能力与语言特定实现解耦的训练方法。

title: Position: Artificial Intelligence Needs Meta Intelligence -- the Case for Metacognitive AI
comment: This is a preliminary version accepted for presentation and publication at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML26). The modified final version will be available in the conference proceedings
summary: This position paper argues for metacognition as a general design principle for creating more accurate, secure, and efficient AI. The metacognitive solution involves systems monitoring their own states and judiciously allocating resources depending on each problem instance's difficulty or cost of mistakes. Drawing inspiration both from past work on resource-rational AI and from well-documented metacognitive strategies in psychology and cognitive science, we identify specific challenges in embedding these strategies into AI design and highlight open theoretical and implementation problems. We showcase these principles through a tangible example of improved learning efficiency, effectiveness, and security in a Federated Learning (FL) case study. We show how these principles can be translated into practice with a novel software framework developed specifically to allow the community to design, deploy, and experiment with metacognition-enabled AI applications.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将"元认知"作为AI设计的通用原则，使系统能够自我监控状态并根据问题难度智能分配资源。通过结合资源理性AI和认知科学策略，识别了嵌入这些策略的具体挑战，并以联邦学习为案例验证了其实用价值，同时开发了配套软件框架。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在准确性、安全性和效率方面仍面临挑战，需要一种通用的设计原则来系统性解决这些问题，使AI系统能够智能地自我调节资源分配。
AI.method: 整合资源理性AI和认知科学中的元认知策略，提出通用设计原则；通过联邦学习（FL）案例研究验证概念；开发专门的软件框架以支持元认知赋能AI应用的设计、部署和实验。
AI.result: 在联邦学习场景中验证了元认知原则能够提升学习效率、效果和安全性；开发了支持元认知AI应用开发的软件框架。
AI.conclusion: 文章提出将元认知作为AI设计的通用原则，通过FL案例验证了其实用价值，并开发了专门的软件框架供社区使用，为后续研究提供了工具支持。

title: PSD: Pushing the Pareto Frontier of Diffusion LLMs via Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked token sequences. Although dLLMs can predict all masked positions in parallel within each step, the large number of denoising iterations still makes inference expensive. This cost can be reduced spatially by unmasking multiple tokens per step, or temporally by collapsing multiple denoising steps into one verification call. We propose Parallel Speculative Decoding (PSD), a training-free framework that jointly improves inference along both axes. Using the confidence scores from a single forward pass, PSD selects positions to unmask via a configurable, adaptive unmasking policy and constructs multi-depth speculative drafts without extra model calls. A final batched verification pass then applies hierarchical acceptance, keeping the deepest draft that remains consistent with the updated predictions. Experiments on three dLLMs across reasoning and code generation tasks show that PSD achieves favorable trade-offs between inference efficiency and generation quality, reaching up to $5.5\times$ tokens per forward pass with accuracy comparable to greedy decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Parallel Speculative Decoding (PSD)，一种无需训练的推理加速框架，通过置信度驱动的自适应解蒙版策略和多深度投机草案机制，在单次前向传播中完成位置选择与草案构建，再通过分层验证保留最深的有效草案。实验表明该方法在保持生成质量的同时可实现高达5.5倍的token处理效率提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）虽然能在每步内并行预测所有掩码位置，但大量去噪迭代导致推理成本高昂。现有方法仅沿空间（每步解蒙版多个token）或时间（将多步去噪合并为一次验证调用）单一维度优化，未能实现两者的协同提升。
AI.method: PSD利用单次前向传播的置信度分数，通过可配置的适应性解蒙版策略选择待解蒙版的位置，构建多深度投机草案而无需额外模型调用。最终通过批量验证传递应用分层接受策略，保留与更新后预测保持一致的最深草案。
AI.result: 在三种dLLM上的推理和代码生成任务实验中，PSD实现了推理效率与生成质量之间的良好权衡，达成最高5.5倍的前向传播token数提升，且准确率与贪婪解码相当。
AI.conclusion: PSD是一种无需训练的推理加速框架，通过联合优化空间和时间维度，显著提升扩散语言模型的推理效率，同时保持与贪婪解码相当的生成质量。

title: STAR: A Stage-attributed Triage and Repair framework for RCA Agents in Microservices
summary:
LLM-based root cause analysis (RCA) agents have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for incident diagnosis in microservice AIOps. However, their reliability remains fragile: an error in early evidence collection, hypothesis formulation, or causal analysis can propagate through the reasoning trace and eventually corrupt the final diagnosis. In this paper, we present \textbf{STAR}, a \emph{Stage-attributed Triage and Repair} framework for repairing erroneous RCA traces. STAR explicitly decomposes an RCA workflow into four structured stages, namely \emph{Evidence Package} (EP), \emph{Hypothesis Set} (HS), \emph{Analysis Structure} (AS), and \emph{Decision Report} (DR), and treats agent failure as a stage-localizable reasoning bug rather than a monolithic end-to-end error. Built on top of LangGraph, STAR performs stage-wise auditing, budget-aware \emph{Fast/Slow Routing}, \emph{decisive stage localization via counterfactual candidate evaluation}, and stage-specific patch-and-replay repair.
  We evaluate STAR on a public large-scale benchmark and a real-world production dataset, using two RCA agent workflows and three foundation models. Experimental results show that STAR consistently improves both root cause localization and fault type classification over strong baselines. Moreover, STAR identifies the decisive faulty stage with high accuracy, repairs most initially incorrect traces within one or two replay rounds, and benefits substantially from both Fast/Slow Routing and counterfactual stage evaluation. These results suggest that explicitly modeling \emph{where} an RCA agent fails is an effective path toward reliable, debuggable, and self-repairing agentic RCA systems.

AI.tldr: STAR是一种基于阶段归因的RCA（根因分析）智能体错误修复框架，通过将RCA工作流分解为四个结构化阶段（证据包、假设集、分析结构、决策报告），实现阶段级错误定位与针对性修复，而非将错误视为端到端问题。
AI.motivation: LLM-based RCA agents在微服务AIOps中的可靠性脆弱，早期阶段的错误（证据收集、假设生成或因果分析）会沿推理链传播并最终污染最终诊断结果。
AI.method: STAR基于LangGraph构建，包含四个核心机制：(1)四阶段结构化分解：EP(Evidence Package)、HS(Hypothesis Set)、AS(Analysis Structure)、DR(Decision Report)；(2)阶段级审计机制；(3)预算感知的Fast/Slow Routing策略；(4)基于反事实候选评估的决定性阶段定位；(5)阶段特定的patch-and-replay修复。
AI.result: 在公开大规模基准测试和真实生产数据集上，使用2种RCA agent工作流和3种基础模型进行评估。STAR在根因定位和故障类型分类上均优于强基线；能高精度识别决定性故障阶段；大多数初始错误轨迹在1-2轮重放中即可修复；Fast/Slow Routing和反事实阶段评估均带来显著收益。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模RCA agent"在哪里"失败是构建可靠、可调试、自修复的agentic RCA系统的有效途径。

title: Bounded-Rationality, Hedging, and Generalization
summary: A learner does not only fit data; it also determines how strongly the training sample may shape its output and how much distortion it can hedge. We study this relation as a bounded-rational decision problem whose primitive object is the induced channel from samples to outputs. The learner's response law determines which changes in this channel are cheap or costly, and therefore induces both a lower tradeoff curve between training loss and sample dependence and a matched upper certificate curve. When the response law is represented by an $f$-divergence regularizer, these curves live in the regularizer's native information geometry, with KL as the special case corresponding to Shannon mutual information. We show how the hedge and the two curves can be recovered from black-box behavior by observing responses to scaled losses and local loss perturbations. In learning, population loss is empirical loss plus the distortion induced by the particular training sample. The recovered hedge gives a practical certificate when it covers that distortion. Thus generalization is treated as a testable hedging property of the learner's own response law.

AI.tldr: 论文把学习者/决策者的响应律（样本→输出的诱导通道 P(A|S)）当作原始对象，用信息论有限理性（自由能 = 期望损失 + (1/β)·f-散度正则）刻画"样本依赖的代价"；通过 Fenchel 对偶把该正则解释为内生对冲：最优对抗扰动恰是原生信息代价关于通道的泛函梯度。由此得到两条配对曲线——原生下界前沿（可达损失的率失真型前沿）与上界证书前沿（对冲保护的损失水平），且证书值等于确定性等价值 L + I_f(S;A)/β。整套几何可由黑箱行为（损失缩放、局部损失扰动、操作路径）反推。最终把泛化刻画为学习者自身响应律的对冲性质：总体损失 = 经验损失 + 通道加权的样本失真，当恢复出的原生对冲覆盖该失真时即得到可检验证书。
AI.motivation: 经典泛化分析（PAC-Bayes、稳定性、信息论界）都在给定通道 P(A|S) 的前提下，依靠分析者外部提供的先验、复杂度度量或尾界，回答"泛化差距最大能有多大"；本文追问的是：在没有外部参照时，通道本身对差距蕴含了什么。学习不仅拟合数据，还决定训练样本能在多大程度上塑造输出、以及允许多大失真被对冲——过拟合可视为对样本特有结构的"失真暴露"。因此以响应律为原始对象，识别其隐式（原生）正则与信息几何，内生地构造对冲与证书，使泛化从"给定假设下的上界"变成"学习者自身响应律的可检验对冲属性"。同时作者强调不使用任何外部给定的参照分布或复杂度惩罚，区别于 DRO 那种先给定歧义集的做法。
AI.method: 1) 有限理性行动：以自由能泛函 F_β[P(A|S)] = L + (1/β)·D_f(P(a|s)‖P(a)) 建模，f 取凸下半连续、f(1)=0、f'(1)=0 的规范代表（KL、Pearson χ²、平方 Hellinger，另含 reverse KL、Neyman χ²、TV、Jensen–Shannon、triangular、hockey-stick）；原生信息坐标 I_f(S;A)=D_f(P(S,A)‖P(S)P(A))。2) 对偶与对冲：Fenchel 对偶把正则写成"对偶惩罚"形式；再做通道级变分（含 P(A) 自洽约束）得最优扰动 C_s^opt(a)=(1/β)[f'(P(a|s)/P(a))+G(a)]，G 为共享边缘 P(A) 引入的跨刺激耦合修正（KL 时 G=0）；无差异条件 ℓ(s,a)+C_s^opt(a)=λ_s（支撑外为不等式），等价于"等惩罚等距曲线法线即策略"；由此定义对抗类 C、证书值 L_f^adv = L + I_f(S;A)/β 与 certainty-equivalent 值相等；并借数据处理不等式给出二元 f-散度尾部转移的高概率界。3) 前沿与跨正则比较：下界前沿 Γ_f 即原生率失真前沿 D_f(R)（有界理性最优是其 Lagrange 参数化，KL 情形给出 Gibbs 形式与 Blahut–Arimoto 不动点）；上界证书前沿逐点配对、间隙=I_f(β)/β；跨正则比较通过把同一通道投影到参照坐标 I_g。4) 黑箱反推：重复观测估计通道与工作损失；损失缩放 t∈[0,1] 得 L_f^adv=∫₀¹L(t)dt；操作路径用 d log β=−dL_adv/(L_adv−L) 与 I_f=β(L_adv−L) 恢复 β 与原生坐标（差一个由 f→cf、β→cβ 带来的乘性常数）；局部损失扰动借无差异关系恢复局部对冲（差刺激级常数，由证书间隙固定）。5) 学习应用：以逐观测损失与 1/(βn) 缩放；样本失真 C_{s,n}(a)=L̄(a)−ℓ_n(s,a) 在乘积律下零均值；重加权恒等式 ∫∫P(s)P(a)[P(a|s)/P(a)−1]C_{s,n} 把总体−经验差距归因于通道似然比位移；证书条件为通道加权盈余 ∫∫P(s,a)[C_opt−C]≥0。
AI.result: 理论与实证结论：(a) 同一正则同时生成原生下界前沿与匹配证书前沿，二者逐点由 L_adv−L=I_f(β)/β 配对，信息代价与对冲溢价是同一量的两种读法；(b) KL 是唯一使 G(a)=0 且原生坐标退化为 Shannon 互信息的情形，此时前沿即 Shannon 率失真前沿，最优通道满足 Blahut–Arimoto 不动点；(c) 实证上可从黑箱行为反推原生几何：图 1 中同一 4×4 类别任务上 KL/Pearson χ²/平方 Hellinger 三个学习者的下界与证书曲线由干预样本成功恢复并与理论曲线吻合；图 8 在固定设计回归（n=100 的等距设计、y=0.8sin(πx)+0.25x+ε）中，用 200 个 k-means 预测码本 + 指数软分配构造经验通道，对单隐层 32 单元 ReLU（Adam 1e-3，训练时长为控制量）与高斯核岭回归（岭参数为控制量）估计出损失曲线与证书曲线，并投影到 Shannon 坐标（损失与证书不变），bootstrap 区间显示估计稳定性；(d) 三个推论：危险样本是"对冲赤字样本"（可能低损失却危险、高损失却无害）；等大中心扰动可产生相反效果（两刺激两动作例中为 ±c(2q−1)），故标量移位距离不足以排序风险；减少样本依赖未必改善泛化（对剪枝、强正则、标签平滑给出统一重解读）；(e) 另有基于二元 f-散度的通道级尾界（KL、χ²、Hellinger 各给出显式形式），但作者说明高概率陈述仍属超出正文范围。
AI.conclusion: 核心主张：泛化是学习者自身响应律的内生对冲属性，可用"恢复出的原生对冲是否覆盖样本失真"作为可检验判据；健壮性编码在行为中，f-散度正则既定义依赖的原生几何也定义保护类，证书在扰动落在该类内时有效、否则可能任意差。与经典分析的关系是互补：外部假设提供在分析者模型下的一致性保证，原生对冲提供针对所观测响应律的"工作点证书"，二者可结合（用外部假设控制尾部、保留原生对冲作为证书来源）。明确局限：证书仅为期望值层面，高概率结论需要额外的乘积律尾界与原生尾部转移（作者列为下一步）；恢复仅在响应几何稳定、无差异关系/证书恒等式/路径关系残差可检验的范围内有效；操作路径必须留在同一正则体制内，改变架构、优化器、数据增强或噪声模型等会切换体制；f 的识别依赖"学习者近似求解正则化目标"这一较强假设，且存在内在尺度自由度；跨正则投影到 Shannon 平面可能破坏原生 Pareto 最优性。应用展望：grokking、双下降、学习率调度、RL 中的奖励误设/模拟器偏差、偏好模型误差等均可被重述为"响应几何如何改变、所得对冲能吸收哪些失真"的问题。

title: Toward LLMs Beyond English-Centric Development
summary: Through an analysis of sequences generated by open-weight large language models (LLMs), we demonstrate that LLMs are heavily biased toward English. While continual pre-training is commonly used to adapt LLMs to a target language, we show that it does not offer a cost advantage over training from scratch, even for improving cultural understanding in the target language. These findings suggest that dedicated per-language investment may become increasingly important for future LLM development, rather than relying primarily on the expansion of English-centric resources.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM存在强烈的英语偏见，而持续预训练在适应其他语言方面并不比从零训练更经济，暗示未来需对每种语言进行专门投入。
AI.motivation: 开源权重LLM存在严重的英语偏见，需要评估通过持续预训练适应目标语言是否具有成本优势。
AI.method: 通过对开源权重大语言模型生成的序列进行分析，比较持续预训练（continual pre-training）与从零训练的成本效益。
AI.result: 持续预训练在提高目标语言文化理解方面，相较于从零训练并未展现出成本优势。
AI.conclusion: 未来LLM开发可能需要专门的每种语言投资策略，而非主要依赖英语资源的扩展。

title: See Before You Code: Learning Visual Priors for Spatially Aware Educational Animation Generation
summary: Large language models can generate executable code for educational animations, but the resulting renders often exhibit visual defects, including element overlap, misalignment, and broken animation continuity. These defects cannot be reliably detected from the code alone and become apparent only after execution. We formalize this problem as render-feedback-aware constrained code generation: given a natural language specification, the model must generate executable code whose rendered output satisfies structured quality criteria that can be evaluated only after rendering. To address this problem, we introduce OmniManim, a render-feedback-aware educational animation generation framework built around a shared scene state, explicit visual planning, structured post-render diagnostics, and localized repair. Within OmniManim, the Vision Agent is a task-specific visual planning module: it predicts sparse keyframe layouts with coarse-to-fine bounding-box denoising and optimizes an interpolation-aware objective to reduce intermediate-frame failures induced by downstream animation interpolation. We further construct two datasets, ManimLayout-1K and EduRequire-500, and provide a reproducible evaluation protocol covering executability, instructional quality, visual quality, and efficiency. On EduRequire-500, OmniManim improves measured render quality over both single-model baselines and existing multi-agent frameworks. Systematic ablation studies further verify that explicit visual planning, especially its coarse spatial prior, bounding-box refinement, and interpolation-aware optimization, is central to these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniManim框架，解决大语言模型生成教育动画代码时的视觉缺陷检测与修复问题。通过引入Vision Agent进行视觉规划和后渲染诊断，实现高质量教育动画的自动生成。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的教育动画代码在执行后常出现元素重叠、对齐错误和动画连续性断裂等问题，这些缺陷仅从代码层面无法可靠检测，必须在渲染后才能发现。
AI.method: OmniManim采用共享场景状态、显式视觉规划、结构化后渲染诊断和局部修复机制。Vision Agent作为任务特定的视觉规划模块，通过粗到细的边界框去噪预测稀疏关键帧布局，并优化插值感知目标以减少下游动画插值导致的中间帧失败。
AI.result: 在EduRequire-500数据集上，OmniManim相比单模型基线和现有多智能体框架在渲染质量上均有提升。消融实验证实显式视觉规划（尤其是粗空间先验、边界框细化和插值感知优化）是性能提升的核心。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合视觉规划与渲染反馈机制，OmniManim有效解决了教育动画生成中的视觉质量问题，为可执行教育内容的自动生成提供了可行方案。

title: LEAP: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLMs in Iterative Scientific Design
summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed in autonomous laboratories, under the assumption that their domain priors and reasoning over iterative feedback let them converge on good designs in fewer iterations than feedback-only baselines. Current iterative scientific design benchmarks, however, score only outcome snapshots at fixed horizons. This leaves the learning trajectory unmeasured, even though the trajectory is what captures learning efficiency, where each iteration saved is a real saving in cost and time. Motivated by this, we examine three evaluation choices that change the conclusions one draws about LLM learning efficiency in iterative scientific design: what to measure, what baseline to compare against, and what to ground against. We introduce LEAPBench, Learning Efficiency in Adaptive Processes, a 55-task framework that pairs a best-so-far area under the curve (AUC) trajectory metric with a classical Bayesian-optimization reference and an audit grounded in published literature. Applied to eight contemporary LLMs, switching from final-outcome to trajectory scoring changes the best-model decision on 53% of tasks at matched horizons, and exposes efficiency gains overlooked by outcome-based scoring. LLMs do not outperform a classical Bayesian baseline. On 16 biology tasks where the oracle's reward signal is aligned with configurations from the published-best design, domain-aware prompting leads to LLM choices that match the published-best's approximately 10 percentage points less often than domain-agnostic prompting at iteration 30. The pattern is sharpest on 6 tasks where the literature-typical and published-best configurations diverge, and domain-agnostic prompting matches the published-best more often on all 6. The trajectory metric also doubles as a tractable training target. Offline reinforcement learning with the metric as a reward improves performance on 14 of 21 held-out tasks.

AI.tldr: LEAPBench通过轨迹度量而非终点结果评估LLM在迭代科学设计中的学习效率，发现轨迹评分显著改变模型比较结论（53%任务最优模型易主），LLM整体不及贝叶斯优化基线，且反直觉地领域无关提示在生物设计任务中优于领域相关提示，同时AUC轨迹度量可作为有效训练目标。
AI.motivation: 当前迭代科学设计基准仅在固定时间点评估最终结果，无法捕捉学习轨迹中的效率差异（如节省的迭代次数对应成本和时间节约）；LLM假设在自主实验室中能够利用领域先验和迭代反馈减少收敛所需迭代，但现有评估方式无法验证这一点。
AI.method: 提出了LEAPBench框架（55任务），采用"至今最佳面积曲线（best-so-far AUC）"轨迹度量替代固定终点快照评估；对比经典贝叶斯优化参考基线；基于已发表文献进行审计验证；对8个当代LLM进行评估实验，并探索将该指标作为离线强化学习奖励信号。
AI.result: 从终点结果切换到轨迹评分后，53%任务在匹配视域下的最优模型决策发生改变；LLM未能超越经典贝叶斯优化基线；在16个生物任务中，领域无关提示比领域相关提示在迭代30时更频繁匹配已发表最佳设计（约高10个百分点）；在6个文献典型配置与发表最佳配置存在分歧的任务中，领域无关提示在所有6个任务上都更常匹配发表最佳；AUC指标作为离线RL奖励可改善14/21保留任务的性能。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在迭代科学设计任务中无法超越经典贝叶斯优化基线；轨迹评分比最终结果评分更能揭示学习效率差异（53%任务改变最优模型决策）；在生物学任务中，领域无关提示反而优于领域相关提示（高出约10个百分点）；AUC轨迹度量可作为可处理的训练目标，离线强化学习利用该指标在21个保留任务中提升了14个的性能。

title: Evaluating Chinese Ambiguity Understanding in Large Language Models
summary: Linguistic ambiguity is critical to the robustness of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing research focuses mostly on English, with limited attention devoted to Chinese. Existing Chinese ambiguity datasets (e.g., CHAmbi) suffer from poor scalability. Guided by Potential Ambiguity (PA) Theory, we design a semi-automatic pipeline to construct CHA-Gen. It is the first PA Theory-grounded Chinese ambiguity dataset, which comprises 5,712 sentences (2,414 ambiguous, 3,298 unambiguous) across 18 potential ambiguous structures. Evaluating LLMs (e.g. Gemma 3, Qwen 2.5/3 series) via direct querying and machine translation, we find that LLMs struggle with ambiguity detection (improved by CoT prompting). Analysis of Qwen3-32B's CoT rationales reveals three common failure modes: ambiguity blindness, misattribution, and premature resolution. Uncertainty quantification with semantic entropy metric shows higher uncertainty for ambiguous sentences. Moreover, instruction tuning induces overconfidence, whereas Base models better capture semantic diversity. We further observe that models exhibit a bias toward dominant interpretations. Our work provides a scalable approach for Chinese ambiguity corpus and insights into LLMs' ambiguity handling, laying a foundation for enhancing Chinese ambiguity research in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于PA理论的半自动流水线构建了首个中文歧义数据集CHA-Gen（含5712条句子），系统评估了多种LLM（Gemma3、Qwen2.5/3等）的歧义处理能力，揭示了LLM在歧义检测中的三种失败模式及过度自信问题。
AI.motivation: 现有中文歧义数据集（如CHAmbi）扩展性差；中文语言歧义研究不足；LLM对中文歧义的处理能力缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 基于潜在歧义（PA）理论设计半自动构建流水线，构建了包含5,712条句子（2,414条歧义、3,298条非歧义）跨越18种潜在歧义结构的CHA-Gen数据集。
AI.result: LLM在歧义检测上存在困难，CoT提示可改善；Qwen3-32B存在三种典型失败模式（歧义失明、错误归因、过早消解）；歧义句子呈现更高不确定性。
AI.conclusion: CHA-Gen数据集为中文歧义研究提供了可扩展方案；指令微调会导致过度自信，Base模型更能捕捉语义多样性；模型对主导解释存在偏置。

title: TopoEvo: A Topology-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) in microservices is challenging due to (i) noisy and heterogeneous multimodal observability (metrics, logs, traces), (ii) cascading failure propagation that amplifies downstream symptoms, and (iii) non-stationary topology drift induced by autoscaling and rolling updates. Recent LLM-based RCA agents can generate tool-grounded explanations, yet they often remain topology-agnostic and suffer from \emph{symptom-amplification bias}, misattributing the root cause to salient downstream victims. We propose \textbf{TopoEvo}, a topology-aware self-evolving multi-agent framework that couples graph representation learning with structured, topology-constrained reasoning. TopoEvo first introduces \emph{Metric-orthogonal Multimodal Alignment} (MOMA), which decomposes metric embeddings into complementary subspaces and contrastively aligns logs and traces to reduce modality redundancy and sparsity, yielding stable node representations for graph encoding. It then applies \emph{Vector Quantization} (VQ) to discretize topology-enhanced states into auditable \emph{symptom tokens} with a symptom lexicon, enabling reliable retrieval and token-level evidence grounding. On top of these discrete topology cues, TopoEvo performs a multi-agent \emph{Hypothesis--Evidence--Test} (HET) workflow to explicitly verify propagation-consistent explanations and separate initiating anomalies from amplified downstream symptoms. Finally, a \emph{Self-Evolving Mechanism} refreshes hierarchical incident memory and performs conservative test-time adaptation with high-confidence pseudo-labels to maintain robustness under drift.

AI.tldr: TopoEvo is a topology-aware multi-agent framework for root cause analysis in microservices that addresses symptom-amplification bias through MOMA-based multimodal alignment, VQ-based symptom tokenization, and a Hypothesis-Evidence-Test workflow with self-evolving mechanisms for drift robustness.
AI.motivation: Root cause analysis in microservices faces three key challenges: noisy heterogeneous multimodal observability (metrics, logs, traces), cascading failure propagation amplifying downstream symptoms, and non-stationary topology drift from autoscaling/updates. Existing LLM-based RCA agents are topology-agnostic and suffer from symptom-amplification bias, misattributing root causes to downstream victims.
AI.method: The framework employs three core mechanisms: (1) MOMA for modality alignment and stable node representation; (2) VQ-based symptom tokenization with a symptom lexicon for auditable retrieval; (3) Multi-agent HET workflow for propagation-consistent hypothesis verification. A self-evolving mechanism provides hierarchical incident memory and test-time adaptation.
AI.result: The framework achieves stable node representations through contrastive multimodal alignment, enables reliable retrieval via discretized symptom tokens, explicitly separates initiating anomalies from amplified downstream symptoms, and maintains robustness under topology drift through conservative test-time adaptation.
AI.conclusion: TopoEvo proposes an integrated solution combining graph representation learning with structured reasoning for robust RCA in dynamic microservice environments. The framework aims to mitigate symptom-amplification bias through explicit topology-constrained verification and maintains robustness under drift via self-evolving mechanisms with pseudo-label adaptation.

title: PACER: Acyclic Causal Discovery from Large-Scale Interventional Data
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (2026)
summary: Inferring the structure of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) from data is a central challenge in causal discovery, particularly in modern high-dimensional settings where large-scale interventional data are increasingly available. While interventional data can improve identifiability, existing methods remain limited by soft acyclicity constraints, leading to optimization over invalid cyclic graphs, numerical instability, and reduced scalability. We introduce PACER (Perturbation-driven Acyclic Causal Edge Recovery), a scalable framework for causal discovery that guarantees acyclicity by construction. PACER parameterizes a distribution over DAGs through a joint model of variable permutations and edge probabilities, enabling direct optimization over valid causal structures without surrogate penalties. The framework supports a unified likelihood-based treatment of observational and interventional data, flexible conditional density models, and the incorporation of structural prior knowledge. For linear-Gaussian mechanisms, we derive closed-form expressions for the expected interventional log-likelihood and its gradients, yielding substantial computational gains. Empirically, PACER matches or exceeds state-of-the-art methods on protein signaling and large-scale genetic perturbation benchmarks, while scaling efficiently to networks with thousands of variables and achieving up to two orders of magnitude speedups over penalty-based differentiable approaches. These results demonstrate that exact and scalable causal discovery from high-dimensional perturbation data is achievable through principled search space design.

AI.tldr: PACER（Perturbation-driven Acyclic Causal Edge Recovery，EPFL Brbić 组，ICML）提出用「Bernoulli–Plackett–Luce 分布」直接对 DAG 建模：用 Plackett–Luce 分布采样变量拓扑序（决定完全图的方向），再用独立的 Bernoulli 掩码删边，从而保证任意采样出的结构都是 DAG，无需 NOTEARS/DCDI 类方法中的无环性软惩罚或事后剪枝。目标函数为所有干预制度下非被干预变量的期望对数似然，梯度用 REINFORCE（带平均基线）估计，并对线性-高斯机制推导出无需采样的解析闭式期望分数与梯度。计算/显存复杂度均为 O(n²)，可扩展到数千变量。实验在 Sachs 蛋白信号、CausalBench（RPE1/K562 Perturb-seq）、Perturb-CITE-seq 及合成数据上表明其精度与 SOTA 持平或更优，同时比基于惩罚的可微方法快最多两个数量级（K562 上超 300 倍加速，Perturb-CITE-seq 上 6–11 分钟 vs DCDFG 的 850–1030 分钟）。
AI.motivation: 从数据中推断有向无环图（DAG）是因果发现的核心问题。观测数据只能识别到 Markov 等价类，干预数据（如 Perturb-seq 高通量扰动实验）能大幅提升可识别性，但在基因组建网这类数千变量的高维场景下，现有的可微因果发现方法（NOTEARS、DCDI、DCDFG 等）把无环性仅作为增广拉格朗日软约束或矩阵指数/谱半径惩罚：① 优化过程中会评估并停留在有环图上，这类图没有良定义的联合似然；② 无环性约束及其梯度计算复杂度高（O(d³)），节点数上升时出现数值不稳定与超时；③ 训练后还需阈值化与剪枝，可能丢弃大量真实边。已有的基于置换（permutation）的离散方法（如 CAM、IGSP）虽天然无环，但依赖启发式稀疏化、只返回单一图、且最坏复杂度 O(n!) 无法扩展；DP-DAG、BCNP 等基于排序分布的可微方法多依赖 O(n³) 算子且多只处理观测数据。因此需要一种在构造上即保证无环、可统一处理观测与干预数据、并能扩展到数千变量的因果发现框架。
AI.method: 1) 搜索空间设计：任何 DAG 均可表示为下三角邻接矩阵，变量置换后仍为 DAG。据此定义 Bernoulli–Plackett–Luce 分布：Plackett–Luce 参数 θ 定义变量偏序/拓扑序分布（p(π|θ)=∏_k e^{θ_πk}/Σ_{u≥k} e^{θ_πu}）；独立的 Bernoulli 边概率矩阵 P 定义边掩码 B；邻接元素 a_ij = b_ij·1[π_i^{-1} < π_j^{-1}]，边存在概率 E[a_ij] = p_ij·(e^{θ_i}/(e^{θ_i}+e^{θ_j}))（Lemma C.1/C.2），联合父对协方差由 Lemma C.3 给出。2) 目标：S(Θ,Ω)=E_{M'~M(Θ)}[Σ_r E_X Σ_{j∉I_r} log p^j_Ω(X_j|M'_j,X_{-j})] − λ‖E[M(Θ)]‖₁，无任何无环约束；干预变量被排除在对应制度的似然之外，各制度共享 Ω。3) 梯度：采样不可微，用带平均基线的 REINFORCE（无偏），并证明方差上界 Var(g) ≤ max_M'[(f−m)²](n + Σ_{i,j} p_ij(1−p_ij))（Plackett–Luce 部分 O(n)、Bernoulli 部分最坏 O(n²)，随边趋于确定而消失）。4) 解析梯度（Theorem 4.4）：线性-高斯条件分布下利用 E[X²]=E[X]²+Var[X] 将期望对数似然展开为闭式表达式，无需采样 DAG 即可得到精确梯度；推广至多元各向异性 Normal（Thm C.5）与一般模型的二阶 Taylor 近似（Thm C.7，误差界 L n^{3/2}/6，但需 O(n²) Hessian，扩展性较弱，留作未来工作）。5) 条件密度模型灵活：默认各变量独立 MLP 输出的高斯（μ_j=MLP(M'_j⊙X_{-j})，σ_j=softplus(MLP(...))），亦支持负二项等（如单细胞 RNA-seq 计数）。6) 结构性先验：θ 可按期望节点中心性初始化，p_ij 可设为高值（如 TF 掩码把非转录因子节点的出边概率置零），无需改动优化过程。7) 复杂度：REINFORCE 版每步 O(MBn²)，解析版 O(Bn²)（通过采 n^{2/3} 个节点把三次的协方差项降为二次），显存 O(Bn+n²)。假设：因果充分（无隐变量）、随机完美干预且目标已知、变量域不限、输出为干预 Markov 等价类中的元素。
AI.result: 合成数据（SDCD/DCDI 协议，d=10–300，固定边密度 0.05，6 小时上限）：PACER 精度与 SOTA 相当或更优且能扩展——DCDI 在 d≥40 时数值不稳定并超时，DCDFG/CAM 的 SID 随规模急剧上升；运行时表格显示 d=300 时仅 GIES(1877s) 与 PACER(9999s) 完成，而 CAM/DCDFG/DCDI 均超时。Sachs 蛋白信号：观测设定下 PACER 是唯一在 SHD/SID/FDR/TPR/F1 全部五项指标中稳定进入前二的方法（NOTEARS 的 SHD 最好、GRaSP 的 SID 最好）；干预设定下 PACER 取得最高 F1 与最佳 FDR，其余指标次优，并复原 PKC→RAF→MEK→ERK 级联与 ERK/PKA→AKT，同时推断出共识网络中不存在的 RAF→ERK 边，与 RAF/ERK 负反馈的既有报道一致。CausalBench（RPE1/K562）：PACER 的 Wasserstein 表现位列前列而计算成本大幅降低，K562 上与最佳方法持平但快 300 倍以上；加入 TF 掩码先验后 Wasserstein 进一步提升（PACER (TF)/(A,TF)）。Perturb-CITE-seq（~960 基因、248 个扰动）：PACER 在 control/co-culture/IFN-γ 三种条件下 I-NLL 与 I-MAE 均最优，平均比 DCDFG 快 300 倍以上（6.4/7.5/11.0 分钟 vs DCDFG 850/1031/950 分钟，NOTEARS 163–277 分钟）。梯度分析：解析估计器方差单调降至近零（比随机估计器低数个数量级）；REINFORCE 需基线控制（无控制变量时 N=500 时方差 ~90，而有控制变量时收敛到 ~0.002；Replogle RPE1 上无控制变量方差 ~3×10⁷）；拓扑序恢复上解析版 ~200 步即达 Kendall τ≈1.0。对比 DP-DAG（d=500，MSE 目标）：两种 PACER 均更优，解析版比 DP-DAG(top-k) 快 ~10×、比 Sinkhorn 快 ~20×。λ 的敏感性在较宽区间内稳定（λ=1 附近接近最优）。
AI.conclusion: 通过「构造性无环」的搜索空间设计——联合建模变量置换（Plackett–Luce）与边概率（Bernoulli）的 Bernoulli–Plackett–Luce 分布——可以在不引入任何无环性代理惩罚的前提下实现精确、可扩展的高维因果发现：统一基于似然的观测+干预目标，灵活的条件密度与先验注入，以及线性-高斯下的闭式期望分数与精确梯度，使 PACER 能在数千变量的图上以 O(n²) 复杂度运行，并在蛋白信号与大规模基因扰动基准上以显著更低成本达到或超过 SOTA 精度；这说明只要恰当设计搜索空间，精确且可扩展的高维扰动数据因果发现是可行的。局限与未来工作：依赖因果充分性与完美（已知目标）干预，不提供经校准的贝叶斯不确定性（所学习的分布可视作干预 Markov 等价类的低成本 bootstrap 后验）；解析推导目前仅覆盖高斯类机制，二阶近似扩展尚缺扩展性；可进一步支持不完美/未知干预目标（附录 P 给出软干预、混合扰动效率与未知目标的参数化方案）、改进随机优化的方差缩减、以及整合多模态生物先验。

title: Dynamic Chunking for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block discrete diffusion language models factorize a sequence autoregressively over fixed-size positional blocks, decoupling within-block parallel denoising from across-block conditioning. We argue that this rigid partition wastes structure already present in the sequence: blocks defined by position rather than by content separate semantically coherent tokens and group unrelated ones together. We introduce the \textbf{D}ynamic \textbf{C}hunking \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{M}odel (DCDM), which replaces positional blocks with content-defined semantic chunks. At its core is Chunking Attention, a differentiable layer that routes tokens into $K$ clusters parameterized by learnable subspaces and shaped end-to-end by the diffusion objective. The resulting cluster assignments induce a chunk-causal attention mask under which a discrete diffusion denoiser factorizes the sequence likelihood autoregressively over semantic chunks, strictly generalizing block discrete diffusion. On downstream benchmarks at parameter scales up to 1.5B, DCDM consistently improves over both unstructured and positional-block diffusion baselines, with the advantage stable across scales and visible early in training.

AI.tldr: DCDM是一种动态分块扩散语言模型，用内容定义的语义块替代传统的基于位置的固定块，通过Chunking Attention将token路由到可学习的聚类中，在多达1.5B参数的模型上持续优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 传统block离散扩散模型使用固定位置大小的块进行自回归分解，但这种刚性划分浪费了序列中已存在的结构：按位置定义的块会分离语义相关的token，并将无关的token组合在一起。
AI.method: 提出Chunking Attention，一种可微分层，将token路由到由可学习子空间参数化的K个聚类中，聚类分配在端到端由扩散目标塑形。聚类分配诱导出一种chunk-causal注意力掩码，离散扩散去噪器在该掩码下按语义块自回归分解序列似然。
AI.result: DCDM严格推广了block离散扩散，在多达1.5B参数的下游基准测试中一致优于非结构化和位置块扩散基线。
AI.conclusion: DCDM的优势在不同规模下保持稳定，并在训练早期就显现出来，表明基于语义的分块策略是离散扩散语言模型的有效改进方向。

title: ColPackAgent: Agent-Skill-Guided Hard-Particle Monte Carlo Workflows for Colloidal Packing
summary: We introduce ColPackAgent, an agent framework that autonomously runs Monte Carlo simulations of colloidal packing through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server and an agent skill, whether as a standalone agent or inside an existing agent system. By harnessing the MCP server and agent skill, ColPackAgent executes a structured workflow for colloidal packing simulations, which are central to studies of phase behavior, self-assembly, and materials design. Without dedicated simulation tools and workflow instructions, general-purpose Large Language Model (LLM) agents tend to describe such workflows rather than execute them reliably. The MCP server exposes a custom-built colpack Python package that wraps HOOMD-blue hard-particle Monte Carlo, and the skill encodes a four-stage workflow contract. ColPackAgent can carry out the workflow interactively with human feedback, autonomously from an end-to-end prompt, or as autoresearch following a provided program file. We demonstrate the system in different modes with several colloidal packing simulation examples such as cube particles in 3D, a binary system of disks and capsules in 2D, and the 2D hard-disk freezing transition using autoresearch. We also compare model performance on this workflow across a panel of LLMs with 17 stage-specific prompts. This benchmark provides a stage-level check of how reliably different models follow the setup, planning, and analysis workflow. Together, these results show that pairing a domain Python package with MCP tools and a portable agent skill provides a practical route for turning a simulation toolkit into an agent-assisted research workflow.

AI.tldr: ColPackAgent是一个基于Model Context Protocol (MCP)的智能体框架，用于自主执行胶体堆积蒙特卡洛模拟。该框架通过将HOOMD-blue硬粒子蒙特卡洛模拟器封装为colpack Python包，并结合四阶段工作流协议，使LLM智能体能够可靠地执行而非仅描述复杂科学模拟流程。
AI.motivation: General-purpose LLM agents tend to merely describe colloidal packing simulation workflows rather than reliably executing them. Without dedicated simulation tools and workflow instructions, autonomous execution of these complex scientific simulations remains challenging.
AI.method: ColPackAgent framework using Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server and agent skill. The MCP server exposes a colpack Python package wrapping HOOMD-blue hard-particle Monte Carlo simulator, while the agent skill encodes a four-stage workflow contract. The framework supports three operational modes: interactive with human feedback, autonomous end-to-end execution, and autoresearch from a program file. Evaluation conducted using 17 stage-specific prompts across multiple LLMs.
AI.result: Demonstrated successfully across multiple scenarios: cube particles in 3D, binary system of disks and capsules in 2D, and 2D hard-disk freezing transition via autoresearch. Benchmark results provide stage-level assessment of different LLMs' reliability in following setup, planning, and analysis workflows.
AI.conclusion: Pairing a domain-specific Python package with MCP tools and a portable agent skill provides a practical route for converting simulation toolkits into agent-assisted research workflows. This approach enables reliable execution of complex simulations rather than mere descriptions of workflows.

title: Controllable Molecular Generative Foundation Models
summary: Despite the success of foundation models in language and vision, molecular graph generation still lacks a unified framework for heterogeneous design tasks with reliable controllability. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural post-training mechanism for task-specific optimization, applying it to graph generative models is hindered by the vast atom-wise action spaces and chemically invalid intermediate states. We propose \textbf{Co}ntrollable \textbf{Mole}cular Generative Foundation Models (CoMole), built with a unified motif-aware graph diffusion pipeline. By learning a motif-aware graph space, CoMole transfers pretrained structural priors into controllable generation, where RL optimizes conditional reverse policies over chemically meaningful decisions. We theoretically characterize the bottleneck of atom-level RL and justify motif-aware policy optimization. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks spanning materials and drug discovery, CoMole ranks first in controllability on all nine targets, reduces MAE by up to 48.2% relative to the strongest baselines, and maintains validity above 0.94 without rule-based correction or post-hoc filtering. We further show that CoMole transfers controllability to unseen properties by optimizing only task embeddings with the generator frozen, achieving performance competitive with strong task-specific baselines.

AI.tldr: CoMole是一个可控分子生成基础模型，融合motif-aware图扩散与强化学习，在保持高化学有效性的同时实现异构设计任务的可控生成，在多基准上取得最优性能并具备跨属性迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 当前分子图生成缺乏针对异构设计任务的统一框架和可靠可控性机制；强化学习虽适合任务特定优化，但直接应用于图生成模型面临原子级动作空间庞大和化学无效中间状态的瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建统一 motif-aware 图扩散管道，学习 motif-aware 图空间，将预训练的结构先验迁移至可控生成；在 motif-aware 动作空间上使用 RL 优化条件逆向策略，避免原子级大规模动作空间问题，保证化学有效性。
AI.result: 在三个异构基准测试（材料和药物发现）的九个可控性目标上均排名第一；MAE相对最强基线降低48.2%；有效性维持在0.94以上；可零样本迁移至未见属性，仅通过优化任务嵌入实现。
AI.conclusion: CoMole在三个异构基准测试中均排名第一，所有九个目标的可控性表现最优；相对最强基线MAE降低48.2%；有效性维持在0.94以上无需规则校正或后过滤；在生成器冻结情况下仅优化任务嵌入即可迁移可控性，性能与强任务特定基线相当。

title: VCG-Bench: Towards A Unified Visual-Centric Benchmark for Structured Generation and Editing
summary: Despite the rapid advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), a critical gap remains in their ability to handle structured, controllable diagrammatic tasks essential for professional workflows. Existing methods predominantly rely on pixel-based synthesis, which operates in probabilistic pixel spaces and is inherently limited in editability and fidelity. Instead, we propose a new Diagram-as-Code paradigm with symbolic logic that leverages mxGraph Extensible Markup Language (XML) for precise diagram generation and editing. We present VCG-Bench, a unified benchmark for visual-centric \texttt{mxGraph} tasks. VCG-Bench comprises: (1) a taxonomized dataset of 1,449 diverse diagrams spanning 6 domains and 15 sub-domains, (2) a paradigm definition that integrates Generation (Vision-to-Code) and Editability (Code-to-Code), (3) a Tailored Evaluation Protocol employing multi-dimensional metrics such as \texttt{mxGraph} Execution Success Rate, Style Consistency Score (SCS), etc. Experimental results highlight the challenges faced by current State-of-the-Art (SOTA) VLMs in structured fidelity and instruction compliance, reflecting their vision and reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diagram-as-Code范式，利用mxGraph XML实现精确图表生成与编辑，并构建VCG-Bench基准评估VLM在视觉中心化mxGraph任务上的表现，揭示了现有模型的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在处理专业工作流程中必需的、结构化可控的图表任务时存在关键缺陷。当前基于像素的合成方法操作于概率像素空间，在可编辑性和保真度方面存在根本性局限。
AI.method: 提出"Diagram-as-Code"范式，使用mxGraph XML实现精确的图表生成和编辑；建立VCG-Bench统一基准，包含1449个多样化图表、6个领域15个子领域；采用多维评估协议，包括mxGraph执行成功率、风格一致性评分等指标。
AI.result: 实验结果强调当前SOTA VLM在结构化保真度和指令遵循方面面临挑战，反映了模型在视觉和推理能力上的不足。
AI.conclusion: VCG-Bench能够有效评估当前SOTA VLMs在结构化图表任务上的能力，揭示了现有模型在视觉理解和推理方面的局限性，为未来改进指明方向。

title: PRISM: Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring for Enterprise Conversational AI
summary: Deploying large language model (LLM)-driven conversational agents in enterprise settings requires prompts that are simultaneously correct at launch and resilient to the non-deterministic behavioral drift that characterizes production LLM deployments. Existing prompt optimization frameworks address prompt quality as a one-time compile-time problem, leaving open the equally critical question of how to detect and repair prompt regressions caused by silent LLM behavior changes over time. We present PRISM (Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring), a closed-loop framework that treats prompt engineering as a continuous reliability engineering problem rather than a one-time authorship task. PRISM takes as input plain-language agent requirements, a set of configured tools and memory variables, and an initial draft prompt. It automatically generates test cases from requirements, simulates full multi-turn conversations against a platform-faithful LLM environment, evaluates pass/fail using an LLM-as-judge, diagnoses root causes of failures, and surgically repairs the prompt -- iterating until all tests pass. Critically, PRISM is designed to run on a scheduled basis (daily), treating LLM behavioral drift as a first-class reliability concern. We evaluate PRISM across 35 enterprise conversational agents over a three-week deployment period on the Yellow.ai V3 platform. PRISM reduces median prompt authoring time from 2 days to under 30 minutes, achieves 99% production reliability across all evaluated agents, and successfully identifies and repairs production regressions caused by LLM behavioral drift within a 24-hour detection window. Our results suggest that continuous, simulation-driven prompt optimization is both tractable and necessary for reliable enterprise conversational AI at scale.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一个面向企业级多轮对话代理的开源闭环框架，把提示词工程从"一次性撰写"转变为"持续的可靠性工程"：由需求自动生成测试用例，在忠实于生产平台（Yellow.ai V3）的仿真环境中回放多轮对话，用 GPT-4.1 作为 LLM 裁判按逐条通过标准判定，通过失败诊断与外科手术式修复迭代直至全通过，并以每日回归测试监控 LLM 行为漂移。在 35 个企业代理、21 天共 735 次每日回归中达到 99.0% 零失败生产可靠性，7 次漂移事件全部在 24 小时内检测并修复，提示词撰写时间中位数从 2.1 天降至 27 分钟（约 98% 降幅）。
AI.motivation: 企业级对话代理（客服、取消订阅、引导、账单争议）依赖"前端提示词"编码严格的多步业务逻辑：先认证再调用工作流、按条件路由人工、不得泄露内部状态、受监管场景须使用规定话术。这类失败并非幻觉或事实错误，而是"程序性合规"失效，作者在 35 个代理中归纳出四类主要失效模式：工具调用跳过(34%)、步骤坍缩(28%)、规则违反(22%)、步骤乱序(16%)。同时，即便固定模型版本，采样温度与厂商未公开的推理层变更仍会导致非确定性的"LLM 行为漂移"，同一提示词可在数日内静默退化，而现有方法（DSPy、OPRO、APE、PromptBreeder）把优化目标固定在编译期，未建模多轮+工具集成环境，也未处理生产期维护需求。
AI.method: 1) 问题形式化：将多步对话代理定义为 A=(P_b, P_f, T, V, S)（后端提示词、仅被优化的前端提示词、工具集、记忆变量集、子代理集），并把提示词可靠性分解为创建时正确性（P1：能否产出通过全部测试的提示词）与运行时可靠性（P2：上线后能否持续通过）两个阶段。2) 需求驱动测试生成：以需求文档+工具返回 schema+记忆变量+子代理列表为输入，LLM 生成测试用例，每个用例含 conversation_script、pass_criteria、mock_overrides，覆盖快乐路径、边界条件、错误路径、合规场景，运维方可再编辑。3) 平台忠实仿真：拼接 P=P_b⊕P_f^(k)，逐轮回放脚本至 OpenAI API，拦截工具调用并以 mock 响应替代，用正则/标记检测 [ROUTE TO: AgentName] 路由事件，记录完整轨迹；评测时温度设为 0 保证固定提示词下逻辑轨迹确定。4) LLM-as-judge：裁判接收完整轨迹、工具调用日志与路由事件，对每条通过标准给出 pass/fail+理由，全部通过才算该用例通过；明确"文本暗示调用"不等于"工具调用日志中出现该 slug"。5) 诊断与外科手术式修复：诊断 LLM 依据失败轨迹、逐条判定和 Yellow.ai 平台指南定位失败对应的提示词段落；修复 LLM 只改写负责失败的段落（每轮平均改动 20–50 行），保留已通过测试的行为，最多迭代 K=10。6) 连续监控：每日对线上提示词重跑全量测试，检测到原通过用例失败即视为漂移事件，重新进入修复环并产出补丁供运维审核部署。7) 实现：Flask + SQLite(WAL) + 原生 JS 前端，SSE 流式推送进度，正则解析器检测 {{variable}}、[kebab-tool]/Call ToolName/@ToolName、[Agent Name]、[kb: topic] 并对未匹配项告警。
AI.result: 35 个代理（3–12 步、6 工具、5 路由目标）上：平均生成 52 条测试（简单 23/中 47/复杂 112，范围 12–147），生成用例覆盖运维人员手写场景的 91%；收敛迭代平均 7.1 次，<30 用例 4.2 次达 100%，30–60 用例 6.7 次达 97%，>60 用例需延展至 20+ 次仅 89% 收敛，全局 97% 收敛。21 天监控共执行 735 次每日回归，728 次(99.0%)零失败；7 次漂移事件（涉及 4 个代理）全部在 24 小时内检测并修复，31/35 代理零漂移。撰写时间中位数由 2.1 天(0.5–5 天)降至 27 分钟(12–68 分钟)，降幅约 98%，剩余时间主要为录入工具 schema 与需求。消融观察显示：全量重写式修复收敛更差，常修好失败用例却破坏已通过用例而导致震荡，外科式修复多数情况下单调改进；mock 响应质量直接决定分支覆盖质量。局限：静态 mock 无法覆盖工具间歇失败/返回异常类型；需求生成的脚本未系统覆盖对抗与分布外输入；100+ 用例时修复 LLM 上下文受限需截断；判定质量受裁判模型能力上限约束。
AI.conclusion: 企业对话 AI 的可靠性缺口主要是提示词工程方法论缺口而非模型能力缺口：模型足以执行规定流程，但缺少系统化验证、监控与维护多步代理行为正确性的工具。PRISM 通过统一"测试—仿真—裁判—修复"环来处理创建时错误与运行时漂移两类问题，证明持续、仿真驱动的提示词优化在企业规模上可行且必要：99% 生产可靠性、98% 撰写时间下降、24 小时内漂移检测与修复。作者开源该工具，并提出按失败类批量修复、对抗性测试生成、跨平台评估（Dialogflow CX/Amazon Lex/MS Bot Framework）、优化循环的形式化收敛保证等后续方向；框架仅要求两层提示词结构、支持函数调用的 LLM 后端和可检测的路由约定，故可迁移至其他平台。

title: Federated Learning of Spiking Neural Networks under Heterogeneous Temporal Resolutions
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are biologically inspired energy-efficient models that use sparse binary spike-based communication between neurons, making them attractive for resource-constrained edge devices. Federated learning enables such devices to train collaboratively without sharing raw data. In time-series applications, edge devices often collect data at different time resolutions due to hardware and energy constraints. This temporal heterogeneity poses a fundamental challenge for federated learning: parameters learned at one temporal resolution do not necessarily transfer directly to another, which might result in the naive federated averaging being ineffective. Targeting SNNs and, more broadly, deep networks with stateful neurons, we propose a federated learning framework that addresses this temporal resolution mismatch. We investigate how neuron parameters learned from data at different temporal resolutions and model aggregation should be integrated. We evaluate the proposed framework across two SNN-native benchmark datasets (SHD and DVS-Gesture) under a range of resolution heterogeneity scenarios. Our results show that the proposed adaptation methods can substantially recover accuracy lost due to temporal mismatch, hence enabling each client to train at their local temporal resolution while remaining compatible with the global model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FedTA（Federated learning with Temporal resolution Adaptation），针对边缘设备因硬件/能耗差异导致数据时间分辨率不一致的问题，在联邦平均（FedAvg）循环中引入"神经元动力学参数的时间分辨率自适应"机制，使各客户端在本地时间分辨率下训练，同时保持与全局模型的可聚合性。在 SHD 与 DVS-Gesture 上验证：适配方法可显著挽回因时间分辨率失配造成的精度损失；线性状态动力学 SSM + FedTA-Int 精度最高（稳定性差），而 LIF 类 SNN 更鲁棒且能耗低 44 倍、训练快 2.1 倍（精度约损失 10%），适配带来的额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习常部署于受能耗、内存、算力严格约束的边缘设备上，其中 SNN 因稀疏二值脉冲通信成为低功耗部署的优选。然而在时间序列任务中，不同客户端因硬件限制、能耗预算、存储容量或带宽受限，往往以不同的时间分辨率（采样间隔）采集数据。由于带状态神经元（stateful neurons）的动力学参数与时间步长内在绑定，在某分辨率下训练得到的参数（如 LIF 的衰减系数 α、SSM 的状态转移矩阵 A）无法直接迁移到另一分辨率，导致朴素的 FedAvg 把"运行在不同时间尺度上的模型"混合平均，从而显著损害全局模型性能。已有联邦学习研究主要关注类别不平衡等数据异质性，尚未处理客户端之间及中心与客户端之间的时间分辨率失配；同时线性 SSM 的分辨率鲁棒性工作（HiPPO-LegS、事件驱动 SSM、resolution-aware training）也均未涉及联邦场景。论文的核心问题是：不同时间分辨率下训练出的模型参数应如何调整后再进行联邦平均。
AI.method:
1) 建模框架：K 个客户端各自以采样间隔 T_k 采集时间序列，中心服务器分辨率 T_c 可由用户指定；网络由若干含 h 个状态神经元的隐藏层堆叠而成，参数分为神经元动力学参数 φ、突触权重 W、归一化参数 ψ。
2) 神经元模型两类四变体：LIF 脉冲神经元（standard-LIF 直接训练 α；Δ-LIF 采用 exp-log 重参数化 α = exp(−e^{Δ_log} e^{γ_log})，将时间分辨率显式编码为可训练参数 Δ_log）；线性对角状态空间模型 LD-SSM（standard-SSM 直接训练 A、B、C；Δ-SSM 采用 S4D 式重参数化 A = exp(−e^{Δ_log}(e^{A_Re,log} − jA_Im))，并用 C̃·(e^A − I)A_c^{-1} 缩放输出矩阵）。全网共享同一神经元模型。
3) FedTA 算法（Algorithm 1）：以 FedAvg 为骨架，每轮通信中仅对 φ 做分辨率适配——服务器下发前将 φ_c 由 T_c 适配到 T_k，客户端本地训练后服务器再将 φ_k 由 T_k 适配回 T_c，随后对 θ_k = {φ_{c,k}, W_k, ψ_k} 做 FedAvg；W 与 ψ 在适配中保持不变。
4) 三种适配规则（ρ = T_r2/T_r1）：Euler 法 A_{r2} = I + ρ(A_{r1} − I)，B_{r2} = ρB_{r1}；Integral 法 A_{r2} = A_{r1}^ρ，B_{r2} = (A_{r2} − I)(A_{r1} − I)^{-1}B_{r1}（源自 Karilanova et al. 2026 的线性 SSM 理论）；Δ 法则仅对 Δ_log 做加性平移 Δ_{log,r2} = Δ_{log,r1} + ln ρ，其余参数不动。对 LIF 则将 α 视作 1×1 实数 A 代入 Euler/Integral（因脉冲复位项 −αθS[t] 引入非线性，该映射仅为近似）。
5) 实验设置：SHD（20 类，8156/2264）与 DVS-Gesture（11 类，1086/256），用 Tonic 的 ToFrame 分箱（窗口 10k/80k），SHD 额外做时空分箱将 700 通道压缩到 140；IID 划分客户端，AdamW + 余弦学习率 + BatchNorm，5 次独立运行取均值±标准差；异质性场景 A（3 客户端，每分辨率 1 个）与 B（15 客户端，每分辨率 5 个），T_ℓ ∈ {1,2,4}；另设同质客户端但与 T_c=1 失配的实验，并比较"每轮适配"与"训练后一次性适配"（-Post 变体）；用 45nm CMOS 的 3.1 pJ/乘法、0.1 pJ/加法估算能耗，LIF 的二值稀疏激活按实际脉冲率只计加法操作。
AI.result:
1) 精度：SHD 上 standard-SSM + FedTA-Int 在全部场景与全部 T_c 下最优（Scenario A、T_c=1 时 91.6%，T_c=4 时 84.3%）；DVS-Gesture 上该组合仅在一半情形最优，另一半由 Δ-LIF + FedAvg 取得最高（T_c=1 时 87.5%）。standard-LIF 各算法在 T_c∈{1,2} 时差异在一个标准差内，T_c=4 时 FedAvg 更优；Δ-SSM 在 T_c=4 时 FedAvg 明显优于 FedTA-Δ（32.9% vs 26.8%，SHD）。
2) 服务器分辨率：T_c=1 或 2 最佳（T_c=1 保留最多信息，T_c=2 居中从而最小化与各客户端特征空间的平均失配）；客户端数从 3 增至 15 通常降低精度，反映异质客户端聚合更难。
