AI.result: The extended losses successfully apply to synthetic examples, SynFlowNets for molecule discovery, and asynchronous LLM tuning, retaining predicted on-policy and off-policy properties across diverse generative model architectures.
AI.conclusion: The proposed losses enable off-policy training while preserving the properties of corresponding f-divergences (e.g., mode coverage), and demonstrate effectiveness across diverse domains including synthetic tasks, molecule discovery, and asynchronous LLM tuning.

title: Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for MT: A Seq2Seq Perspective
summary: Production machine translation relies overwhelmingly on encoder-decoder Seq2Seq models, yet reinforcement learning approaches to MT fine-tuning have largely targeted decoder-only LLMs at $\geq$7B parameters, with limited systematic study of encoder-decoder architectures. We apply Group Relative Policy Optimization to NLLB-200 (600M and 1.3B) using a hybrid reference-free reward (LaBSE and COMET-Kiwi) that requires no parallel data at fine-tuning time, evaluating across 13 typologically diverse languages. GRPO yields consistent improvements on all 13 languages, up to $+$5.03 chrF++ for Traditional Chinese, and, without any target-language data, competes with 3-epoch supervised fine-tuning on morphologically complex languages . We identify a consistent empirical pattern in which gains are largest where baseline performance is weakest and reward discriminability is highest, making this approach most effective precisely where parallel data is scarcest, and replicate this pattern across English and Spanish source languages.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了将 GRPO 强化学习微调应用于小型编码器-解码器翻译模型 NLLB-200（600M/1.3B）。在微调阶段完全不使用平行语料、仅靠 LaBSE + COMET-Kiwi 混合"无参考"奖励的条件下，13 种语言全部获得性能提升（最高为繁体中文 +5.03 chrF++），并在形态复杂语言上追平 3 epoch 监督微调；训练仅需单张 24GB GPU（4-bit + LoRA，峰值 4–6GB）。核心经验规律：基线越弱、奖励可区分性越高的语言，增益越大。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的机器翻译仍以编码器-解码器 Seq2Seq 模型为主（低延迟、低显存、源目标对齐强），但近年的 RL 微调研究几乎全部集中于 ≥7B 的解码器-only LLM（如 Qwen2.5-7B、SSR-Zero 等），这些模型对多数语言的长尾翻译场景并不实用，且缺乏对编码器-解码器架构的系统性研究。同时既有工作多聚焦高资源语言对，未刻画 GRPO 增益在不同书写系统、形态类型和基线水平语言上的变化规律。同期工作（Attia & Fikri 2026）虽也用 GRPO 微调 NLLB-200，但固定英语为源语言、采用间接的往返重建目标，仅评测 6 种语言，且缺少 SFT 对比与跨域分析。作者因此要回答的核心问题是：去掉平行监督的代价是什么，以及对哪些语言这笔代价值得付。
AI.method: 方法层面：把 MT 建模为 RL 问题，策略为 NLLB-200 翻译模型，每步温度采样（K=12, T=1.2）生成候选，用 PPO 裁剪目标 + 前向 KL 惩罚更新，优势由组内奖励标准化估计 A_i=(r_i-mean(r))/(std(r)+ε)，ε=1e-4 作为奖励方差崩塌时的稳定下限；关键实现技巧是参考模型 π_ref 直接通过关闭 LoRA 适配器获得，无需独立参考模型，从而抑制策略漂移与灾难性遗忘。奖励为混合无参考信号：LaBSE 跨语言嵌入余弦相似度 + COMET-Kiwi 直接评估质量，各占 0.5，二者在 5060 条基线假设上仅中等相关（r=0.528），互补性强；训练前用 6 级质量梯度（每语言 50 句）做可区分性验证，各权重配置 |r|>0.81，0.5/0.5 平均最优（-0.930）。模型方面对 NLLB-200 600M/1.3B 做 4-bit NF4 量化 + LoRA（r=16, α=32, dropout 0.05，仅训练 q_proj/v_proj），单张 NVIDIA A10G 24GB 即可。实验分两部分：实验 A 用 FLORES-200 dev 源侧单语约 997 句训练 3 epoch（约 3000 步），在 devtest 上对比未微调基线、同配置 SFT（并行数据）与 GRPO；实验 B 用 CCNews 1 万条单语英语训练 1 万步，在 FLORES-200 devtest（域外）与 NTREX-128（新闻近域）评测。另在巴斯克语与繁体中文上做 KL 系数 β∈{0,0.001,0.01,0.05} 与训练规模 N∈{100,250,500,1000} 消融，用西班牙语源句做跨源复现，并做人类偏好评测与遗忘测试。评测以 chrF++ 为主，另报 SacreBLEU、COMET-22、BERTScore F1 作为独立验证器，显著性用配对 bootstrap（n=1000，p<0.05）。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 实验 A 中 13 种语言、两种规模全部相对基线提升，繁体中文最高 +5.03 chrF++（基线仅 14.5），藏语 +3.01、巴斯克语 +2.57、斯瓦希里语 +2.30；增益与基线呈负相关（剔除 NLLB 简繁混淆缺陷的繁中后 Spearman ρ=0.67, p=0.018，bootstrap 95% CI [0.17,0.98]），跨英语/西班牙源语言复现秩相关 ρ=0.893 (p=0.007)。(2) 与 SFT 对比：1 epoch 时两者接近，GRPO 在形态复杂弱基线语言占优（巴斯克 +1.76、孟加拉 +0.87、斯瓦希里 +0.75）；3 epoch SFT 平均更强但差距有限，捷克语、波兰语、孟加拉语、白俄罗斯语差异在 ±0.2 chrF++ 内不显著，GRPO 在巴斯克语反超 +0.51；阿拉伯语是唯一持续利于 SFT 的语言（SFT_3ep +1.27 vs GRPO +0.10）；BERTScore 上 GRPO 在 13 种语言中 10 种优于 SFT_1ep，日语 COMET-22 增益为 SFT 的三倍，而约鲁巴语 SFT 反而使 COMET-22 下降 -0.022。(3) 模型规模：1.3B 在 7/13 语言更强（繁中 +5.03 vs +3.94），但藏语、孟加拉语、约鲁巴语等出现反向缩放，600M 以 4GB 显存即可恢复约 80% 增益，是低资源部署的实用默认。(4) 跨域实验 B 在 FLORES-200 devtest 复现同样规律（繁中 1.3B +4.88、斯瓦希里 +3.00），NTREX-128 上 GRPO 在巴斯克语、藏语、日语、繁中超过 SFT_3ep，白俄罗斯语两种方法均低于基线（域不匹配）。(5) 消融显示结果对 β 不敏感（巴斯克语跨度 0.19、中文 0.61 chrF++），说明 LoRA 已提供足够结构约束；N<500 时两法均无显著增益，N=500 同时达到显著，N=1000 时 GRPO 在巴斯克语显著优于 SFT（p=0.019）。(6) 失败模式：阿拉伯语因基线强、COMET-Kiwi 对词根形态校准差而始终不受益；藏语在 1 万步长训练下出现奖励方差崩塌（std(r)→ε），输出退化至 chrF++<2.0，需早停与最佳检查点选择（西班牙语源的约鲁巴语也复现该崩塌）。此外 39 次 GRPO 适配器评测中零灾难性遗忘（保留语言平均 +0.34 chrF++），唯一遗忘事件来自 SFT。人类评测显示明显可感知阈值：繁中 68% 偏好 GRPO（p<0.001），而孟加拉、土耳其、波兰的小幅增益与随机无异。解码控制消融排除了增益源自采样解码设定的可能。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是：质量上限由奖励的可区分性而非策略优化决定。GRPO 无参考微调在编码器-解码器 NLLB-200 上可行且廉价——单卡 24GB、约 500 条源句即可获得可靠增益、无灾难性遗忘，且在形态复杂语言上无需任何目标语言数据即可与 3 epoch 监督微调相当；其最有效的场景恰是平行数据最匮乏、基线最弱的语言，可为实践者提供选语言的参考信号。边界同样清晰：阿拉伯语（强基线 + 奖励校准缺口）与藏语（长训练下奖励方差崩塌）划出了当前方法的适用区间，早停应被视为训练流程的必要环节而非可选优化。作者同时坦承局限：奖励模型自身预训练依赖平行语料（"无参考"仅限微调阶段）、可区分性分析用的是构造质量梯度而非真实 rollout、源语言以英语为主、仅 NLLB-200 与 13 种语言，因此所得规律应视为待验证的假设而非普适定律。后续方向包括形态感知的奖励组件、自适应方差正则化、多语联合 GRPO 训练。

title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration
summary: Desktop GUI agents operate under partial observability: visually similar screens can correspond to different underlying workflow states, so locally plausible actions can lead to sharply different outcomes. We frame this as a problem of computer/OS state exploration, where effective behavior requires both expanding the reachable frontier and reducing ambiguity before committing. We present ScreenSearch, a system that combines structural screen retrieval and deduplication with an ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration. The retrieval layer converts UIA trees into location-aware structural features, indexes related screens through sparse token search and metadata filters, and maintains a shared deduplicated state graph across VM workers. On top of this graph, we define a scalable ambiguity signal based on matched-action outcome dispersion. If similar screens produce different next states under the same action signature, the state should be probed further rather than treated as resolved. We use this signal together with frontier rewards to drive large-scale exploration and replay-start policy evaluation over the shared graph. Across 11 desktop applications, ScreenSearch collects over 1M screenshots and over 30K deduplicated states, yielding large exploration corpora with substantial cross-application and within-application diversity. On a fixed replay-start slice, we observe a clear novelty--ambiguity trade-off: some policies reduce ambiguity quickly while discovering little frontier. Ambiguity reduction alone is therefore not a sufficient exploration objective. Appendix ablations show that stronger proposal priors can materially improve unique-state discovery during corpus building. These results suggest that state identity, proposal quality, and ambiguity-aware search all matter when deciding when to probe and when to commit.

AI.tldr: ScreenSearch是一个用于大规模桌面探索的系统，通过结构化屏幕检索、去重和歧义感知PUCT图bandit，在11个应用上收集100万+截图和3万+去重状态，证明状态识别、提议质量、歧义感知搜索三者缺一不可
AI.motivation: 桌面GUI智能体在部分可观测环境下操作：视觉相似的屏幕可能对应不同的工作流状态，局部合理的动作可能导致截然不同的结果，这本质上是一个计算机/操作系统状态探索问题
AI.method: 将UIA树转换为位置感知结构特征，通过稀疏token搜索和元数据过滤器索引相关屏幕，在VM workers间维护共享去重状态图；定义基于匹配动作结果分散性的可扩展歧义信号，结合前沿奖励驱动PUCT图bandit进行大规模探索和重放启动策略评估
AI.result: 在11个桌面应用上收集超过100万张截图和3万多个去重状态；发现在固定的replay-start切片上存在明显的novelty-ambiguity权衡；更强的提议先验可显著提升独特状态发现
AI.conclusion: 状态识别、提议质量和歧义感知搜索在决定何时探索和何时提交时都很重要；强先验可提升独特状态发现；歧义减少本身不是充分的探索目标

title: Lagrangian Flow Matching: A Least-Action Framework for Principled Path Design
summary: Flow matching trains a neural velocity field by regression against a target velocity associated with a prescribed probability path connecting a simple initial distribution to the data distribution. A central design choice is the path itself. Existing constructions, including rectified and optimal-transport-based paths, transport samples along straight lines between coupled endpoints and thus cover only a narrow class of dynamics. We observe that this corresponds to the simplest case of the least-action principle in classical mechanics, in which the kinetic Lagrangian yields free-particle straight-line trajectories. Building on this observation, we propose Lagrangian flow matching, a physics-based framework in which the probability path and velocity field are determined by minimizing the action of a general Lagrangian subject to the continuity equation and the prescribed endpoints. We show that this dynamic problem admits an equivalent static optimal transport (OT) formulation, yielding a family of simulation-free training objectives that recover OT-based flow matching as the kinetic special case and the trigonometric variance-preserving diffusion path as the harmonic-oscillator case. More general Lagrangians give rise to new probability paths and velocity fields, and numerical experiments show that they induce meaningful changes in the learned dynamics while remaining competitive with existing conditional flow matching models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拉格朗日流匹配框架，将流匹配与经典力学中的最小作用量原理结合。通过最小化一般拉格朗日量的作用量来确定概率路径和速度场，该动态问题可等价转化为静态最优传输问题。此框架统一了现有 OT 流匹配和方差保持扩散路径，并可通过选择不同拉格朗日量获得新的概率路径和动力学特性。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配方法（包括纠正型和基于最优传输的路径）仅沿直线传输样本，仅覆盖极窄的动力学类别。作者观察到这对应于经典力学中最简 action 原理情形（动能拉格朗日量产生自由粒子直线轨迹），因此考虑推广到一般拉格朗日量以获得更丰富的概率路径和动力学。
AI.method: 提出拉格朗日流匹配框架，通过最小化一般拉格朗日量在连续性方程和指定端点约束下的作用量来确定概率路径和速度场。证明该动态问题存在等价的静态最优传输(OT)公式化，从而得到一族无模拟的训练目标。
AI.result: 推导出新的概率路径和速度场，其中 OT 流匹配作为动能特例被恢复，而三角方差保持扩散路径作为谐振子情形被恢复。更一般的拉格朗日量产生有意义的变化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究开辟了基于经典力学原理设计概率路径的新方向，通过推广到一般拉格朗日量可获得新的概率路径和速度场，且与现有条件流匹配模型具有相当的竞争力。

title: Ontology for Policing: Conceptual Knowledge Learning for Semantic Understanding and Reasoning in Law Enforcement Reports
summary: Law enforcement reports contain structured fields and written narratives. However, many incident facts that are needed for review, police training, and investigations are in natural language and require manual reading. We propose a framework using symbolic methods for converting narratives into evidence-linked facts. Our objective is to measure the value of narratives to recover incident details only from the unstructured text and build temporal graphs with time cues and domain axioms. We achieve this by redacting personal identifiers, semantic parsing, predicate mapping to ontology, and reasoning. We evaluate the symbolic approach on 450 property crime reports and a short human review. Of the extracted events from the system, 54.1% had a confidence score of at least 0.80 and 93.7% were mapped through the PropBank--VerbNet--WordNet semantic path. 100% agreement was reached on incident initiation, stolen items, and temporal cues and lower agreement for forced entry interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于符号方法的框架，将执法报告中的自然语言叙述转换为可链接证据的结构化事实，通过语义解析、谓词本体映射和推理实现自动化信息提取，在450份财产犯罪报告上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 执法报告中许多需要用于审查、警察培训和调查的事件事实以自然语言形式存在，需要人工阅读，导致效率低下。
AI.method: 采用符号化方法流程：个人标识符编辑、语义解析、谓词映射到本体论（PropBank-VerbNet-WordNet语义路径）、最后进行推理。从非结构化文本中恢复事件细节，构建带有时间线索和领域公理的时间图。
AI.result: 54.1%的提取事件置信度达到0.80以上；93.7%的事件通过PropBank-VerbNet-WordNet语义路径完成映射；事件初始化、被盗物品和时间线索提取达到100%一致性；强制进入解读一致性较低。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在事件提取和语义映射方面展现出较高准确性，尤其在事件初始化、被盗物品识别和时间线索提取上达到100%一致性，但在强制进入解读上一致性较低。

title: Reasoners or Translators? Contamination-aware Evaluation and Neuro-Symbolic Robustness in Tax Law
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly enhanced automated legal reasoning. Yet, it remains unclear whether their performance reflects genuine legal reasoning ability or artifacts of data contamination. We present a comprehensive empirical study of tax law reasoning approaches and implement a contamination detection protocol to rigorously assess LLM reliability. We show that performance can be inflated by contamination. Building on this analysis, we conduct a systematic evaluation, comparing monolithic LLMs with hybrid systems that translate statutory text into formal representations and delegate inference to symbolic solvers. We build a novel test suite designed to probe generalization to unseen documents via case and rule variations. Our findings indicate that legal reasoning is inherently compositional and that neuro-symbolic frameworks offer a more reliable and robust foundation for legal AI, as well as improved generalization to unobserved situations.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了LLM在税法推理中的表现，发现传统LLM的性能可能被数据污染高估。通过对比单体LLM与神经符号混合系统，发现后者在法律推理的可靠性和泛化能力上表现更优，证实了法律推理的组合性特征。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在自动化法律推理方面取得了显著进展，但尚不清楚其表现是真正的法律推理能力还是数据污染的产物。
AI.method: 实现了一套污染检测协议以严格评估LLM可靠性；构建了新型测试套件，通过案例和规则变化测试对未见文档的泛化能力；对比了单体LLM与将成文法条翻译为形式化表示并委托给符号求解器的混合系统。
AI.result: 研究表明污染可以夸大模型性能；法律推理本质上是组合性的；神经符号框架更加可靠和稳健。
AI.conclusion: Neuro-symbolic frameworks为法律人工智能提供了更可靠、更稳健的基础，并在未见情况中展现出更好的泛化能力。

title: DualKV: Shared-Prompt Flash Attention for Efficient RL Training with Large Rollouts and Long Contexts
summary: Modern RL post-training methods such as GRPO and DAPO train on $N$ response sequences of $R$ tokens sampled from a shared prompt of $P$ tokens, but standard FlashAttention replicates all $P$ prompt tokens $N$ times across both forward and backward passes -- duplicating compute and memory on identical hidden states. In large-rollout, long-context RL training ($N{\geq}16$, $P{\geq}8\text{K}$), this redundancy dominates the policy update cost. We observe that in decoder-only models, causal masking makes prompt representations invariant across sequences at every layer, so all per-token operations (norms, projections, MLP) and attention can process the prompt once -- a property not yet exploited at the kernel level for training. We propose \textbf{DualKV}, the first FlashAttention kernel variant that eliminates shared-prompt replication during RL training, via (1)~fused CUDA forward and backward kernels that iterate over two disjoint KV regions -- shared context and per-sequence response -- in a single kernel launch, and (2)~a data-pipeline redesign in veRL that repacks $N(P{+}R)$ tokens into $P{+}NR$ tokens per micro-batch, extending the token reduction from attention to the entire model by a factor $ρ= N(P{+}R)/(P{+}NR)$. DualKV is mathematically equivalent to standard attention and introduces no approximation. On Qwen3-8B GRPO training with 8$\times$H100 GPUs ($N{=}32$, 8K-context), DualKV achieves $1.63$--$2.09\times$ policy-update speedup, enables $2\times$ larger micro-batches, and raises MFU from $36\%$ to $76\%$. Similar gains hold for DAPO ($2.47\times$ speedup, $77\%$ MFU). At 30B MoE scale on 16$\times$H100, DualKV achieves $3.82\times$ policy-update and $3.38\times$ end-to-end step speedup over FlashAttention (which requires 4-way Ulysses sequence parallelism to avoid OOM).

AI.tldr: DualKV 是首个在 CUDA kernel 层消除 RL 后训练中「共享 prompt 重复计算」的 FlashAttention 变体。它把微批从 N(P+R) 个 token 重打包为 P+NR 个 token，融合前向/反向 kernel 在单次 launch 内遍历「共享上下文 KV + 各序列自身响应 KV」两个物理分离区域，并用 fp32 原子累加解决 N 路序列并发写共享 KV 梯度的竞态。数学上与标准注意力完全等价（无近似）。在 Qwen3-8B GRPO（8×H100, N=32, 8K 上下文）上策略更新加速 1.63–2.09×、MFU 从 36% 提升到 76%；30B MoE（16×H100）上策略更新加速 3.82×、端到端步时加速 3.38×，并可免除序列并行。
AI.motivation: GRPO/DAPO 等 RL 后训练方法在同一 prompt 上采样 N 条响应（P token prompt + R token 响应），标准 FlashAttention-2（FA2）在前向与反向中把 P 个 prompt token 完整复制 N 份，导致对完全相同的隐状态重复计算与占用显存。随着 rollout 因子 N 增大与上下文变长（agentic 任务、仓库级代码生成等），这一冗余在 N≥16、P≥8K 时主导策略更新开销。已有方案各有缺口：paged attention / prefix caching / RadixAttention / bifurcated attention 仅面向推理的只读共享 KV，无训练反向、无 autograd 兼容的梯度累积、无法接入 RL 策略更新流水线；Prefix Grouper 只在框架层重组数据，KV 仍以 N 份复制形式送入 FA2，保留 O(N·P·d) 的显存瓶颈；序列并行（Ulysses/Ring）只切分已复制的序列，去不掉复制本身，反而引入逐层 all-to-all 通信。因此需要一个 kernel 层的、具备精确反向与梯度累积能力的共享 prompt 去重原语。
AI.method: 1）核心观察与证明：在 decoder-only 模型中，因果掩码保证 prompt 位置的隐状态在所有层对所有序列完全一致（Claim 1，逐层归纳覆盖 RMSNorm、QKV 投影、RoPE、因果注意力、MLP、残差），因此 prompt 的所有 per-token 操作与注意力都只需算一次。2）两段式注意力分解：Call 1 用标准 FA2 对单份 prompt 做上下文自注意力（O(P²Hd)）；Call 2 用新的 DualKV kernel 计算各响应对 [K_P; K_R_i] 的注意力（O(N·R·S·Hd)）。3）DualKV 前向 kernel：扩展 FA2 的 tiled online-softmax，在一次 launch 内迭代两个物理不相邻的 KV 区域（共享 context tile 与各序列 decoded tile），通过 context_seqlen=P 将物理块索引映射到逻辑位置 P+r 实现统一因果掩码，并处理两处可能的边界半块 OOB 掩码；支持 GQA、变长响应、GQA 头重复。4）DualKV 反向 kernel（Algorithm 1）：网格 (n_ctx+n_dec, N, H) 做两区域指针分派；关键创新是对共享 K_c/V_c 采用 fp32 scratch 原子累加（解决 N 个 block 并发写同一地址的竞态与 bf16 累加精度损失），随后 Algorithm 2 的 convert_dkv_context 统一一次性转 bf16，类比 FA2 的 dQ fp32→bf16 两段流水线。5）数据流水线改造：在 veRL 中把 N(P+R) 重打包为 P+NR（同 prompt 组的响应共置于同一 GPU 同一微批），跳过 balance_batch 的长度重排并关闭 epoch 内 shuffle；理论上证明训练步级梯度估计器无偏（Theorem 2）。6）与 Ulysses 序列并行组合：先重打包后切片，注意力前后各一次 all-to-all；对共享 prompt 首 token 的 log-prob 通过 O(G·d) 的一次 all-reduce 重建（首 token 概率一致性 max|Δ|=0）。7）额外 kernel 变体：head dim 512 全注意力路径（用 dynamic shared memory opt-in，d=512 超出 FA2 的 d≤256 限制）与 kernel 原生因果滑动窗口（SWA）路径，使 Gemma-4 混合注意力栈可用。
AI.result: Kernel 层（A100，Qwen3-8B 维度，R=2048）：fwd+bwd 加速 1.65×（P=4K, N=28）到 5.48×（P=32K, N=16），峰值显存最多降低 86%，P=64K 时 FA2 直接 OOM 而 DualKV 可跑；反向与前向加速相差 <3%，bwd/fwd 比值恒定约 2.7×，说明两区域反向未引入结构性开销。对比 Prefix Grouper（单层 H100）：DualKV 快 2–4×、省显存 3–5×（P=8K, mb=16 时 9.9 GB vs 50.7 GB），PG 因 padding 与 KV 展开几乎与 FA2 持平。端到端 LongReason（Qwen3-8B，8×H100，N=32）：GRPO 策略更新加速 1.63×（mb=4）/2.09×（mb=8），MFU 36%→76%，峰值显存 106→81 GB（mb=4，FA2 mb=8 OOM）；DAPO 加速 1.91×/2.47×，MFU 31%→77.4%；所有配置奖励曲线一致（val acc 0.78/0.85–0.87）。多节点 MoE（Qwen3-30B-A3B，16×H100，2 节点）：DualKV SP=1 对 FA2 SP=4 策略更新 3.82×、端到端 3.38×（5284s→1564s，吞吐 293→991 tok/s），29 步从 42.6h 降到 12.6h（≈省 6K 美元），且 FA2 需 SP=4 才能避免 OOM。显存标度：DualKV 呈 M0+c_P·P+c_mbR·mb·R（拟合 M0≈41.1GB, c_P≈0.475GB/Ktok, r²=0.989），提示词成本与 mb 无关，P=96K 时 mb 从 4 增到 16 仅多约 4 GB，而 FA2 需 225→775 GB。数值正确性：与 FA2 在 half 精度舍入内一致（allclose atol/rtol=1e-3），覆盖 head dim 64/96/128/192/256、GQA 多种配置；vLLM 贪心解码产生完全相同 token 序列。SP 组合（Gemma-4-31B，8×H200）：16K/SP=1 96.8GB → SP=4 77.0GB（+约12% 步时），32K/SP=4 79.8GB，64K/SP=8 78.9GB 且可完成训练。短提示 GSM8K（A100，N=8, R=256）：更新加速仅 1.04–1.19×，但显存从 37.8→26.5GB（−30%），P≥2.5K 时 FA2 OOM 而 DualKV 仍可训练。
AI.conclusion: DualKV 通过「kernel 级两区域 FlashAttention 变体 + veRL 数据流水线重打包」在 RL 策略更新中消除共享 prompt 的复制，策略更新加速 2–3.8×、MFU 由 36% 提升至 76%，并在长上下文下大幅降低乃至免除序列并行需求，把瓶颈从策略更新转移到 rollout 生成。其正确性由 kernel 级梯度等价定理（Theorem 1）与训练步级无偏性定理（Theorem 2）保证，与标准注意力数学等价、无任何近似。局限与展望：当前假设每个微批组只有单一共享前缀，收益随 P/R 增长，尚未支持共享子图的任意树结构（多轮对话部分重叠前缀、tree-of-thought 搜索）；尚需移植到 FA3/Hopper 与 FA4/Blackwell 后端；代码以 flash_attn 2.8.4 与 verl 0.7.0 的补丁形式开源（github.com/amazon-science/dualkv-flash-attn-for-rl，Gemma-4 支持在 gemma4-dev 分支）。

title: Defining Cultural Capabilities for AI Evaluation: A Taxonomy Grounded in Intercultural Communication Theory
summary: Tremendous efforts have been put into evaluating the inclusivity and effectiveness of AI systems across cultures. However, the cultural capabilities considered in much of the literature remain vaguely defined, are referred to using interchangeable terminology, and are typically limited to recalling accurate information about various demographics, regions, and nationalities. To address this construct ambiguity, we draw from Intercultural Communication scholarship and propose a three-level taxonomy of AI-relevant cultural capabilities: Cultural Awareness answers "Does the model know?", Cultural Sensitivity answers "How does it frame its knowledge?", and Cultural Competence answers "Can it adapt as the interaction evolves?". Beyond conceptual clarification, we position this taxonomy as a practical tool for improving the validity and interpretability of AI evaluation in real-world, multicultural settings. Without such construct clarity, evaluation results risk overstating model capabilities and may lead to inappropriate deployment decisions in culturally sensitive contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文借用跨文化沟通理论（ICC）提出一个三层级"文化能力"分类法，用于规范和澄清AI文化能力评估中的构念混淆：Level 1 文化意识（模型是否"知道"文化知识）、Level 2 文化敏感度（模型如何"框定"其知识，是否尊重且非民族中心）、Level 3 文化能力（模型能否随互动演进"适应"）。该分类法以可观测系统行为而非模型内在特质来定义各层级，并给出对应各层级的评估方法与现有基准的映射示例。
AI.motivation: NLP领域已有大量工作评估AI的文化能力（如FORK、CulturalBench、BLEnD、INCLUDE、NormGenesis、SocialCC等），但"cultural awareness / sensitivity / competence / understanding / adaptation"等术语被随意混用，甚至在同一篇论文内含义不一致，导致：①测量目标不明确，跨基准结果不可比；②把狭窄的知识型表现误读为广义"文化能力"，高估模型成熟度；③在文化敏感场景（如医疗、教育）中导致不当部署决策。跨文化沟通（ICC）、跨文化社会心理学与教育学早已指出文化能力是多维、可分解的复合构念，但AI评估严重欠理论化，因此需要先在可观测行为层面给出系统化定义，再谈测量工具。
AI.method: 三步法构建分类法。Step 1：审视三个经典ICC评估模型——DMIS（跨文化敏感性发展模型，Bennett；六阶段从民族中心主义到民族相对主义，IDI测量）、文化智力CQ（Earley & Ang；动机、认知、元认知、行为四维，CQS测量）、跨文化能力过程模型PMIC（Deardorff；态度—知识—技能—内部/外部结果的循环模型，ICA与VALUE Rubric测量）——将其中元素区分为"动机/情感成分"（仅适用于人类，不投射给AI）与"行为成分"（可在语言输出中观察）。例如DMIS各阶段被解读为话语对应物：Denial→差异的抹除，Defence→优越性框架，Minimization→普遍化语言；CQ的认知维→事实性召回，元认知维→推理/修正/显式修正解释，行为维→语域、礼貌策略变化；PMIC的知识与技能→描述、解释、比较文化实践，外部结果→恰当得体的沟通。Step 2：将可观测行为重组为三大家族：认知基础、框架与立场、互动适应。Step 3：为AI重新诠释为三个可实证检验的层级，并按层级给出评估范式：Awareness用多语多地区QA与知识基准；Sensitivity用专家标注的单轮语气/立场/框架探针；Competence用多轮模拟、场景化对话与人在环研究。强调"能力"指交互中激发的可观测行为，而非脱离情境的稳定特质。
AI.result: 1）提出并形式化了三级分类法：Cultural Awareness（准确表示与检索文化信息、避免幻觉与整体化归并）、Cultural Sensitivity（单轮中对差异的尊重性、非民族中心框定，不落入Denial/Defence/Minimization）、Cultural Competence（多轮中随新文化线索的出现动态调整语域、框架、视角并修复先前的错误框定）。2）给出统一的判定问题："模型知道吗？""它如何框定知识？""它能随互动演进而调整吗？"3）完成已有NLP评估与三层的映射：如GeoMLAMA/FORK/BLEnD/INCLUDE/CulturalBench属Awareness层；SHADES、MC-SIGNS属Sensitivity层；NormGenesis、SocialCC、Havaldar等框架、Nunchi-Bench（可扩展为多轮）属Competence层。4）以K–12教育对话系统为例（如UNESCO在津巴布韦的聊天机器人、"为何某些社群偏好灵性疗法"对话）说明实际任务往往需同时满足三层。5）指出未来方法基础可借用偏见检测、反刻板印象生成、立场检测与情感计算。
AI.conclusion: 构念清晰度是可信AI评估的前提：若文化能力定义不充分，评估结果会系统性高估模型就绪度，尤其容易把知识型成绩误当作完整能力。本文主张以能力层级对齐的评估实践，明确"测了什么、没测什么"，并在多文化场景中减小误读后果。作者亦声明局限：严谨测量本身无法消除英语中心AI的社会技术性危害；该分类法非穷尽，ICC模型带有"外来者"视角而AI用户多为"内部人"视角；文化与文化群体本身流动变化，完整规范知识不可能穷尽；元认知类高阶行为（在给出回答前识别情境相关规范并主动获取缺失信息）仍被忽视；三层边界并非刚性互斥，实际系统中常同时出现，故该分类法应视为帮助研究者表述"评估针对哪一维度"的概念脚手架而非定论。

title: Sign-Separated Finite-Time Error Analysis of Q-Learning
summary: This paper develops a sign-separated finite-time error analysis for constant step-size Q-learning. Starting from the switching-system representation, the error is decomposed into its componentwise negative and positive parts. The negative part is dominated by a lower comparison linear time-invariant (LTI) system associated with a fixed optimal policy, whereas the positive part is controlled by a linear switching system. The resulting bounds show that the negative-side LTI certificate is no slower than the positive-side switching certificate and may produce a faster exponential envelope. The analysis identifies a max-induced asymmetry in Q-learning error dynamics. This asymmetry is connected to overestimation: positive action-wise errors can be selected and propagated by the Bellman maximum, whereas negative errors admit an optimal-policy lower comparison. Finite-time bounds are provided for both deterministic and stochastic constant-step-size recursions.

AI.tldr: This paper provides a sign-separated finite-time error analysis for constant step-size Q-learning by decomposing errors into positive and negative components, identifying a structural asymmetry caused by the max operator that leads to overestimation, and establishing separate convergence bounds for both components.
AI.motivation: Standard Q-learning analysis often treats positive and negative errors symmetrically, but the maximum operator in the Bellman equation creates inherent asymmetry in error dynamics that is not well-characterized in existing finite-time bounds.
AI.method: The methodology decomposes the Q-learning error into componentwise negative and positive parts using a switching-system representation, where the negative part is analyzed via a lower comparison LTI system associated with the optimal policy, and the positive part is controlled by a linear switching system.
AI.result: The bounds demonstrate that the negative-side LTI certificate converges no slower than the positive-side switching certificate and can produce a faster exponential envelope, revealing that positive action-wise errors are preferentially selected and propagated by the Bellman maximum.
AI.conclusion: The max-induced asymmetry in error dynamics reveals a structural advantage in Q-learning's positive-side error propagation, and finite-time bounds for both deterministic and stochastic constant-step-size recursions are established.

title: Spectral Priors vs. Attention: Investigating the Utility of Attention Mechanisms in EEG-Based Diagnosis
summary: Electroencephalograph (EEG) timeseries signals are characterized by significant noise and coarse spatial resolution, which complicates the classification of neurodegenerative diseases. Even SOTA deep learning architectures struggle to distinguish between healthy controls and diseased subjects, or between different disease types, due to high intergroup similarity. In this paper, we show that a spectrally selective approach to feature construction enhances class separability. By isolating signal strengths within the primary brainwave bands, we transform high dimensional raw data into high value spectral features. Our results demonstrate that a) features derived from frequency and time frequency domain allow traditional machine learning models to match or exceed the performance of SOTA deep learning models, b) Attention mechanism is unable to distill the stable feature signatures that characterize healthy neural activity in both resting and task EEGs, and c) the limitations of attention based models in finding relevant spectral features appear to be fundamental in that providing frequency selective time domain input do not appreciably improve their performance. We validate our methodology across three open source resting EEG datasets and one task EEG dataset, providing robust empirical evidence for our claims.

AI.tldr: 本文针对脑电图(EEG)信号分类神经退行性疾病的挑战，提出基于频谱选择的特征构建方法来增强类别可分离性。通过提取主要脑波频段内的信号特征，将高维原始数据转化为高价值频谱特征。实验表明，传统机器学习模型配合频域/时频域特征即可达到或超越最先进的深度学习模型性能，且注意力机制无法有效提取健康神经活动的稳定特征签名。
AI.motivation: EEG时序信号具有显著噪声和粗糙的空间分辨率，增加了神经退行性疾病分类的难度。即使是最先进的深度学习架构也难以区分健康对照组与疾病组，或不同疾病类型之间的差异，原因在于组间相似性高。
AI.method: 采用频谱选择方法进行特征构建：隔离主要脑波频段（δ、θ、α、β、γ等）内的信号强度，将高维原始数据转换为高价值的频谱特征。方法涵盖频率域和时频域特征提取。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：a) 基于频域和时频域特征的传统机器学习模型可匹配或超越SOTA深度学习模型性能；b) 注意力机制无法提取健康神经活动中稳定的特征签名（在静息态和任务态EEG中均如此）；c) 注意力模型的局限性似乎是根本性的，提供频谱选择的时域输入也无法显著改善其性能。
AI.conclusion: 在三个开放获取的静息态EEG数据集和一个任务态EEG数据集上验证了方法的有效性，为所提主张提供了稳健的实证证据。

title: Can Vision Language Models Be Adaptive in Mathematics Education? A Learner Model-based Rubric Study
summary: Adaptive learning refers to educational technologies that track learners' learning progress and adapt the instructional process based on individual learners' learning performance. It is increasingly recognized as critical for developing an effective learning support tool. Vision language models (VLMs) have seen adoption in mathematics education, and students have been using them as learning aids for personalized instruction. However, it is unknown whether VLMs have the ability to adapt to different learner profiles when providing mathematical instructions. Current VLMs lack a systematic evaluation framework for this adaptivity to different learner profiles in mathematics tutoring tasks. To address this gap, we draw on the learner model from the adaptive learning framework (Shute and Towle, 2018) and propose a learner model-based rubric. Our rubric formalizes adaptivity assessment into three aspects: cognitive aspects, motivational aspects, and complexity. We also evaluate two additional dimensions of VLM responses: correctness (of answers and solutions) and quality (of the response itself). Our experimental results show measurable differences in adaptivity across models and also reveal that current VLMs struggle to consistently produce learner model-based instructional responses, especially when receiving limited learner information.

AI.tldr: 该研究填补了VLM在数学辅导中适应能力评估的空白，通过学习者模型框架揭示了当前模型在个性化教学方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏系统性的评估框架来衡量视觉-语言模型在数学辅导任务中对不同学习者画像的适应能力
AI.method: 提出基于学习者模型的评估标准（认知、动机、复杂度三维度）+ 补充正确性和质量两个维度
AI.result: 不同模型间存在可测量的适应能力差异；当前VLMs难以持续产生基于学习者模型的响应，尤其在信息受限时表现不佳
AI.conclusion: 现有VLMs在数学辅导中的个性化教学能力仍需提升，特别是在信息受限场景下难以有效适配不同学习者画像。

title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents
summary: Developing and evaluating e-commerce web agents requires environments that preserve meaningful task structure while enabling controllable, reproducible, and scalable scientific comparison. Existing methodologies force a tradeoff: live storefronts provide realism but are non-stationary, difficult to inspect, and irreproducible, while hand-built sandbox benchmarks provide control but cover only a narrow range of layouts, catalogs, policies, and interaction patterns. We argue that the core bottleneck is methodological: the field lacks a scalable way to construct evaluation settings that are simultaneously realistic, diverse, controllable, inspectable, and reproducible. We introduce ShopGym, an integrated framework for realistic simulation and scalable benchmarking of e-commerce web agents. ShopGym is a framework for constructing e-commerce simulation environments and grounded benchmark tasks. Its simulation layer, ShopArena, converts live seed storefronts into self-contained sandbox shops through anonymized shop specifications and a staged, validated generation process. On top of these simulated storefronts, ShopGuru synthesizes benchmark tasks across seven skill categories, grounding each task in the shop's catalog, navigation structure, policies, and interaction affordances. Together, ShopArena and ShopGuru produce self-contained, resettable, inspectable, and stable evaluation artifacts that preserve structural properties and agent-evaluation signals relevant to shopping tasks. We validate the framework through graph-based structural analysis and agent-based behavioral evaluation with 224 generated tasks across six sandbox shops: three constructed with synthetic data and three with real data. Our results show that the synthetic shops preserve key structural properties of live storefronts, with agent performance on synthetic shops positively correlated with performance on live storefronts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ShopGym框架，用于电子商务网页智能体的现实模拟和可扩展基准测试，通过ShopArena模拟层和ShopGuru任务合成器解决现有评估方法的现实性与可控性之间的矛盾，并在224个任务上验证了合成商店与真实商店的结构相似性和评估信号一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前电子商务网页智能体评估面临两难选择：真实网店提供现实性但不可控、难以检验且不可复现；手工构建的沙盒基准测试可控但覆盖范围狭窄。核心瓶颈在于缺乏一种可扩展的方法来构建同时具备真实性、多样性、可控性、可检验性和可复现性的评估环境。
AI.method: ShopGym框架包含两个核心组件：1) ShopArena模拟层，通过匿名化商店规范和阶段性验证生成流程，将真实种子网店转换为自包含的沙盒商店；2) ShopGuru任务合成器，跨七个技能类别合成基准测试任务，基于商店目录、导航结构、政策和交互能力进行任务锚定。采用图结构分析和智能体行为评估进行验证。
AI.result: 在6个沙盒商店（3个合成数据、3个真实数据）上生成224个任务进行评估，结果表明合成商店保留了真实网店的关键结构属性，且智能体在合成商店上的表现与在真实商店上的表现呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了框架有效性，合成商店保留了真实商店的关键结构属性，且智能体在合成商店与真实商店上的表现呈正相关。

title: On the Stability of Growth in Structural Plasticity
summary: Standard deep-learning pipelines usually choose the network architecture before training and keep it fixed throughout optimization. In contrast, a model can also be adapted by editing its structure during training, for example by pruning existing hidden-neuron units or growing new ones. Although growth is appealing for adaptive and continual systems, we show that it is not simply the inverse of pruning. Pruning selects among units that have participated in training from the start, whereas growth inserts new units into an already specialized optimization trajectory. We isolate this insertion problem and show that newborn units are often forward-active but backward-starved: they participate in the forward computation, yet receive much weaker gradient signal than incumbent units. This disadvantage is minor in small MLP benchmarks, but becomes clear in harder image-classification settings with a convolutional trunk. In these settings, \textsc{Grow} can achieve high final accuracy during the structural-editing procedure, while \textsc{Prune} is stronger when performance is averaged over the training trajectory or when the final sparse network is retrained from scratch. Interventions targeting optimizer state, insertion, selection, and trainability show that improving the integration of newborn units can improve adaptive performance, but does not automatically produce better final subnetworks. In continual-learning benchmarks stressing plasticity loss, \textsc{Grow} becomes competitive mainly when new units have enough time to integrate. Together, these results suggest that \textsc{Grow} should be evaluated not only as an architecture-search operator, but as a time-sensitive optimization process whose success depends on insertion stability.

AI.tldr: 本文深入剖析结构可塑性中"生长"(Grow)算子的优化本质：生长并非剪枝的逆操作，其核心瓶颈是"插入稳定性"(insertion stability)——新生单元虽在前向计算中"活跃"(forward-active)，却因梯度信号匮乏而"向后饥饿"(backward-starved)。在小型MLP中该差异不显著，但在卷积特征学习与残差网络中显现为可测量的性能与表征差异。研究提出:评估生长不应只看最终发现的稀疏架构质量,更应看新增容量能否在下次结构变更前被有效整合利用。
AI.motivation: 标准深度学习流程在训练前固定架构,而结构可塑性(通过训练中剪枝/生长编辑结构)是自动机器学习在参数、FLOPs、延迟约束下的自然原语。然而实践中结构适应仍以剪枝为主流,因为生长与剪枝在优化上并不对称:剪枝是在从头参与训练的单元中做选择(符合lottery-ticket视角),而生长是把新容量插入到已高度特化的优化轨迹中。已有研究指出若新生单元无法在下次信号变化前完成整合,反复扩张本身就会破坏学习稳定性。这导致Grow与Prune的对比混淆了两件事:(1)最终稀疏架构的质量,(2)产生该架构的自适应过程效率。本文因此把生长重新框定为"时敏的优化过程",核心问题是"插入稳定性"——模型能否在可用训练窗口内吸收一次结构新增。为刻画该问题,作者指出新生单元面临三类出生时劣势:函数冲击(function shock,插入扰动已学到的输入-输出映射)、优化器冷启动(新参数无优化器状态)、弱学习信号(新生单元获得的信用分配相对在职单元过少)。
AI.method: 1)三模型族对比:Dense(无编辑)、Prune(IMP,每次剪枝后回卷存活权重)、Grow(从稀疏种子激活休眠单元,按激活频率启发式排序,原位更新掩码不回卷,新单元不继承优化器状态,所有活跃参数联合可训练);采用共享参数生长而非模块化/冻结式生长。2)双评估协议:In-place structural-edit(编辑轨迹内的性能,报告ACC与TAA)与Winning-Ticket(冻结最终掩码、重置权重、从头重训),以区分"最终掩码质量"与"产生它的路径"。3)事件对齐的新生单元诊断:按队列(newborn/incumbent,kept/pruned)测量激活率(后激活幅度)与梯度幅度(前激活梯度),以对数奇偶比/相对队列信号量化"前向参与"与"后向信用",取Post/Exit/End三个时间快照。4)ResNet编辑位点研究:Head、Late、Mid+Late、All四种残差通道编辑位点,用总协方差方差(尺度)、归一化有效秩(支撑)、冻结特征线性探针(效用)刻画已实现表征;并用类别置换重映射探针(固定预算B=2400步全参数微调)测量"有界未来可达性"(AUC与终点精度)。5)四类干预探针:优化器状态(Two-Speed临时放大更新、Moment Transplant继承供体单元的优化器缓冲)、插入(Net2Wider保函数)、选择(GradMax按梯度评分)、可训练性(Rand. Smooth-Leaky随机平滑 leaky激活)。6)持续学习基准:Split-CIFAR100顺序类累积,以及Permuted MNIST、Random-Label MNIST/CIFAR、CIFAR 5+1、Continual ImageNet五个重复移位基准,报告TAOA与Early Task TAA。
AI.result: 1)小型MLP(MNIST、Split-MNIST+ER、Split-Fashion-MNIST)上Grow与Prune的掩码可重训性相当,无稳定排序,说明该不对称并非由稀疏性或类增量训练本身引起。2)CIFAR-100 ConvNet上,Grow的编辑轨迹终点显著更强(50%紧凑度下54.3% vs Prune 50.2%、Dense 49.7%,Welch检验p<0.05),但回卷重训后两者WT ACC统计上不可区分,表明差异来自自适应过程而非最终架构。3)诊断证实新生单元出生即前向活跃(激活率接近或超过在职单元)但梯度信号仅为在职单元的一个显著更小的比例,且整周期内持续存在;该现象在梯度招募下依旧、在更频繁生长下更严重;剪枝则相反,早期选择性强(留存单元活性约为被删单元128–138%)但随周期趋近100%,存活单元需更强再调整。4)残差网络中编辑位点决定结果:Head位点Grow把总方差从35.4提升到53.5、线性探针从55.1%到57.0%,虽有效秩更低(0.516 vs Dense 0.588),仍实现更快的有界重映射(500步约25% vs Dense 19%、Prune 16%,终点均约51%);而All位点下Grow方差更大(17.7 vs 8.3)但有效秩更低(0.405 vs 0.528)、探针更差(45.4% vs 50.5%),终点也更低(41.9% vs Prune 46.2%、Dense 51.3%);AUC随位点从Head 36.5降至All 28.4。类别散度分解显示Head下Grow同时放大类间与类内散度(类间增幅更大),而残差层级编辑压缩特征几何。5)干预解耦了当前性能与未来适应性:ConvNet上早期新生梯度信号与In-place ACC呈负相关(ρ=−0.62);Rand. Smooth-Leaky在提升新生梯度信号同时降低当前精度(ResNet Head约58%→54%),却显著提高未来可达AUC(Head约42 vs vanilla Grow ~38;All约37 vs ~29–30),Two-Speed与Net2Wider效果较弱,Moment Transplant与GradMax偶有增益。6)持续学习:Prune在快速移位下最可靠;Grow+Rand. Smooth-Leaky是最稳定的生长变体,在Split-CIFAR100上显著优于vanilla Grow(平均ACC Δ+12.42,终精度Δ+14.56),在5+1 CIFAR Δ+35.14、Random-Label CIFAR Δ+81.64、Random-Label MNIST Δ+61.38、Continual ImageNet Δ+11.91;但在i.i.d. CIFAR-100上所有方法均下降(约−3至−11)。Growth频率压力测试(5/10/20次编辑)显示越频繁越损害TAA,残差层级尤其明显。
AI.conclusion: 生长与剪枝是互补但优化上不对称的结构可塑性形式:在相同紧凑度与算力下二者都能得到有竞争力的稀疏架构,差异主要体现在产生它们的过程。新单元被加入已特化的网络,可能在获得可比的反向信用之前就已激活,造成"架构扩张"与"功能整合"之间的滞后;该滞后在小MLP中微弱,在卷积特征学习中显现,当编辑进入残差层级时后果加剧。Head局部化生长可产生集中且任务对齐的表征并支持快速功能重映射,而广泛残差生长虽给出相似当前终点,却有更窄的特征支撑与更低的有界未来适应性。干预进一步表明改善新生单元可训练性并不必然改善即时精度,而是改变生长留下的优化状态、使未来解更易到达。在持续移位下,当新生单元足够可训练且有足够时间完成整合时,Grow才具备竞争力。因此结构生长应不仅按其产出的架构评判,更要看它所增加的容量能否成为后续优化的可用资源。作者建议未来以"已实现(realized)容量"而非"新增容量"为目标,设计整合感知的增长策略:用新生/在职梯度平衡、表征支撑或短程有界可达性作为信号来决定何时何地增加结构,必要时推迟下一次编辑直至新增容量稳定,并将结构适应与其留下的优化状态联合评估。

title: Judge Circuits
summary: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant paradigm for grading model outputs at scale, yet the same model assigns systematically different scores when its output format changes (e.g., a 1-5 rating vs. a True/False label). Existing diagnoses of these format-induced inconsistencies stop at the input-output level. Using Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching (PEAP), we causally investigate the internal mechanism in Gemma-3, Qwen2.5, and Llama-3. We find that judgments across structured understanding and open-ended preference tasks share a sparse, generalized Latent Evaluator sub-graph in the mid-to-late multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs); zero-ablating it collapses judgment while preserving world knowledge in architecturally modular models. By structurally decoupling abstract judging from output formatting, we provide a mechanistic account of format-induced inconsistency on the open-weight models we study: a continuous judgment signal computed in the shared trunk is mapped through fragile, format-specific terminal branches, enabling format-independent preference to be isolated downstream of the requested output format. Our findings imply that benchmark-level reliability comparisons across formats are partially measuring formatter geometry rather than evaluation quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了LLM-as-a-judge在不同输出格式下产生系统性评分差异的内部机制：在中后层MLP中存在一个通用的"潜在评估器"子图，负责计算格式无关的连续判断信号；该信号通过格式特定的终端分支映射为具体输出。这一发现表明现有的跨格式可靠性比较实际上部分测量的是"格式化器几何结构"而非评估质量。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge在输出格式变化时（如1-5评分与True/False标签）系统性地给出不同分数，既有问题但现有诊断仅停留在输入-输出层面。
AI.method: 使用PEAP（位置感知边缘归因修补）在Gemma-3、Qwen2.5和Llama-3三个模型中进行因果性内部机制探究，覆盖结构化理解和开放式偏好任务。
AI.result: 判断任务共享一个位于中后层MLP中的稀疏、泛化的潜在评估器子图；零扰动该子图会破坏判断能力但保留世界知识。抽象判断与输出格式在结构上可解耦——连续判断信号在共享主干中计算，通过脆弱的格式特定终端分支映射。
AI.conclusion: Benchmark-level reliability comparisons across formats partially measure "formatter geometry" rather than evaluation quality；格式无关的偏好信号可从共享主干的判断计算中被下游隔离，与请求的输出格式无关。

title: Property-Guided LLM Program Synthesis for Planning
summary: LLMs have shown impressive success in program synthesis, discovering programs that surpass prior solutions. However, these approaches rely on simple numeric scores to signal program quality, such as the value of the solution or the number of passed tests. Because a score offers no guidance on why a program failed, the system must generate and evaluate many candidates hoping some succeed, increasing LLM inference and evaluation costs. We study a different approach: property-guided LLM program synthesis. Instead of scoring programs after evaluation, we check whether a candidate satisfies a formally defined property. When the property is violated, we stop the evaluation early and provide the LLM with a concrete counterexample showing exactly how the program failed. This feedback drastically reduces both the number of program generations and the evaluation cost, and can guide the LLM to generate stronger programs. We evaluate this approach on PDDL planning domains, asking the LLM to synthesize direct heuristic functions: every state reachable by strictly improving transitions has a strictly improving successor. A heuristic with this property leads hill-climbing algorithm directly to a goal state. A counterexample-guided repair loop generates one candidate program, checks the property over a training set, and returns the first case that violates the property. We evaluate our approach on ten planning domains with an out-of-distribution test set. The synthesized heuristics are effectively direct on virtually all test tasks, and compared to the best prior generation method our approach generates seven times fewer programs per domain on average, solves more tasks without using search, and requires several orders of magnitude less computation to evaluate candidates. Whenever a problem admits a verifiable property, property-guided LLM synthesis can reduce cost and improve program quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出属性引导的LLM程序综合方法，通过形式化属性检查替代简单的数值评分，在属性违反时提供具体反例指导LLM修复。在PDDL规划领域合成启发式函数的实验中，相比最佳基线方法，生成程序数量减少七倍，计算评估成本降低数个数量级，且能解决更多无需搜索的任务。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM程序综合依赖简单数值评分（如解决方案价值或通过测试数量）来指示程序质量，但评分无法提供程序失败原因的指导，导致系统需要生成和评估大量候选程序，造成高昂的LLM推理和评估成本。
AI.method: 属性引导的LLM程序综合方法：在程序评估后检查其是否满足形式化定义的属性；违反属性时提前停止评估并提供具体反例。通过反例引导的修复循环，在训练集上检查属性并返回第一个违反属性的案例。应用于PDDL规划领域，合成直接启发式函数。
AI.result: 在十个规划领域和分布外测试集上的评估表明：合成的启发式函数在几乎所有测试任务上都是有效的直接启发式；相比最佳先前生成方法，平均每个领域生成的程序数量减少七倍；能在更多任务上无需搜索直接求解；评估候选程序的计算成本降低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 只要问题存在可验证的属性，属性引导的LLM综合方法就能降低成本并提高程序质量。该方法通过形式化属性检查和反例反馈，能有效指导LLM生成更强的程序。

title: Don't Stop Me Yet: Sampling Loss Minima via Dissipative Riemannian Mechanics
summary: The minima of modern neural network loss functions are typically not isolated, rather they form connected components of reparameterization invariant solutions on the training data. Analytically characterizing these solutions is a hard problem, but sampling approaches are feasible. By construction, existing methods either spread over low-loss regions, and thus do not sample reparameterization invariant solutions exactly, or are inherently local, which limits exploration of other minima valleys. We propose sampling such reparameterization invariant models using a dynamical system based on kinetic energy, subject to a gravitational pull and a friction term that dissipates energy from the system. Our proposed sampler, DiMS, is guaranteed to sample exactly from the minimum level sets and depends on physically motivated hyperparameters which allows control over the exploration capabilities of the sampler. We consider uncertainty quantification in Bayesian inference as the motivating problem and observe improved performance compared to previously proposed approaches.

AI.tldr: DiMS is a physics-inspired sampler using kinetic energy dynamics with configurable exploration to exactly sample reparameterization invariant minima in neural networks, showing promise for Bayesian uncertainty quantification.
AI.motivation: Modern neural network loss functions have non-isolated minima forming connected components of reparameterization invariant solutions; existing sampling methods either spread over low-loss regions without exact sampling or are inherently local, limiting exploration across different minima valleys.
AI.method: Proposes DiMS, a dynamical system-based sampler using kinetic energy with gravitational pull and friction dissipation, designed to sample exactly from minimum level sets while controlling exploration via physically motivated hyperparameters.
AI.result: DiMS achieves exact sampling from minimum level sets with improved performance compared to previously proposed approaches in Bayesian uncertainty quantification.
AI.conclusion: DiMS provides an exact, physically-motivated sampling method that balances exploration and convergence, demonstrating improved performance in Bayesian uncertainty quantification tasks.

title: From Flat Language Labels to Typological Priors: Structured Language Conditioning for Multilingual Speech-to-Speech Translation
comment: Submitted to IEEE/ACM TASLP. This work extends S2ST-Omni, accepted to Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Compositional speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) systems built upon speech large language models (SpeechLLMs) have recently shown promising performance. However, existing S2ST systems often either neglect source-language information or encode it through a language-as-label paradigm, representing each source language as an independent flat embedding. Such a design overlooks systematic linguistic structure shared across languages, which may limit data-efficient multilingual adaptation when supervised S2ST data are scarce. To address this issue, we propose S2ST-Omni 2, a many-to-one compositional S2ST framework that systematically reformulates multilingual language conditioning from flat language labels to structured typological priors. Specifically, S2ST-Omni 2 revisits language conditioning at three levels: typology-informed hierarchical language encoding for structured source-language representation, dynamically-gated language-aware Dual-CTC for content-adaptive acoustic modulation, and typology-aware LLM prompting for decoder-side linguistic guidance. Experiments on CVSS-C show that S2ST-Omni 2 achieves superior average performance among representative S2ST approaches across BLEU, COMET, ASR-BLEU, and BLASER 2.0 under the adopted evaluation protocol. Ablation studies indicate that the proposed representation-level, acoustic-level, and decoding-level strategies provide complementary benefits. Moreover, controlled data-budget analyses and a Japanese-to-English evaluation using only approximately 3 hours of supervised training data suggest that explicit typological priors provide useful inductive biases for data-efficient multilingual S2ST.

AI.tldr: 本文（arXiv 全文题为《Conditioned in Training, Dispensable at Inference: Typological Conditioning for Multilingual Speech Translation》）提出语音翻译前端 TypoCast：以源语言的类型学画像（形态类型、语序、语系）替代"语言标签"作为条件信号，通过 TI-HLE 层级编码 + 双路 MoE adapter + 类型学感知 prompt 三处注入，在 CVSS-C 上以仅 228M 可训练参数（占 4.9B 的 4.6%）超过 S2ST-Omni 与现有 S2ST 系统。其最核心的发现是：类型学条件信号主要在训练期起作用，推理时可被移除而不损失性能（<0.2 BLEU），说明收益源于它对训练数据划分与 adapter 容量分配的影响，而非推理期信息供给；并由此提出"多数画像捕获"（majority-profile capture）及其无法在路由层被纠正的结论。注意：所附摘要对应的是另一篇姊妹作《S2ST-Omni 2》（含 data-budget 与日语→英语约 3 小时数据实验），与全文并非同一篇，方法名词高度对应但结论侧重不同。
AI.motivation: 多语语音到语音翻译（S2ST）前端普遍以 language-as-label 方式条件化源语言（语言 token / 专属 embedding / 专属 adapter / 专属专家），每种语言只从自身数据学习，彼此不共享任何信息，即"身份隔离"（identity isolation）；日语与土耳其虽同为黏着语、动词末置，其嵌入却彼此无关。在 CVSS-C 这类极不均衡语料（法 207,364 条 vs 日 1,119 条，差 185 倍）中，低资源语言无法从类型学近邻受益。直接改用共享属性编码又引出第二个问题——"多数画像捕获"（majority-profile capture）：类内共享嵌入按数据量加权近似为成员最优值的加权平均（式 1），因而被资源最丰富的成员主导，低资源成员继承了在关键属性上并不适合它的先验。作者进一步提出一个此前在语音 LLM 前端领域未被提出的问题：条件信号何时起作用——推理期（为已训练模型提供额外信息）还是训练期（塑造模型本身）？两种假说给出截然不同的可检验预测。
AI.method: TypoCast 保留 S2ST-Omni 骨架：冻结 Whisper-Large-v3 编码器 + 混合卷积/自注意力 adapter + Qwen3-4B 解码器（LoRA rank 8, scaling 32, dropout 0.1，作用于 Q/V 投影）。源语言画像 a(ℓ)=(形态类型, 语序, 语系) 取自 URIEL/WALS 与 Comrie(1989)，在三个位点注入：(1) TI-HLE——属性类嵌入 u 与 per-language 通道 e_ℓ 拼接，经 LN+GELU 融合为 z_ℓ，替换 S2ST-Omni 语言感知 CTC 分支中的身份嵌入；由 FiLM 生成器产生有界的 γ/β，并经带可学习温度 τ 的帧级门控 g_t 调制 adapter 特征 (1+g_tγ)⊙h_t+g_tβ，调制后的特征只送入两个 CTC 头，解码器接收未调制输出，故该位点仅训练期生效；(2) 双路 MoE adapter——adapter 注意力块前馈子层替换为 4 个路由专家 + 1 个恒定激活共享专家、top-2 门控，router logits s_t = W_r x_t（内容项）+ W_s z^typ_ℓ（共享类型学项）+ b_ℓ（per-language 残差），W_s 与 b_ℓ 均零初始化，使训练从纯内容路由起步、类型学结构由学习获得而非人为施加；(3) 类型学感知 prompt——以画像描述 + 三条据此手写的翻译准则替换语言名，相同画像共享同一 prompt。训练沿用两阶段配方：Stage 1 训 adapter、条件模块与 CTC 分支（冻结解码器），Stage 2 加入 LoRA，全程加负载均衡损失（权重 0.01）；bf16、两张 A6000，Stage 1/2 各 150k 步，beam=4 解码，推理时 CTC 头与 FiLM 被丢弃。数据集为 CVSS-C（基于 CoVoST 2），设 Setting A（fr/de/es→en，用于与既有系统对比，三属性划分一致故无法解耦）与 Setting B（七语言 fr,de,es,zh,tr,cy,ja，属性交叉、无两属性产生相同划分，用于全部消融）。评测：BLEU(SacreBLEU)、COMET(wmt22-comet-da)、ASR-BLEU（wav2vec 2.0 转写）、BLASER 2.0（ref 与 qe），语音由零样本合成器 VoxCPM2 生成；所有 Setting B 变体共享编码器/解码器/参数预算/优化与选点规则，仅改动单一组件。
AI.result: Setting A：ASR-BLEU 平均 37.99，较最强既有系统 SLM-S2ST（25.54）高，比 LLaS2S-2.3B（35.69）高 2.30，且三个方向全部领先；文本 BLEU 41.10，超 S2ST-Omni 的 35.67 达 5.43；BLASER 2.0 4.19 vs 4.14（仅德语低 0.01）；COMET 84.46 vs 82.02。Qwen3-Omni-30B 文本 BLEU 高 3.31，但 ASR-BLEU 仅高 1.97、BLASER 仅高 0.02（qe 变体 0.04），说明文本优势不必传导到语音端。Setting B：29.77 BLEU / 27.88 ASR-BLEU（size-weighted 37.17 / 34.55），较同配方 S2ST-Omni 的 26.99 提升 2.78 且七语言全领先（土耳其 +4.27 最大、威尔士 +0.57 最小）；仅把 TI-HLE 换回身份嵌入即降至 27.88（−1.89，为最大单项损失），说明增益并不限于有类型学近邻的语言（德语 +3.00）。核心分析：(1) 训练期作用、推理期可弃——推理时移除 router 语言项，七语均值仅变 0.04 BLEU（单语 ≤0.15），移除类型学 prompt 仅 0.07，二者皆移除仅 0.18；而训练时不用则分别损失 1.50 与 1.10（土耳其 −2.94/−2.88）；专家使用分布变化 ≤0.02 TV，而无语言项训练的模型差异 0.06–0.10 且语言间分离度下降，支持"容量分配"解释。(2) 描述被整体消费——三个属性通道的损失（形态 1.58、语序 1.43、语系 1.24）之和 4.25 超过整体 1.89 的两倍，说明其作用是联合的；错配画像（placebo）得 28.28，与纯内容路由 28.27 几乎相同，即错误描述不值一文。(3) 多数画像捕获可在路由中测得——威尔士的共享项与 Romance 共享项对齐 +0.954（Romance +0.980），残差范数 0.011 仅为共享项 0.244 的约 1/20；将残差放大 13 倍后威尔士 BLEU 仍降 0.14，说明路由级纠偏无法撤销已确定的分配，纠偏必须作用于分配本身（类内梯度重加权或预留容量）。(4) 收益在何处变薄——依赖度与语料规模无单调关系：土耳其最依赖（2.79），威尔士最低（0.50），日本语料更少但因与土耳其共享形态与语序而依赖度近威尔士三倍；提出"邻域判据"——当邻域信息（自身数据量足够、有同画像同伴、或所共享的类在任务所需属性上正确）充分时类型学先验最有用。稳健性：四种合成后端（VoxCPM2/Qwen3-TTS/IndexTTS-2/OmniVoice）间 ASR-BLEU 差 ≤0.21、BLASER 差 ≤0.02，系统排序不变；文本→语音后七语言排序不变。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献不在于提出一个更强的推理期条件机制，而在于反转了设计方向：多语前端应从"更丰富的推理期每语言表示"转向"该信号如何划分训练数据与划分 adapter 容量"。其结论是类型学条件在训练期被消费、推理期可弃（移除代价 <0.2 BLEU），属性作为整体联合起作用，错误的画像等于没有画像，且路由层面的纠偏无法挽救被多数画像捕获的低资源语言——补救必须落在分配机制上（如类内梯度重加权、为少数成员预留容量），这与低资源语言从"共享先验"获益有限、真正受益于"信息充分的类型学邻域"的邻域判据一致。局限：仅用三个粗粒度离散属性（德语被简化为单一语序类）；prompt 消融同时替换画像与手写准则、placebo 同时错配两者，故无法把 prompt 位点收益归因于类型学描述本身；MoE 固定 4 个路由专家，路由纠偏失败仅在该预算成立；七语言中仅威尔士一个"捕获成员"，邻域判据与残差路由仅单例验证；未评测语言外语画像的迁移；源语言为给定而非识别（Whisper 对威尔士仅 83% 正确），但完全不给语言信息也仅损失 0.18 BLEU。

title: Look Before You Leap: Autonomous Exploration for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model based agents often fail in unfamiliar environments due to premature exploitation: a tendency to act on prior knowledge before acquiring sufficient environment-specific information. We identify autonomous exploration as a critical yet underexplored capability for building adaptive agents. To formalize and quantify this capability, we introduce Exploration Checkpoint Coverage, a verifiable metric that measures how broadly an agent discovers key states, objects, and affordances. Our systematic evaluation reveals that agents trained with standard task-oriented reinforcement learning consistently exhibit narrow and repetitive behaviors that impede downstream performance. To address this limitation, we develop a training strategy that interleaves task-execution rollouts and exploration rollouts, with each type of rollout optimized by its corresponding verifiable reward. Building on this training strategy, we propose the Explore-then-Act paradigm, which decouples information-gathering from task execution: agents first utilize an interaction budget to acquire grounded environmental knowledge, then leverage it for task resolution. Our results demonstrate that learning to systematically explore is imperative for building generalizable and real-world-ready agents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型智能体在陌生环境中因"过早开发"而失败的问题，提出将自主探索能力作为构建自适应智能体的关键。研究引入可验证指标"探索检查点覆盖率"(ECC)来量化智能体的探索广度，并开发了结合任务执行与探索的交替训练策略，以及"先探索后行动"(Explore-then-Act)范式，证明了系统化探索学习对构建可泛化、适应真实世界的智能体至关重要。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体在陌生环境中表现不佳，根源在于"过早开发"（premature exploitation）——在获取足够环境特定信息前就依赖先验知识行动。这反映出智能体缺乏系统化的自主探索能力，限制了其在开放世界中的适应性和泛化性。
AI.method: 1) 提出可验证指标"探索检查点覆盖率"(Exploration Checkpoint Coverage)，衡量智能体发现关键状态、对象和可供性的广度；2) 开发交替训练策略，交替执行任务执行rollout和探索rollout，分别由各自的可验证奖励优化；3) 提出"先探索后行动"范式(Explore-then-Act)，将信息收集与任务执行解耦：先利用交互预算获取环境知识，再用于任务解决。
AI.result: 系统评估表明，采用标准任务导向强化学习训练的智能体表现出狭隘且重复的行为模式，阻碍下游性能。通过学习系统化探索，智能体能够更广泛地发现环境中的关键元素，从而提升泛化能力和真实世界适应性。
AI.conclusion: 学习系统化探索是构建可泛化、真实世界可用智能体的必要条件。"先探索后行动"的范式通过将探索阶段与执行阶段解耦，有效解决了过早开发问题，为构建自适应智能体提供了新思路。

title: DrugSAGE:Self-evolving Agent Experience for Efficient State-of-the-Art Drug Discovery
summary: Building state-of-the-art (SOTA) predictive models for drug discovery requires expensive search over tools, architectures, and training strategies. Current LLM-based agents can find SOTA solutions through extensive trial and error, but they do not retain the experience accumulated along the way and therefore pay the full search cost on every new task. We propose \method (Self-evolving Agent Experience), a framework that accumulates and reuses experience across tasks to build SOTA drug discovery models efficiently. \method maintains a cross-task memory of verified skills, statistical evidence about effective strategies, and a record of recurring errors and their fixes. In some cases, \method transfers a working solution directly without test-time search. In 33 molecular property prediction tasks, \method ranks first among nine SOTA agents in a single-task setting. With memory accumulated from 16 smaller tasks, \method achieves an averaged normalized score of 0.935 on 17 held-out tasks in a cross-task evaluation setting and outperforms all baseline agents by 10-30\% in a zero-test-time search regime. In summary, our work shows the advantage of cross-task memory for efficient SOTA model development in drug discovery.

AI.tldr: SEAE是一个跨任务记忆框架，通过积累和重用经验来高效构建药物发现领域的SOTA预测模型。在33个分子性质预测任务中排名第一，在跨任务评估中平均归一化得分达0.935，零测试时搜索模式下比基线高出10-30%。
AI.motivation: 构建药物发现SOTA预测模型需要昂贵的搜索过程。当前基于LLM的智能体虽能找到SOTA方案，但每次新任务都需从头搜索，无法利用累积经验，导致重复消耗计算资源。
AI.method: SEAE框架维护跨任务记忆库，包括：1) 验证过的技能；2) 有效策略的统计证据；3) 错误记录及修复方案。可直接复用已验证方案或进行测试时搜索。
AI.result: 单任务设置：33个分子性质预测任务中排名第一。跨任务评估：16个小任务记忆迁移至17个保留任务，平均归一化得分0.935。零测试时搜索模式下比所有基线高10-30%。
AI.conclusion: 跨任务记忆机制能显著提升药物发现中SOTA模型开发效率，证明经验复用是解决LLM智能体重复搜索问题的有效途径。

title: RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents
summary: Memory systems often organize user-agent interactions as retrievable external memory and are crucial for long-running agents by overcoming the limited context windows of LLMs. However, existing memory systems invoke LLMs to process every incoming interaction for memory extraction, and such an eager memory consolidation scheme leads to substantial token consumption. To tackle this problem, we propose RecMem by rethinking when memory consolidation should be conducted. RecMem stores incoming interactions in a subconscious memory layer and encode them using lightweight embedding models for retrieval. LLMs are only invoked to extract episodic and semantic memory when sustained recurrence are observed for semantically similar interactions. Such recurrence-based consolidation works because these interactions correspond to a semantic cluster with rich information and thus are worth extraction and summarization. To improve accuracy, RecMem also incorporates a semantic refinement mechanism that recovers the fine-grained facts omitted by memory extraction. Experiments show that RecMem reduces the memory construction token cost of three SOTA memory systems by up to 87% while exceeding their accuracy.

AI.tldr: RecMem是一种面向LLM智能体的记忆系统，通过延迟记忆整合策略降低LLM调用频率，仅在检测到语义相似交互的持续重复时才触发LLM记忆提取，实现token成本降低87%且准确性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统在处理每个用户-智能体交互时都调用LLM进行记忆提取，这种"急切记忆整合"方案导致大量token消耗，对于需要长期运行的智能体系统而言成本过高。
AI.method: RecMem采用分层记忆架构：1）潜意识记忆层：使用轻量级嵌入模型存储原始交互；2）仅当观察到语义相似交互的持续重复时，才调用LLM提取情景和语义记忆；3）语义精炼机制：恢复记忆提取中遗漏的细粒度事实。
AI.result: RecMem将三个SOTA记忆系统的记忆构建token成本降低了最高87%，同时准确性超过基线系统。
AI.conclusion: RecMem通过观察相似交互的重复发生来决定何时调用LLM进行记忆提取，是一种高效的记忆管理方法，可大幅降低token消耗同时保持或提升准确性。

title: An Algebraic Exposition of the Theory of Dyadic Morality
summary: This paper provides an algebraic exposition of the theory of dyadic morality (TDM), a psychological model of moral judgment grounded in a simple two-node template: an intentional agent causing harm to a vulnerable patient. We formalize TDM using structural causal modeling (SCM) notation and identify three psychological operators (typecasting operator, completion operator, and valence-dependent inference mechanism) that extend standard SCM to capture how people compute moral judgments under constraints. We address scalability challenges arising from TDM's dyadic limitation, showing how moral cognition compresses multi-node scenarios through node collapse and sequential processing. Drawing on this algebraic framework, we demonstrate concrete applications to AI policy design: detecting conflicting obligations, structuring helpfulness policies to preserve user agency, and designing post-failure communication as causal interventions. Finally, we recommend scoped, contextual measurement of mind perception over universal averaging to operationalize the theory empirically. This algebraic formalization enables neurosymbolic AI systems to compute morality in a way that is both mathematically rigorous and faithful to human moral cognition.

AI.tldr: 本文将二元道德理论（TDM）进行形式化，使用结构因果建模识别三种心理操作符，并展示在AI政策设计中的具体应用。
AI.motivation: 为二元道德理论（TDM）提供代数形式的正式框架，TDM是一种基于简单二元模板（有意主体导致脆弱客体受到伤害）的道德判断心理学模型，现有理论缺乏形式化基础。
AI.method: 使用结构因果建模（SCM）符号形式化TDM，识别三个心理操作符（类型转换操作符、完成操作符、 valence依赖推理机制），通过节点崩溃和顺序处理解决扩展性问题，展示道德认知如何压缩多节点场景。
AI.result: 完成TDM的数学形式化；揭示道德认知通过节点崩溃和顺序处理压缩多节点场景的机制；开发出可应用于AI政策设计的具体工具（冲突义务检测、用户能动性保护、因果干预沟通设计）。
AI.conclusion: 提出三种具体应用（冲突义务检测、帮助性策略设计、故障后沟通干预）；推荐情境化心智感知测量方法；使神经符号AI系统能够以数学严谨且忠实于人类道德认知的方式计算道德问题。

title: Layer-wise Derivative Controlled Networks
comment: Under Review at Neural Network Elsevier
summary: As machine learning models grow in complexity, they increasingly struggle with three conflicting demands: the need for high accuracy, the requirement for hardware efficiency, and the necessity of functional stability. Traditional architectures often achieve performance at the expense of spiky or unpredictable behavior, where small changes in input lead to massive swings in output -- a critical flaw for real-world deployment in sensitive environments. This paper introduces ChainzRule (CR), a novel neural architecture designed to harmonize these competing goals. ChainzRule replaces standard piecewise-linear activations with a Polynomial Engine governed by Differential Regularization (DREG). Unlike traditional methods that impose global, coarse-grained constraints on a model's Lipschitz constant, DREG acts as a targeted regularization on intermediate derivatives. This approach suppresses extreme sensitivity without attenuating the representational power inherent in the Polynomial Engine. In head-to-head "Fair Fight" benchmarks, ChainzRule outperformed standard models while using 15.5x fewer parameters. On the MNIST dataset, it reduced peak gradient volatility by an average of 23.1%, ensuring a smoother and more predictable manifold. On Yelp Full ordinal regression under explicit DREG regularization, ChainzRule achieves 70.17% accuracy, validating that derivative-aware regularization is compatible with competitive performance on realistic tasks. By embedding gradient awareness into the architecture via DREG, ChainzRule demonstrates that stability and accuracy need not be competing objectives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ChainzRule（CR）：一种用"多项式引擎 + 逐层导数正则化（DREG）"替换传统分段线性激活的神经网络架构。其核心是在前向传播中以"前向模式雅可比累积"同步传播值流与导数流，并对各层雅可比 Frobenius 范数施加软性惩罚，以抑制重尾"尖刺"敏感度而不过度压缩表征能力。实验：MNIST 上 24 组配对检验显示 p99 输入梯度在 24/24 对比中显著下降（p<1e-6），POLY_DREG 平均尾比 18.08，峰值梯度波动较其他架构平均降低 23.1%；"Fair Fight"合成基准中 3.3K 参数的 CR 测试 MSE 0.0788，优于 51.2K 参数 MLP（0.0883），即 15.5× 更少参数；Yelp Full 序数回归达 70.17%（3.22M 参数，ReLU+DREG 仅 58.98%）；CIFAR-10-C 腐蚀平均准确率 63.84% vs 61.52%（+2.32%，p=6.18e-5），PGD-10 鲁棒精度 +1.04%。结论：在架构层内置导数控制可使"稳定性与精度"由对立走向协同，但证据主要基于小规模模型与固定嵌入，尚缺端到端大规模验证与严格理论刻画。
AI.motivation: 现代模型（Transformer 等）为追求精度上限而膨胀、敏感且行为不可预测：小的输入扰动会引起输出剧烈波动（"spiky"行为），在代理建模、实时控制、科学计算等高风险场景中构成致命缺陷。作者指出既有导数控制手段的根本缺陷在于作用位置过粗或过晚：(1) 谱归一化（SN）施加全局、非选择性的 Lipschitz 硬约束（σ(W)≤1），切断所有频率的表达能力，带来明显精度税；(2) 输入梯度惩罚（IGP）只是终端惩罚，只约束端到端映射，无法抑制深度上链式复合导致的中间层敏感度放大，且需双反向传播（显存 O(N)、低容量模型浮点溢出）；(3) Sobolev 训练需要真值导数标签并依赖双反向传播，代价 O(3C_f)；(4) Neural ODE / PINN 各自存在推理开销或需要已知控制方程。论文的动机是：现有工作中尚无通用架构把"逐层导数控制"直接嵌入前向传播，同时兼顾精度、硬件效率与功能稳定性。作者还观察到现代参数高效研究（PEFT、低秩更新、瓶颈结构）只关注可训练权重数量，忽视了映射本身的敏感度，故需要一个"多项式归纳偏置 + 逐层敏感度治理"的架构，把导数平滑当作一等设计目标而非事后调参。
AI.method:
架构：ChainzRule 由 L 个 PolyLayer 组成，每层先做仿射变换 z^(l)=W^(l)h^(l-1)+b^(l)，再接 G 次可学习多项式展开 h_i^(l)=Σ_{k=1..G} α_{i,k}(z_i^(l))^k（全文实验固定 G=3），每个神经元自行学习多项式系数。相比 ReLU 的 C^0 导数（分段常数、z=0 处形成"悬崖"），多项式基为 C^∞ 解析导数 φ'(z)=Σ k·α_k z^{k-1}，并可借 Stone-Weierstrass 定理以更少层数/参数逼近光滑流形。
核心机制——双流前向传播（Dual-Stream Pass）：在传播值流 h 的同时，用前向模式（forward-mode）累积雅可比 S^(l)=∂h^(l)/∂x，解析递推 S^(l)=diag(φ'(z^(l)))·W^(l)·S^(l-1)。该设计受 LSTM "Constant Error Carousel" 启发，灵感源于 Chain Rule 本身：每层始终保有自身的敏感度轨迹。由于 φ'(z) 是解析幂级数，敏感度累积与数值流同精度，无需存储二阶计算图，计算开销与标准前向同阶 O(L·H²)，而 Sobolev/IGP 需 O(C_f+2C_b)≈O(3C_f) 与双反向传播的 O(N) 显存代价。
正则化 DREG：以逐层累积雅可比的 Frobenius 范数 d_l(x)=||S^(l)||_F² 定义"敏感度预算"，总损失 L = L_task + λ·Σ_{l=1..L} E_{x~B}[d_l(x)]，λ=10^-2.5≈0.00316（验证集网格搜索确定）。这是"软性敏感度预算"，只选择性压掉重尾尖刺而非均匀收缩，故不同于 SN 的硬性全局截断。理论上作者给出命题 4.1（层间敏感度界：若 ||diag(φ')W||_F² ≤ γ_l 则该层 Lipschitz 常数受 γ_l 约束，全网 Lipschitz 常数受各层乘积约束）。
实验设计：MNIST 取 4 个容量块 (32,16)/(128,64)/(256,128)/(512,256)，每块 3 seed，构成 2 激活（POLY/RELU）× 4 正则（无/DREG/IGPEN/SN）的 24 组配对比较，统计量含 IG Mean/p95/p99/Max 与尾比 p99/Mean；采用配对双侧 t 检验、Wilcoxon 符号秩检验与精确符号检验（α=0.05），并以到"乌托邦点"的欧氏距离做稳定性-精度 Pareto 分析。Yelp Full（75 万条，650k/50k/50k 划分）用固定 300 维 GloVe 平均池化作序数回归：输出连续标量 y∈ℝ，后处理用坐标搜索学习阈值 [T1..T4]=[0.2,1.5,2.5,3.8] 最大化 QWK；损失为 MSE + λE||∂y/∂x||_F²，Adam lr=5e-4，20 epoch，batch 1024，早停 patience=10。CIFAR-10 在共享 ResNet-18 骨干（MobileNetV2 备用）上对比参数对齐的头部（GAP+MLP 约 293,009 参数 vs GAP+ChainzRule 约 294,106 参数），200 epoch、3 seed（1337/1339/2024），用 Accuracy/log10(Params) 作效率 KPI；鲁棒性用 CIFAR-10-C（15 类腐蚀×5 强度）与 PGD-10（L∞, ε=8/255）评估，并做输入显著性图 ∇_xL 机制解释。消融含 5 个合成数据族（Smooth/Piecewise/Sparse/Oscillatory/Entangled）的 λ 扫描与"稳定平台"分析、3.3K 参数 "Fair Fight" 对照（对比 NODE、Sobolev MLP、KAN、MLP）、以及输入维度 D∈{16,32,64,128} 与隐藏宽度 H∈{4..128} 的 scaling law 扫描。
AI.result:
MNIST：POLY_DREG 在 (32,16) 块达 96.38%（比 ReLU 基线低 0.33%），IG 均值下降 4.03×、p99 下降 2.97×；DREG 在 24/24 配对中 p99 更低（p<1e-6），且 p99 相对降幅超过均值降幅（24/24，p<1e-7），呈"选择性抑制"而非均匀收缩。SN 绝对尾指标最低但代价明显（(32,16) 精度 94.70% vs 基线 96.33%，约 −1.63%），DREG 在 (32,16) 反而略提精度（96.38% vs 95.94%）并把尾比从 19.70 降到 15.22。随容量增大未正则模型尾比从 17.79 膨胀到 35.60，POLY_DREG 稳定在 15.22–19.22（均值 18.08），相对其他架构平均"峰值梯度波动"降 23.1%、相对正则基线降 15.2%；Welch 检验最小容量 p<0.01、更大容量 p<0.001。最大容量 Pareto 距离 POLY_DREG 11.23 优于 RELU_DREG 12.42。
合成消融：λ 从 1e-4 增至 1e-2 时梯度 p90 显著下降而 MSE 基本稳定，"稳定平台"起点为 λ≥3e-3；各数据族梯度范数相对下降 32.4%–88.2%，MSE 变化在 −1.02%（Smooth 略升）至 +4.12%（Sparse 改善）之间。Fair Fight：CR+DREG 3.3K 参数 MSE 0.0788（无 DREG 0.0790，差 0.25%），优于 NODE 21.5K/0.0794、Sobolev MLP 11.1K/0.0852、KAN 21K/0.0872、MLP 51.2K/0.0883——即 15.5× 参数效率优势。
Yelp Full：ChainzRule 达 70.17%（优于所列 10 个既有基准平均 66.35%，低于 SOTA 84.49%），参数 3.22M；对照 ReLU+DREG 仅 58.98%，说明低维任务上二者持平、高维（300 维连续情感）上分段线性底座的表征效率崩塌。
CIFAR-10：参数对齐下 ChainzRule 头与 MLP 头精度实质持平（85.30 vs 85.24、83.67 vs 83.25、83.60 vs 83.37，效率 KPI 15.598 vs 15.592 等），作者明确不主张此任务上的优越性；CIFAR-10-C 平均 mCA 63.84% vs 61.52%（+2.32%），其中脉冲噪声 +5.80、玻璃模糊 +5.23、高斯噪声 +4.96，Pixelate −0.32 为唯一退化项；PGD-10 鲁棒精度高 1.04%±0.596%。配对检验 n=57，t=4.33、p=6.18e-5，Wilcoxon p=2.87e-4，Bonferroni 校正后仍显著；显著性图显示 CR 的 ∇_xL 更稀疏、聚焦于语义区域，而 MLP 呈弥散分布。
需要指出的内部不一致与局限：(a) 命题 4.1 的推导不严谨——由 ||diag(φ')W||_F² ≤ γ_l 推出层 Lipschitz 常数 ≤ √γ_l 缺少谱范数与 Frobenius 范数关系的正确处理，全网 Lipschitz 乘积界亦未给出严格证明；(b) 摘要中的"15.5× 更少参数"仅来自合成 Fair Fight 基准（51.2K vs 3.3K），与 Yelp 上"3.22M 参数"的自述规模口径不一致，且 Yelp 架构描述（300→1 单层 PolyLayer）与 3.22M 参数难以对应；(c) "23.1% 峰值梯度波动降低"实为尾比均值比较的重新表述，非直接峰值梯度降幅；(d) Table 4 标题写 λ=10^-2 而正文为 10^-2.5；(e) Table 1 中 POLY_IGPEN 与 POLY_BASE 的 IG 统计量几乎完全相同（如 0.224 vs 0.224），提示 IGP 基线可能未有效施加，削弱"优于 IGP"的对比力度；(f) POLY_DREG 在 (128,64) 块的 IG Max 反而高于基线（19.7 vs 12.5），"抑制极端尖刺"并非处处成立；(g) scaling law 在合成正弦函数上验证，存在天然偏向多项式近似的循环论证风险；(h) 全部实验使用固定嵌入或小规模模型，缺端到端可学习特征、大模型与 transformer 规模验证；(i) 低 λ 区域（<3e-3）梯度抑制呈非单调性，来源未解释；(j) ReLU 与多项式底座的"分化阈值"未定位，作者自承为未来工作。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张：在激活流形与其导数被当作统一数学对象处理时，逐层导数控制与高精度是可协同而非对立的。其机理链条是：多项式基提供 C^∞ 解析导数底座 → 前向模式雅可比累积以近似标准前向的代价实时获知各层敏感度 → DREG 以软性预算选择性压掉重尾尖刺而不作全局截断 → 稳定性-精度 Pareto 前沿优于 SN 与 IGP，且效率随输入维度增长而放大（与 Yelp 上 ReLU+DREG 崩塌至 58.98% 形成对照）。DREG 的核心价值被明确定位为"治理机制"而非"精度提升机制"（合成数据上仅 0.25% MSE 差异），真正承载精度的是多项式底座的高阶曲率表达能力。实用建议是：低维低噪任务用 ReLU+DREG 更简单；高维、光滑流形或强鲁棒需求场景用 POLY+DREG。作者将贡献定位为"整合式功能稳定性"的概念验证，而非新 SOTA，并列出关键后续方向：端到端可学习特征与预训练嵌入微调下的验证、严格理论刻画（真实 Lipschitz 界与逼近能力）、定位底座分化的复杂度阈值、向 transformer 规模模型与长时序领域扩展。

title: Can Large Language Models Imitate Human Speech for Clinical Assessment? LLM-Driven Data Augmentation for Cognitive Score Prediction
summary: Accurate assessment of cognitive decline from spontaneous speech remains challenging due to limited dataset size and class imbalance. In this work, we propose a large language model (LLM)-driven data augmentation framework to improve the prediction of cognitive scores from speech. Experiments are conducted on a Japanese corpus in which each participant provides both a spontaneous oral narrative and a written response to the same clinical prompt. The written responses serve as semantic anchors to generate multiple oral-like monologues in different styles using GPT-5. We then predict Hasegawa Dementia Scale scores, a widely used cognitive screening tool in Japan, using a Partial Least Squares regression model trained on Sentence-BERT speech embeddings. We investigate two augmentation strategies: random class-balanced selection, which yields moderate but unstable improvements, and similarity-guided class-balanced selection. The latter prioritizes semantically close synthetic samples, leading to more consistent improvements and substantially reducing prediction error for minority low-score participants while maintaining performance for the majority group. Overall, our findings demonstrate the potential of semantically guided LLM-driven augmentation as a principled approach for addressing class imbalance and improving data efficiency in clinical speech analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于大语言模型的数据增强框架，利用书面回答作为语义锚点生成多样化的类口语样本，以改善日语认知量表评分预测。针对类别不平衡问题，相似性引导的类别平衡选择策略表现优于随机选择，可有效提升少数群体的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 从自发语音准确评估认知能力下降面临挑战，主要受限于数据集规模有限和类别不平衡问题。
AI.method: 采用日语文本语料库，包含同一临床提示的口头自发叙述和书面回答。书面回答作为语义锚点，使用GPT-5生成多样化的类口语独白。通过Sentence-BERT提取语音嵌入，结合偏最小二乘回归模型预测长谷川痴呆量表评分。对比两种增强策略：随机类别平衡选择与相似性引导的类别平衡选择。
AI.result: 相似性引导的类别平衡选择策略优于随机选择，带来更稳定的改善，显著降低少数低评分参与者的预测误差，同时维持多数群体的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了语义引导的LLM驱动数据增强在解决临床语音分析中类别不平衡问题方面的潜力，为提高数据效率提供了原则性方法。

title: GRLO: Towards Generalizable Reinforcement Learning in Open-Ended Environments from Zero
summary: Post-training has become a crucial step for unlocking the capabilities of large language models, with reinforcement learning (RL) emerging as a critical paradigm. Recent RL-based post-training has increasingly split into two paradigms: reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), which optimizes models using human preference signals in target domains, and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which operates in verifier-backed environments. The latter has dominated recent reasoning-oriented post-training because it delivers stronger gains and higher efficiency on domain-specific tasks (e.g., reasoning). However, although in-domain RL training achieves promising performance, it still requires a substantial amount of GPU compute, which remains a major barrier to broad adoption. In this work, we study the generalization ability of RLHF learned from scratch from a small set of interactions in open-ended environments, and investigate whether the conversational abilities it explicitly acquires can implicitly transfer to downstream tasks such as mathematical reasoning and code generation, namely GRLO. Specifically, on Qwen3-4B-Base backbone, GRLO improves the average performance across all domains from 24.1 to 63.1 with only 5K prompts and 22.7 GPU hours, requiring about $46\times$ less data and $68\times$ less compute than a strong in-domain RLVR baseline. The resulting model is even competitive with Qwen's released post-trained models which required a much larger training cost. Notably, a subsequent in-domain RLVR stage brings only selective gains, mainly on harder competition-math benchmarks. We hope GRLO offers a simple and efficient recipe for building broadly capable post-trained models. Our code and data will be available at: \href{https://github.com/SJY8460/GRLO}{https://github.com/SJY8460/GRLO}.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于"RL 训练中在哪里训练（where，提示分布）与奖励什么（what，验证器 vs. 奖励模型）"如何影响跨域迁移的受控实证研究。作者固定优化器（PPO）、固定预算（5K prompts、15 epochs、60 iterations），仅交叉改变提示来源（Math / WebInstruct / UltraFeedback chat）与奖励类型（规则验证器、1.5B 模型验证器、偏好奖励模型），在 Qwen3-4B/8B-Base 与 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上评测可验证域（数学/科学/代码）与开放式对话（AlpacaEval 2 LC、Arena-Hard）。核心结论是一种"不对称迁移"：可验证域的收益几乎与"在哪里训、奖励什么"无关——仅用 5K 开放式 chat 提示 + 奖励模型（Chat-RM）即可在数学与代码上比肩数学 RLVR（MATH500 79.2 vs 79.8，HumanEval 82.3 vs 82.9）；而开放式对话的收益必须依赖奖励模型，且随提示越开放而单调增长（AE2 LC：Math-RM 34.3 → Web-RM 47.8 → Math+Chat-RM 54.0 → Chat-RM 61.2），使用验证器时无论提示多开放都停在低位（≤35.1）。由此得出高效配方：在开放提示上用奖励模型做 RL，可同时获得两类收益，兼具低成本（单次训练约 3 GPU-小时、约 20–27 GPU-hours）与强通用性。
AI.motivation: 大模型后训练目前分裂为两条路线：RLVR（在有参考答案、可被规则校验的域上做强化学习，推理导向、收益强但需大量 GPU 算力）与 RLHF（用学习到的奖励模型在开放式对话上优化）。生产流程常把两者串联，但已有研究大多各自用自己的数据、奖励与协议训练并只在自身域内评测，因此"RLVR 的数学能力能否迁移到对话""RLHF 的对话能力能否隐式迁移到数学与代码"仍不清楚。根本障碍在于直接比较 RLVR 与 RLHF 同时改变了两个变量：训练位置（where：提示来自哪个域）与奖励方式（what：规则验证器 vs. 奖励模型），因此无法归因。已有"扩展可验证覆盖"的方案（如 General-Reasoner）代价高昂（230K prompts、约 1.5K GPU-hours/4B），且大量开放式请求本无标准答案、天然应由奖励模型评分。缺少一个固定单一配方、只交叉"提示域 × 奖励类型"的受控研究。
AI.method: 受控研究设计：固定 backbone（主实验 Qwen3-4B-Base，另有 Qwen3-8B-Base、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct）、固定优化器（PPO + 从 base 初始化的 value critic，GAE γ=λ=1，无 KL 惩罚、无熵奖励）、固定训练量（5K prompts、15 epochs = 60 iterations、每 prompt 1 个采样、batch 1024、mini-batch 256、actor lr 1e-6、critic lr 1e-5、clip 0.2、响应上限 3072 tokens），仅变化两个因子。Where：Math（MATH 训练集竞赛题）、Web（General-Reasoner 的 WebInstruct 多域题，含参考答案、要求 \boxed{} 输出）、Chat（UltraFeedback 随机抽取的开放式多域对话提示，无参考答案）。What：规则验证器（Math，末答案等价则 1）、模型验证器（Web，General-Verifier 1.5B，匹配 +1 / 不匹配 0 / 抽不出答案 −0.5）、奖励模型（Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B，对整段回复打分）。共 8 种 RL 配置（Math-RLVR、Web-RLVR、Math-RM、Web-RM、Math+Chat-RM、Math-RLVR+Chat-RM、Web-RLVR+Chat-RM、Chat-RM）。评测：可验证域用 MATH500、OlympiadBench、Minerva Math、AIME 2024–2026（avg@32 + pass@k）、GPQA-Diamond、HumanEval、MBPP（chat 式协议，含转义修复）；开放式用 AlpacaEval 2 长度受控胜率（参考 GPT-4 Turbo）与 Arena-Hard v0.1（基线 GPT-4-0314，双向对打 + Bradley-Terry 风格控制），主裁判 Qwen2-72B-Instruct，另用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 做第二裁判复核。基线含 base、General-Reasoner-4B、两个同预算 SFT（OpenR1-Math、UltraChat），并追加种子复现、逐 epoch checkpoint、响应长度与风格控制、MATH500 错误分解（格式 vs 推理）、1K/3K/5K 数据规模、以及验证器↔奖励模型两阶段顺序训练等消融。
AI.result: ① 核心不对称结论：可验证域收益与 where/what 几乎无关——Chat-RM（从不看参考答案）在数学与代码上追平 Math-RLVR（MATH500 79.2 vs 79.8、Olympiad 43.6 vs 41.3、HumanEval 82.3 vs 82.9，仅 AIME 11.7 vs 14.3 落后）；反过来 Math-RLVR/Web-RLVR 在几乎没有编程提示的情况下 HumanEval 提升 +24.4/+25.7，与 Chat-RM 的 +23.8 相当，且双向迁移。② 开放式域则 both 因素都重要：验证器下无论 Math/Web（AE2 LC 29.9/35.1，Arena-Hard 64.2/65.9，甚至 46× 更多数据的 General-Reasoner-4B 也只有 30.3/65.0）都停在低位；换成奖励模型后随提示开放度单调提升（AE2 LC 34.3→47.8→54.0→61.2；Arena-Hard 65.8→73.7→76.6→79.4）。③ 联合训练可兼得：Math+Chat-RM 保持数学分（MATH500 78.6 vs Math-RM 78.8）同时 AE2 LC +19.7、Arena-Hard +10.8；两阶段顺序训练则由顺序决定保留哪类收益（验证器优先 MATH500 最高 83.2 但 AE2 LC 降到 48.8；奖励模型优先保住 Arena-Hard 78.7–80.2 但 AE2 LC 降到 52.2）。④ 收益来自推理而非格式：MATH500 推理错误率从 base 26.6% 降至 19.6–21.6%，格式错误 ≤0.8%（base 1.8%），AIME pass@k 在 k≤32 全区间优于 base。⑤ 非长度/风格假象：长度控制与 Arena-Hard 风格控制后排序不变（Chat-RM 77.0 vs Math-RLVR 62.8），裁判换成 Gemini 仍保持差距（AE2 LC 21.9 vs 8.9/11.4）。⑥ 稳健性：奖励模型 3B/4B/8B 结果一致（无需大 RM）；Qwen3-8B（Chat-RM AE2 LC 63.6 / Arena-Hard 85.1）与 Llama-3.2-3B（35.1/45.9）复现同一不对称性；数据规模上 1K chat 提示已达验证器run的开放水平（34.8），3K 接近 Web-RM（46.4 vs 47.8），5K 达 61.2 且未见饱和，而可验证能力在 1K 时已基本到位（MATH500 76.4）。⑦ 成本：单次 4B 训练约 2.6–3.4 小时（8×RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell），与 General-Reasoner-4B 相比少约 46× 数据与约 68× 算力而接近其数学/代码水平。
AI.conclusion: RL 在可验证域与开放式域之间的迁移是不对称的：数学与代码的收益既不依赖提示来源也不依赖奖励类型（奖励模型本身可能已编码部分正确性/推理质量，因此显式验证器并非必需），而开放式对话的收益必须由奖励模型提供，并随提示的开放程度单调增长（验证器无法奖励开放式评估所测量的质量）。因此"在开放式提示上用奖励模型做 RL"是同时获得两类能力的高效途径，可作为低成本构建通用后训练模型的简洁配方。局限：仅研究基座模型在单轮生成、固定生成预算、非思考模式下的 RL 行为，未探索额外推理预算/思考模式与长程 agentic 任务；奖励模型与裁判编码了训练数据的偏好可能放大社会偏见，checkpoint 未做安全训练，仅为研究产物；部分 AIME 对比受 30 题/场、单题 3.3 分的统计粒度限制（如 AIME 2026 上 base 在 k=32 反超）。

title: Multi-Level Contextual Token Relation Modeling for Machine-Generated Text Detection
summary: Machine-generated texts (MGTs) pose risks such as disinformation and phishing, underscoring the need for reliable detection. Metric-based methods, which extract statistically distinguishable features of MGTs, are often more practical than complex model-based methods that are prone to overfitting. Given their diverse designs, we first place representative metric-based methods within a unified framework, enabling a clear assessment of their advantages and limitations. Our analysis identifies a core challenge across these methods: the token-level detection score is easily biased by the inherent randomness of the MGTs generation process. Then, we theoretically derive the multi-hop transitions of the token-level detection score and explore their local and global relations. Based on these findings, we propose a multi-level contextual token relation modeling framework for MGT detection. Specifically, for local relations, we model them through a lightweight Markov-informed calibration module that refines token-level evidence before aggregation. For global relations, we introduce a rule-support reasoning module that uses explicit logical rules derived from contextual score statistics. Finally, we combine the local calibrated score and the global rule-support reasoning signal in a joint multi-level inference framework. Extensive experiments show broad and substantial improvements across various real-world scenarios, including cross-LLM and cross-domain settings, with low computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机器生成文本（MGT）检测中的"基于度量（metric-based）"方法提出统一分析与增强框架：指出所有此类方法共有的瓶颈是 token 级检测分数易受 LLM 采样随机性污染；理论上从"注意力分数"推广到"token 分数"、从单跳推广到多跳，推导并实证了两类上下文关系（局部：邻域相似性、初始不稳定性；全局：分数稳定性、相邻差/长程差稳定性）；据此提出"多层次上下文 token 关系建模"框架——局部用 Markov 随机场（均值场近似）校准 token 分数，全局用基于阈值的规则-支持推理给出置信分数，二者在联合推断中以可学习系数 λ 融合。在 9 个基线检测器、4 个数据集、跨 LLM/跨域/对抗/改写/混合文本等场景下取得显著提升（如 Essay 上 Likelihood 的 TPR@FPR-1% 由 52.41%→82.65%，DetectGPT 由 0.15%→82.32%），且额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 机器生成文本（MGT）可能被用于虚假信息、钓鱼与侵犯知识产权，检测需求迫切。现有方法分为主动水印（需修改生成模型、访问权限高，不实用）、基于模型（训练二分类器，结构复杂、易过拟合、跨域泛化差）与基于度量（利用 LLM 内在统计偏置，模型无关、泛化更好）三类。作者指出，尽管 Log-Likelihood、Entropy、Binoculars、DetectGPT、Fast-DetectGPT、DNA-DetectLLM 等度量式方法设计各异，但其共同结构是"先计算 token 级检测分数，再以各种策略聚合为文本级分数并阈值判决"，而 LLM 采样过程的固有随机性会使 token 级分数带有偏置，聚合步骤无法纠正这种误差，检测性能因此被 token 级分数精度所限死。由此自然引出核心问题：能否显式揭示并利用 token 级检测分数之间的上下文关系（局部短程与全局长程）来修正分数误差、提升检测效果？
AI.method: 方法分四部分。（1）统一框架：在简化单层单头 Transformer 代理模型上，令 token 级检测分数 d(s_t)=G(α_t)（G 为 L∞-Lipschitz），Theorem 1 给出相邻位置分数差的界 |d(s_{t+1})-d(s_t)| ≤ L(1+√2)ε·max_j(x_jWx_j^T)/((t+1)||a_t||₂)，蕴含"邻域相似性"（分数差随跳数增大而增大）与"初始不稳定性"（界随 t 增大而收紧，故序列开头更不稳定）；Theorem 2 将其推广到多跳 |d(s_{t+k})-d(s_t)| ≤ L(1+√2)ε·max_j(x_jWx_j^T)·ln(1+k/t)/min_{0≤i<k}||a_{t+i}||₂，t 大时 ln(1+k/t)→0，说明长程分数变化亦受结构约束，并据此提出三个全局统计量：分数稳定性 σ²_late、相邻差稳定性 σ²/μ_late,adj、长程差稳定性 σ²/μ_late,long（均取 t>t₀=20 的后段）。（2）局部校准模块（源自其前期工作）：构建二元 pMRF（Gibbs 分布），一元势取 −log p(s_t)，成对势以 w 奖励相邻同标签/惩罚异标签，并用 Sigmoid 位置权重 β(j)=1/(1+exp(−(j−t₀))) 抑制前段不稳定位置；精确推断不可行，采用均值场变分近似的矩阵迭代更新 Q^(r)=softmax(log Q^(r−1) − A Q^(r−1)(W⊙[[-1,1],[1,-1]]))，迭代 T=10 次后对早期位置再降权得 Q_final，再交回原检测器的聚合模块 f_dec，即 f_enh(s)=f_dec(f_mrf(f_tok(s)))。（3）全局规则-支持推理模块：给出理想规则推理分解 p(y|s,b) ∝ Σ_α p(b|α)·p(y|α)·p(α|s)，分别对应规则先验（由全局统计量在训练集上的经验区间均匀离散为 K=10 个区间、得到阈值原子，每个统计量恰选一个原子，规则形式为"原子1 AND 原子2 AND …"，可行规则空间 Ω）、规则生成（由输入文本的统计量确定性地映射到唯一规则 α(s)，p(α|s) 退化为 one-hot）、检测项（理想上用满足规则样本的类占比，但因 K^M 组合爆炸导致稀疏，改用逐原子的支持分数 r(y|o)=n_{o,y}/n_o，未见原子取 0.5 作中性值，再对激活的 M 个原子取平均得 r_rule(s)，明确声明其为"支持分数"而非校准后验概率）。（4）联合多层推断：F(s)=f_enh(s)+λ·r_rule(s)，λ≥0 可学习（验证集选择）；总复杂度 O(NT+NM+MK)，远低于基于模型的训练成本。实验采用严格黑盒威胁模型，以 GPT-2（Fast-DetectGPT/DetectLLM 用 GPT-2-XL）为代理评分模型；4 个数据集（Essay、Reuters、TruthfulQA、DetectRL），10% 训练 / 验证+测试各半，阈值与原子支持分数仅在训练集估计，5 个随机种子重复；指标为 AUROC 与 TPR@FPR-1%。
AI.result: 1) 跨 LLM 泛化（Essay 上以 GPT4All 文本训练）：TPR@FPR-1% 平均值 Likelihood 52.41%→77.87%(M)→82.65%(Mult)，DetectGPT 0.15%→37.17%→82.32%，FastGPT 4.43%→26.58%→85.25%，DetectLLM 1.20%→15.29%→82.32%，AdaGPT 20.30%→24.17%→84.11%；AUROC 同样单调提升（如 DetectGPT 49.33%→97.76%，DetectLLM 44.49%→96.97%，Binoculars 97.36%→98.45%）。2) TruthfulQA（短文本）上同样有效，如 Likelihood 46.38%→69.30%。3) 跨域（DetectRL 的 arXiv/XSum/Writing Prompts/Yelp，16 组训练-测试对）以 DetectLLM 为例，AUROC 相对原始检测器平均 +19.1，相对前期局部工作 +7.2。4) 混合文本（1/4 机器句替换为人类句）、Dipper/Polish 改写攻击、字符级与词级对抗扰动下，该方法在多数设置中优于原始检测器与仅局部版本；但作者坦承对 ChatGPT 混合文本接近随机猜测（AUROC≈0.5），说明增强依赖基础检测器本身具备一定预测力。5) 规则可视化（Fig.9）显示后段稳定性越强的规则对应越高 MGT 经验概率，与 Fig.3 的分布证据一致。6) 与严格概率化规则基线对比，本文逐原子支持分数聚合策略更优（因小样本下 K^M 规则稀疏不稳）。7) 消融显示去掉全局分支性能明显下降（FastGPT、DetectLLM 上尤甚），去掉局部分支在多数设置仍具竞争力，说明全局分支本身贡献主要判别力。8) 敏感性分析：对 K（10）与 t₀（20）在较宽范围内稳定，K 过大时因桶内样本过少而下降；t₀=0 时仍优于无全局推理。9) 运行时间开销可忽略（如 DetectLLM 推理 169.12s→178.87s，FourierGPT 97.18s→111.01s）。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于：把差异化的度量式 MGT 检测器纳入"token 级打分—聚合判决"的统一视角，定位出其共性缺陷（token 级分数被生成随机性污染）；将上下文关系建模从注意力分数推广到 token 分数、从单跳推广到多跳，理论上刻画并实证了局部（邻域相似性、初始不稳定性）与全局（分数/相邻差/长程差稳定性）关系；提出 Markov 校准 + 规则-支持推理的联合多层框架，实现对任意 token 级可分解检测器的即插即用增强，在跨 LLM、跨域、改写与对抗场景下取得一致且显著的提升，且几乎不增加推理开销。局限与展望：框架仅适用于分数可在 token 级分解的度量式检测器；未来针对自适应攻击可能刻意破坏分数稳定性模式的风险尚未解决；此外在基础检测器近乎随机时增强效果有限。

title: Toward World Modeling of Physiological Signals with Chaos-Theoretic Balancing and Latent Dynamics
summary: Physiological time series signals reflect complex, multi-scale dynamical processes of the human body. Existing modeling studies focus on static tasks such as classification, event forecasting, or short-horizon next step prediction, while long-horizon signal-level forecasting and predictive nature of physiological signals remain underexplored. We introduce NormWear-2, a world model that encodes both multivariate physiological signals and clinical intervention variables into a shared latent space and models their joint temporal evolution as a dynamical system. Our approach combines inference from prior pre-trained knowledge (intuition) with instant non-parametric latent state transition adaptation (insight), enabling coherent forecasting across multiple temporal scales, conditioned on heterogeneous clinical interventions. During the pretraining phase, we find that chaos-theoretic balancing of dynamical regime diversity yields more robust representations, with a smaller balanced corpus outperforming one twice its size and capturing bifurcation regimes. We evaluate the world model performance across diverse real-world physiological datasets spanning heterogeneous temporal resolutions and intervention regimes, covering daily life, point-of-care, and clinical settings, including fitness planning, hemodialysis, diabetes management, and surgical monitoring. These evaluation datasets comprise records from 8,026 subjects, spanning study durations from 3.2 hours for high-resolution signal data to 2.3 years for longitudinal clinical biomarker tracking. NormWear-2 achieves the best overall forecasting performance across time, frequency, and latent representation domains, with significant improvements over state-of-the-art time series foundation models, while maintaining competitive downstream representation quality, providing a step toward general-purpose world models for physiological signals.

AI.tldr: NormWear-2 is a world model for physiological signals that combines prior knowledge with adaptive state transitions for multi-scale forecasting, outperforming existing foundation models across diverse clinical and daily-life datasets.
AI.motivation: Existing physiological signal modeling focuses on static tasks (classification, event forecasting, short-horizon next step prediction), leaving long-horizon signal-level forecasting and the predictive nature of physiological signals underexplored.
AI.method: NormWear-2 encodes multivariate physiological signals and clinical intervention variables into a shared latent space, modeling their joint temporal evolution as a dynamical system. The approach combines inference from pre-trained knowledge (intuition) with non-parametric latent state transition adaptation (insight). A chaos-theoretic balancing strategy of dynamical regime diversity is used during pretraining.
AI.result: NormWear-2 achieves best overall forecasting performance across time, frequency, and latent representation domains on 8,026 subjects spanning 3.2 hours to 2.3 years, with significant improvements over state-of-the-art time series foundation models.
AI.conclusion: NormWear-2 represents a step toward general-purpose world models for physiological signals, with competitive downstream representation quality alongside superior forecasting performance.

title: DebiasRAG: A Tuning-Free Path to Fair Generation in Large Language Models through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved unprecedented success due to their exceptional generative capabilities. However, because they depend on knowledge encapsulated from training corpora, they may produce hallucinations, stereotypes, and socially biased content. In particular, LLMs are prone to prejudiced responses involving race, gender, and age, which are collectively referred to as social biases. Prior studies have used fine-tuning and prompt engineering to mitigate such biases in LLMs, but these methods require additional training resources or domain knowledge to design the framework. Moreover, they may degrade the original capabilities of LLMs and often overlook the need for dynamic debiasing contexts for fairer inference. In this paper, we propose DebiasRAG, a novel tuning-free and dynamic query-specific debiasing framework based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). DebiasRAG improves fairness while preserving the intrinsic properties of LLMs, such as representation ability. DebiasRAG consists of three stages: (1) query-specific debiasing candidate generation; (2) context candidate pool construction; and (3) gradient-updated debiasing-guided context piece reranking. First, DebiasRAG leverages self-diagnosed bias contexts relevant to the query through regular retrieval, where the bias contexts are prepared offline by the DebiasRAG provider.
