AI.result: 基线 Edge Impulse KWS 模型：3,859 参数，测试精度 0.921（错误率 0.079）。800 次试验的完整扫描显示两个一致的支配性模式：在每一个水平精度阈值上，最左侧（达到该精度所需最少参数）的点均为树突模型；在每一个垂直参数预算上，精度最高的点亦为树突模型。关键模型对比：最小的超越基线精度模型为树突模型，1,556 参数、精度 0.933（错误率 0.067），相对基线错误率降低 16%、参数量减少 60%；最高精度模型为树突模型，11,421 参数、精度 0.958（错误率 0.042），而参数量相近（10,595）的最接近传统模型其错误率高 29%。整体最优模型相对基线实现参数量 −60%、错误率 −46%。结果在精度—效率权衡曲线的每一个操作点上都优于传统架构，而非仅在单一配置上偶然胜出。
AI.conclusion: PB/树枝突架构在关键词唤醒任务中于精度—效率权衡的所有工作点上一致优于传统架构，验证了其作为「通用深度网络训练改进手段」的适用性，扩展了此前在化学图网络、股市预测、时序医疗数据、NLP、蛋白质生物学与图像分类上的验证谱系至音频边缘推理领域。实现上以 PyTorch 包装器形式提供，无需改动模型定义与训练流程，代码与 Dendritic NN Impulse Block 已开源。对边缘 AI 工程师而言，树突模型在固定参数量下精度更高、在固定精度下参数量更小，因此在任一维度受限的场景下都能直接获益。局限与展望：作者承认论文以应用与实证为主，PB 早期文献指出尚无树突模型达到 SOTA 精度；未来工作包括推广到更多音频架构与嵌入式部署基准、与硬件感知的神经架构搜索结合，并在真实 MCU 上的推理延迟与内存占用需进一步验证。

title: Towards Code-Oriented LM Embeddings for Surrogate-Assisted Neural Architecture Search
comment: This is an extended version of work accepted to GECCO 2026. Our code is available at https://github.com/pcsom/cole/tree/v1.0
summary: Developing effective surrogates (performance predictors) for Neural Architecture Search (NAS) typically requires expensive fine-tuning or the engineering of complex representations. We propose a low-cost embedding strategy that leverages the inductive bias of Language Models (LMs) to eliminate these overheads. By representing architectures as PyTorch class definition text, we demonstrate that off-the-shelf LMs act as competitive feature extractors without NAS-specialized fine-tuning. The final predictor is constructed by passing the extracted Code-Oriented LM Embeddings (COLE) through a lightweight regression head. We also investigate strategies to improve embedding quality and utilization. Our experiments on the NAS-Bench-201 and einspace search spaces reveal that raw code inputs yield higher predictive performance than other text-based encodings (e.g., ONNX-to-text encodings) when using frozen LMs. We also observe COLE drives superior surrogate-assisted search using the BANANAS algorithm in NAS-Bench-201. When optimizing for CIFAR-100 performance, replacing structural path encodings with COLE for architecture representation allows for a 34% decrease in the evaluation budget required to reach within 1% of the fittest architecture in the search space (by test accuracy). As any neural architecture can be represented as code, these findings establish COLE as a versatile and efficient foundation for advancing NAS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 COLE（Code-Oriented LM Embeddings）：把神经架构直接转写为 PyTorch 类定义源码，用冻结的开箱即用大语言模型（默认 CodeLlama Python 7B）做 token 级均值池化得到嵌入，再经 PCA 降维到 128 维、接轻量 MLP 回归头（成对 Hinge 损失优化 Kendall's Tau）作为 NAS 代理模型。作者证明免微调的代码原生编码在排序相关性上优于 ONNX-to-text、einspace 推导树字符串等文本编码，并在 NASLib 的 BANANAS 中替换路径编码，使 CIFAR-100 达到最优架构 1% 精度内所需评估次数从 200 降至 132（-34%），CIFAR-10 -13%、ImageNet16-120 -18%。
AI.motivation: NAS 中构建性能预测器（代理模型）代价高昂：一是需要昂贵的大模型微调（Qin 等用 ModernBERT 在推导树字符串上端到端微调），二是结构化编码（邻接矩阵、路径编码）刚性、维度固定、语义不完整，超参数（如卷积核大小）需为每个取值单独注册配置，且迁移到新搜索空间需重新设计编码。作者的核心洞察是：架构天然有"代码"表示，而 LM 的预训练语料以代码为主，ONNX-to-text、推导树字符串等文本格式在预训练分布中代表性不足、错配模型已学分布；因此用冻结 LM 的原生代码理解能力做零样本嵌入，可同时省去微调开销并支持冷启动搜索。
AI.method: 1) 原生代码字符串化：NAS-Bench-201 的管道分隔基因型串被确定性翻译为 PyTorch nn.Module 子类；考察三种冗长度（Helper Method 完整实现 / Inline 用 nn.Sequential 内联 / Excluded Helper 仅调用签名），最终采用 token 最省的 Excluded Helper 模式；另设 Backbone（宏架构源码）与 Comment（自然语言 docstring）两种上下文附加。einspace 侧实现确定性转译器，递归遍历推导树，将非终结符（Sequential/Branching/Routing/Computation）映射为容器类，终结符映射为原子层，并用正则从操作名解析超参（如 linear(128)）。2) 冻结嵌入提取：完全冻结 LM，取最后一层各 token 隐状态做 mean pooling 得 4096 维（CodeLlama 7B）嵌入；默认 CodeLlama Python 7B（Python -centric 预训练对齐 PyTorch 语法）。3) 代理头：PCA 降至 128 维以缓解维度灾难，串联三层 MLP（每层 128 隐藏单元、LeakyReLU、dropout 0.1），用成对 Hinge 损失优化排序（Kendall's Tau），兼顾绝对精度可用 MSE。4) 实验协议：NAS-Bench-201 全部 15,625 个架构，10 折分层交叉验证，每折内按训练预算 N∈{14,55,220,879,3516} 分层采样 10 个种子共 100 次试验；与 ONNX 语料按精度 1e-7 对齐得 7,400 架构子集；einspace 语料为 9 次搜索历史聚合的 2,837 个架构。5) 下游搜索：接入 NASLib 的 BANANAS，保持同一 MLP 预测器，100 次独立试验、500 次真实评估预算，前 20 次为正则化进化种群初始化，每 10 次评估重训代理模型，对比路径编码。
AI.result: NAS-Bench-201 基准配置（CodeLlama Python 7B + PCA-128 + 成对 Hinge）Kendall's Tau 随训练量从 0.463(N=14) 升至 0.797(N=3516)；PCA 在 N≥220 后关键（N=879 时 0.703 vs 无 PCA 0.645）；成对 Hinge 排序性能优于 MSE（0.703 vs 0.691），但 MSE 绝对误差更小（33.74 vs 104.21）；三种代码冗长度几乎无差异，Backbone 附加仅微弱提升（0.711@879）而显著增token，8-bit 量化仅在 N=14 时略优。模型对比：CodeLlama Python 7B/34B 整体领先，7B→34B 增益有限（0.703→0.711），Yi Coder 1.5B（0.698）与 ModernBERT Large 相当，CodeBERT 明显落后（0.659@879）；decoder-only 总体优于 encoder-only。编码对比：NAS-Bench-201 上 PyTorch 文本在 N≥220 显著优于 ONNX-to-text（0.794 vs 0.760，CodeLlama；ModernBERT 0.780 vs 0.721）；einspace 上 PyTorch 优于推导树字符串（0.817 vs 0.804@2553），且 COLE 仅用 220 个样本即达 τ≈0.71，而 Qin 等约 6.5k 架构微调后仅 τ=0.628。搜索效率：COLE 替换路径编码后，BANANAS 达到搜索空间最优 1% 内所需评估：CIFAR-10 52 次 vs 60 次（-13%），CIFAR-100 132 次 vs 200 次（-34%），ImageNet16-120 164 次 vs 200 次（-18%）；CIFAR-100 几乎全程差异显著（p<0.05），ImageNet16-120 早期显著；t-SNE 显示 COLE 对高/低性能架构的分离比结构编码更清晰。
AI.conclusion: 冻结 LM 配合"原生代码"输入可作为免微调、搜索空间无关的 NAS 架构嵌入器：既省去昂贵微调与专用编码工程，又在排序相关性与下游代理辅助搜索效率上优于结构化路径编码与既有文本编码，被定位为"冷启动"场景下的通用低开销基座，兼具联合结构-超参搜索与多目标（如硬件感知）扩展的潜力。局限：下游搜索验证仅限 NAS-Bench-201，编码对比仅覆盖 NAS-Bench-201 与 einspace；7B 模型嵌入抽取开销远高于路径字符串，绝对 Kendall's Tau 仍低于 FLAN、HyperNAS 等领域专用预测器；尚未探索更优池化策略、回归头结构、LM 微调等方向。

title: Layer Equivalence Is Not a Property of Layers Alone: How You Test Redundancy Changes What You Find
comment: 40 pages, 8 figures, 24 tables. Code and frozen JSON logs are not public during write-up; the authors plan to open https://github.com/Gpgabriel25/ProtocolGapDiagnostic
summary:
When researchers ask whether two transformer layers are "equivalent" for compression, they often conflate distinct tests. Replacement asks whether one layer's map can substitute for another's in place; interchange asks whether two layers approximately commute when their positions are swapped. Both are output-grounded swap-KL probes, but they need not agree: on pretrained transformers the protocol gap can change which layers look safe to prune by several-fold under the same evaluator, especially when replacement distances are high.
  We measure both protocols across checkpoints and architectures. On a Pythia training trajectory (410M and 1.4B), the replacement-interchange gap grows from initialization to convergence. Under one matched WikiText-2 contract at 8B scale, Qwen3-8B enters a divergent regime: interchange-guided removal is several-fold safer than replacement-guided at the same layer budgets, while Llama-3.1-8B ties the two protocols for pruning cost even though interchange KL is lower, showing metric gaps need not map one-to-one to removal. Before layer removal or merging, score both swap-KLs on the target checkpoint; the diagnostic requires only unlabeled forward passes.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了transformer层压缩中替换与互换两种测试协议的系统性差异，发现两者的gap在预训练过程中扩大，且可能使同一层在不同协议下被判定为安全或不安全，提示压缩前应同时评估两种swap-KL指标。
AI.motivation: 研究者压缩transformer层时，替换协议和互换协议常被混用，但这两个协议在评估层等价性时可能给出不一致的结果，导致对哪些层可以安全剪枝的判断产生数倍差异。
AI.method: 在多个模型架构（Pythia-410M/1.4B、Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B）上跨检查点和训练轨迹测量替换协议与互换协议的swap-KL差异；采用WikiText-2困惑度作为评估指标。
AI.result: 协议差距在预训练过程中从初始化到收敛持续增大；Qwen3-8B出现发散 regime，互换引导的删除比替换引导的删除安全性高数倍；Llama-3.1-8B两协议在剪枝代价上持平，但互换KL更低，表明指标差距与删除效果并非一对一映射。
AI.conclusion: 建议在层删除或合并前对目标检查点同时评估两种swap-KL指标；该诊断仅需未标注的前向传播。协议差距可能显著影响压缩策略安全性，在不同架构间表现差异显著。

title: Sharp Spectral Thresholds for Logit Fixed Points
summary:
Softmax feedback systems are a common mathematical core of entropy-regularized reinforcement learning, logit game dynamics, population choice, and mean-field variational updates. Their central stability question is simple: when does a self-reinforcing softmax system produce a unique and globally predictable outcome? Classical theory gives a conservative answer. By treating softmax as a unit-scale response, it certifies stability only in a strongly randomized regime.
  We prove that the classical approach misses an entire stable regime and does not identify the point at which the qualitative change truly occurs. For finite-dimensional affine logit systems, the sharp dimension-free Euclidean threshold is $$β\|ΠWΠ\|_{\mathcal T\to\mathcal T}<2,$$ rather than the previously used condition, which certifies stability only while the softmax system remains safely over-regularized. Our theorem fills the previously missing pre-bifurcation regime, extending stability guarantees for affine softmax feedback systems to reward-responsive yet globally predictable systems. It enlarges the certified stability boundary for these systems and identifies where the model genuinely undergoes a phase transition.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了经典理论对softmax反馈系统的稳定性分析过于保守。对于有限维仿射logit系统，作者给出了精确的欧几里得阈值条件β||ΠWΠ||_{T→T}<2，发现经典理论遗漏了整整一个稳定区域，未能识别相变发生的真实临界点。
AI.motivation: Softmax反馈系统是熵正则化强化学习、logit博弈动力学、人口选择和平均场变分更新的共同数学核心。经典理论对这些系统的稳定性判定仅在强随机化 regime 下成立，答案过于保守，需要重新审视稳定性的真实边界。
AI.method: 对有限维仿射logit系统进行严格数学分析，采用T→T算子范数作为度量尺度，建立维度无关的欧几里得稳定性阈值。
AI.result: 证明经典理论遗漏了一个完整的稳定区域；给出了精确阈值条件β||ΠWΠ||_{T→T}<2（而非此前使用的保守条件）；该阈值在系统仍处于"过度正则化"安全区域时就已允许存在稳定的可预测行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究填补了分岔前的regime空白，将稳定性保证扩展到奖励响应型yet全局可预测的系统；增大了softmax反馈系统的认证稳定性边界，并精确识别了系统发生相变的临界位置。

title: On the Power of Adaptivity for $\varepsilon$-Best Arm Identification in Linear Bandits
summary:
We study the minimax sample complexity of $\varepsilon$-best arm identification in linear bandits. Given a compact action set $\mathcal{X}$ that spans $\mathbb{R}^d$ and an unknown reward vector $θ\in\mathbb{R}^d$, the goal is to output an arm $\widehat{x}\in\mathcal{X}$ such that $\langle \widehat{x},θ\rangle \ge \max_{x\in\mathcal{X}} \langle x,θ\rangle - \varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-δ$, using as few samples as possible.
  First, we present a non-adaptive fixed-design method with sample complexity $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\frac{d\log(1/δ)}{\varepsilon^2}+\frac{w(\mathcal{X})^2}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$, where $w(\mathcal{X})$ is a Gaussian width term dependent on $\mathcal{X}$, and we prove a matching lower bound $Ω\!\left(\frac{d\log(1/δ)}{\varepsilon^2}+\frac{w(\mathcal{X})^2}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ for all non-adaptive fixed-design methods.
  We then turn to adaptive sampling. We raise an important structural question: beyond the canonical basis, are there structured action sets for which adaptivity yields only logarithmic-factor improvements over the optimal non-adaptive rate? We answer in the affirmative for several natural action sets, namely the hypercube, the $\ell_2$ ball, $m$-sets, and multi-task multi-armed bandits.
  Finally, we provide the first construction of an action set $\mathcal{X}$ for which adaptivity yields a polynomial-factor improvement over every non-adaptive algorithm. A key ingredient behind this separation is an $\ell_2$-norm estimation subroutine: we design an adaptive algorithm that uses $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\frac{d\log(1/δ)}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ samples from the unit $\ell_2$ ball in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and outputs an estimate $\widehat r$ satisfying $|\widehat r-\|θ\|_2|\le \varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-δ$, where $θ$ is the unknown reward vector.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线性匪徒中ε-最优臂识别的极小极大样本复杂度，建立了非自适应方法的下界，并系统分析了自适应采样的优势：对自然动作集仅获对数改进，但存在动作集可使自适应获多项式级改进。
AI.motivation: 研究线性匪徒中ε-最优臂识别问题的极小极大样本复杂度，核心问题是自适应采样相对于非自适应方法能带来多大改进。
AI.method: 1. 使用非自适应固定设计方法；2. 研究自适应采样策略；3. 关键创新：ℓ2-范数估计子程序
AI.result: 1. 提出非自适应方法样本复杂度为O(d log(1/δ)/ε² + w(X)²/ε²)，并证明匹配下界；2. 对于超立方体、ℓ2球、m-集和多任务多臂匪徒，自适应仅带来对数因子改进；3. 构造出首个动作集使自适应产生多项式级改进；4. ℓ2-范数估计子程序可O(d log(1/δ)/ε²)样本完成。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了线性匪徒中自适应与非自适应方法之间复杂的关系结构。通过构造具体例子证明自适应可带来多项式级改进，同时证明对于多种自然动作集自适应仅带来对数级改进。这为理解自适应采样的价值提供了完整的理论图景。

title: Rule2DRC: Benchmarking LLM Agents for DRC Script Synthesis with Execution-Guided Test Generation
summary: Manufacturable chip layouts must satisfy thousands of geometry-based design rules, and design rule checking (DRC) enforces them by running executable DRC scripts on layouts. Translating natural language rules into correct DRC scripts is labor-intensive and requires specialized expertise, motivating LLM agents for DRC script synthesis and debugging. However, existing benchmarks have small evaluation sets and often evaluate scripts by code similarity rather than execution correctness, and prior machine learning-based methods either ignore execution feedback or require labeled test layouts as agent's input. To this end, we introduce Rule2DRC, a large-scale benchmark for DRC script coding agents with 1,000 rule-to-script tasks and 13,921 evaluation chip layouts for execution-based scoring. Rule2DRC provides an evaluation pipeline that measures functional correctness via DRC execution outcomes without requiring evaluation layouts as input to the agent. We also propose SplitTester, a tester agent for program selection that uses execution feedback to generate discriminative test cases and separate previously indistinguishable candidate scripts, substantially improving Best-of-N selection performance in this domain. We release the code at https://github.com/snu-mllab/Rule2DRC.

AI.tldr: Rule2DRC是一个用于评估DRC脚本编码智能体的大规模基准，包含1,000个任务和13,921个评估布局，通过执行结果评估功能正确性。提出的SplitTester方法利用执行反馈区分候选脚本，大幅提升Best-of-N选择性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的基准测试存在评估集规模小、仅通过代码相似度而非执行正确性评估脚本的问题。此外，现有机器学习方法要么忽略执行反馈，要么需要标记的测试布局作为智能体输入。这些局限性阻碍了DRC脚本综合与调试自动化的发展。
AI.method: 该研究提出了两个主要贡献：(1) Rule2DRC基准：一个包含1,000个规则到脚本任务和13,921个评估芯片布局的大规模DRC脚本编码智能体评估基准，使用执行结果评估功能正确性，无需将评估布局作为智能体输入；(2) SplitTester：一种用于程序选择的测试智能体，利用执行反馈生成判别性测试用例，区分先前难以区分的候选脚本，从而改善Best-of-N选择性能。
AI.result: 通过使用执行反馈生成判别性测试用例，SplitTester显著提升了DRC脚本编码智能体的Best-of-N选择性能。
AI.conclusion: Rule2DRC benchmark is released with code available at https://github.com/snu-mllab/Rule2DRC. The SplitTester approach substantially improves Best-of-N selection performance for DRC script coding agents by leveraging execution feedback.

title: Interaction-Aware Influence Functions for Group Attribution
summary: Influence functions approximate how removing a training example changes a quantity of interest, called the target function, such as a held-out loss. To estimate the influence of a group of examples, the standard practice is to sum the individual influences of its members. However, this sum does not capture how examples jointly affect the target: a pair of examples may be redundant or complementary, but the sum cannot distinguish these cases. We propose an interaction-aware influence function that characterizes how interactions between examples influence the target. By expanding the target to second order around the trained parameters, we obtain an estimator that augments the standard sum with a pairwise interaction term that captures the alignment between two examples' effects on the target. We empirically evaluate our estimator in two settings. First, on six dataset-model pairs spanning logistic regression, MLPs, and ResNet-9, our estimator tracks leave-group-out retraining substantially better than first-order influence across all settings. Second, when used as a greedy selection rule for instruction-tuning data on Llama-3.1-8B, it beats prior influence-based and representation-similarity baselines on five of seven downstream tasks, in a regime where standard influence-based selection underperforms random selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互感知影响函数，通过引入二阶项来捕捉训练样本之间的交互作用对目标函数的影响，从而超越传统一阶影响函数只能独立求和样本影响的局限。在多个数据集和模型上验证了该方法在追踪leave-group-out重训练效果方面的优越性，并在Llama-3.1-8B指令调优数据选择任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 标准影响函数仅通过累加各样本的一阶影响来估计移除样本集的效果，但这无法捕捉样本间的交互效应——两个样本可能是冗余的（可互换）或互补的（联合影响），而一阶和无法区分这些情况。
AI.method: 将目标函数在训练参数处展开至二阶，得到包含成对交互项的估计器。该交互项捕捉两个样本对目标影响之间的对齐程度。具体地，在参数θ处对目标函数L进行二阶泰勒展开，添加Hessian矩阵项H = ∇²L来建模参数曲率，从而量化样本间的交互效应。
AI.result: 1) 在6个数据集-模型组合（逻辑回归、MLP和ResNet-9）上，交互感知影响函数追踪leave-group-out重训练的效果显著优于一阶影响函数。2) 在Llama-3.1-8B指令调优数据选择任务中，该方法在7个下游任务中的5个上超越了基于影响函数和表示相似性的基线方法，尤其在一阶影响选择表现不如随机选择的设定下仍能胜出。
AI.conclusion: 通过建模样本间的二阶交互效应，交互感知影响函数能更准确地估计样本组对目标的影响，为数据选择和模型分析提供了更精细的工具。

title: FRWKV+: Adaptive Periodic-Position Branch Interaction for Frequency-Space Linear Time Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting is essential for decision making in energy, finance, transportation, and healthcare systems. Recent lightweight forecasting models improve efficiency by operating in transformed or linearized spaces, but two challenges remain in frequency-space forecasting. The real and imaginary streams of complex spectra contain complementary information that is often weakly exchanged, and periodic-position cues can help recurring patterns only when they are reliable for the current dataset and prediction horizon. To address these challenges, we propose FRWKV+, an enhanced FRWKV forecasting model for selective periodic-position branch interaction. FRWKV+ first introduces cross-branch gates that exchange compact contexts between the real and imaginary frequency streams, allowing each stream to modulate the other. It then uses the Adaptive PhaseGate mechanism to extract periodic-position context and generate signed corrections to these gates. An adaptive trust mechanism controls the correction strength at the sample, variable, and channel levels, so periodic-position information is admitted as a reliable correction signal while preserving the efficiency of the FRWKV backbone. External benchmark tables report a separately labeled FRWKV-family selected system for manuscript-level comparison, while mechanism-level claims are based on strict matched-seed FRWKV-family ablations and representative component-level ablations. Under this matched protocol, FRWKV+ achieves the largest MSE winner coverage among the family variants and provides clear gains in selected periodic regimes. Component analysis further supports the usefulness of periodic-position context, signed correction, and adaptive trust in these regimes, while revealing boundary cases where simpler correction rules remain preferable.

AI.tldr: FRWKV+通过交叉分支门实现复频谱实部与虚部流的信息交换，利用自适应相位门机制提取周期位置上下文并生成带符号校正，通过自适应信任机制在样本、变量和通道级别控制校正强度，从而增强长期时间序列预测能力。
AI.motivation: Lightweight forecasting models operating in transformed or linearized spaces face two challenges: (1) real and imaginary streams of complex spectra contain complementary information that is often weakly exchanged, and (2) periodic-position cues can only help recurring patterns when they are reliable for the current dataset and prediction horizon.
AI.method: FRWKV+ introduces cross-branch gates to exchange compact contexts between real and imaginary frequency streams, enabling mutual modulation. It uses the Adaptive PhaseGate mechanism to extract periodic-position context and generate signed corrections. An adaptive trust mechanism controls correction strength at sample, variable, and channel levels.
AI.result: Under strict matched-seed protocol, FRWKV+ achieves the largest MSE winner coverage among family variants and provides clear gains in selected periodic regimes. Component analysis confirms the usefulness of periodic-position context, signed correction, and adaptive trust.
AI.conclusion: FRWKV+ achieves the largest MSE winner coverage among family variants and provides clear gains in selected periodic regimes. Component analysis supports the usefulness of periodic-position context, signed correction, and adaptive trust in these regimes, while revealing boundary cases where simpler correction rules remain preferable.

title: SEED: Targeted Data Selection by Weighted Independent Set
summary: Data selection seeks to identify a compact yet informative subset from large-scale training corpora, balancing sample quality against collection diversity. We formulate this problem as a Weighted Independent Set (WIS) on a similarity graph, where nodes represent data samples weighted by influence, and edges connect semantically redundant pairs. This formulation naturally yields subsets that are simultaneously high-quality and diverse. However, two challenges arise in practice: naive node weights fail to distinguish informative signals from gradient noise, and edge construction under heterogeneous domain distributions produces structurally imbalanced graphs that bias selection toward sparse regions. To address these issues, we introduce two principled refinements from a unified graph perspective: (1) \textit{node value calibration} that restricts influence estimation to the bilateral salient subspace to ground node importance in task-relevant signals rather than surface-level statistics; (2) \textit{local scale normalization} that adapts edge thresholds to local neighborhood density, mitigating graph imbalance induced by cross-domain distribution shifts. Together, these components yield a robust and scalable data selection pipeline dubbed SEED. We further construct \texttt{Honeybee-Remake-SEED-200K}, a compact multimodal dataset curated by SEED. Extensive experiments show that SEED consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on instruction tuning, visual instruction tuning, and semantic segmentation across diverse model families.

AI.tldr: A new data selection pipeline called SEED formulates the problem as a Weighted Independent Set on similarity graphs, addressing quality-diversity balance through node value calibration and local scale normalization. It achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple tasks including instruction tuning, visual instruction tuning, and semantic segmentation.
AI.motivation: Current data selection methods face two key challenges: (1) naive node weights cannot distinguish informative signals from gradient noise, and (2) edge construction under heterogeneous domain distributions creates structurally imbalanced graphs that bias selection toward sparse regions. Existing approaches fail to balance sample quality with collection diversity.
AI.method: The authors formulate data selection as a Weighted Independent Set (WIS) problem on a similarity graph, then introduce two refinements: (1) node value calibration that restricts influence estimation to a bilateral salient subspace for task-relevant signals, and (2) local scale normalization that adapts edge thresholds based on local neighborhood density to mitigate cross-domain imbalance. These components create a scalable pipeline that produces compact yet informative subsets.
AI.result: SEED consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse model families on instruction tuning, visual instruction tuning, and semantic segmentation tasks. The curated dataset Honeybee-Remake-SEED-200K demonstrates the practical effectiveness of this approach.
AI.conclusion: SEED provides a principled graph-based framework for data selection that simultaneously addresses quality and diversity challenges. The method establishes new state-of-the-art results across instruction tuning, visual instruction tuning, and semantic segmentation tasks, demonstrating broad applicability and robustness.

title: Tighter Regret Bounds for Contextual Action-Set Reinforcement Learning
summary:
We study episodic reinforcement learning with fixed reward and transition functions, but with episode-dependent admissible action sets that are observed at the start of each episode. Performance is measured by cumulative regret against the episode-wise optimal value, $\sum_{k=1}^K [V^{*,M^k} - V^{π^k,M^k}]$, where $M^k$ represents the action context in the $k$-th episode. We show that the MVP algorithm naturally extends to this framework and enjoys strong theoretical guarantees. In particular, we establish a minimax regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAH^3K\log L})$ for adversarial contexts, where $L$ denotes the number of possible contexts. This result implies a regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAH^3K})$ for stochastic contexts. We further translate the stochastic regret guarantee into a sample complexity bound of $\widetilde{O}(SAH^3/ε^2)$ for a fixed context distribution.
  In addition, we derive a gap-dependent regret bound of \[ \widetilde O\left( \inf_{p\in [0,1)} \left( \frac{1}{Δ_{\min}^{p}} + pKΔ_{\min}^{p} \right)\log K \cdot \mathrm{poly}(S,A,H) \right), \] where $Δ_{\min}^{p}$ is the global $p$-trimmed positive-gap floor over suboptimal $(h,s,a)$ triples. This bound can substantially improve upon the minimax rate when the relevant suboptimality gaps are large.

AI.tldr: 研究了具有episode依赖 admissible action sets的episodic强化学习，MVP算法可自然扩展到此框架。对抗性上下文下达到~O(√(SAH³K log L))的minimax regret，随机上下文下为~O(√(SAH³K))，样本复杂度~O(SAH³/ε²)，并给出了依赖于gap的regret上界。
AI.motivation: 研究episodic强化学习在episode依赖的 admissible action sets（上下文）下的regret minimization问题。上下文在每个episode开始时观测得到，奖励和转移函数固定，目标是相对于episode-wise最优值最小化累积regret。
AI.method: 将MVP（Mean-Variance Penalty）算法自然扩展到可变动作集框架。该算法通过估计值函数并应用方差惩罚来处理不确定性。
AI.result: 建立了多项理论界：(1)对抗性上下文的minimax regret界为Õ(√(SAH³K log L))，其中L为可能的上下文数；(2)随机上下文下regret界为Õ(√(SAH³K))；(3)固定上下文分布的样本复杂度为Õ(SAH³/ε²)；(4)给出了gap-dependent regret界，当次优性gap较大时可显著优于minimax rate。
AI.conclusion: MVP算法能够有效处理具有episode依赖动作集的RL问题，在对抗性和随机上下文情况下均具有强有力的理论保证。gap-dependent界在gap较大时可提供更紧的regret估计。

title: Going Beyond the Edge: Distributed Inference of Transformer Models on Ultra-Low-Power Wireless Devices
summary: Transformer models are rapidly becoming a cornerstone of modern Internet of Things (IoT) applications, yet their computational and memory demands far exceed the capabilities of a single typical ultra-low-power IoT device. We present CATS, a framework for distributed transformer inference on ultra-low-power wireless devices, enabling multiple devices to collaboratively execute models far larger than what a single device can sustain. At its core, CATS is a communication-aware distributed transformer inference scheme co-designed across transformer partitioning, wireless communication and training. It employs SomeGather, a new pruned communication primitive that selectively broadcasts activation columns to reduce communication bandwidth and RAM usage without sacrificing model accuracy. Building on SomeGather, we design a partitioning method that exploits this primitive for efficient model parallelism. To cope with unreliable wireless communication, CATS employs message-dropout during training, which mimics packet losses and yields models that are robust to message loss during inference. In real-world experiments, we show that CATS brings distributed transformer inference to ultra-low-power wireless devices for the first time, with deployments on up to 16 devices that collaboratively execute transformer models up to 14 times larger than what a single device can run.

AI.tldr: CATS是一个面向超低功耗无线设备的分布式Transformer推理框架，通过通信感知的设计（SomeGather通信原语、模型并行分区、message-dropout训练）实现多设备协作执行超出单机能力的大型模型。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型计算和内存需求远超单个超低功耗IoT设备能力，亟需分布式解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SomeGather剪枝通信原语进行选择性激活列广播以降低通信带宽和RAM占用；基于此设计高效模型并行分区方法；采用message-dropout训练模拟丢包使模型对消息丢失具有鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在真实实验中，CATS在最多16台设备上协作执行Transformer模型，规模达到单机可运行模型的14倍。
AI.conclusion: CATS首次将分布式Transformer推理带到超低功耗无线设备上，支持最多16台设备协作执行比单机大14倍的Transformer模型。

title: AGOP-IxG: A Gradient Covariance Filter for Local Feature Attribution on Tabular Data, with a Controlled Benchmark
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to AutoML Conference 2026 (ABCD Track)
summary: Automated machine learning pipelines increasingly produce models whose predictions must be explained to end users, auditors, and downstream decision systems. The most widely used feature attribution methods (SHAP, Integrated Gradients, LIME) are typically chosen by convention rather than measured fidelity, because rigorous evaluation is impeded by the absence of ground-truth attribution on real data. We propose AGOP-IxG, a fast per-sample attribution method for tabular classifiers that pre-multiplies the per-sample gradient by a top-$K$ rank-truncated Average Gradient Outer Product matrix, and evaluate it against four widely-used baselines on a controlled tabular benchmark designed for AutoML practitioners. In Part 1, we construct three synthetic multi-class tabular tasks (linear, sparse nonlinear, interaction-based) where ground-truth attribution per sample is analytically or numerically derivable, and compare five methods: AGOP-IxG, SHAP (DeepExplainer), Integrated Gradients, InputXGradient, and LIME. AGOP-IxG leads on Spearman rank correlation and noise feature mass on all three synthetic datasets, and on top-$k$ precision on the interaction dataset. Across all settings, AGOP-IxG is approximately $350\times$ to $1{,}650\times$ faster than SHAP. In Part 2, we evaluate global faithfulness on Adult Income and Credit Card Default using the ROAR protocol; the methods cluster within $\sim 1.7\%$ relative AUC, consistent with AGOP-IxG being optimized for per-sample local attribution rather than global feature ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGOP-IxG，一种用于表格分类器的快速样本级特征归因方法，通过预乘top-K秩截断的平均梯度外积矩阵实现高效计算。在三个合成表格任务（线性、稀疏非线性、交互型）上，AGOP-IxG在秩相关和噪声特征质量指标上优于SHAP、Integrated Gradients、InputXGradient和LIME，且速度比SHAP快350-1650倍；但在真实数据集的全局特征排序任务上，各方法性能相近。
AI.motivation: 自动化机器学习流水线产生的模型需要向用户、审计人员和下游决策系统解释其预测，但现有的主流特征归因方法（SHAP、Integrated Gradients、LIME）通常是凭惯例选择而非基于真实保真度评估，因为缺乏真实数据上的ground-truth归因来进行严格评估。
AI.method: 提出AGOP-IxG方法——一种快速的样本级归因方法，通过将样本梯度与top-K秩截断的平均梯度外积矩阵相乘来实现归因计算。
AI.result: Part 1：AGOP-IxG在三个合成数据集的Spearman秩相关和噪声特征质量上均领先，在交互数据集上top-k精确率也表现最佳，且比SHAP快约350倍至1650倍；Part 2：在Adult Income和Credit Card Default数据集上使用ROAR协议进行全局忠实度评估，各方法在~1.7%的相对AUC范围内聚类。
AI.conclusion: AGOP-IxG在具有ground-truth的合成基准上表现优异，但在全局特征排序任务上与其他方法性能接近（差异~1.7%），这表明该方法主要优化的是局部样本级归因而非全局特征排名。

title: Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents Incentivizes Swarm Intelligence of Large Language Models
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have catalyzed the development of multi-agent systems (MAS) for complex reasoning tasks. However, existing MAS typically rely on pre-defined or pre-compiled communication topologies, which limits their flexibility and adaptability to dynamic task requirements. In this work, we propose Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA), a self-evolving multi-agent framework that enables elastic and adaptive agent collaboration during inference. Instead of statically constructing workflows, DMoA dynamically routes and activates agents at each reasoning step, allowing the system to implicitly simulate diverse communication topologies and adapt to evolving demands. To achieve this, we design a differentiable, context-aware routing mechanism that leverages recurrent structures to incorporate historical and contextual information, producing sparse agent activations in a step-wise manner. Furthermore, we introduce predictive entropy as self-supervised signals to optimize the routing process, enabling efficient test-time adaptation without external annotations. Extensive experiments across 9 benchmarks demonstrate that DMoA achieves state-of-the-art performance while exhibiting strong efficiency, robustness, and ensembling capabilities.

AI.tldr: DMoA是一种自进化多智能体框架，通过可微分、上下文感知的路由机制，在推理过程中动态激活智能体，实现灵活的自适应协作，而非依赖预定义的通信拓扑。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS系统依赖预定义或预编译的通信拓扑，限制了系统对动态任务需求的灵活性和适应性。
AI.method: 1) 设计可微分、上下文感知的路由机制，利用循环结构整合历史和上下文信息；2) 以预测熵作为自监督信号进行测试时优化；3) 采用稀疏智能体激活实现步骤级动态路由。
AI.result: 在9个基准测试集上达到SOTA性能，同时展现出高效率、强鲁棒性和良好的集成能力。
AI.conclusion: DMoA通过动态路由和自适应激活机制，有效解决了传统多智能体系统在通信拓扑上的局限性，为复杂推理任务提供了更灵活、高效的解决方案。

title: Bidirectional Fusion Guided by Cardiac Patterns for Semi-Supervised ECG Segmentation
summary: Accurate delineation of electrocardiogram (ECG), the segmentation of meaningful waveform features, is crucial for cardiovascular diagnostics. However, the scarcity of annotated data poses a significant challenge for training deep learning models. Conventional semi-supervised semantic segmentation (SemiSeg) methods primarily focus on consistency from unlabeled data, underutilizing the information exchange possible between labeled and unlabeled sets. To address this, we introduce CardioMix, a framework built on a bidirectional CutMix strategy guided by cardiac patterns for ECG segmentation. This approach enriches the labeled set with realistic variations from unlabeled data while simultaneously applying stronger supervisory signals to the unlabeled set, as the cardiac pattern-guided mixing ensures all augmented samples remain physiologically meaningful. Our framework is designed as a plug-and-play module, demonstrating high compatibility with various SemiSeg algorithms. Extensive experiments on SemiSegECG, a public multi-dataset benchmark for ECG delineation, demonstrate that CardioMix consistently outperforms existing CutMix-based fusion strategies across diverse datasets and labeled ratios as a plug-and-play module compatible with various SemiSeg algorithms.

AI.tldr: CardioMix是一个基于心脏模式引导的双向CutMix半监督学习框架，用于解决ECG分割中标注数据稀缺问题。该方法通过有标签与无标签数据集之间的双向信息交换，实现生理学上有意义的样本增强，在SemiSegECG基准数据集上验证了其优于现有CutMix融合策略的有效性。
AI.motivation: ECG心电图分割对于心血管疾病诊断至关重要，但深度学习模型训练面临标注数据稀缺的重大挑战。现有半监督语义分割方法主要关注无标签数据的一致性，对有标签和无标签数据集之间的信息交换利用不足。
AI.method: 提出CardioMix框架，采用双向CutMix策略，以心脏模式为引导进行混合操作。该策略一方面将无标签数据的真实变化丰富到有标签集，另一方面对无标签数据施加更强的监督信号，确保所有增强样本在生理学上保持有意义。框架设计为即插即用模块，可与多种半监督语义分割算法兼容。
AI.result: CardioMix作为即插即用模块，在SemiSegECG公共多数据集基准上，通过多种SemiSeg算法验证，在不同数据集和标注比例下均持续优于现有CutMix融合策略。
AI.conclusion: CardioMix作为一个即插即用的模块，在SemiSegECG基准数据集上表现优异，在不同数据集和标注比例下均优于现有CutMix融合策略，且与多种SemiSeg算法兼容良好，展示了在ECG分割任务中处理标注数据稀缺问题的有效解决方案。

title: GOMA: Toward Structure-Driven Multimodal Alignment from a Graph Signal Smoothing Perspective
summary: Multimodal alignment is commonly learned from isolated image-text pairs via CLIP-style dual encoders, leaving the relational context among entities largely unused. Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs), where nodes carry multimodal attributes and edges encode corpus structure, provide a natural setting for refining frozen vision-language embeddings. This refinement is challenging: visual, textual, and cross-modal relations often induce different neighborhood geometries, while unrestricted graph propagation can quickly over-smooth retrieval representations. Effectively leveraging graph context therefore requires simultaneously breaking modality-specific topological barriers, controlling the smoothing regime, and preserving informative smoothing before semantic boundaries collapse. We propose Graph-Optimized Multimodal Alignment (GOMA), a structure-driven post-alignment framework that views frozen multimodal embeddings as graph signals and addresses these requirements through a unified retrieval-oriented design. GOMA decouples three key design choices: where messages should flow, how multimodal evidence should propagate, and which smoothing depth should be retained. Concretely, it learns modality-aware propagation operators, performs finite-step coupled smoothing without diagonal cross-modal shortcuts, and adaptively reads out node-specific smoothing trajectories to preserve useful smoothing before collapse. All experiments follow a transductive MAG retrieval protocol where the graph serves only as unlabeled context and diagonal self-pair edges are removed. On seven MAG benchmarks, GOMA achieves state-of-the-art or tied state-of-the-art retrieval and remains substantially more stable than the strongest graph competitor, demonstrating that MAG structure can serve as an effective post-encoder for frozen multimodal embeddings.

AI.tldr: GOMA是一个结构驱动的后对齐框架，通过解耦传播方向、传播机制和读取策略三个设计选择，有效利用多模态属性图(MAG)上下文对冻结的多模态嵌入进行 refinement，在7个基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP风格双编码器仅利用孤立图文对，忽略了实体间关系上下文。MAG提供了天然 refinement 场景，但面临三重挑战：视觉/文本/跨模态关系诱导不同邻域几何；无限制图传播导致检索表示过平滑；需同时打破模态拓扑屏障、控制平滑 regime 并保留有用平滑直到语义边界坍塌前。
AI.method: GOMA将冻结的多模态嵌入视为图信号，通过统一的三组件设计：(1) 学习模态感知传播算子实现跨模态消息流动；(2) 执行有限步耦合平滑避免对角跨模态捷径；(3) 自适应读取节点特定平滑轨迹以保留有用平滑。三组件解耦设计使各组件可独立优化。
AI.result: GOMA在7个MAG基准上实现SOTA或tied SOTA检索性能，且比最强图竞争方法稳定得多。
AI.conclusion: GOMA在7个MAG基准上实现了最先进或持平的检索性能，且比最强图对比方法稳定得多，证明了MAG结构可作为冻结多模态嵌入的有效后编码器。

title: A Unified Perturbation Framework for Analyzing Leaderboard Stability and Manipulation
summary: Evaluation leaderboards such as LMArena play a central role in benchmarking large language models by aggregating pairwise human preferences into model rankings, yet the robustness of these rankings remains poorly understood. We present a unified perturbation framework for analyzing Bradley-Terry leaderboards under structured data modifications using influence-based approximations. Our framework studies three match-level perturbations -- Drop, Add, and Flip -- together with player removal, and evaluates their effects on top-k membership, global ranking consistency via Kendall's tau, and confidence-interval-based uncertainty. Across Chatbot Arena and six additional pairwise-comparison datasets, we show that modern leaderboards are non-robust across all three objectives: sub-1% targeted perturbations can change the top-ranked model, degrade Kendall's tau, and alter confidence intervals. Beyond robustness auditing, we show that the same influence scores enable efficient targeted perturbations, promoting or demoting specific models and reducing target-model uncertainty with fewer actions than previous manipulation and active-sampling baselines. By summarizing these effects with normalized dataset-level robustness scores, our framework provides a practical and helpful tool for auditing leaderboard stability and motivating more robust evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出基於影響力的擾動框架，用於審計LLM排行榜穩健性，發現現有排行榜對微小數據變動高度敏感，提供實用審計工具以推動更穩健的評估協議。
AI.motivation: 評估排行榜（如LMArena）在彙聚成對人類偏好生成模型排名方面起核心作用，但這些排名的穩健性尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 提出統一的擾動框架，結合影響力近似方法分析Bradley-Terry排行榜。研究三種比賽層級擾動（Drop、Add、Flip）與選手移除策略，從Top-k成員資格、 Kendall's tau全局排名一致性、置信區間不確定性三個維度評估效果。
AI.result: 實驗證明現代排行榜在所有三個目標上均非穩健：低於1%的針對性擾動即可改變排名第一模型、降低Kendall's tau並改變置信區間。同時，影響力分數可實現高效針對性擾動，比現有操控和主動採樣基線用更少操作即可promote/demote特定模型並減少目標模型不確定性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一個實用工具，可用於審計排行榜穩定性並推動更強健的評估協議，為LLM評估框架提供關鍵的品質保障方法。

title: Continual Learning of Domain-Invariant Representations
summary: Continual learning (CL) aims to train models sequentially over multiple domains without forgetting previously learned knowledge. However, existing CL methods optimize for in-domain performance and are therefore prone to learning spurious, domain-specific cues (``shortcut learning''), which limits generalization to unseen domains after deployment. In this paper, we address this limitation through continual learning of domain-invariant representation. We introduce a broad class of CL methods that sequentially learn representations capturing invariant structures across domains. Our methods are motivated by the observation that such invariant structures often preserve the underlying causal mechanisms, which can reduce the risk of overfitting to domain-specific cues and thus offer better out-of-domain generalization. Our proposed CL methods combine replay-based training with a tailored sequential invariance alignment to learn -- and preserve -- invariant structures over time. We evaluate our methods under a deployment-oriented protocol that measures performance on unseen target domains. Across six benchmark and real-world datasets spanning vision, medicine, manufacturing, and ecology, our methods consistently outperform existing CL baselines in terms of generalization to unseen target domains. As an ablation, we further show that naïve extensions of sequential training with existing domain-invariant representation learning (DIRL) methods provide only limited benefits. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to develop domain-invariant representation methods for CL.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将领域不变表征学习(DIRL)与持续学习(CL)结合，通过Replay训练+顺序不变量对齐的方法，解决现有CL方法因学习虚假领域特定线索而导致的泛化能力不足问题。在6个跨视觉、医学、制造、生态领域的基准数据集上，该方法在未见目标域泛化任务中一致优于现有CL基线。
AI.motivation: 现有CL方法优化域内性能，但容易学习虚假、领域特定的捷径(shortcut)，导致部署后泛化到新领域的能力受限。
AI.method: 提出一类结合Replay训练的CL方法，通过顺序不变量对齐(sequntial invariance alignment)学习并保持跨领域的不变结构。该方法基于观察：不变量结构通常保持底层因果机制，可减少对领域特定线索的过拟合。
AI.result: 在6个跨视觉、医学、制造、生态领域的基准及真实数据集上，采用部署导向评估协议，方法在未见目标域泛化性能上一致优于现有CL基线。消融实验表明，直接将现有DIRL方法进行顺序训练扩展仅能带来有限收益。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将领域不变表征学习方法引入持续学习领域，为提升CL模型在部署后对新领域的泛化能力提供了新思路。

title: Grokking as Structural Inference: Transformers Need Bayesian Lottery Tickets
summary: Why does a Transformer that has memorized its training set wait thousands of steps before it generalizes? Existing accounts locate this delay in norm minimization, feature emergence, or the late discovery of sparse subnetworks. These explanations capture important parts of the transition, but ignore a constraint unique to attention-based models: if attention discards an informative token, no bounded downstream computation can recover it. We formalize attention as an implicit Bayesian posterior over the task dependency graph and prove that generalization requires two separable conditions: a familiar Goldilocks bound on MLP capacity, coinciding with norm-based theories of grokking, and a novel Bayesian structural condition requiring attention to place sufficient mass on every informative token. This decoupling explains delayed generalization as delayed structural inference. Early in training, the MLP memorizes through unaligned features, drives the cross-entropy loss near zero, and thereby starves attention of structural gradient. Weight decay must then erode memorization before the missing graph becomes learnable, yielding the known inverse-weight-decay delay, which we derive as a structural waiting time. We then prove that this explaining-away delay can be bypassed by a KL-based structural intervention, yielding an inverse-intervention-strength scaling law for the grokking time. Experiments on algorithmic sequence tasks isolate structure from capacity and show that this Bayesian ticket matches or outperforms lottery-ticket transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Grokking = 延迟的结构推断"这一新视角：把注意力的注意力分布形式化为对任务依赖图的隐式贝叶斯后验，并证明泛化必须同时满足两个可分离条件——注意力在每个信息性位置上质量不低于阈值的"贝叶斯结构条件"与 MLP 参数范数落在 Goldilocks 区间的"范数条件"。训练早期的快速记忆使交叉熵趋零，从而"饿死"了流向注意力的结构梯度；权重衰减必须先侵蚀掉记忆解，缺失的依赖图才变得可学，由此导出 O(1/λ) 的结构性等待时间；而引入指向 oracle 注意力的 KL 惩罚可完全绕过该平台期，给出 O(1/β) 的 grokking 加速标度律。
AI.motivation: Grokking 现象（Power et al., 2022）显示模型先记忆训练集、数千步后才突然泛化。现有三类因果解释各有盲区：(1) 范数优化/损失景观理论（Liu et al. 2023；Boursier et al. 2025；Lyu et al. 2024）认为权重衰减把参数推入"Goldilocks 区间"；(2) 特征学习与相变动力学（Kumar et al. 2024；Clauw et al. 2024）视其为从惰性记忆到特征学习的相变；(3) 结构/回路与稀疏"中奖彩票"理论（Minegishi et al. 2025；Nanda et al. 2023）。三者共同忽略了一个只属于注意力架构的独立约束：注意力一旦丢弃某个信息性 token，任何有界的下游计算都无法恢复它——因此"注意力分布"必须是泛化条件中一个独立成立的维度，而非 MLP 范数或特征丰富度的附属品。此外，本文试图将"注意力作为贝叶斯结构推断"的已有观点（Singh & Buckley 2023；Zhang et al. 2023）引入 grokking 解释，并解释此前缺乏理论支撑的 inverse-weight-decay 延迟定律。
AI.method:
**任务与模型设定**：k-sparse 结构化序列预测任务（k 个信息性位置决定目标，其余为干扰项，固定查询位置），最小化单层单头注意力 + 两层 ReLU MLP 的 Transformer；注意力权重限制在单纯形 Δ^{T-1} 上，代表 h(s)=Σ_j α_j W_V e_j。

**核心概念**：
- 贝叶斯结构条件 B_γ：min_{j∈I*} α_j ≥ γ（每个信息性位置上的注意力质量下界）；oracle 分布 α* 在 I* 上均匀取 1/k。
- Goldilocks 范数条件 N：‖θ_MLP‖_F ∈ [r_min, r_max]，从而 MLP 的 Lipschitz 常数 L_f ≤ L_max。
- (λ, ρ̄)-范数收缩优化器抽象（附录 B 证明 SGD/AdamW/Muon/Lion 满足）。

**定理 4.3（解耦定理）**：零测试误差 ⟺ B_γ ∧ N（在解耦最大间隔假设 C.1 下）。必要性通过"质量守恒消去"（附录 A.3）得到表示距离上界 ‖h(s)−h(s')‖₂ ≤ (α_{j0}(s)+α_{j0}(s'))·Δ_emb，与 Lipschitz 界、分类间隔 c 联立反证；充分性由 B_γ 下表示注入性下界 γ·Δ'_emb 配合最大间隔收敛给出。推论 4.5：零测试误差蕴含 D_KL(α*‖α) ≤ log(1/(kγ))。

**动力学分析（引理 5.1 + 四阶段）**：经 Pinsker 不等式证明注意力 logit 的任务梯度 |∂L_CE/∂ℓ_j| ≤ 2 L_f(t)‖W_V‖√(2 L_CE(t))，即随交叉熵以平方根速率消失（explaining-away / 梯度饥饿）。四阶段：快速记忆 → explaining-away 平台期（纯权重衰减，‖θ‖ 几何收缩）→ 信号复苏（损失微升，结构梯度重启）→ grokking。平台期下界 Δt_plateau ≥ (2/λ)·log(‖θ_mem‖_F/r_max)，给出 O(1/λ) 延迟律。

**KL 加速（定理 5.2）**：增广损失 L_total = L_CE + β_KL·D_KL(α*‖α)；softmax 下 ∂D_KL/∂ℓ_j = α_j − α*_j，为与 L_CE 无关的"自校正"结构梯度；结合 Polyak–Łojasiewicz 不等式（Lemma D.1）得 D_t ≤ D_0 e^{−β̃ t}，从而 Δt_grok^KL ≤ (1/β̃)log(D_0/δ_nec)。

**实验**：最小 Transformer + AdamW 在模 113 加法基准上训练，追踪注意力分布、MLP 范数、注意力梯度范数；四阶段诊断、范数匹配（Norm-Matching）消融（Oracle vs 对抗性先验）、KL 强度扫描与延迟标度、Bayesian Ticket 与 Lottery Ticket 迁移对比；附录含先验类型、教师蒸馏、动态路由、多头、维度/长度外推、任务与优化器鲁棒性。
AI.result:
**理论**：泛化被严格解耦为"结构路由"与"表示容量"的合取，单纯的范数控制是必要而不充分的（显式构造了范数匹配但注意力被导向干扰项、测试精度停留在随机水平的构型）。该双条件将彩票假说形式化为两张票——结构路由票 B_γ 与表示票 N。注意力后验在测试精度跃升之前先"凝聚"到 oracle 依赖图附近，说明相变并非由训练损失单独触发。explaining-away 平台期被证明为 grokking 延迟的主导来源，其时长给出 O((1/λ)·log(‖θ_mem‖/r_max)) 下界，与文献中 inverse-weight-decay 经验定律吻合。KL 结构先验完全消除平台期，注意力以指数速率收敛，grokking 时间近似随 1/β 线性缩放（直至早期优化下限）。

**实验**：模加法上四阶段动力学被完整复现；注意力任务梯度在记忆后塌缩数个数量级且始终低于引理 5.1 的理论上界；范数匹配消融显示对抗性路由即使在范数受控下也无法泛化，而 oracle 路由但范数不受控只能部分泛化，二者齐备才有完美泛化；KL 惩罚显著提前相变，延迟与 1/β 近似线性；以 KL 先验初始化的"Bayesian Ticket"在跨随机初始化的迁移中匹配或优于完整 Lottery Ticket 迁移（说明结构路由票即可承担迁移收益）。附录显示 teacher 注意力蒸馏可传递大部分加速效应，序列相关 oracle 可支持随机化信息位置，维度增大加速泛化，多头模型通过聚合质量满足路由条件。
AI.conclusion:
grokking 应被理解为"延迟的结构推断"：Transformer 的泛化条件是 MLP 容量壳层（Goldilocks 范数条件 N）与注意力结构对齐（贝叶斯结构条件 B_γ）的合取，缺一不可；记忆先行的 MLP 会解释掉（explain away）结构信号，权重衰减侵蚀记忆的过程本身构成了结构学习的等待期；直接注入贝叶斯结构先验（KL 惩罚）可把离散的 O(1/λ) 等待期替换为连续的指数收敛轨迹。据此，Transformer 的"中奖彩票"不是单一子网络，而是可分离的路由票 + 表示票，且前者单独即足以复现彩票迁移的加速效果。

**局限与展望**：充分性方向依赖"解耦最大间隔假设"（未证明全 Transformer 联合优化的全局收敛）；理论限定于单层单头、线性 ReLU/softmax 注意力与固定查询位置；softmax 情形下解释平台期与 logit 方差收缩仅为猜想（Conjecture E.1）；多头情形下 B_γ 松弛为分布式聚合条件为猜想（Conjecture E.2）；离散梯度流的精确界、动态自回归查询与多头分布式路由的推广仍待完成；作者还指出 KL 项与任务损失的耦合、以及基线权重衰减与 KL 加速在超参尺度上的交互需更细致检验。

title: Learning Context-conditioned Gaussian Overbounds for Convolution-Based Uncertainty Propagation
summary: Uncertainty quantification is essential in safety-critical settings--from autonomous driving to aviation, finance, and health--where decisions must rely on conservative bounds rather than point estimates. Predictor-level intervals (e.g., from quantile regression, conformal prediction, variance networks, or Bayesian models) generally do not compose: adding two per-variable intervals need not yield a valid interval for their sum or preserve coverage. In aviation, Gaussian overbounding replaces complex error distributions with a conservative Gaussian whose tails dominate the truth, so conservatism propagates through linear operations. Yet classical overbounds are global, often overly conservative, and hard to adapt to feature-conditioned errors. We propose a unified learning framework that trains neural networks to produce context-aware Gaussian overbounds--mean and scale--with provable conservatism on a finite quantile grid and, under three explicit regularity assumptions, continuous-tail conservatism on a certified interval. Our overbounding loss enforces conservativeness at selected quantiles while penalizing distributional distance with a Wasserstein-style term. The learned bounds support conservative linear-combination and convolution analysis on the enforced grid, and on the certified interval when assumptions hold, while being less redundant than traditional methods. We provide a scoped analysis of discrete-to-continuous conservatism and compact-domain objective regularity, and validate on synthetic data and real-world datasets, including multipath, ionospheric, and tropospheric residual errors. Across these settings, the method yields tighter bounds while maintaining conservatism on the enforced grid and in experiments. The framework is modality-agnostic and applicable to learning systems that require conservative, feature-conditioned uncertainty estimates in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个单阶段、特征条件化（context-conditioned）的学习框架：直接用神经网络输出条件高斯 overbound 的均值与标准差，并把"成对 overbounding（paired overbounding）+ 超额质量松弛 ε"的保守性约束直接嵌入分位数空间的训练损失中，配合 Wasserstein 型紧致性惩罚与单调性正则，在有限分位数网格上给出可证明的单侧保守性（并在三条正则性假设下推广到认证区间），从而支持卷积式（convolution-transitive）误差传播与保护水平（PL）计算。实验表明其在合成混合分布与对流层残差、城市多路径、电离层残差等真实场景中显著收紧 PL 并保持保守性。
AI.motivation: 安全攸关系统（自动驾驶、航空航天、金融、医疗）需要的是"保守上界"而非点估计，而主流不确定性量化（UQ）方法存在结构性缺陷：贝叶斯模型、深度集成、方差网络、分位数回归（QR）、共形预测（CP/CQR）等只保证单目标的校准性或边缘覆盖率，其区间在加性组合/卷积下不封闭——两个各带 (1−α) 覆盖的边际区间相加并不给出和的有效区间，只能用 Bonferroni（IR/n 分配）粗糙合并，在 n 大或尾重时过度保守；CP 的无分布保证也仅为边缘覆盖，精确的条件覆盖在无附加假设时不可能。两阶段学习方案（先由 MLP/LSTM 预测分位数，再套用 classical overbounding）进一步叠加保守性：建模与定界分别优化，且缺少紧致性准则；quantile overbounding 强行假设零均值高斯，常因保守性失效而需事后验证。经典高斯 overbounding（Rife 对称/成对 overbounding、Blanch 两步高斯 overbounding）虽支持卷积传递性保守性，但为全局性、依赖完整无条件误差分布、缺乏紧致性目标，难以适配由连续上下文特征（几何、环境）驱动的条件误差分布。
AI.method: 框架将 overbounding 约束内嵌进学习目标，而非事后处理。核心步骤：(1) 用多分位数回归（pinball loss）表示条件分布，引入局部 overbounding 因子 k_τ∈[1,(1+ε)/τ]，把分位数写为 q_τ = μ_τ + Q⁻¹(k_τ·τ/(1+ε))·σ_τ，即在分位数空间实现带超额质量 ε 的"成对 overbounding"松弛约束 F_L(F⁻¹(τ))≥τ/(1+ε)、F_R(F⁻¹(τ))≤(τ+ε)/(1+ε)；(2) 讨论三种参数共享情形——Case 1（μ、k 共享）因符号相反约束不可行，Case 3（μ、σ 共享、k_τ 可学）理论可行但极端尾部数值不稳定（Q⁻¹ 导数与 sigmoid 饱和相互作用），最终采用 Case 2（σ 与 k 全局共享、μ_τ 逐分位数可学，σ>0 经 log 参数化、k=1+ε·sigmoid(s_k)）；(3) 分位数加权 w_τ=1/(4τ(1−τ))（由 J_τ∝τ(1−τ) 推导）均衡各分位数贡献并强调尾部；(4) 加入左尾 Wasserstein-1 型惩罚 J_p（度量 overbound 与真实分位函数差异）以驱动紧致性，以及单调性惩罚 J_m=max(q̂_τi−q̂_τi+1,0)；(5) 为防止紧致性惩罚破坏保守性，将分位数水平缩放为 t·τ，并经一阶稳定性条件推导最坏充分界 t≤1−(n_L−1)λ/(w_ττ)，实践取启发式 t=1−200λ；(6) 右界通过对 −y 的对称构造获得（共享 σ、均值取反）；(7) 理论部分给出网格到连续区间推广（定理 1：三条假设——尾部正则性、认证区间与网格、实际/高斯分位函数 Lipschitz——下 g(τ)≥m_T−(L_q+L_q̄)h_T，从而在认证区间 [τ_min,1/2] 上成立）以及紧致域上目标的局部 Lipschitz、几乎处处可微与 Clarke 次梯度存在性（命题 1）；(8) 推理时用 5 个随机种子的小集成，在左右尾分别选取最保守的保护水平参数作为启发式保险。实验侧用 100 个均匀分位数网格、ε=0.0025、IR=10⁻³ 计算 PL¹、PL¹⁰，指标含 PL、Wasserstein 距离 W_L/W_R 与平均全局 overbounding 因子 K_L/K_R；基线为两步高斯 overbounding、成对 overbounding、quantile overbounding（0.99），并另对比 Bonferroni 聚合界与 GIVE。
AI.result: 合成实验（三种各 30 万样本的三分量高斯混合：Type1 多模态近零均值、Type2 负均值左偏、Type3 正均值重右尾）中，Case 2 在所有基线成功 overbound 的场景均全面占优：Type1 的 PL¹ 区间宽度较两步/成对分别缩短约 7.3%/21.7%，PL¹⁰ 缩短约 18%/12%；与真值（自卷积）偏差从 7.0/12.6 降至 4.71（>33% 改善），PL¹⁰ 从 6.6/5.6 降至 3.8（约 32%）；左尾 W_L 降 71%/58%，K_L 降 65%/99%。Type2 左尾 W_L 降 77%/20%、K_L 降 76%/54%，PL¹ 偏差从 5.15/6.05 降至 3.3（36%）；Type3 左尾 W_L 降 73%/13%，PL¹ 偏差从 5.17/4.1 降至 2（>51%），PL¹⁰ 偏差降约 21%。Quantile overbounding 在三类分布上均违反保守性（如图线与经验分布相交）。消融：Case 1/3 无法完全 overbound；加入 Wasserstein 惩罚使 PL¹⁰、W_L、K_L 分别改善 40%/83%/72%；均匀权重在 τ<10⁻⁶ 出现欠覆盖；仅 t=1−200λ 保持极端尾部完全保守（t=1 与 t=1−50λ 均在 0–0.01 分位区间失效）；可学 k 全面优于固定 k=1。真实数据：对流层 ZWD 残差（HKSL，2022，GPR 插值 vs IGS/CDDIS 真值，单位换算为厘米）近似对称单峰，Case 2 全面约束略优于成对但部分指标不及两步，而"Case 2 半约束"变体（仅 τ<1/2 施约束）最优，W_L/K_L 较两步降 31%/39%，PL¹ 偏差从 1.59/1.56 降至 0.96（>38%）。城市多路径（UrbanNav，MPNMLP，特征为仰角/方位角/CN0）经按预测参数归一化后，本文方法的归一化分布最贴近标准正态；PL¹ 区间 [7.85, 61.97] 较两步/成对收窄 83%/81.5%，PL¹⁰ 收窄 79%/78%，平均 σ 由数十降至约 4，K 较两步改善 22%/39%。电离层残差（香港 19 站 TEC，太阳活动 25 周期极端扰动 Kp≥8、Dst<−100nT，逾 300 万样本，以 Rfit/RCM 为条件特征的五层 MLP，可选加入仰角）三个变体（Case 2、Case 2 半约束、Case 2 半约束+仰角）PL¹ 区间约 [−0.5, 0.5] 较两步/成对改善超 90%、PL¹⁰ 改善超 85%，较 GIVE 改善约 71%/47%，平均 σ 由约 0.5 降至约 0.1，加入仰角特征在所有指标上一致进一步改善。
AI.conclusion: 本文把经典 GNSS 完整性监测中的高斯 overbounding 与现代学习式 UQ 用一个单阶段约束学习框架打通：在分位数空间内嵌带超额质量松弛的成对 overbounding 约束，配以 Wasserstein 型紧致性惩罚与单调性正则，输出可直接参与卷积传播与 PL 计算的条件高斯上界，并给出明确划定范围的理论保证（有限网格上的保守性；在尾部正则、认证区间与 Lipschitz 分位函数三条假设下的连续区间保守性；紧致域目标的局部正则性）。实验证明该框架在多种分布形态与真实误差场景下同时降低 PL 范围、降低 Wasserstein 偏离与平均 overbounding 因子，且保持经验保守性，优于两步高斯、成对与 quantile overbounding 等基线，也验证了 Wasserstein 惩罚、分位数加权、参数化方案与 t 缩放的必要性。作者亦明确了保证的边界：t=1−200λ 属启发式有限网格安全裕度而非形式化认证，理论分析是"有范围的"而非全局优化器定理，且网格/尾部的数值刚性（Q⁻¹ 导数爆炸）需靠截断与紧致域处理。后续方向包括推广到多元/联合高斯上界、更一般的定界族认证，以及引入时间结构以支持序贯不确定性与变化检测。

title: AOT-POT: Adaptive Operator Transformation for Large-Scale PDE Pre-training
summary: Pre-training neural operators on diverse partial differential equation (PDE) datasets has emerged as a promising direction for building general-purpose surrogate models in scientific machine learning. However, the inherent complexity and structural diversity of PDE solution operators make multi-PDE pre-training fundamentally challenging. Existing methods mainly address this by increasing model capacity, while leaving the target solution operators unchanged. Inspired by classical numerical analysis, we instead propose to transform complex and diverse solution operators into simpler, better-aligned forms that are easier to model jointly. Since the optimal transformation varies across PDE types, it must be adaptive and input-dependent, allowing a single neural operator to approximate an entire family of operators. We instantiate this idea as AOT-POT (adaptive operator-transformation for pre-training operator transformer), which expands hidden representations into multiple parallel streams, adaptively aggregates and redistributes them before and after each sub-layer, and mixes streams through Sinkhorn-projected doubly stochastic matrices for stable training. These mechanisms together reshape diverse solution operators into a unified form that can be effectively modeled by a single architecture. Empirically, AOT-POT achieves state-of-the-art performance on 12 PDE benchmarks with only 3\% additional parameters, reducing relative L2 error by up to 77.6\% (40.9\% on average). Fine-tuning AOT-POT further reduces L2 error by up to 92\% on in-domain PDEs and 89\% on out-of-domain PDEs (unseen types during pre-training), demonstrating that adaptive operator transformation is an effective and complementary direction for advancing PDE foundation models beyond simply scaling model capacity.

AI.tldr: AOT-POT提出自适应算子变换方法，通过将复杂多样的PDE解算子转换为更简单的对齐形式来解决多PDE预训练难题。模型通过并行流展开、自适应聚合和Sinkhorn投影双随机矩阵混合，仅增加3%参数即在12个PDE基准上达到最优，测试误差平均降低40.9%。
AI.motivation: 当前多PDE预训练方法主要通过增加模型容量来应对PDE解算子的复杂性和结构多样性，但忽视了算子本身的可变性。论文认为应从经典数值分析获得启发，通过变换将复杂多样的解算子转化为更简单、对齐的形式，从而降低单一神经算子的建模难度。
AI.method: AOT-POT的核心机制包括：(1) 将隐藏表示展开为多条并行流；(2) 在每个子层前后自适应聚合和重新分配表示；(3) 通过Sinkhorn投影的双随机矩阵混合流，实现稳定训练。这些机制共同将多样化解算子重塑为可被单一架构有效建模的统一形式。
AI.result: 在12个PDE基准上达到最优性能，仅增加3%参数。相对L2误差最多降低77.6%，平均降低40.9%。微调后在域内PDE上误差降低最多92%，域外（预训练未见类型）上降低89%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应算子变换是推进PDE基础模型的有效方向，与单纯扩大模型容量互补。该方法证明了通过变换使解算子对齐的思路比单纯增加模型容量更具参数效率，为构建通用PDE surrogate模型提供了新范式。

title: Martingale Neural Operators: Learning Stochastic Marginals via Doob-Meyer Factorization
summary: Neural operators excel as deterministic surrogates, but inevitably collapse to the conditional mean when applied to stochastic PDEs, discarding the variance and tail structure upon which uncertainty quantification depends. Recovering this structure typically requires Monte Carlo rollouts or grafted generative models, both of which surrender the one-shot efficiency and resolution invariance that define the operator paradigm. To resolve this, we draw on the Doob-Meyer theorem, which establishes that any semimartingale fundamentally decomposes into a predictable drift and an unpredictable, zero-mean martingale. Translating this theorem into an architectural prior, we introduce the Martingale Neural Operator (MNO). MNO maps an initial condition directly to the conditional mean and covariance of the terminal law, parameterized by a drift-like mean and a low-rank factor $B_φ$ with $B_φ^\top B_φ$ positive semi-definite by construction. For our experiments, we use a Gaussian residual instantiation. Across 1D SPDEs, rough volatility, and 2D operator tasks, MNO reduces Wasserstein distance by up to $120\times$ on $φ^4$ field theory and $68\times$ on stochastic Burgers, evaluating $\sim 3\times$ faster than a conditional diffusion baseline at matched wall-clock training budgets. On 2D tasks, MNO is comparable to FNO on zero-shot resolution transfer and turbulent flow, while quasi-deterministic systems such as Gray-Scott remain a failure mode.

AI.tldr: MNO通过Doob-Meyer定理将随机PDE的半鞅分解为漂移和鞅分量，直接预测条件均值和协方差结构，在保持算子范式效率的同时实现不确定性量化。在多个随机系统上取得数量级性能提升，但无法处理准确定性系统。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子在处理随机PDE时不可避免地坍缩到条件均值，丢弃了对不确定性量化至关重要的方差和尾部结构。现有方法（如Monte Carlo rollout或生成模型）牺牲了单次推理效率和分辨率不变性。
AI.method: MNO基于Doob-Meyer定理构建，将半鞅分解为可预测漂移和不可预测的零均值鞅。架构将初态直接映射到终端律的条件均值和协方差，通过漂移式均值和低秩因子 $B_\phi$（$B_\phi^\top B_\phi$ 半正定）参数化，采用高斯残差实例化。
AI.result: 在1D SPDEs、rough volatility和2D算子任务中，MNO在φ⁴场论上Wasserstein距离降低最高120倍，在随机Burgers上降低68倍；在相同训练预算下评估速度比条件扩散基线快约3倍；在2D任务中零样本分辨率迁移和湍流流场上与FNO相当。
AI.conclusion: MNO provides a principled, one-shot approach to UQ in neural operators, achieving up to 120× improvement in Wasserstein distance over baselines while maintaining resolution invariance and computational efficiency. Quasi-deterministic systems (e.g., Gray-Scott) remain a failure mode.

title: Intrinsic Wasserstein Rates for Score-Based Generative Models on Smooth Manifolds
summary: Score-based generative models are trained in high-dimensional ambient spaces, yet many data distributions are supported on low-dimensional nonlinear structures. We prove that, for compact $d$-dimensional smooth manifolds $\mathcal{M} \subset [0,1]^D$ with $d > 2$ and $β$-Hölder densities strictly positive on $\mathcal{M}$, a variance-preserving SGM estimator attains the intrinsic Wasserstein--1 sample exponent $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(D^{\mathcal{O}_β(d)}n^{-(β+1)/(d+2β)})$, up to logarithmic factors and explicit geometry and density factors. The full nonasymptotic bound explicitly isolates the finite-order geometry envelope, Hölder radius, density lower bound, ambient dependence, and finite-order correction terms. The analysis separates score approximation into a large-noise tangent-cell regime and a small-noise projection-centered, de-Gaussianized Laplace regime. The key technical ingredient is a ReLU implementation of nearest-projection coordinates via finite intrinsic anchors and Gauss--Newton iterations, rather than approximating the manifold projection as a black-box high-dimensional smooth map. Consequently, for families with polynomially controlled geometry and density lower bounds, the constructed score-network parameters have polynomial ambient dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文为支撑在紧致 d 维光滑流形上的分数型生成模型（SGM）给出内蕴 W1 速率：在 β-Hölder 且严格正密度的假设下，方差保持（VP）SGM 估计器达到样本指数 n^{-(β+1)/(d+2β)}（对数因子及显式几何/密度/环境维数多项式因子在外），即固定几何下匹配光滑密度的内蕴 W1 minimax 指数。核心贡献是把分数函数逼近拆成大噪声"切平面胞元"与小噪声"投影中心 de-Gaussianized Laplace"两区制，并用有限内蕴锚点 + Gauss–Newton 的 ReLU 网络实现最近点投影 Π_M，从而给出参数对环境维数 D 具多项式依赖的显式构造。
AI.motivation: 分数型生成模型（扩散模型）在高维环境空间中训练，但许多数据分布实际支撑在低维非线性结构上；流形假设预言样本复杂度应只依赖内蕴维数 d 而与 D 无关。现有全维扩散模型收敛/分数估计理论（Log-Sobolev 到 Fisher 信息、Besov/Hölder 分数率）都针对 R^D 中的满维密度，无法解释奇异流形律为何以 d 为速率变量；针对非线性流形的结果要么带 e^D 的环境前因子（如 TY24）、要么速率更慢且带高维近似因子（如 YP25）、要么依赖"支撑感知"的样本相关局部低秩分解与 σ_t^2 加权目标、且残留 n^δ 松弛（ADR24）。本文目标是在不做支撑预处理的完全显式环境分数网络实现中，给出定理级的构造性审计，达到精确内蕴指数。
AI.method: 设定：M ⊂ [0,1]^D 为紧致 C^∞ 的 d 维黎曼流形，reach κ>0，体积 S_M；密度 p_0 关于 vol_M 绝对连续，属 H^β(M,B_0)，且 p_0 ≥ p_min>0。方法分四层：(1) 管域局域化——前向管半径 ρ_t = C_ϱ σ_t sqrt(D∨log n)，借助 Tweedie 公式与 Gaussian 集中，证明经截断（‖s‖_∞ ≤ Cσ_t^{-1}(D∨log n)^{1/2}）后管外分数风险可忽略；(2) 中心化比值表示——以投影图集 + 分拆 unity 写密度/分数矩 Q、P，并定义中心化分子 U = (m_t P − x Q)/σ_t，从而 σ_t s* = U/Q，避免分别逼近 m_t P 与 x Q 后的相消误差；大噪声区用切平面仿射中心 T_ν 与切向高斯包络分解相位，胞元尺度 h = c_0 σ_{t_{k-1}} ∧ r_{*,n}，固定阶 Taylor（q_geom−2）替换几何后按存储矩实现 ReLU 网络，固有胞元数 σ_{t_{k-1}}^{-d} + r_{*,n}^{-d}；(3) 小噪声区——以最近投影点 Π_M(x/m_t) 为中心展开：先"de-Gaussianization"消去公共法向高斯因子得 Q̄ ≥ C^{-1}Γ^{-C} p_min (D∨log n)^{-d/4} 的多项式分母下界，再在投影中心的切坐标 (u = u^Π + σ_t w) 做 Laplace 展开（系数为 A_{i,q,λ}，正则性 H^{β−q}）；投影中心本身用有限内蕴锚点 + 展开的 Gauss–Newton 迭代 + ReLU 目标门实现（Theorem F.13），避免把 Π_M 当作黑盒 D 维光滑映射（黑盒路线在 β̃ ≳ Dβ/d 时需 exp(c_{β,d}D) 个混合偏导数）；(4) 统计与传输——截断 ERM 预言机（近似误差 + 稀疏 ReLU 覆盖数 log N ≤ C M (D∨log n)^C），小噪声一次训练 [t_0,t_1]、大噪声按二进板 slab 分别训练并用 ReLU 时间开关组装，最后用 slabwise W1 扰动引理 + early-stopping/终端高斯误差做 telescoping。有限几何阶 q_geom 先固定不随 n、D、d 增长，d>2 时取规范选择 q_opt(β)。
AI.result: 主定理（Theorem 5.1 / Corollary H.1）：E W1(P_0, P̂_{t_0}^{lb}) ≤ C Γ^C B_0^C p_min^{-C} (D∨log n)^{p_{β,d}} [r_n + n^{-1/2} + n^{-1/2} r_n^{-d/(2q_*)}]，其中 r_n = n^{-(β+1)/(d+2β)}、q_* = q_geom−2，且包含显式的有限阶几何包络 Γ、Hölder 半径 B_0、密度下界 p_min、环境依赖 (D∨log n)^{p_{β,d}}。当 d>2 且取 q_geom = q_opt(β) 时 q_* ≥ d(β+1)/(d−2)，两个修正项均为 O(r_n)，p_{β,d} = O_β(d)，故简化为 E W1 ≤ C Γ^C B_0^C p_min^{-C} D^{O_β(d)} n^{-(β+1)/(d+2β)}，在固定几何意义下匹配内蕴 minimax W1 指数。附加结论：(i) 学得分数网络宽度/稀疏度为 n^{d/(d+2β)} 量级，环境依赖为 (D∨log n)^{p_{β,d}}，在多项式几何族（仿射球、平坦乘积环面、有限阶/闭图型嵌入满足 S_M∨κ^{-1}∨K_{M,q} ≤ D^a）下参数对 D 为多项式依赖；(ii) 固定几何下充分的环境增长条件 D∨log n ≤ c n^{a_{β,d}}（a_{β,d} = min{2/(d+2β), 2β/((d+2β)(p_{β,d}−1))}），此时小噪声的 reach 与分母分辨条件自动成立；(iii) 大噪声容量 σ_{t_{k-1}}^{-d} + r_{*,n}^{-d}、小噪声容量 n^{d/(d+2β)} 均被显式记录而非隐藏在 𝒪̃(·) 中。
AI.conclusion: 本文在"精确支撑 + 密度严格正下界 + 正 reach + 显式有限阶几何包络 + 小噪声 reach/分母分辨条件"下，给出 VP-SGM 的内蕴 W1 保证，速率指数只依赖内蕴维数 d 与密度正则性 β（n^{-(β+1)/(d+2β)}），并把环境维数依赖隔离在显式的多项式因子 D^{O_β(d)} 中；关键方法论贡献是把最近点投影做成有限锚点 Gauss–Newton 的构造性 ReLU 实现（内蕴复杂度 ε^{-d/β}）与解析 de-Gaussianization（保证分母多项式下界），从而绕开黑盒高阶环境光滑映射审计的指数代价。局限与展望：结论条件于精确支撑、密度下界与显式小噪声可容许条件；分析针对理想化的板式（slabwise）估计器而非共享参数的端到端扩散训练；未含观测噪声、优化误差与离散化误差；作者列出放松支撑/密度假设、加入环境观测噪声、分析优化与离散化误差为开放问题。

title: From Observed Viability to Internal Predictive Approximation: A Single-Subject Latent-Space Analysis of Gait Dynamics Under Occlusal Constraint
comment: 31 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Exploratory single-subject study combining gait analysis, occlusal observational probes, PCA-based latent-space modeling, and supervised predictive approximation
summary:
Adaptive biomechanical systems may show similar observable gait performance while differing in latent organization and longitudinal behavior. This study examines whether an observed longitudinal transformation of gait organization can be approximated within a predictive latent-space framework, without claiming clinical prediction or causal occlusal effects.
  Using an exploratory single-subject design in a Parkinsonian participant, gait was recorded with instrumented insoles during two sessions separated by eleven weeks. Six occlusal observational probes were tested: natural occlusion, open-mouth disengagement, strong clenching, two vertical-dimension increases in centric relation, and one vertical-dimension increase with mandibular protrusion. Principal Component Analysis was used to construct a PC1--PC2 latent representation. A simplified supervised machine-learning model, implemented as a feed-forward neural network, was trained to approximate the observed M1--M2 transformation.
  The primary analysis focused on the three centric-relation conditions and tested whether the displacement hierarchy could be reproduced. The model preserved the ordering OC3 < ONL < OC2.5. The extended six-probe analysis also preserved the global structure of the exploratory displacement pattern, with OC3 and OC3P closely grouped and the highest displacements associated with OC2.5 and open-mouth disengagement. Held-out M2 and leave-condition-out analyses showed condition-dependent approximation variability.
  These findings do not establish generalizable prediction, therapeutic superiority, causal occlusal effects, or clinical viability forecasting. They support only the restricted conclusion that observed longitudinal latent transformations can be internally approximated within this single-subject dataset, providing a methodological bridge toward future multi-subject predictive viability models.

AI.tldr: 本文是该系列研究的"Level 5"部分：在一名帕金森病参与者的单被试数据中，用主成分分析（PCA）构建 PC1–PC2 潜空间，再以一个简化的前馈神经网络（16–16 隐层、ReLU、Adam、MSE 损失、800 epoch）近似 M1→M2 的潜变量坐标变换。核心结果：模型在 ONL/OC2.5/OC3 三条件上复现了 Level 4 的欧氏质心位移层级 d_OC3 < d_ONL < d_OC2.5（观测 5.35/5.73/6.39，预测 5.32/5.72/6.45）；六探针扩展分析保持整体排序结构（OC3 与 OC3P 近似并列，OC2.5 与 OBL 位移最大），留出 M2 与留条件交叉验证显示仍可内部近似但误差随条件变化。作者明确声明结论受限：仅为单被试内部近似，不构成临床预测、因果咬合效应、治疗优势或一般化预测。
AI.motivation: 作者构建了一个多层级分析框架（Level 3→4→5）。Level 3 发现聚合标量评分与静态 UMAP 嵌入都无法唯一解析咬合观测探针（静态表征不可识别性）；Level 4 在共同 PCA 表征中描述了各条件的 M1–M2 质心位移，但属于纯回顾性描述，无法回答"已观测到的表征变换能否被学习模型内部逼近"这一问题。因此本研究（Level 5）转向内部预测逼近（internal predictive approximation）：检验在所选 PCA 坐标系中观察到的 M1–M2 变换能否被一个简化的监督模型在同一单被试数据集内近似，并保持条件级位移层级。核心概念区分是"纵向系统演化"与"观测性约束"：咬合条件仅在步态采集期间施加，属于离散观测探针，而非驱动 11 周演化的持续因果输入。
AI.method: 单被试探索性纵向设计：一名自主步行的帕金森病参与者，仪器化鞋垫记录步态（时空参数与压力相关变量，60 个数值变量经 z-score 标准化，排除 side/flag/overflow 等非数值字段）。两次测量会话 M1 与 M2 间隔 11 周，期间接受 11 次" sophrology 导向感觉运动干预"（身体觉察、内感受注意、姿势调节、呼吸控制、本体感觉参与），被整体视为结构化的纵向背景而非可分离的因果因素。六个咬合观测探针：ONL（自然中性咬合）、OBL（张口无牙接触）、OSL（强紧咬）、OC2.5（ centric relation 下垂直距离增加 2.5°）、OC3（增加 3°）、OC3P（增加 3° + 下颌前伸，颞下颌铰链轴位移 2 mm）。数据共 12 次录制（6 条件 × 2 会话），观测数 33–62/条件不等。表征：核心分析沿用与 Level 4 相同的特征集与 PC1–PC2 投影；扩展分析在六探针数据集上重算 PCA。训练对：在同一条件内将 M1 与 M2 观测截断至最小样本数后人为配对（仅为计算目的，非生理步级匹配）。模型：单一前馈网络联合近似 G_θ（纵向变换）与 H_φ（观测约束），输入为 (PC1, PC2, 条件描述符, 时间转移指示)，输出预测的 M2 PC1/PC2；描述符编码（牙接触、开口、强咬、VDO 增加、前伸 mm）是为支持留条件交叉验证而采用的务实选择。评估：全数据集逼近、留出 M2（按条件 20% 划分）、留一条件交叉验证，以及以 ONL 为参考的会话内层级分析；主指标为条件级质心位移 d_obs、d_pred 与质心误差 e_centroid，点级 RMSE 为次要指标。
AI.result: 核心分析重算观测位移为 ONL 5.73、OC2.5 6.39、OC3 5.35（与 Level 4 的 5.76/6.47/5.32 略有差异但不改变排序）；模型预测为 5.72/6.45/5.32，质心误差 0.01–0.06，完整保持 d_OC3 < d_ONL < d_OC2.5。六探针扩展分析观测位移为 OSL 5.57 < ONL 5.72 < OC3 5.77 < OC3P 5.78 < OC2.5 6.32 < OBL 6.72；预测为 5.55/5.61/5.75/5.74/6.41/6.65，仅 OC3 与 OC3P 之间出现微小次序反转（两者数值几乎相等），质心误差 0.01–0.20。留出 M2 逼近：全局点级 RMSE 1.78，条件级质心误差 0.04–1.70（OC3P 最大）。留一条件交叉验证：质心误差 0.40–1.08（OC3P 最小、ONL 最大），点级 RMSE 0.86–3.86。点级误差普遍存在，说明模型未复现细粒度变异。会话内层级：M1 为 ONL<OSL<OC3<OC3P<OC2.5<OBL，M2 为 ONL<OSL<OC3<OBL<OC3P<OC2.5；ONL、OSL、OC3 三者始终最接近 ONL，OBL 相对位置变化最大。
AI.conclusion: 本研究仅支持受限结论：在该单被试数据集内，已观测到的、依赖于表征选择的纵向潜变量变换可以被内部近似（"静态表征不可识别性 → 观测纵向质心位移 → 对该位移的内部逼近"这一推进仍然属探索性质）。研究明确不建立咬合的因果效应、临床预测效度、经验证的"活力"（viability）阈值或区域、治疗优势或最优咬合配置，也不构成一般化的患者层面预测。贡献是方法论层面的：从回顾性描述质心位移走向未来多被试建模的计算桥梁；作者指出 Level 6 需要多名行走者、重复纵向转移、前瞻性验证、固定共享表征并对未见个体进行显式评估。其他限制包括：单被试、模型被刻意简化、PCA 前两主成分仅保留部分方差、核心与扩展分析的坐标系不同因距离不可跨分析直接比较、M1–M2 变换混合了内在演化、干预、自发变异与日常因素且无法解离、训练对非生理匹配、描述符编码非经验证的生物力学参数化、OBL 等非 VDO 条件不可作治疗性比较。

title: Ti-iLSTM: A TinyDL Approach for Logic-Level Anomaly Detection in Industrial Water Treatment Systems
summary: Industrial Water Treatment Systems (IWTS) are safety critical cyber-physical infrastructures and due to increased connectivity, these systems are exposed to cyber threats that can manipulate process behaviour without creating obvious devices outliers. In particular, logic-layer deception anomalies can preserve numerically plausible measurements while breaking expected cause-and-effect relationships in the control process. These attacks are difficult to detect using threshold-based monitoring or require heavy server-oriented anomaly detection models. This paper explores the potential of Tiny Deep Learning (TinyDL) to provide lightweight on-device logic-level anomaly detection for resource constrained Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs). We propose a novel framework, TinyDL-based incremental LSTM (Ti-iLSTM) which optimises the memory and space foot print of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), to detect logic-layer inconsistencies in Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) based Industrial Water Treatment Systems (IWTS). Experiments on the publicly available SWaT dataset show that the optimised model achieves high detection performance (F1-score=0.983 and ROC-AUC=0.998). A deployment-style validation on the WADI dataset confirms that the proposed light-weight framework remains applicable beyond a single dataset. The research demonstrates that combining logic-aware supervision with Tiny Deep Learning (TinyDL) sequence learning creates an efficient and accurate anomaly detection suitable for resource constrained Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) in industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ti-iLSTM（基于 TinyDL 的增量式 LSTM）框架，用于在资源受限的可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）上对工业水处理系统进行逻辑层异常检测：通过可解释的过程规则自动生成异常标签（不依赖数据集自带攻击标注）、三阶段特征选择将输入压缩到 10 个特征、采用短滑动窗口与分块增量训练以约束内存占用。在 SWaT 上取得 F1≈0.98、ROC-AUC≈0.998，在不重训的情况下直接迁移到 WADI 仍获得 F1≈0.957，并首次在物理 PLC（Industrial Shields Raspberry PLC 50RRA）上报告推理阶段的 RSS 内存（约 709 MB）与验证时间等资源可行性证据。
AI.motivation: 工业水处理系统（IWTS）是安全关键的信息物理基础设施，随着 IIoT 互联程度提升，面临逻辑层欺骗攻击（logic-layer deception）：攻击者保持数值上合理的传感器读数，却破坏控制过程中的因果关系，使泵/阀门状态与其对应传感器的响应脱节，从而在阈值监控下不触发任何告警而逐渐将过程推向不安全状态。现有防御手段（阈值告警、规则校验、基于物理模型的检测）难以识别此类"统计正常但逻辑异常"的隐蔽攻击；而主流 ML/DL 异常检测方法（多模态 DNN、VAE-LSTM、STAE-AD、图神经网络、Transformer+GWO 等）普遍存在三个问题：① 面向服务器/GPU 部署，使用 51–127 个特征、120 秒级长窗口与庞大参数集，无法在内存与算力受限的 PLC 级设备上运行；② 关注全局统计偏差或跨传感器相关性，对 PLC 内部局部控制逻辑的一致性关注不足；③ 几乎不报告 CPU 占用、内存占用与端侧稳定性等部署可行性证据。此外，实际工业环境中显式攻击标签极少，依赖数据集标注限制了方法的可推广性。因此需要一种标签自生成、模型紧凑、可在 PLC 上就地推理的逻辑层异常检测方案。
AI.method: 框架分数据收集、训练、预测三阶段。①数据：SWaT（v2，51 变量、1 秒采样）用于训练与验证，WADI（123 变量）仅做部署式验证，不重训、不重选特征。②标签：定义三类逻辑不一致规则——泵-液位不匹配（P101 开启而 LIT101 在观测窗内无变化）、阀-流量不匹配（MV101 开启而 FIT101 近零）、执行器切换时的传感器冻结（P101 状态跃迁而 LIT101 无响应），均带容差以抑制噪声与稳定延迟；各时间戳独立判定后以逻辑 OR 聚合为二值标签 y_t=max(δ_pump, δ_valve, δ_freeze)。③特征选择三阶段：Pearson 相关性过滤（|ρ|>0.9 剔除，51→约 20）→ 方差膨胀因子 VIF 迭代剔除多重共线性 → 以 200 棵树的随机森林估计重要性并做 RFE，最终保留 10 个特征（FIT_101、LIT_101、MV_101、AIT_202/203/302、DPIT_301、LIT_301、MV_302、P3_STATE）。④数据划分与平衡：分层 70%/30% 划分，仅在训练集上用 SMOTE 过采样以避免信息泄漏，标准化参数仅由训练集拟合，SMOTE 后按固定随机种子打乱以避免分块增量训练中的顺序偏置。⑤模型：LSTM（16 单元），滑动窗口构造长度为 w 的序列，标签取窗口末时刻，输出 sigmoid 概率经阈值 τ 转为二分类。⑥增量训练：数据按固定大小分块，每块构造重叠序列并训练 1 个 epoch，跨块保留权重更新 W_{i+1}，内存中仅驻留一个块，块间显式垃圾回收；每次块更新记录 RSS 与验证时间并以 F1 做早停。⑦基线配置 W=5、C=1000、B=64、U=16、τ=0.5，并通过 E1–E8 单变量受控实验（窗口、批大小、分块大小、单元数、阈值；E2/E3 为资源密集型对照）评估性能与资源权衡。⑧指标：Accuracy/Precision/Recall/F1/ROC-AUC 加验证时间与 RSS 内存（psutil 采集），并在物理 PLC 上做推理验证。
AI.result: SWaT：Accuracy≈0.98、Precision≈0.974、Recall≈0.989、F1≈0.981–0.983、ROC-AUC≈0.998；混淆矩阵为 TN 16,154、FP 342、FN 108、TP 13,387，仅漏检 108 个逻辑异常序列。跨数据集零样本迁移到 WADI（不重训、不重选特征）：Accuracy 0.949、Precision 0.974、Recall 0.94、F1 0.957，性能下降属预期（系统物理布局与动态不同），且精度保持高位说明逻辑感知监督具有跨场景可迁移性。资源可行性：笔记本验证 RSS 701.18 MB，物理 PLC 推理 RSS 708.83 MB（增量仅 +7.65 MB），系统内存占用 81.6%→81.7%，推理验证时间约 1.2 s；窗口从 5 增至 20 使 RSS 由 750.89 MB 升至 862.92 MB，批大小从 16 增至 128 使准确率降至 0.970，分块 5000 时 RSS 达 1019.44 MB，单元数从 16 增至 64 仅带来 F1 0.982→0.984 的边际提升而推理时间增至 1.812 s；阈值 0.3 召回 0.998/精度 0.959，阈值 0.9 精度 0.994/召回骤降至 0.891，故选 0.5。对比基准：优于 STAE-AD（F1 0.88、51 特征、120 s 窗）与既有 LSTM（F1 0.94、51 特征、服务器），且为该对比中唯一报告运行时内存与时间的工作。作者亦承认局限：基于日志数据而非在线运行、逻辑规则仅覆盖三类简单依赖、CPU/内存为推理期快照而无完整周期剖析与功耗测量。
AI.conclusion: Ti-iLSTM 证明了"逻辑感知监督 + TinyDL 序列学习"的组合能够在资源受限的 PLC 级硬件上兼顾检测精度与可部署性：仅用 10 个特征与 5–10 步短窗口的轻量增量 LSTM，在 SWaT 上取得 F1≈0.98、ROC-AUC≈0.998，零样本迁移至 WADI 仍保持 F1≈0.957，并在物理 PLC 上实测内存增量仅约 7.65 MB、推理时间约 1.2 s，填补了既有研究缺失的 PLC 端资源可行性证据空白。核心洞见是：异常标签不必依赖数据集提供的攻击标注，而可由传感器—执行器因果规则自动生成，从而更具真实部署价值；特征压缩、短窗口与分块增量训练是控制内存与算力成本的关键。未来方向包括通过量化与剪枝进一步压缩模型、引入大语言模型对检测到的逻辑异常进行可解释分析与人类可读安全洞察生成，以及将一致性规则扩展到更多工艺阶段与更复杂的跨阶段因果模式。

title: Shapley Neuron Values for Continual Learning: Which Neurons Matter Most?
comment: This paper has been accepted to ICML 2026
summary: Continual learning enables neural networks to learn tasks sequentially without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. However, neural networks suffer from catastrophic forgetting, where learning new tasks degrades performance on earlier ones. We address this problem with Shapley Neuron Valuation (SNV), a principled framework that quantifies Neuron importance in continual learning, grounded in cooperative game theory. SNV selectively freezes important Neurons while keeping others plastic, enabling buffer-free continual learning without expanding architecture. Experiments on ImageNet-1k show that SNV consistently outperforms existing buffer-free methods. In particular, SNV improves accuracy by +2.88% in the class incremental learning and +6.46% in the task incremental learning scenarios compared to the second baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Shapley Neuron Valuation (SNV)：把卷积网络的"神经元"（卷积核）视为合作博弈中的玩家，用模型性能 V（准确率）作为收益函数，依据 Shapley 值的四条公理（有效性、零贡献、对称性、线性）推导出唯一的"Shapley 神经元价值" φ_i，用以在固定容量的骨干网络内为每个任务挑选 top-⌊c·N⌋ 个关键神经元并冻结，其余保持可塑，从而在无回放缓冲、不扩展结构的严格持续学习设定下抑制灾难性遗忘。精确计算不可行，故用"蒙特卡洛采样 + 截断 + 多臂老虎机（TMAB-Shapley）"近似；累积掩码 B_t=∪S_i 逐任务冻结参数以实现稳定性-可塑性分离。在 ResNet-18 上于 CIFAR-100/Tiny-ImageNet/ImageNet-1k、10/20/50 任务的 CIL 与 TIL 下，SNV 全面优于所有 buffer-free 基线（ImageNet-1k CIL 10 任务 41.30%，比第二名 NFL+ 高 2.88 点；TIL 高 6.46 点且 BWT=0.0），在部分设定下甚至超过使用 2 万样本回放的 DyTox；额外计算开销约 1.24× FLOPs、推理延迟不变、显存 +0.1GB。
AI.motivation: 持续学习面临灾难性遗忘，而现有三类方法各有硬伤：(1) 正则化类（EWC、SI、LwF）虽无回放，但需额外任务模块/辅助损失或架构约束，且其 Fisher/路径重要性在对角近似下难以刻画 1000 类任务的复杂参数交互，任务高度异质时性能急剧退化；(2) 基于记忆类（iCaRL、DER++、PODNet、COIL、GEM）依赖回放样本，违反"仅当前任务数据可访问"的严格持续学习设定，并带来隐私（GDPR）与显存开销问题；(3) 动态结构类（PNN、DyTox、MEMO）随任务数增长导致参数与显存无界扩张，长任务序列下不可行。作者的核心问题是：能否在固定骨干容量内、不访问历史数据、不扩展结构的前提下实现抗遗忘的学习？其洞察是现代网络高度过参数化、存在大量冗余容量，若能以原则化机制可靠识别每个任务最重要的神经元并结构化保留，则固定容量模型足以编码长任务序列。
AI.method:
问题形式化：任务序列 T={T_t}、数据 D_t 仅在训练第 t 个任务时可访问；"神经元"定义为卷积核，N=Σ_l C_l；V 为黑盒性能函数（准确率/损失），需满足 Σ_i φ_i(V,M)=V(M)。屏蔽策略：将被屏蔽滤波器的输出替换为其在验证集上的"均值响应"而非置零，以保持后续层信号统计量不变；子网络 S⊆M 的性能 V(S) 在不重训参数的前提下直接前向评估。每个任务的子网络由带稀疏约束的组合优化给出：min_{S_t∈{0,1}^N} (1/k_t)Σ L(f(x;M⊙S_t), y)，s.t. ‖S_t‖_0 ≤ ⌊c·N⌋（c 为容量比率，如 1/T），精确求解不可行，改为按 Shapley 值排序取 top-k。定理 2.1：满足四条公理（有效性、零贡献、对称性、线性）的唯一神经元估值即 φ_i=Σ_{S⊆M\{i}} |S|!(|M|-|S|-1)!/|M|! · [V(S∪{i})−V(S)]，即经典 Shapley 值（Neuron=玩家、性能=收益的合作博弈）。相较 WSN 的二值重要度，φ_i∈ℝ 提供连续排序，可在紧预算 c 下按阈值裁剪出二值掩码 S_t。
估值估计（TMAB-Shapley）：(1) 蒙特卡洛——对均匀随机排列求边际贡献均值，φ_i=E_π[V(S_i^π∪{i})−V(S_i^π)]，为无偏估计；(2) 截断——当 V(S)≤τ 时模型已近乎失效，跳过边际计算，算力节省近一个数量级；(3) 多臂老虎机——仅对置信区间 (|φ̂_i−φ^(k)|<δ_i, δ_i=z_α σ_i/√n_i) 与当前 top-k 阈值重叠的神经元采样，配合利用（对高估值者加密采样）与探索（对高不确定者抽样）两阶段，直至 top-k 与其余神经元在误差容忍度内可区分。
累积掩码与冻结：B_{t-1}=∪_{i<t} S_i 表示已被占用的滤波器集合；参数级掩码 M_{t-1} 将属于这些滤波器的权重梯度置零，更新规则 θ←θ−η(∂L/∂θ ⊙ M_{t-1})，从而区分"稳定神经元"（旧任务知识）与"可塑神经元"（新任务学习）；训练完当前任务后再用验证集估计 S_t 并并入 B_t。
实验设置：ResNet-18（He 初始化、Adam、batch 64/128、最多 200/100 epoch + 早停），10 次随机种子，70% 训练/20% 测试/10% 验证；数据集 CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet-1k；CIL 与 TIL，10/20/50 任务；指标 ACC、BWT、PS 及自定义 CAP（各任务子网并集参数占比）。基线：buffer-free（EWC、SI、LwF、PEC、WSN、SpaceNet、NISPA、DCNet、NFL+）、memory-based（iCaRL、DER++、DyTox）；超参仅用首个任务验证集按 GTEP 原则一次性网格搜索确定，后续任务不再调参（作者强调这对依赖 buffer 管理超参的记忆类方法尤为关键）。
AI.result: ImageNet-1k CIL：SNV 达 41.30/34.20/25.60%（10/20/50 任务），较第二名 buffer-free 方法 NFL+ 分别高 2.88/2.70/3.20 点，并超过使用 20000 样本回放的 DyTox（40.15/33.20/24.50%），说明"选对参数"可补偿无回放。ImageNet-1k TIL：SNV 57.82/50.45/40.18%，BWT 全为 0.0，优于所有 buffer-free 方法；正则化类则崩溃（EWC CIL 10 任务仅 7.53%，SI CIL 50 任务 4.50%）。CIFAR-100 CIL 10/20 任务：54.70%/44.85%（BWT −0.04），且方差最小（±0.42 vs NFL+ ±2.45、DCNet ±2.70），表明 Shapley 估计给出跨种子更稳定的神经元选择。TIL：CIFAR-100 c=0.5 时 79.76%（BWT 0）超过 DyTox 73.80%（BWT −3.50）、DER++ 70.60%、iCaRL 70.10%；Tiny-ImageNet 74.82% vs DyTox 68.50%。与 WSN 的对照隔离出 Shapley 选元的贡献：同为掩码冻结（BWT 均为 0），c=0.5 时 CIFAR-100 79.76% vs 64.00%、Tiny-ImageNet 74.82% vs 61.06%，c=0.03 时 71.74% vs 59.65%，说明二值选择缺乏排序机制是主要差距来源。剪枝-效率分析：SNV 的精度悬崖比 NFL+ 更靠后（CIFAR-100 可维持到 30% 剪枝后于 40% 崩塌，NFL+ 在 20–30% 间即崩塌），而 PEC/EWC/LwF 呈缓慢退化，说明其参数冗余度高。容量分析：SNV 仅使用骨干 18–80% 的参数即可达到最优精度-容量权衡，容量与性能呈非线性关系。计算成本：SNV 的 FLOPs 约为 NFL+ 的 1.24×，额外显存约 0.1 GB，推理延迟不变；估值阶段占整条序列总时长约 23–24%（CIFAR-100 11.7 min / Tiny-ImageNet 37.8 min）。消融：纯 MC 97 min、54.92%；MC+截断 73 min、54.84%；完整 TMAB 62 min、54.70%——4× 加速仅损失 0.22 点，且重要性排序在 5 个种子下稳定。机制分析：Shapley 热图高度稀疏且随任务推进稀疏度递增，存在跨任务持续高价值的"通用特征"神经元（早期层更均匀、后期层更任务特异）；任务掩码 Jaccard 重叠度约 0.3–0.5，兼顾知识共享与干扰隔离。失败尝试（附录C）：精确 Shapley 需 4×A6000 跑一周仅完成 30%；去掉累积掩码性能崩塌；允许 1–5% 冻结权重解冻即大幅掉点；完全禁止新任务访问冻结参数会显著变差（说明需保留一定共享复用）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：SNV 用 Shapley 值给出"哪个神经元最重要"的原则化答案，证明在固定容量、buffer-free、无结构扩展的严格持续学习设定内即可逼近甚至匹配/超越依赖回放的记忆类方法，同时消除数据留存带来的隐私风险，适合存储受限与隐私敏感场景。其理论贡献在于把持续学习的重要性选择问题严格归约为合作博弈估值问题，并导出满足四条公理的唯一解；其工程贡献为 TMAB-Shapley 近似（截断+MAB）使估值代价降至总训练时间的约四分之一且几乎无损。局限：(1) 任务后置估值阶段的成本随网络宽度与任务复杂度增长，在超大模型上可能成为瓶颈；(2) 精确估值不可行，仅能近似；(3) TIL 结果的零遗忘部分源于掩码冻结的构造性保证，而 CIL 场景中仍存在可观遗忘（ACC 矩阵显示 CIFAR-100 T1 由 90.0%→33.5%，20 任务时 88.0%→21.9%），且上三角接近随机基线表明正迁移有限；(4) 容量上限（c>0.5 无增益）与"新任务不能完全独占冻结参数"的耦合使超参需按数据集设定，跨场景泛化仍待验证。未来工作：借鉴 Data Shapley 的在线近似，使 Shapley 估计随参数更新同步进行，在任务边界即刻给出重要性评分，消除独立估值阶段。

title: Practical Validity Conditions for Byzantine-Tolerant Federated Learning
summary:
Robust aggregation is the core operation in Byzantine-tolerant federated learning. To ensure the quality of aggregation independently of data distribution or attacks, validity conditions are needed. They provide geometric guarantees of where the output of the aggregation must lie. The widespread convex validity requires the output to lie in the convex hull of the honest vectors. Although this guarantee is strong in theory, it is poorly suited to modern federated learning systems, as it has dimension-dependent resilience and excludes many practical aggregation rules.
  We introduce the minimum enclosing ball (MEB) validity condition for robust aggregation, as well as its multiplicative relaxation, $c$-MEB validity, where $c$ is a constant. We show that exact MEB validity still suffers from limited resilience, while relaxed $c$-MEB validity is achievable if a majority of clients is honest, i.e. $n>2t$. We give an optimal MinMax-MEB rule for the relaxed condition with the bound $c<\sqrt{2}$ and prove explicit relaxed-MEB guarantees for standard aggregators including minimum-diameter averaging, medoid and geometric median. Finally, we relate MEB validity to convex, relaxed-convex and box validity studied in prior literature, thus providing a systematic map of geometric validity conditions for Byzantine-robust aggregation. Our results show that relaxed MEB validity connects validity conditions in distributed computing and Byzantine-tolerant aggregation rules, and offers a practical alternative to convex validity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对拜占庭容错联邦学习中的鲁棒聚合问题，提出了最小包围球(MEB)有效性条件，证明了其放松形式(c-MEB)在诚实多数条件下可达，并给出了最优聚合规则及标准聚合器的保证，为几何有效性条件提供了系统化框架。
AI.motivation: 现有凸有效性条件虽然在理论上提供强保证，但在实际联邦学习系统中表现不佳：具有维度依赖的恢复力限制，且排斥许多实用的聚合规则。因此需要新的几何有效性条件来适配现代联邦学习系统。
AI.method: 提出最小包围球(MEB)有效性条件及其乘法松弛形式c-MEB有效性，设计了最优MinMax-MEB聚合规则(c<√2)，并为最小直径平均、中位数和几何中位数等标准聚合器提供了显式松弛MEB保证。通过几何分析建立了MEB与凸、放松凸及盒式有效性条件之间的系统性关联。
AI.result: 证明精确MEB有效性仍受限于较低恢复力，但放松的c-MEB有效性在诚实客户占多数(n>2t)时可达；最优MinMax-MEB规则达到c<√2的紧界；多种标准聚合器满足放松MEB保证；建立了MEB与已有有效性条件的层次关系。
AI.conclusion: c-MEB validity为拜占庭容错联邦学习提供了一种在计算可行性与理论保证之间取得平衡的实用替代方案，弥合了分布式计算几何与拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则之间的鸿沟。

title: CHoE: Cross-Domain Heterogeneous Graph Prompt Learning via Structure-Conditioned Experts
summary: Heterogeneous Graph Prompt Learning (HGPL)has emerged as a promising paradigm for bridging the gap between the objectives of pre-training foundation models and their downstream applications in heterogeneous graph settings. However, existing HGPL methods are primarily designed for in-domain scenarios, whereas real-world deployments often span multiple domains, and the data used for pre-training and downstream tasks may originate from different distributions. Consequently, the applicability of current HGPL approaches is limited to in-domain settings, and their performance typically degrades when application domains shift. To address this serious limitation, we develop CHoE, a cross-domain HGPL method built upon an expert network. During pre-training, we introduce and train structure-conditioned experts, and during prompt tuning, we adopt a structure-aware expert routing and load balancing mechanism to select structurally compatible experts for each meta-path view. In addition, we design a prompt-based semantic fusion module to integrate representations across multiple views for downstream prediction. Extensive experiments show that CHoE consistently improves performance in few-shot cross-domain applications, outperforming all baseline approaches.

AI.tldr: CHoE 是一个面向异质图的跨域图提示学习（HGPL）框架，基于"结构条件专家网络"实现预训练模型到下游异质图的迁移。它在预训练阶段学习结构条件专家池，在提示调优阶段通过结构感知的专家路由与负载均衡为每个元路径视图选择结构兼容的专家，并设计基于提示的语义融合模块跨视图聚合表示。在 ACM→DBLP/Aminer/Freebase 等少样本跨域节点分类任务上全面超越 11 个基线，尤其在 Aminer、Freebase 上提升显著（如 5-shot Macro-F1 49.75 vs 基线最优 40.91）。
AI.motivation: 异质图提示学习（HGPL）现有方法（HGPrompt、HetGPT 等）均假设预训练与下游任务处于同域，实际部署中源域与目标域分布不同（如生物医学网络预训练、应用到化学领域），导致性能显著退化，甚至不及直接全量微调。核心挑战有二：(1) 模型兼容性——源域与目标域的元路径类型与数量不一致，现有方法与预定义元路径强耦合，表征难以迁移；(2) 语义与结构分布偏移下的知识迁移困难。因此需要既保持预训练模型对下游异质图兼容、又能显式弥合跨域语义与结构差异的框架。动机实验显示：在 Aminer/Freebase 上预训练、DBLP 上微调时，HeCo 与 HetGPT 相对同域设置出现明显性能下降。
AI.method: 整体含四个组件。(1) 自监督预训练：基于元路径采样构造邻接矩阵，用 SVD 对齐跨域特征维度，采用 HAN 作为编码器/解码器；设计掩码特征重建与掩码边重建两个生成式任务（Bernoulli 掩码、余弦型缩放损失 γ1/γ2），每个元路径视图分别计算损失后通过注意力权重加权聚合，总损失 L_pre = L_feat + λ_edge·L_edge。(2) 结构条件专家池：冻结预训练编码器，按源域元路径划分 L 层、每层 |P| 个 GAT 专家 E_i^l，任意目标域元路径均可复用该专家池，从而摆脱元路径绑定。(3) 结构感知专家路由与负载均衡：为每个目标域元路径视图采样正样本对（边相连）与负样本对（不相连），用专家表示相似度计算正/负得分，经温度 τ 的 sigmoid 得到专家得分 r_i^l；维护跨 epoch 累积的专家负载计数器 m_i，归一化相对负载 m̃_i 后以 γ_i = exp(−λ_balance·m̃_i) 惩罚过载专家，再 softmax 归一化得路由权重 α_i^l 并加权聚合专家表示，同时更新计数器。(4) 基于提示的语义融合：对每个目标域元路径视图做均值池化得到全局表示 h_j，用可学习提示向量 p_j 计算语义重要性得分 s_j，跨视图归一化得 β_j，加权聚合各视图表示后送入线性分类器。微调阶段仅更新提示向量 {p_j} 与分类器参数，预训练模型完全冻结。
AI.result: 在 ACM 预训练、四个目标数据集的 5-shot 设置下，CHoE 全面优于 11 个基线：ACM 83.27/83.79、DBLP 88.47/89.47、Aminer 53.87/62.16、Freebase 49.75/51.81（Macro/Micro-F1），在 Aminer 与 Freebase 上增益最大（较 HGPrompt 提升约 13 与 9 个百分点）；DBLP 上因结构稠密、基线可捕获足够结构信息而差距较小。1-shot 与 3-shot 实验结论一致。全部 4×4 上游-下游组合实验显示 CHoE 在大多数设置下最优且更稳定，而 HGPrompt 在部分上游域更高但跨域迁移时波动明显。消融实验显示去掉专家路由（w/o ER）下降最大，去掉提示模块与负载平衡亦均有下降；对 λ_balance 与 τ 不敏感；层数 L=2 最佳，1 层容量不足、3 层因过平滑而退化。
AI.conclusion: 论文指出现有 HGPL 方法存在隐含的同域假设，提出 CHoE——一个基于结构条件专家的跨域 HGPL 方法，通过迁移预训练专家池、结构感知路由与负载均衡机制缓解跨域结构差异，并以基于提示的语义融合模块实现跨域语义适配。实验验证了其在跨域与同域场景下的有效性与稳健性，为异质图基础模型提供了新的跨域迁移思路。局限方面可延伸：专家池随元路径数量增长带来的存储开销、跨域 SVD 特征对齐的信息损失、以及在更大规模真实异质图上的验证仍有空间。

title: From Layers to Networks: Comparing Neural Representations via Diffusion Geometry
summary: Diffusion geometry is a manifold learning framework that uses random walks defined by Markov transition matrices to characterize the geometry of a dataset at multiple scales. We use diffusion geometry for neural representations, incorporating tools from multi-view learning into this field for the first time. Our key technical observation is that a broad class of similarity measures based on representational similarity matrices (RSMs) admits a closed-form equivalent formulation in terms of row-stochastic Markov matrices, opening the door to manipulations from diffusion geometry.
